decision_desc.arg_manage_ballot_boxes: The provincial machines see to the next local elections. The coalition stays in charge and the barracks see it.
decision_desc.arg_plata_union_appeal: Ask the river's republics again to join the United Provinces.
decision_desc.arg_ypf_drilling: Send more rigs to Patagonia for a season.
decision_desc.aus_dec_austerity: Ration clothes, tea, sugar and petrol, and put the savings into war production.
decision_desc.aus_dec_call_up_militia: Put the militia battalions into full-time camp for a year.
decision_desc.aus_dec_empire_1: Put Australian cruisers at the Admiralty's disposal in the sea lanes of the Empire.
decision_desc.aus_dec_empire_2: Send the AIF to fight in the Empire's decisive theatre.
decision_desc.aus_dec_empire_3: Make Australia the Empire's workshop and depot east of Suez.
decision_desc.aus_dec_pacific_1: Spend the defence vote on airfields and forts in the north instead of on Singapore.
decision_desc.aus_dec_pacific_2: Invite American aircraft and advisers to Australian bases.
decision_desc.aus_dec_pacific_3: Offer Melbourne and Brisbane as the seat of the Allied command in the Pacific.
decision_desc.aus_dec_tasman_union: Send the offer of a single Commonwealth of Australasia across the Tasman.
decision_desc.aus_dec_vdc: Enrol the veterans of the last war to guard bridges, beaches and airfields.
decision_desc.aus_dec_wool_purchase: Agree to sell the whole wool clip to Britain at a fixed price for the duration.
decision_desc.bel_dec_ask_london: Ask Britain to promise publicly that it will defend Belgium.
decision_desc.bel_dec_ask_paris: Ask France to promise publicly that it will defend Belgium.
decision_desc.bel_dec_ban_militias: The gendarmerie raids the uniformed squads of the extreme parties.
decision_desc.bel_dec_call_the_allies: Open the frontier to the French and British armies before the enemy strikes, and give up neutrality.
decision_desc.bel_dec_congo_levies: The colony raises more soldiers and labourers for the war.
decision_desc.bel_dec_fn_exports: Rifles from the army's stocks are sold to foreign buyers.
decision_desc.bel_dec_language_concession: A new language law or a Dutch-speaking institution answers Flemish demands.
decision_desc.bel_dec_strengthen_liege: More concrete, more turrets and more garrison for the forts facing Germany.
decision_desc.bel_dec_union_lux: Offer the Grand Duchy a union under one government.
decision_desc.bel_dec_union_nld: Offer The Hague a union of the Low Countries under one government.
decision_desc.bel_dec_unitary_line: The government refuses further language demands in the name of the unity of the state.
decision_desc.bel_dec_uranium_to_america: Offer the Katanga uranium stock to the United States.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_ban_legion_rallies: The police break up the Legions' marches and close their halls.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_claim_macedonia: Prepare a war goal on the holder of Vardar Macedonia.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_claim_thrace: Prepare a war goal on the holder of Western Thrace and the Aegean coast.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_federation_offer: Invite people's Yugoslavia to unite with Bulgaria in one federation.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_german_arms_credit: Rifles, guns and anti-tank guns on credit, paid for with future crops.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_labour_conscripts: The labour battalions are drilled as soldiers in all but name.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_macedonian_bands: Armed bands cross the border to remind Macedonia's holder that the question is open.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_seek_award: Ask this great power to back Bulgaria's claims on its lost lands.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_tobacco_for_currency: This year's tobacco is sold in the West for pounds and francs.
decision_desc.bgr_dec_tobacco_to_germany: This year's tobacco goes to Germany on clearing accounts.
decision_desc.bgr_demand_dobruja: Ask Romania to return Southern Dobruja, lost to it in 1913.
decision_desc.bra_burn_coffee_stocks: The state buys the surplus and burns it. The planters are calm for another year.
decision_desc.bra_buy_krupp_guns: Another batch of field guns and anti-aircraft guns from Essen.
decision_desc.bra_coffee_deal_usa: A year's coffee sold to the United States at an agreed price.
decision_desc.bra_compensation_deal_deu: Coffee and cotton for guns and machines, paid in compensation marks for a year.
decision_desc.bra_court_the_green_shirts: Posts and favours for Integralist leaders buy calm, and make the movement stronger.
decision_desc.bra_fortify_the_bulge: Coastal guns at Natal and Recife and a new airfield on the bulge facing Africa.
decision_desc.bra_lend_lease_request: Rifles and aircraft from American stocks, in return for bases and raw materials.
decision_desc.bra_play_both_sides: With both deals running, each buyer pays more to keep Brazil from the other, though neither likes it.
decision_desc.bra_rubber_soldiers: Northeastern migrants are sent to tap the wild rubber of the Amazon.
decision_desc.bra_rule_by_decree: The president governs by decree for a season: order is kept and the green shirts lose ground.
decision_desc.can_bill_80: Repeal the clause that kept conscripts at home. Overseas conscription becomes legal, though not yet ordered.
decision_desc.can_billion_dollar_gift: Britain has run out of dollars. Give it the war material outright, rather than lend it what it can never repay.
decision_desc.can_halifax_convoys: Gather the merchant ships in Bedford Basin and see another convoy out under Canadian escort.
decision_desc.can_keep_volunteers: No conscription for overseas service, now or later. The army will be what volunteers make it.
decision_desc.can_nrma_act: Call up men for the defence of Canada only, as the pledge allows. More soldiers, at a price in goodwill.
decision_desc.can_overseas_draft: An order-in-council sends the home-defence conscripts to the front. The infantry gets its men, and Quebec its grievance.
decision_desc.can_plebiscite: Ask the whole country to release the government from its promise. English Canada will say yes; Quebec will not forget.
decision_desc.can_price_ceiling: Freeze every retail price and wage at its current level, and give the Wartime Prices and Trade Board the power to enforce it.
decision_desc.can_tanks_for_russia: Ship a year's run of Canadian-built tanks to the Soviet Union by the northern convoys.
decision_desc.can_uranium_contract: Eldorado's ore is wanted by the Americans and the British for a secret project. Sell it to them, at a good price and a better favour.
decision_desc.can_victory_bonds: Parades, posters and payroll savings: another drive to sell war bonds to every household.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_base_central_china: Between the Yangtze and the Huai, the New Fourth Army can build a base of its own among the rich villages of the delta.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_base_jin_cha_ji: Send cadres and a regiment into the mountains and plains between Shanxi and Beijing to build a government behind the occupier's lines.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_base_shandong: Shandong's hills and coast are full of armed bands without a master. Gather them into a base of the party.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_base_taihang: The ridges of the Taihang hide a division and its arsenals. Build a base where Shanxi, Hebei, Shandong and Henan meet.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_harvest_drive: Offices close for the harvest weeks and everyone goes to the fields.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_kwantung_arsenals: The depots of the Kwantung Army stand unguarded or in Soviet hands. Take the rifles, the guns, the tanks and the aircraft before anyone else does.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_militia_drive: Village meetings, songs and a quota for every county: the self-defence corps fills the army's ranks.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_recruit_the_northeast: Former soldiers of Manchukuo, miners and landless peasants of the Northeast join the army in their tens of thousands.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_rouse_the_bases: Rent cuts, winter schools and the militia's call in every base at once. Men and anger flow to the front.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_run_the_blockade: Bribe the posts, open smugglers' roads and trade through the warlords' lands until the blockade leaks like a sieve.
decision_desc.ccp_dec_study_sessions: Every office and unit studies the same documents for a month and discusses them. Doubts are spoken and answered.
decision_desc.ccp_new_base_area: Send work teams into Japanese-occupied areas to found a new base and raise local resistance.
decision_desc.chn_central_officers: Officers trained by the central government take over provincial units. The balance moves 8 toward the centre.
decision_desc.chn_dec_amnesty_red_soldiers: Land and a pardon for every Red soldier who comes over with his rifle.
decision_desc.chn_dec_blockade_border_region: Ring the Communist base with garrisons that let no salt, cloth or medicine through.
decision_desc.chn_dec_front_conference: Sit down with the Communist delegates in the wartime capital and settle areas, supplies and orders, for now.
decision_desc.chn_dec_new_life_rally: Parades, lantern processions and speeches on propriety and sacrifice in every provincial capital.
decision_desc.chn_dec_print_money: The war costs more than the taxes bring in. The banks will print the rest.
decision_desc.chn_dec_provincial_armies: Sichuan, Guangxi and Yunnan troops march to the front, under their own officers and their own flags.
decision_desc.chn_dec_soviet_credit: Aircraft and tanks on credit, repaid in tea, wool and tungsten.
decision_desc.chn_dec_tungsten_to_america: Sell the ore against an American loan and buy lorries and rifles with it.
decision_desc.chn_dec_tungsten_to_germany: Another shipload of ore through Hong Kong; another shipment of guns from Hamburg.
decision_desc.chn_integrate_warlord: Ask a clique marked for integration to hand its army and administration to the centre. Possible only with good relations or at war.
decision_desc.chn_regional_appeasement: Titles and subsidies keep the provincial commanders quiet. The balance moves 8 toward the regions, stability +3%.
decision_desc.chn_request_soviet_aid: Ask the Soviet Union for lend-lease, after first winning Moscow's goodwill.
decision_desc.csk_ask_britain: Ask London to stand behind France's promise.
decision_desc.csk_ask_france: Send the envoy to the French foreign ministry to ask for a plain promise.
decision_desc.csk_ask_moscow: Ask the Soviet Union for help that does not wait on Paris.
decision_desc.csk_danube_union_aut: Propose that Austria join the Danubian federation.
decision_desc.csk_danube_union_hun: Propose that Hungary join the Danubian federation.
decision_desc.csk_forts_complete: Close the last gaps and arm the casemates. The border becomes a fortress.
decision_desc.csk_forts_heavy: Blockhouses and artillery forts on the crests of the border mountains.
decision_desc.csk_forts_light: Pour concrete for the light pillboxes along the German border.
decision_desc.csk_general_mobilisation: Call up every reservist and send the army to the border.
decision_desc.csk_move_industry_east: Dismantle machine tools in Bohemia and set them up again in central Slovakia.
decision_desc.csk_skoda_sale_abroad: Zbrojovka Brno ships rifles to buyers in Asia and South America.
decision_desc.csk_skoda_sale_rou: Romania wants Škoda's light tanks. Sell from our own stock.
decision_desc.csk_skoda_sale_yug: Belgrade wants Škoda howitzers for its divisions.
decision_desc.deu_demand_austria: Order Vienna to hand power to the Austrian National Socialists and accept union with the Reich.
decision_desc.deu_demand_bohemia: Summon the Czech president to Berlin and demand that his state place itself under German protection.
decision_desc.deu_demand_danzig: Demand the Free City of Danzig and a German road and railway across the Polish corridor.
decision_desc.deu_demand_memel: Demand that Lithuania return the Memel Territory to the Reich, by force if need be.
decision_desc.deu_demand_sudeten: Claim the German-speaking border districts of Czechoslovakia and force the great powers to settle the question.
decision_desc.deu_invite_balkans: Invite a Balkan state to join the Tripartite Pact and stand with the Axis.
decision_desc.deu_sign_tripartite: Bind Germany, Italy and Japan to aid one another against any power that enters the war against them.
decision_desc.deu_soviet_pact_proposal: Send the foreign minister to Moscow to offer a non-aggression pact and a secret division of eastern Europe.
decision_desc.esn_argentine_wheat: Buy grain from Argentina on long credit; the bread ration grows.
decision_desc.esn_army_arbitrates: The head of state, as a soldier, trims whichever faction has grown too strong.
decision_desc.esn_call_up_requetes: The Carlist battalions of Navarre answer once more, and expect to be remembered for it.
decision_desc.esn_favour_falange: Give the party's men the governorships and the syndicates.
decision_desc.esn_favour_traditionalists: Give the Carlists and the Church's men the ministries and the town halls.
decision_desc.esn_hunt_the_maquis: Sweep the sierras with the Civil Guard and army columns.
decision_desc.esn_moroccan_recruits: Raise new tabors of Moroccan infantry for Spanish service.
decision_desc.esn_social_aid: Soup kitchens and orphanages run by the party: charity, propaganda and a hold on the poor.
decision_desc.esn_wolfram_to_allies: Sell tungsten to the British and Americans and take payment in fuel.
decision_desc.esn_wolfram_to_germany: Ship tungsten to Germany in exchange for rifles and machine guns.
decision_desc.esr_buy_through_paris: Spend the gold in Paris on whatever the dealers can deliver past the embargo.
decision_desc.esr_children_abroad: Evacuate children from the bombed cities to friendly countries until the war is over.
decision_desc.esr_dig_in: Fortify the sectors where the enemy is likely to strike next.
decision_desc.esr_favour_cnt: Let the anarchist union keep its collectives and its columns.
decision_desc.esr_favour_pce: Give the party's men the commands and the posts they ask for.
decision_desc.esr_mercury_contracts: Sell the mercury of Almadén abroad for rifles and fuel.
decision_desc.esr_order_from_moscow: Pay from the gold in Moscow for another shipment of tanks, aircraft and guns.
decision_desc.esr_president_mediates: The head of state and the socialists bring whichever side leads back toward the middle.
decision_desc.esr_youngest_levy: Call up the youngest class, boys of seventeen. The front needs men.
decision_desc.fin_dec_buy_arms_abroad: Spend scarce currency on guns from whoever will sell them.
decision_desc.fin_dec_call_civil_guards: The guard companies report to their mobilisation stations.
decision_desc.fin_dec_estonian_union: Offer Tallinn one state on both shores of the gulf.
decision_desc.fin_dec_guard_exercises: A summer of field exercises for the parish companies.
decision_desc.fin_dec_line_1: Dig trenches and log bunkers across the Karelian Isthmus.
decision_desc.fin_dec_line_2: Pour concrete bunkers at the main road junctions.
decision_desc.fin_dec_line_3: Close the gaps between the bunkers with tank obstacles and wire.
decision_desc.fin_dec_nickel_concession: Decide who may buy the nickel of Petsamo.
decision_desc.fin_dec_proclaim_union: Estonia has agreed: one state, one army, one coast.
decision_desc.fin_dec_resettle_karelians: Give the evacuees land from the state and the church and from large estates.
decision_desc.fin_dec_swedish_volunteers: Call on the volunteer corps the Swedish officers promised.
decision_desc.fra_dissolve_vichy: With Paris in French hands again, the Provisional Government declares the acts of the Vichy regime void and takes over the territories it still holds.
decision_desc.fra_rearmament_act: A large rearmament programme rallies the centre and the right. The balance moves 15 to the right.
decision_desc.fra_social_reform: Paid holidays and the forty-hour week widen the Popular Front's support. The balance moves 10 to the left.
decision_desc.gbr_destroyers_for_bases: Offer the United States long leases on Atlantic bases in return for fifty old destroyers.
decision_desc.gbr_free_french_recognition: Recognise the French leaders who fight on from London as the voice of France at war.
decision_desc.gbr_guarantee_poland: Pledge to defend Poland if its independence is threatened, and ask France to join.
decision_desc.gbr_guarantee_romania_greece: Extend the same pledge of defence to Romania and Greece to hold the eastern Mediterranean.
decision_desc.gbr_levant_intervention: Prepare an advance from Palestine into Vichy-held Syria and Lebanon.
decision_desc.gbr_occupy_iceland: With Denmark in German hands, land troops in Iceland before Germany can use it against the Atlantic routes.
decision_desc.gen_annex_subject: Over 180 days, merge a fully integrated puppet and its army into our own state.
decision_desc.gen_coup_com: For 90 days, arms and money go to communists abroad; if they reach half the country's support, its government falls.
decision_desc.gen_coup_dem: For 90 days, arms and money go to democrats abroad; if they reach half the country's support, its government falls.
decision_desc.gen_coup_fas: For 90 days, arms and money go to fascists abroad; if they reach half the country's support, its government falls.
decision_desc.gen_coup_neu: For 90 days, arms and money go to non-aligned factions abroad; if they reach half the country's support, its government falls.
decision_desc.gen_demand_autonomy: Push our overlord for a larger say in our own affairs: autonomy +10%.
decision_desc.gen_downgrade_subject: Bring a subject with no autonomy left one step closer under our rule.
decision_desc.gen_emergency_draft: Wider age limits and fewer deferments put more men into uniform at once.
decision_desc.gen_exile_recruit: Enlist our citizens who escaped abroad and those in allied hands: manpower from 1% of the core population our side holds.
decision_desc.gen_exile_resistance: Send money, radios and organisers into our occupied homeland: resistance there grows faster for 90 days.
decision_desc.gen_expand_staff_college: More officers pass through the staff course. Division experience gain +10% for 180 days.
decision_desc.gen_fortify_border: Positions and obstacles go up quickly along the border with the most threatening neighbour.
decision_desc.gen_hire_general: An able colonel is promoted to general and given an army to lead.
decision_desc.gen_industrial_subsidy: Grants to builders and manufacturers speed up work on civilian factories.
decision_desc.gen_invite_neighbours: Invite a non-aligned neighbour without a faction into the entente we lead.
decision_desc.gen_join_allies: Ask the leader of the Allies to accept us as a member.
decision_desc.gen_join_axis: Ask the leader of the Axis to accept us as a member.
decision_desc.gen_join_comintern: Ask the leader of the Comintern to accept us as a member.
decision_desc.gen_martial_law: The army takes over policing and bans gatherings; order returns, but the factories slow down.
decision_desc.gen_partisan_support: Supply the partisans behind enemy lines in our occupied lands: resistance there rises for 90 days.
decision_desc.gen_party_support_com: Money and leaflets for another country's communists widen their support for 180 days.
decision_desc.gen_party_support_dem: Money and newspapers for another country's democratic parties widen their support for 180 days.
decision_desc.gen_party_support_fas: Money and leaflets for another country's fascists widen their support for 180 days.
decision_desc.gen_party_support_neu: Money and newspapers for another country's non-aligned factions widen their support for 180 days.
decision_desc.gen_rally: Rallies across the country win new supporters for the ruling party for 90 days.
decision_desc.gen_release_subject: End our protection over a subject; it stays in our faction.
decision_desc.gen_request_autonomy: Our autonomy has reached its limit: ask the overlord to raise our status, or to let us go if we are already a dominion.
decision_desc.gen_restore_country: Where we have freed the core lands of a country that no longer exists, recreate its state and invite it to our faction.
decision_desc.gen_science_mobilisation: Scientists and engineers are drafted into war research: one more research slot, for good.
decision_desc.gen_suppress_opposition: The largest opposition's papers and meetings are restricted; its support falls, but resentment grows.
decision_desc.gen_suspend_elections: General elections wait until the war is over, and the sitting parliament carries on.
decision_desc.gen_tech_exchange: Engineers sent to our faction's leader bring home a technology we still lack.
decision_desc.gen_tighten_control: For 90 days, officials and advisers sent to a subject hold back its autonomy.
decision_desc.gen_war_bonds: Selling bonds to the public raises money for the war and ties citizens to its outcome.
decision_desc.grc_arms_exports: Greek cartridge works sell rifles and ammunition to the Spanish Republic through middlemen.
decision_desc.grc_buy_polish_fighters: Order another batch of fighters from Warsaw.
decision_desc.grc_charter_ships_fra: Charter Greek tramps to French ports for a year.
decision_desc.grc_charter_ships_gbr: Charter part of the merchant fleet to British shippers for a year. London gains hulls, we gain sterling and goodwill.
decision_desc.grc_fleet_sails_abroad: The mainland is lost. The merchant fleet sails to Allied ports and serves under their orders.
decision_desc.grc_island_exile: Send the latest arrests to the barren islands of the Aegean. The opposition loses its organisers for a while.
decision_desc.grc_mobilise_reserves: Call up another class of reservists.
decision_desc.grc_purge_the_officers: Retire the Venizelist officers still on the lists. The regime is safer, the army poorer in experience.
decision_desc.grc_tobacco_clearing: Sell a year's tobacco to Germany on the clearing account. Berlin is pleased, London less so.
decision_desc.grc_venizelist_amnesty: Pardon the officers and politicians of the failed revolts and let some return.
decision_desc.hun_levente_call_up: Call the Levente youth to service as auxiliaries and reserves.
decision_desc.hun_propose_danube_aut: Propose that Austria join Hungary in a Danubian federation.
decision_desc.hun_propose_danube_csk: Propose that Czechoslovakia join Hungary in a Danubian federation.
decision_desc.hun_request_arbitration: Ask Germany and Italy to arbitrate Hungary's claim to southern Slovakia.
decision_desc.hun_request_transylvania: Ask Berlin to settle Hungary's claim to northern Transylvania by arbitration.
decision_desc.hun_rev_ask_berlin: Ask Germany to stand behind Hungary's claims.
decision_desc.hun_rev_ask_rome: Ask Italy to stand behind Hungary's claims.
decision_desc.hun_rev_claim_ruthenia: With a great power's backing, lay claim to Carpathian Ruthenia.
decision_desc.hun_rev_claim_transylvania: With a great power's backing, lay claim to northern Transylvania.
decision_desc.hun_rev_propaganda: Rallies, maps on every school wall and 'No, no, never!' on everyone's lips: keep the lost lands in the people's mind.
decision_desc.hun_secret_armistice_talks: Send emissaries to Istanbul and Lisbon to sound out the Western Allies. Berlin has ears there too.
decision_desc.hun_sell_bauxite: Sell a year's bauxite to Germany for credits and goods.
decision_desc.imjin_command_righteous: Send the court's orders to the leaders of the righteous armies. Whether they obey depends on the court's standing.
decision_desc.imjin_envoy_ming: Send an envoy to Beijing to tell the emperor what Japan intends and to ask for help.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_cheongya: Carry the grain and the people of the counties into the mountain fortresses and leave the enemy nothing to eat. The work of the fields stops while it lasts.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_hullyeon: Ming's officers are drilling our men in the southern way. Raise a standing corps of gunners, archers and blades trained by the new manual.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_archers: Hold archery drills in every county, and give the best archers posts on the walls.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_beacons: Put the beacon towers along the coast and the roads back in order, so that word of the enemy reaches the capital in time.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_blank_titles: Sell letters of office with the name left blank to anyone who gives grain or silver.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_fortresses: Repair the old hill forts at Suwon, Haengju and Gongju, where the people can shelter and hold out.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_grain: Carry grain into the walled towns and hill forts before the enemy can reach the fields.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_guns: Cast cannon for the walls and the army.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_hullyeon: Set up a standing army of gunners, archers and spearmen, drilled after the Ming general Qi Jiguang's manual.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_jochong: Have the smiths take apart the Japanese arquebuses we have taken and make our own.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_muster_rolls: Many on the rolls exist only on paper, or have paid cloth to stay home. Count the men again and call them up.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_panokseon: Order a squadron of panokseon, the navy's high-decked gun ships, for the southern bases.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_passes: Build palisades and posts at Joryeong, Chupungnyeong, Jungnyeong and Cheolryeong, the passes on the roads north.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_relief: Open relief kitchens on the roads where the refugees gather.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_somogun: Enrol commoners and slaves alike into local companies that drill in the slack season.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_turtle: Yi Sun-sin has drawn up a covered warship with spikes on its roof and guns on every side. Build it at Yeosu.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_prep_walls_south: Rebuild the walls of Dongnae, Miryang, Jinju and Gimhae. The labour falls on the farmers, who will complain.
decision_desc.imjin_jos_restore_jingwan: The levies waited at their muster points for a general from the capital, and the enemy came first. Give each district back its own commander and its own men.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_build_sekibune: Have the coastal domains build sekibune and transports for the crossing.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_demands_so: Have the Sō house of Tsushima carry the Taikō's demands to the Joseon court.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_grant_fiefs: Reward the great lords to keep them loyal.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_hostages: Have every great lord keep his wife and heir at Osaka while his men are abroad.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_korea_roads: Have the Sō house's traders draw the roads, passes and river crossings from Busan to the Joseon capital.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_kuki_ships: Have Kuki Yoshitaka and the coastal lords build more transports for the crossing.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_kunitomo_guns: Order arquebuses and cannon from the gunsmiths of Kunitomo and Sakai.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_muster_daimyo: Order every great lord to raise his quota of men for the crossing.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_nagoya_castle: Raise a great castle on the Hizen coast as the base of the war.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_relay_castles: Build castles on Iki and Tsushima where the convoys can rest, take on water and wait out bad weather, and hire Tsushima's pilots.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_rice_stores: Fill storehouses at Nagoya, on Iki and on Tsushima with rice for the army across the sea.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_second_levy: Call up more men from the home domains to fill the corps in Joseon.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_village_notices: Post notices that farmers who go back to their fields will be left in peace and taxed lightly.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_volley_drill: Drill the arquebusiers to fire by ranks, one rank loading while another fires.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_wajo: Build Japanese-style castles on the headlands of Joseon's south coast to guard the landing places.
decision_desc.imjin_jp_winter_clothes: Send padded clothes, straw boots and blankets across the sea before the cold comes.
decision_desc.imjin_jpn_waeseong: Hold the southern coast with stone castles on the hills above the harbours, each with its own grain and its guns over the anchorage.
decision_desc.imjin_muster_righteous: Bring the righteous armies into the regular army. They stop raiding behind the enemy's lines.
decision_desc.ita_send_ctv: Four divisions of the Corpo Truppe Volontarie sail for Spain to fight beside Franco's Nationalists.
decision_desc.jpn_army_budget: The army's share of the budget grows. The balance moves 10 toward the army.
decision_desc.jpn_demand_indochina_access: Demand that the authorities of French Indochina let Japanese troops in — first the north, then the south.
decision_desc.jpn_navy_budget: The navy's share of the budget grows. The balance moves 10 toward the navy.
decision_desc.lat_join_hemisphere: Ask to join the alliance the United States leads, or the Allies if Washington leads none.
decision_desc.mck_dec_collective_hamlets: Move the hill villages into walled hamlets and burn what is left, so that the partisans starve.
decision_desc.mck_dec_concordia_rally: Fill the squares with the Association's members and banners.
decision_desc.mck_dec_grain_quota: Ship the year's quota of grain to Japan and the Kwantung Army.
decision_desc.mck_dec_loosen_grip_1: With enough room of our own, the Kwantung Army's direct orders can give way to advice.
decision_desc.mck_dec_loosen_grip_2: The ministries take their own decisions and the advisers learn to wait for them.
decision_desc.mck_dec_native_officials: Fill a department with Manchukuo's own officials in place of seconded Japanese.
decision_desc.mck_dec_qing_heartland: Lay claim to Beijing and the plain of Hebei in the dynasty's name.
decision_desc.mck_dec_sell_soybeans: Sell the soybean harvest to Germany under the trade agreement, for marks and machinery.
decision_desc.mck_dec_shale_oil: Build another battery of retorts at Fushun to wring oil from the shale.
decision_desc.mck_dec_xingan_levy: Call another cavalry division from the Mongol banners of Xing'an.
decision_desc.mex_arm_the_ejidos: Distribute rifles to the rural defence corps of the ejidos.
decision_desc.mex_barter_oil_deu: Trade crude to Germany for machinery and manufactured goods, no dollars needed.
decision_desc.mex_barter_oil_ita: Italy pays in tankers and rayon for Mexican crude.
decision_desc.mex_barter_oil_jpn: Japanese buyers pay well for oil from the Pacific coast, and Washington watches.
decision_desc.mex_claim_belize: Press Mexico's reservation on British Honduras as a war goal.
decision_desc.mex_curb_the_sinarquistas: Ban their marches and arrest their local leaders, at the risk of making martyrs.
decision_desc.mex_ejido_grants: Sign another round of land titles for the villages that have waited longest.
decision_desc.mex_isthmus_union_offer: Invite a Central American republic to join Mexico as a free state.
decision_desc.mex_oil_to_allies: With the claims settled, Mexican oil goes north under contract.
decision_desc.mex_party_discipline: Remove a rebellious governor and a corrupt union boss. The party remembers who decides.
decision_desc.mex_volunteer_squadron: The squadron, trained on American fighters, joins the air war in the Pacific beside American units.
decision_desc.nld_call_up_reserves: Call up the older classes of reservists to fill the line.
decision_desc.nld_drain_the_polders: The danger has passed. Pump the water out and give the land back to the farmers, keeping the sluices ready.
decision_desc.nld_freeze_japanese_assets: Follow America: freeze Japan's money in the Indies and end the oil trade with Tokyo for good.
decision_desc.nld_inundate_water_line: Open the sluices: the polders before the line go under knee-deep water, too deep to march and too shallow for boats. Farms and goods are lost while it lasts.
decision_desc.nld_oil_contract_allies: Sell a year's oil from the Indies to Britain and America, and win their goodwill.
decision_desc.nld_oil_contract_japan: Sell a year's oil from the Indies to Japan. Tokyo pays well and is pleased; Washington is not.
decision_desc.nld_prepare_inundations: Check the sluices, the dikes and the pumping stations so that the polders can be flooded at short notice.
decision_desc.nld_propose_union: Ask Belgium or Luxembourg to join the Netherlands in one state.
decision_desc.nld_reinforce_knil: Send men and money to the East Indies Army and strengthen the island defences.
decision_desc.nld_sail_for_the_allies: Put the merchant fleet that is at sea under Allied orders and pay the government in exile from its earnings.
decision_desc.nor_call_up_the_watch: Reservists to the coast forts and the frontier for a year, while the great powers fight nearby.
decision_desc.nor_charter_to_britain: A year's charter of Norwegian ships to the British trade. London is pleased; Berlin takes note.
decision_desc.nor_charter_to_germany: A year's charter of Norwegian ships to German trade, paid in coal and machinery. London takes note.
decision_desc.nor_general_mobilisation: Every reservist is called to the colours, however late.
decision_desc.nor_propose_union: Offer one of the old union partners a joint realm under the Norwegian crown.
decision_desc.nor_requisition_fleet: Every Norwegian ship outside enemy waters comes under the government's shipping mission.
decision_desc.nor_sell_heavy_water_east: A year's output of Vemork goes to the German chemical trust.
decision_desc.nor_sell_heavy_water_west: A year's output of Vemork goes to French and British laboratories.
decision_desc.nor_whaling_expedition: The factory ships sail for the Antarctic for a season.
decision_desc.pol_dec_air_defence_loan: A public loan buys anti-aircraft guns; citizens subscribe at the post office.
decision_desc.pol_dec_arms_exports: The state export company sells rifles from the arsenals to whoever pays.
decision_desc.pol_dec_bereza_camp: Send the regime's opponents from both ends to the camp at Bereza Kartuska without trial.
decision_desc.pol_dec_bridgehead_retreat: Pull the army back to the southeast and hold there.
decision_desc.pol_dec_cop_investment: Another works for the Central Industrial District.
decision_desc.pol_dec_evacuate_gold: Send the Bank of Poland's gold out of the country before the front reaches it.
decision_desc.pol_dec_navy_collection: The Maritime League's collectors go from door to door for the fleet.
decision_desc.pol_dec_open_to_opposition: Bring opposition figures into commissions and loosen the press rules.
decision_desc.pol_dec_reinforce_border_corps: More watchtowers and bunkers along the eastern frontier.
decision_desc.pol_dec_tighten_camp: Purge the doubters and fill the offices with the camp's people.
decision_desc.pol_order_uprising: Order the underground army to rise in the capital while the occupier's hold is weak.
decision_desc.pol_zaolzie_ultimatum: Demand the Teschen district of Silesia from Czechoslovakia while Prague is at its weakest.
decision_desc.prt_azores_lease_gbr: Lease bases in the Azores to the old ally, in return for fighters and goodwill.
decision_desc.prt_azores_lease_usa: Let the Americans build their own airfield in the Azores.
decision_desc.prt_colonial_garrison: Send an expeditionary column to Angola.
decision_desc.prt_fortify_azores: More guns and works on the Azores and Madeira.
decision_desc.prt_legion_mobilisation: Call the Portuguese Legion to guard bridges, ports and railways.
decision_desc.prt_propose_union: Offer Spain one state for the whole peninsula.
decision_desc.prt_refugee_transit: Let the refugees pass through Lisbon to the Americas, and listen to what they know.
decision_desc.prt_viriatos: Volunteers, called Viriatos after the Lusitanian hero, go to fight for the Nationalists.
decision_desc.prt_wolfram_embargo: No more wolfram for Germany, whatever it pays.
decision_desc.prt_wolfram_sale_allies: A year's wolfram for British oil, wheat and sterling. London is pleased; Berlin is not.
decision_desc.prt_wolfram_sale_deu: A year's wolfram for German coal, steel and gold. Berlin is pleased; London is not.
decision_desc.rou_buy_czech_arms: Another order of rifles and guns from Škoda and Zbrojovka, paid partly in oil and grain.
decision_desc.rou_fortify_ploiesti: More anti-aircraft guns and field works around the refineries.
decision_desc.rou_legion_concession: Lift a ban, free a few prisoners and buy calm in the streets for a while.
decision_desc.rou_oil_contract_deu: A year's deliveries to Germany: fuel for Berlin, political power and goodwill for us, a cooler London and Moscow.
decision_desc.rou_oil_contract_fra: A year's deliveries to France: fuel for Paris, political power and goodwill for us, a cooler Berlin.
decision_desc.rou_oil_contract_gbr: A year's deliveries to Britain: fuel for London, political power and goodwill for us, a cooler Berlin.
decision_desc.rou_oil_contract_ita: A year's deliveries to Italy: fuel for Rome, political power and goodwill for us, a cooler London.
decision_desc.rou_oil_embargo_deu: End the German contract and embargo Germany. London and Paris will be grateful; Berlin will not forget.
decision_desc.rou_royal_decree: The king rules by decree for a season: order is kept and the Legion loses ground.
decision_desc.spa_send_eastern_division: Send a volunteer division to fight beside Germany against the Soviet Union, without declaring war.
decision_desc.sun_aid_spain: Ship rifles and guns to the Spanish Republic, paid for with its gold reserves.
decision_desc.sun_baltic_bases: Demand a mutual assistance pact with Soviet garrisons and bases on Baltic soil.
decision_desc.sun_baltic_ultimatum: Demand a new government and the free entry of Soviet troops, ending the state's independence.
decision_desc.sun_demand_bessarabia: Demand that Romania hand over Bessarabia and northern Bukovina within days.
decision_desc.sun_demand_karelia: Demand that Finland move its border away from Leningrad and lease Hanko as a naval base.
decision_desc.sun_offer_finnish_peace: Offer to end the war in return for the Karelian Isthmus, the Ladoga shore and land in the north.
decision_desc.sun_propose_pact: Offer Germany a non-aggression pact before the Western powers can draw us into their war.
decision_desc.swe_arms_to_finland: Ship rifles and anti-aircraft guns from Swedish depots to the Finnish army.
decision_desc.swe_bofors_licences: Sell a batch of guns and the right to build them abroad. Money and friends, for guns we will not have.
decision_desc.swe_ease_readiness: The danger has moved away. Send some classes home to the farms and factories.
decision_desc.swe_full_readiness: War is on our doorstep. Mobilise everything and dig in, whatever it costs the economy.
decision_desc.swe_ore_contract_deu: A year's ore for German coal and coke. Berlin is pleased; London takes note.
decision_desc.swe_ore_contract_gbr: A year's ore shipped west for fuel and goods from the Atlantic. Only possible while the Norwegian coast is free.
decision_desc.swe_ore_embargo: Germany has attacked a Nordic neighbour or Sweden itself. Stop every tonne of ore and let Berlin feel it.
decision_desc.swe_propose_union: Ask a Nordic neighbour to join the union. It may refuse.
decision_desc.swe_raise_readiness: The great powers are at war. Call up more classes and man the borders.
decision_desc.swe_train_police_troops: Arm the Norwegian refugees in Swedish camps as 'police troops', ready to go home with their government.
decision_desc.swe_volunteer_corps: Thousands of Swedes volunteer for Finland. Form them into a corps with its own aircraft and send it to the front.
decision_desc.tur_call_up_reserves: Call the reserve classes back to the colours.
decision_desc.tur_close_the_straits: Under Montreux the Straits may be shut to the warships of belligerents.
decision_desc.tur_eastern_pacification: Build roads, schools and gendarme posts in the restless eastern provinces.
decision_desc.tur_fortify_the_dardanelles: More guns and concrete on both shores of the Dardanelles.
decision_desc.tur_hatay_joint_garrison: Ask France to let Turkish troops into the Sanjak until its future is decided.
decision_desc.tur_hatay_question: Press France to let the Sanjak of Alexandretta join Turkey.
decision_desc.tur_levy_straits_dues: Raise the dues for lighthouses, pilots and sanitary control on every ship passing the Bosporus.
decision_desc.tur_reopen_the_straits: Let warships pass again under the convention's peacetime rules.
decision_desc.usa_defense_bill: Congress funds new arms plants at a political price. Two military factories, support of Congress −5 points.
decision_desc.usa_fireside_chat: The President speaks to the nation over the radio. Support of Congress +12 points, war support +3%.
decision_desc.usa_lobby_congress: The administration wins over committee chairs and party whips one by one. Support of Congress +8 points.
decision_desc.usa_oil_embargo: Japanese assets in the United States are frozen and oil exports stop. Japan loses most of its fuel imports.
decision_desc.usa_recognize_exiles: Washington formally recognises the allied governments in exile and receives their envoys, backing their claim to speak for their peoples.
decision_desc.usa_volunteer_air_group: American pilots leave the services and sign on to fly fighters for China, in aircraft bought on American credit.
decision_desc.yug_bauxite_contract: A year of Herzegovinian bauxite for German aluminium works.
decision_desc.yug_bor_to_allies: Keep the copper flowing to France and Britain.
decision_desc.yug_bor_to_germany: Sell a year's copper to Germany, whatever the French owners say.
decision_desc.yug_call_reserves: Call up the older classes of reservists.
decision_desc.yug_claim_albania: Whoever holds Tirana, the northern Albanian highlands belong in our sphere.
decision_desc.yug_court_the_hss: Offer the Croat Peasant Party posts and money to move the balance toward agreement.
decision_desc.yug_federation_offer: Propose a Balkan federation to a communist Bulgaria.
decision_desc.yug_reassure_officers: Promotions and promises for the Serbian officer corps, which fears the state is being given away.
decision_desc.yug_slovene_autonomy: Give the Drava Banovina the powers Croatia received.
decision_desc.zaf_cape_convoy_service: Dockers, ship repairers and the canteens of Cape Town and Durban work round the clock for the troopships.
decision_desc.zaf_chrome_contract: Long contracts for Bushveld chrome with the British and American steelmakers.
decision_desc.zaf_gold_sale_london: A year's output sold in London: sterling for the treasury and goodwill in Whitehall.
decision_desc.zaf_gold_sale_washington: A year's output sold in New York for dollars, the currency every arms maker wants.
decision_desc.zaf_hertzog_compromise: Concessions on the flag, the anthem and the language of the civil service keep the nationalist wing inside the government.
decision_desc.zaf_koffiefontein_internment: Round up the Sentinel's officers and the stormjaers and hold them in the camp until the war is over.
decision_desc.zaf_recruiting_drive: Bands, posters and speeches in every town: the army needs more volunteers for the orange tab.
decision_desc.zaf_smuts_speaking_tour: The general tours the platteland and the English towns alike, arguing that the Union's safety lies with the Commonwealth.
decision_desc.zaf_wool_barter: The year's wool clip goes to Germany in exchange for machinery. The farmers are pleased; London is not.

event_desc.arg_ev_barracks_march: Columns from Campo de Mayo are marching on the capital. The government asks the navy and the police whether they will fight.
event_desc.arg_ev_brazil_arms: Brazil receives American arms and builds steel at Volta Redonda. Our general staff warns that the balance of the south is shifting.
event_desc.arg_ev_chaco_conference: Bolivia and Paraguay have stopped fighting over the Chaco, but the border is still undrawn. They ask Buenos Aires to host the peace talks.
event_desc.arg_ev_colonel_arrested: Rival generals have arrested the colonel of the Secretariat of Labour and sent him to an island. Workers from the suburbs march on the Plaza de Mayo.
event_desc.arg_ev_lodge_discovered: The police bring the minister a list of officers sworn to a secret lodge, with plans for a new government.
event_desc.arg_ev_maize_as_fuel: With no ships to carry it, the maize harvest rots in the ports, while coal from Britain no longer comes.
event_desc.arg_ev_malvinas_note: The anniversary of the islands' loss comes round again, and the press asks what the government will tell London.
event_desc.arg_ev_meat_inquiry: A senator from Santa Fe accuses the British packers of cheating on prices and the government of covering for them. The Senate wants the books opened.
event_desc.arg_ev_ortiz_illness: The president is going blind. He must hand the office to his vice-president or govern from his sickbed.
event_desc.arg_ev_packinghouse_strike: The packinghouse workers of Berisso have walked out, and the cattle wait in the pens. The companies want the police.
event_desc.arg_ev_palomar_scandal: The army paid three times the price for land beside the El Palomar airfield, and deputies have the receipts. Ministers and officers are implicated.
event_desc.arg_ev_peace_prize: Our foreign minister has won the Nobel Peace Prize for the Chaco settlement, the first for Latin America.
event_desc.arg_ev_presidential_election: The coalition's candidate faces the old Radical leader. In the provinces the police already know the result.
event_desc.arg_ev_san_juan_earthquake: An earthquake has destroyed the city of San Juan and killed thousands. The capital organises collections and trains of relief.
event_desc.arg_ev_spy_scandal: The British have taken our envoy off his ship on the way to Europe, with papers about buying German arms. Washington is reading them.
event_desc.arg_ev_union_offer: Argentina offers to join our country to theirs as one of the United Provinces of the River Plate, with our own seat in the new state.
event_desc.arg_ev_university_protests: Students occupy the faculties and demand elections. The rectors side with them.
event_desc.arg_ev_us_pressure: The United States freezes our gold, stops our fuel shipments and calls us the hemisphere's weak link. It demands a break with the Axis.
event_desc.aus_curtin_appeal: With Japan at war in the Pacific, the Prime Minister writes in a Melbourne newspaper that the Pacific war is no sideshow of the war in Europe but a struggle in its own right. Australia, he says, now looks to the United States for its defence, whatever its old ties with Britain. London is displeased; Washington takes note.
event_desc.aus_ev_australia_first_arrests: Security officers round up members of the Australia First Movement, accused of planning to welcome a Japanese invader. Most of the evidence is thin.
event_desc.aus_ev_brisbane_line: A Labor minister claims the previous government meant to abandon the north to the Japanese. The opposition demands proof; the files say little.
event_desc.aus_ev_coal_strike: The miners of the Hunter walk out over conditions in the pits. Without coal the steelworks and the railways will soon follow.
event_desc.aus_ev_convoy_sails: Liners painted grey wait in Sydney Harbour to take the volunteers to the Middle East. Crowds line the foreshore.
event_desc.aus_ev_cowra: Hundreds of Japanese prisoners storm the wire of the camp at Cowra in the night, armed with baseball bats and knives. Most die rather than be taken again.
event_desc.aus_ev_cpa_ban: The party calls this an imperialist war, and the security service wants it outlawed under the National Security Regulations.
event_desc.aus_ev_curtin_government: The two independents vote against the budget. The Governor-General sends for the Labor leader without an election.
event_desc.aus_ev_dalfram: At Port Kembla the waterside workers will not load the Dalfram with pig iron bound for Japan. The Attorney-General threatens the union with the law.
event_desc.aus_ev_darwin_bombed: Carrier aircraft that struck Pearl Harbor now strike Darwin. Ships burn in the harbour and the town empties down the track south.
event_desc.aus_ev_harbour_raid: Japanese midget submarines slip into Sydney Harbour at night and sink a depot ship. The war is no longer far away.
event_desc.aus_ev_look_to_america: The Prime Minister's New Year article in a Melbourne paper says Australia looks to America. Churchill is furious; Washington is less impressed than Canberra hopes.
event_desc.aus_ev_lyons_succession: Joseph Lyons, worn out by office, dies suddenly. The coalition must find a successor, and Earle Page refuses to serve under Menzies.
event_desc.aus_ev_new_guard_rally: Uniformed squads parade through the Sydney suburbs and break up a Labor meeting. The police ask Canberra what to do.
event_desc.aus_ev_sydney_lost: The cruiser that sank the Colleoni has vanished off Western Australia with all hands after a fight with a disguised German raider.
event_desc.aus_ev_tasman_union: Canberra offers New Zealand an equal partnership in a single Commonwealth of Australasia, with its own states and its own seats.
event_desc.aus_ev_trade_diversion: Tokyo answers our quotas with a boycott of Australian wool and wheat. The graziers are furious; London is grateful.
event_desc.aus_ev_westminster: The Attorney-General brings the adoption bill to the House. Lawyers say it changes little; sentiment says it changes a great deal.
event_desc.aut_berlin_ultimatum: Berlin demands that the Chancellor call off his plebiscite on independence and hand power to the Austrian National Socialists, or German troops will cross the border. No foreign government has promised to help Vienna.
event_desc.bal_greek_no: Shortly after three in the morning the Italian minister called on the prime minister with an ultimatum: Italian troops must be allowed to occupy 'strategic points' in Greece, which it does not name. The answer is due within three hours, and the Italian army on the Albanian border is already poised to move.
event_desc.bal_guarantee_request: A neighbour has asked us to guarantee its borders. If we agree, an attack on it will draw us into the war; if we refuse, it will remember.
event_desc.bal_mutual_assistance: Moscow demands a mutual assistance pact that would station Soviet garrisons, air bases and naval bases on our soil. Germany, now bound to the Soviet Union, offers no help, and the Red Army is massing at the border. Refusing means risking war.
event_desc.bal_royal_dictatorship: King Carol II has dismissed the short-lived cabinet and appointed the Patriarch to head a new government. A new constitution that gathers power in the king's hands is to go to a plebiscite within weeks, and the parties are to be curbed. The far right and the old opposition object loudly.
event_desc.bal_salonika_agreement: At Salonika, Bulgaria and the four Balkan Entente states have drafted an agreement. Bulgaria promises not to change its borders by force; in return the arms limits of the Treaty of Neuilly fall away. The questions of Southern Dobruja and Macedonia remain open.
event_desc.bal_soviet_ultimatum: Moscow accuses us of plotting against the Soviet Union and demands a new government and free entry for any number of Soviet troops, with only hours to answer. No power in Europe is in a position to stand with us.
event_desc.bel_ev_amnesty_vote: The amnesty bill divides every party. The francophone veterans' leagues march against it; the Flemish benches will bring down the government if it fails.
event_desc.bel_ev_brussels_by_election: The Rex leader forces a by-election in the capital and stands himself, sure that the city will vote for him. The other parties must decide how to meet him.
event_desc.bel_ev_flemish_grievance: A Flemish soldier is court-martialled in French, a court in Antwerp refuses Dutch papers, a ministry answers a Flemish town in French. The nationalist press fills its front page.
event_desc.bel_ev_force_publique_north: Italy's East African empire borders the Sudan, and the British need every man. The colonial army's officers ask to march north.
event_desc.bel_ev_free_hands: Before the council of ministers the King explains why Belgium must have free hands. The ministers ask whether the speech should be published.
event_desc.bel_ev_gold_reserve: The National Bank's gold must leave before the enemy arrives. Paris offers to keep it; London and New York are further from the front.
event_desc.bel_ev_guarantee_given: The guarantor promises to defend Belgium. The newspapers print the text in full.
event_desc.bel_ev_guarantee_refused: The answer is polite and empty. Belgium will have to rely on its own army and on others' interests.
event_desc.bel_ev_guarantee_request: Brussels asks us to promise, in public, to defend Belgian independence if it is attacked. Belgium will not join any alliance in return.
event_desc.bel_ev_kings_choice: The army is cornered and the ministers urge the King to leave with them and carry on the war from abroad. He answers that his place is with his soldiers.
event_desc.bel_ev_lowlands_news: With the union, the Dutch-speaking share of the state grows. Francophone Brussels wonders where that leaves it; Flemish Antwerp celebrates.
event_desc.bel_ev_march_on_brussels: Rexist columns are on the roads to the capital. The gendarmerie waits at the city limits for orders.
event_desc.bel_ev_mechelen_incident: A German aircraft lost in fog lands in a Belgian field. Its passenger tries to burn his papers: they are the plans for an invasion of the Low Countries.
event_desc.bel_ev_national_bank_affair: Questions are raised about payments the Prime Minister received from the National Bank before he took office. Nothing illegal is proven, but the opposition will not let it rest.
event_desc.bel_ev_rex_breakthrough: The election shakes the old parties: Rex takes a large share of the francophone vote and the Flemish nationalists gain in the north. Communists gain too. The three old parties together still hold a majority, but only together.
event_desc.bel_ev_rex_vnv_quarrel: In power, the two movements discover that a strong Belgium and a free Flanders cannot both be had. Each demands the ministries that matter.
event_desc.bel_ev_shinkolobwe_ore: The director of the Union Minière fears the uranium ore of Katanga will fall to the wrong hands. He proposes to ship a great stock of it quietly to a warehouse in New York.
event_desc.bel_ev_summer_strikes: From the Antwerp docks the strike runs to the mines of Hainaut and the mills of Liège. Hundreds of thousands are out. The unions did not call it and cannot stop it alone.
event_desc.bel_ev_union_offer: Belgium proposes that our two countries become one state, under one government, with our institutions protected. The offer is serious.
event_desc.bel_ev_union_refused: Our neighbour prefers to remain on its own. The talks end politely.
event_desc.bel_ev_walloon_congress: Walloon deputies and writers meet in Liège. They fear that a Flemish majority will run the state, and some speak of federalism or even of France.
event_desc.bgr_ev_award_backed: A great power has promised to support our claims. The committees for the lost lands celebrate and the general staff takes out its maps.
event_desc.bgr_ev_award_request: Bulgaria's envoy asks us to back its claims on its lost lands and to settle them in our favour when the map is redrawn.
event_desc.bgr_ev_border_incident: Armed men from Bulgaria have crossed into Macedonia, burned a gendarmerie post and slipped back over the mountains. Sofia denies everything.
event_desc.bgr_ev_cairo_talks: Our envoy has met the Allies in Cairo. They want Bulgaria out of the war and out of the lands it occupied.
event_desc.bgr_ev_dobruja_regained: Bulgarian troops enter Dobrich and Silistra to flowers and church bells. The land lost in 1913 is home again.
event_desc.bgr_ev_federation_proposal: Sofia proposes that our two people's republics become one federation of the South Slavs, with Macedonia as a member of its own.
event_desc.bgr_ev_german_transit: Berlin asks for the right to march its divisions across Bulgaria toward the south. Refusing means facing those divisions on the Danube.
event_desc.bgr_ev_imro_feud: Two factions of the Macedonian organisation settle an old quarrel with revolvers in a Sofia street. The press asks whether the government controls its own bands.
event_desc.bgr_ev_lukov_shot: The leader of the Legions has been shot dead at his front door by a partisan cell. His followers demand revenge on the left.
event_desc.bgr_ev_macedonia_regained: The army enters Skopje and Ohrid. Bulgarian teachers and priests follow, and the old Exarchate churches ring their bells.
event_desc.bgr_ev_partyless_chamber: The partyless elections have returned a loyal majority, but several dozen opposition deputies have got in as individuals and mean to speak.
event_desc.bgr_ev_peshev_letter: The deputy speaker and forty deputies of the majority protest against plans to deport the kingdom's Jews. The Church and the professions join them.
event_desc.bgr_ev_sobolev_mission: A Soviet envoy arrives in Sofia with an offer of mutual assistance. Leaflets about it appear in the factories, and petitions in its favour pile up at the palace.
event_desc.bgr_ev_sofia_bombed: Enemy bombers have struck the capital. Whole streets burn and tens of thousands flee to the villages.
event_desc.bgr_ev_symbolic_war: Our allies ask Bulgaria to declare war on Britain and its friends. The ministers argue that a war declared on far-away powers costs nothing.
event_desc.bgr_ev_thrace_regained: Bulgarian flags fly over Kavala and Xanthi. For the first time since Neuilly the kingdom touches the Aegean.
event_desc.bgr_ev_tsar_dies: Boris III has died suddenly after returning from a hard meeting abroad. His heir is a child, and the kingdom needs a regency at once.
event_desc.bgr_ev_velchev_trial: The colonel who led the Military League and plotted against the crown stands before a court martial. The judges ask for death; the Tsar must decide on mercy.
event_desc.bgr_fatherland_front: The Soviet Union has declared war on us and its troops are crossing the Danube. In Sofia, the Fatherland Front coalition has taken over the ministries overnight and offers to join the war against Germany.
event_desc.bgr_greek_thrace: Our army has followed the German advance into eastern Macedonia and Western Thrace, and the Greek government has gone into exile. Sofia regards the region, with its outlet to the Aegean, as land lost in 1919 and wants to join it to the kingdom.
event_desc.bra_ev_abc_invitation: Brazil proposes a common alliance of the southern cone, open to us as an equal.
event_desc.bra_ev_aranha_in_washington: The Foreign Minister is received by the President. The Americans offer credits and ask for bases in return.
event_desc.bra_ev_arms_ship_seized: A Brazilian freighter carrying Krupp guns is stopped by the Royal Navy under the blockade of Germany.
event_desc.bra_ev_coffee_glut: The warehouses of Santos are full and the price is falling again. The planters want the state to buy.
event_desc.bra_ev_cohen_plan: The papers print a document that describes a communist rising with names and targets. Congress is asked for a state of war.
event_desc.bra_ev_compensation_offer: Germany offers machines and arms for coffee and cotton, paid in marks that can only be spent in Germany.
event_desc.bra_ev_crown_returns: Bells ring in Petrópolis. The new emperor must choose how to begin his reign.
event_desc.bra_ev_generals_price: With the regime shaken, the generals ask for more money, more men and more say.
event_desc.bra_ev_generals_turn: Brazilian soldiers are fighting for democracy in Europe. At home the generals tell the president his time is up.
event_desc.bra_ev_green_parade: Thousands of green shirts march down the avenues of Rio with drums and banners. The police chief asks for orders.
event_desc.bra_ev_northeast_drought: The rains fail in the sertão again. Families walk to the coast with what they can carry.
event_desc.bra_ev_palace_attack: Green-shirted men attack the president's residence. Vargas and his daughter hold out with pistols until the army arrives.
event_desc.bra_ev_plate_arms_race: Buenos Aires orders cruisers and destroyers abroad. The admirals in Rio want an answer.
event_desc.bra_ev_prestes_trial: Luís Carlos Prestes faces the National Security Tribunal. The sentence will be heard in every union hall.
event_desc.bra_ev_ships_sunk: U-boats sink Brazilian freighters and passenger ships within sight of the coast. Crowds attack German shops.
event_desc.bra_ev_snake_smokes: The first echelon of the expeditionary force boards the transports with the smoking snake on its shoulder patch.
event_desc.bra_ev_three_candidates: José Américo for the government's friends, Armando de Sales Oliveira for São Paulo, Plínio Salgado for the green shirts. The palace must decide whom to favour.
event_desc.bra_ev_washington_trade: The State Department offers a trade agreement and asks Rio to end its barter deals with Germany.
event_desc.bra_feb_departure: An American troop transport waits in the harbour of Rio de Janeiro. The first echelon of the Brazilian Expeditionary Force, some five thousand men, is ready to embark for Naples and the Italian front. It will be the first South American force to fight in Europe.
event_desc.can_alberta_disallowance: The Social Credit government in Edmonton has passed laws to control the banks and pay every citizen a dividend. The banks are a federal matter, and Ottawa holds the old power to disallow provincial acts.
event_desc.can_bcatp_agreement: Britain, Australia and New Zealand will send recruits to train at Canadian schools, and Canada will pay most of the bill. Ottawa wants its own graduates to serve in Canadian squadrons, not as anonymous reinforcements for the RAF.
event_desc.can_bloc_populaire: Young nationalists who led the no campaign found a party of their own to fight conscription in Ottawa and Quebec City alike.
event_desc.can_ccf_breakthrough: Midway through the war a poll puts the social democrats ahead of both old parties. Business is alarmed; the Liberals take notes.
event_desc.can_conscription_crisis: Heavy losses in Europe have left the infantry short of trained replacements, and too few home-defence conscripts volunteer to serve abroad. The cabinet is split, and its members from Quebec warn that sending conscripts overseas will divide the country. The Prime Minister must decide.
event_desc.can_dieppe_raid: The army has trained in England for years without a battle, and the public asks why. Combined Operations offers a raid in force on a Channel port.
event_desc.can_duplessis_election: Quebec's premier calls a snap election to fight Ottawa's war measures. The federal ministers from Quebec say they will resign if he wins, leaving the province no voice against conscription.
event_desc.can_gouzenko_affair: A clerk from the Soviet embassy walks into a newspaper office with stolen files: a spy ring reaching into the atomic research. Nobody wants to listen at first.
event_desc.can_hong_kong_battalions: London asks for two battalions to strengthen the Hong Kong garrison as a sign to Tokyo. Defence headquarters thinks the colony cannot be held.
event_desc.can_hyde_park: Canada pays for American parts and machines in dollars it no longer has. At the President's home on the Hudson the leaders agree that Washington will buy Canadian munitions to close the gap.
event_desc.can_newfoundland_joins: Newfoundland and Labrador join Confederation. The Dominion now runs from the Pacific to the Grand Banks.
event_desc.can_newfoundland_offer: Canada offers to take Newfoundland and Labrador into Confederation as a province, debts and all. The island has been run by a commission from London since it went bankrupt.
event_desc.can_ogdensburg: The President proposes a permanent joint board to plan the defence of North America. It binds Canada to a neutral United States while Britain fights alone.
event_desc.can_on_to_ottawa: The men of the relief camps rode the freight cars east to put their case to Ottawa and were stopped by the police in Regina. With the camps closing, what becomes of them?
event_desc.can_oshawa_strike: Four thousand workers at the General Motors plant in Oshawa walk out for recognition of their industrial union. Ontario's premier swears to keep the American union organisers out of the province.
event_desc.can_padlock_law: Quebec's new law lets the attorney general lock any building used for communist propaganda, with no definition of communism and no appeal. Unions and civil libertarians ask Ottawa to disallow it.
event_desc.can_parliament_decides: Prime Minister Mackenzie King promised that Parliament would decide whether Canada goes to war. In a special session the members vote to stand with Britain, and Canada declares war on Germany in its own name, a week after Britain.
event_desc.can_plebiscite_result: The country is asked whether the government may be released from its promise not to conscript for overseas service. English Canada says yes; Quebec says no, by a wide margin.
event_desc.can_quebec_conference: The British and American leaders meet at the Citadel above the St. Lawrence to plan the invasion of Europe. Canada is the host; it is not at the table.
event_desc.can_ralston_crisis: The Defence Minister comes back from the front with figures: the infantry is short of reinforcements, and only the home-defence conscripts can fill the gap. He wants them sent.
event_desc.can_royal_tour: The King and Queen cross the country from Quebec to Victoria. Crowds line the railway at every halt, and the Queen tells a veteran she is Scottish too.
event_desc.can_terrace_mutiny: Home-defence conscripts in a British Columbia camp take over their barracks and refuse orders rather than be shipped overseas.
event_desc.can_war_vote: Britain is at war with Germany. Canada is not, not yet: the Prime Minister promised that Parliament would decide, and Parliament now meets.
event_desc.casablanca_conference: The President and the Prime Minister have met in Casablanca to plan the coming year of the war. Before they part, they agree to accept nothing short of the unconditional surrender of Germany, Italy and Japan.
event_desc.ccp_ev_after_xian: The Generalissimo has been released and flown home. He promised to stop the war on us. A promise from Chiang is worth what we can make him keep.
event_desc.ccp_ev_bethune: A Canadian surgeon has reached the front with a small medical team. He wants to operate where the wounded fall, not in Yan'an.
event_desc.ccp_ev_blockade: Nationalist divisions dig a ring of posts around the Border Region. The subsidy stops, and goods no longer pass.
event_desc.ccp_ev_chongqing_invitation: Japan has surrendered. The Generalissimo invites the chairman to Chongqing to discuss peace and the future government of China.
event_desc.ccp_ev_dixie_mission: An American transport plane has landed on the Yan'an strip with officers and diplomats. They want to see our army, our bases and our intelligence.
event_desc.ccp_ev_first_harvest: Fields broken by soldiers and cadres bring in their first harvest. The granaries of the Border Region are full for once.
event_desc.ccp_ev_friction_behind_lines: Nationalist guerrilla commanders in the occupied north attack our units as often as they attack the Japanese. Our commanders ask for permission to hit back.
event_desc.ccp_ev_korean_volunteers: Several hundred Korean exiles have reached our lines in the Taihang mountains and ask to fight under their own banner.
event_desc.ccp_ev_ma_cavalry: Muslim cavalry of the Ma family rides along our western border, raiding villages and testing our posts.
event_desc.ccp_ev_northwest_council: The generals of the northwest and the party's envoys meet as a council. The generals want soldiers and money; the party wants the villages.
event_desc.ccp_ev_party_underground: The party no longer rules, but its cells meet at night in the villages and its old cadres ask for a hearing.
event_desc.ccp_ev_plenum: The Central Committee meets for weeks. Mao's report on the new stage of the war wins the room, and the International's men fall silent.
event_desc.ccp_ev_rescue_excess: The security campaign has produced thousands of confessions. Most of the accused are young volunteers who came to fight Japan.
event_desc.ccp_ev_soviets_in_manchuria: Soviet armies are pouring into Manchuria. The Kwantung Army's depots, arsenals and factories lie behind them, for whoever reaches them first.
event_desc.ccp_ev_three_alls: The occupier answers our offensive with columns that burn the base villages, kill those who stay and carry off the grain. The bases are shrinking.
event_desc.ccp_ev_truce_breaks: The agreements signed after the war are dead letters. Both armies race for the north, and the clashes grow into battles.
event_desc.ccp_ev_wang_ming_returns: A plane from the Soviet Union lands at Yan'an carrying the party's delegate to the International and his comrades. He brings Moscow's view of the war and of who should lead.
event_desc.ccp_ev_western_route: Part of the joined armies has crossed the Yellow River heading west, to open a road to the Soviet border. The Ma family's cavalry waits in the corridor.
event_desc.ccp_long_march_end: The last Red Army columns have joined the Central Red Army in Gansu and northern Shaanxi, two years after the retreat from Jiangxi began. Only a fraction of those who set out have arrived. The party now rebuilds its army and administration around a small, poor base in the northwest.
event_desc.ccp_new_fourth_clash: In southern Anhui, Nationalist troops have attacked the New Fourth Army's headquarters column as it moved north on orders. After a week of fighting the column was broken and its commander taken prisoner. The government has declared the army disbanded. Yan'an must decide whether to rebuild it or end the united front.
event_desc.chn_burma_road_open: The road from Lashio in Burma to Kunming is open to traffic. Labourers from the villages along its route built it in little more than a year, over high ranges and river gorges. As the ports close one after another, it may become China's main link with the outside world.
event_desc.chn_ev_advisers_recalled: Berlin orders its officers home from China. Some ask to stay; their families in Germany are named in the reply.
event_desc.chn_ev_american_chief_of_staff: The American general who commands China's troops in Burma wants command of all of them, and says so in writing. Washington backs him.
event_desc.chn_ev_ask_soviet_pilots: The Chinese want pilots as well as planes. Our crews would fly in civilian clothes and come home with experience no exercise can give.
event_desc.chn_ev_berlin_choice: The Chinese ask openly which of our two friends in Asia we mean to keep. The army wants China's tungsten; the foreign ministry wants Japan against Moscow.
event_desc.chn_ev_henan_famine: Drought, locusts and the grain levy together: whole counties are eating bark. The army still wants its grain, and foreign reporters are on the way.
event_desc.chn_ev_inflation: The printing presses run day and night and a sack of rice costs more each week. Officers' salaries buy less than a coolie's wage did before the war.
event_desc.chn_ev_mediation: The German ambassador brings Japan's terms: autonomy for the north, a common front against communism, an indemnity. Each week the Japanese advance, the terms grow.
event_desc.chn_ev_national_salvation: Seven leaders of the National Salvation Association have been arrested for 'endangering the Republic'. Their crime was to demand war with Japan sooner than the government wanted.
event_desc.chn_ev_no_more_concessions: From the summer capital on Mount Lu the government speaks: if the last moment has come, every man, young or old, north or south, must resist.
event_desc.chn_ev_one_army_offer: Nanjing offers ranks, posts and pay for every Communist officer in a single national army under one command. The party would remain; its army would not.
event_desc.chn_ev_provinces_submit: For once every provincial governor answers the summons in person. The photographers have trouble fitting them into one picture.
event_desc.chn_ev_red_army_renamed: Nanjing offers numbers, pay and supplies if the Red Army takes the Nationalist badge. The commanders would stay; the political commissars would have to go, or at least change their titles.
event_desc.chn_ev_road_closed: Under Japanese pressure Britain closes the Burma Road for the rainy season. The lorries stand still at Lashio.
event_desc.chn_ev_south_anhui: The New Fourth Army was ordered north across the Yangtze and moved too slowly, or by the wrong road. Government divisions have surrounded its headquarters column.
event_desc.chn_ev_soviet_credit: The Chinese ask for a credit in aircraft and tanks, repayable in tea, wool and tungsten. Every Japanese division in China is one less on the Amur.
event_desc.chn_ev_vice_chairman_leaves: The party's second man has flown out of the wartime capital without a word. A telegram from abroad will explain why.
event_desc.chn_ev_victory_at_the_canal: A Japanese column that pushed too far down the Grand Canal has been cut off and broken in a walled town. For the first time the newspapers can print the word victory.
event_desc.chn_ev_warlords_defiant: Provincial commanders have stopped forwarding taxes and started printing their own notes. A telegram calls for a 'national salvation army' that answers to them.
event_desc.chn_ev_young_marshal: Zhang Xueliang flew to Nanjing with his prisoner and gave himself up. His Northeastern Army waits to learn what becomes of its commander.
event_desc.chn_flying_tigers: China's government asks that American pilots and ground crews be allowed to leave the services and fly for the Chinese air force under a retired American air officer. A hundred fighters bought for China are already waiting in Burma. Officially, the United States would remain neutral.
event_desc.chn_soviet_treaty: Moscow offers China a treaty of non-aggression, and with it credits, aircraft and volunteer pilots for the war against Japan. Signing will alarm Tokyo and the Western powers, but no one else is offering guns.
event_desc.chn_united_front_offer: The National Government proposes to end the civil war. The Red Army would join the national army under its own commanders, and the party would drop its call to overthrow the government. In return, the arrests and the blockade would stop. Some in the party fear losing their independence.
event_desc.chn_warlord_joins: The National Government asks our province to place its army, revenues and administration under the centre. Our commanders would keep their posts for now, but the province would answer to the capital. Refusing keeps our autonomy and leaves the question open.
event_desc.chn_xian_incident: Marshal Zhang Xueliang has detained Chiang Kai-shek at Xi'an, demanding an end to the war on the Communists and a united front against Japan. Chiang's release now depends on what Nanjing is willing to promise. In Nanjing, some call for troops to march on Xi'an.
event_desc.chw_join_offer: One of the regional cliques offers to place its army and its province under the National Government. Its leaders ask to keep their ranks in the national army. Accepting brings the province under direct rule at once.
event_desc.chw_sheng_turn: Border Defence Commissioner Sheng Shicai is turning away from Moscow. Delegations of the National Government have arrived in Urumqi, and the Soviet advisers and troops are being asked to leave. Moscow's goodwill would be lost, but the National Government offers recognition and support.
event_desc.csk_after_munich: The borderland with its forts, its mines and its factories is gone. Many say the democracies betrayed us and democracy itself failed.
event_desc.csk_air_meeting: Our Avia fighters took prizes at the international meeting in Switzerland. Only the new German monoplanes were faster.
event_desc.csk_ally_promise: Our ally has guaranteed the Republic's borders. In the cafés of Prague people breathe more easily.
event_desc.csk_ally_refusal: Our ally's answer is polite and empty. It will not promise to fight for us.
event_desc.csk_ally_request: The Czechoslovak envoy asks whether we will stand by the Republic if Germany attacks it. A promise could deter Berlin, or drag us into its war.
event_desc.csk_benes_resigns: Berlin demands his removal and much of the country blames him. The President offers to resign and go abroad.
event_desc.csk_danube_offer: Prague proposes that our state join a Danubian federation, with a common government, army and market. Some see rescue from Berlin, others the end of our independence.
event_desc.csk_danube_refused: Our neighbour has turned down the federation. The council's work is undone, at least for now.
event_desc.csk_fight_alone: No one came. The army is in the forts and the reservists are at the border. The Republic will fight.
event_desc.csk_fortress_tour: French and Romanian officers inspect the new blockhouses. They say the line is the equal of anything in Europe.
event_desc.csk_henlein_demands: The leader of the Sudeten German Party demands self-government for the German districts and the freedom to profess the German world view. Everyone knows who wrote the speech.
event_desc.csk_hungarian_demands: Hungary demands the districts of southern Slovakia where Hungarians are the majority. Its delegates are waiting at Komárno.
event_desc.csk_masaryk_dies: Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk, the philosopher who built the Republic, has died at his country house. Hundreds of thousands line the streets of Prague.
event_desc.csk_may_crisis: Reports speak of German divisions moving towards our border. The general staff asks to call up a class of reservists at once.
event_desc.csk_munich_dictate: The terms have reached Prague: the German-speaking border districts must be handed to Germany within days, with the fortifications built to defend them. If we refuse, we will have to fight Germany alone. None of Prague's allies will step in.
event_desc.csk_parachutists: Soldiers trained in Britain wait for the order to drop into the occupied homeland. Their mission would strike at the occupiers' leaders, and the reprisals would be terrible.
event_desc.csk_prague_ultimatum: The President has been summoned to Berlin and told that German troops will march at dawn. If he signs, Bohemia and Moravia become a German protectorate and the rest of the state falls apart; if he refuses, Prague will be bombed.
event_desc.csk_runciman_mission: A British lord arrives to mediate between the government and the Sudeten German Party. He is courteous, and he spends his weekends at the castles of the German nobility.
event_desc.csk_sdp_growth: The Sudeten German Party now wins more votes than any other party in the Republic. Some ministers want it banned.
event_desc.csk_skoda_order: A foreign government wants guns and tanks from Plzeň, paid in hard currency.
event_desc.csk_slovak_demands: Hlinka's Slovak People's Party calls a congress and demands a Slovak government and assembly. Its guards march in Bratislava.
event_desc.csk_tank_trials: ČKD's light tank finished the trials with hardly a breakdown. Škoda's design broke down again and again.
event_desc.csk_vienna_award_notice: Meeting in Vienna, the German and Italian foreign ministers have drawn a new frontier between Czechoslovakia and Hungary. The southern strip of Slovakia, with Košice, passes to Hungary; Prague was not asked to agree. There is no way to refuse.
event_desc.csk_zaolzie_ultimatum: Poland demands the Teschen district of Silesia, with its coal mines and ironworks, and gives Prague less than a day to answer. With the Sudeten frontier already gone, the army is in no position to fight on a second front. Hungary is pressing claims on the southern frontier too.
