focus_desc.ccp_seventh_congress: The first congress in seventeen years. Delegates from every base confirm the leadership and its thought as the party's guide.
focus_desc.ccp_shaanbei_refuge: The march is over. The survivors dig cave homes in the loess and set up the party, the government and the army in a land poorer than the one they left.
focus_desc.ccp_sinified_marxism: Theory must speak the language of peasants and fit China's own conditions. Cadres who quote Moscow without thinking are told to study again.
focus_desc.ccp_social_affairs: One department for security and intelligence: it watches for spies at home and runs agents in the enemy's cities.
focus_desc.ccp_southern_guerrillas: The bands that survived three years in the southern mountains are told to fight on and draw Nanking's troops away.
focus_desc.ccp_soviet_advisers: Moscow sends instructors and asks Stalin's government for arms. The Red Army will learn staff work from the Red Army.
focus_desc.ccp_soviet_model_army: Regular regiments, political commissars and drill manuals translated from Russian. Fewer guerrillas, more soldiers.
focus_desc.ccp_soviet_republic_revived: The red flag of the soviet government flies again over the northwest. Land is taken from the landlords and handed out at once.
focus_desc.ccp_soviets_come: If the Soviet armies enter Manchuria, the Kwantung Army's depots will be open. Our men must be there first.
focus_desc.ccp_sparrow_warfare: Groups of three or five strike, scatter and strike again, like sparrows round a field. The enemy never sees the whole flock.
focus_desc.ccp_spin_our_own: Every office has its spinning wheel, from the clerks to the chairman. Cloth no longer has to cross the blockade.
focus_desc.ccp_staff_work: Maps, orders in writing and reports on time. A guerrilla army that wants to fight big battles needs a staff.
focus_desc.ccp_stop_the_civil_war: The slogan is aimed at the soldiers sent to destroy us: Chinese should not kill Chinese while Japan takes the north.
focus_desc.ccp_three_alls_endured: The occupier burns, kills and loots to empty the bases. The bases shrink, hide and come back.
focus_desc.ccp_three_armies_meet: The First, Second and Fourth Front Armies finally stand on the same ground. Together they are an army again; apart they were columns of refugees.
focus_desc.ccp_three_thirds: Communists may hold only a third of the seats in the councils; progressives and the middle hold the rest. Power shared is power kept.
focus_desc.ccp_through_the_blockade: Traders, smugglers and sympathetic officers on the other side keep goods flowing. Every blockade has a price.
focus_desc.ccp_through_the_front: Nothing is done without the Nationalists' consent. Our armies are part of the national army, and our quarrels wait until Japan is beaten.
focus_desc.ccp_tunnel_warfare: On the open plain there is nowhere to hide, so the villages dig. Tunnels join the houses, the wells and the next village.
focus_desc.ccp_united_front: Stop the civil war with the Nationalists and join a national united front against Japan.
focus_desc.ccp_unity_and_struggle: Answer every attack, but on just grounds, to our advantage and with restraint. The front must bend but not break.
focus_desc.ccp_war_for_china: Only one government can rule China. The final contest with the Nationalists begins.
focus_desc.ccp_wayaobao_line: The Politburo turns from class war to a national front against Japan, open to anyone who will fight, landlords and generals included.
focus_desc.ccp_xinhua_radio: A transmitter in a cave broadcasts the news to the whole of China. People listen at night with the windows shut.
focus_desc.ccp_xinjiang_road: The governor in Dihua is friendly to Moscow. Through his province a road could bring Soviet arms to the northwest.
focus_desc.ccp_yanan: Make Yan'an in northern Shaanxi the base of the party, the government and the army.
focus_desc.ccp_yanchang_oil: China's oldest oil wells lie inside the Border Region. They give a trickle, but a trickle of our own.
focus_desc.ccp_yangtze_bureau: The party's men work openly in the wartime capital, among students, workers and editors, far from the poor hills of Shaanxi.
focus_desc.ccp_young_marshal_talks: The Northeastern Army lost its homeland to Japan and has no wish to die fighting us. Its commander sends envoys at night.
focus_desc.chl_mining: Copper and iron mines in the north expand with new state credit.
focus_desc.chn_action_committee: The followers of the executed Deng Yanda revive their committee: land to the tiller, the revolution of the twenties finished at last.
focus_desc.chn_air_commission: Let the Aviation Commission run pilot training and aircraft purchases, and build airfields in Sichuan.
focus_desc.chn_aircraft_factory: An American company assembles Hawks in China from parts shipped across the Pacific. When Hangzhou falls, the factory moves to the Burmese border.
focus_desc.chn_american_air_adviser: A retired American captain with deaf ears and firm ideas: fight in pairs, and listen to the villages. Spotters with telephones report every engine they hear.
focus_desc.chn_american_volunteers: American pilots resign their commissions, sign contracts with a Chinese company and paint shark mouths on their fighters.
focus_desc.chn_appeal_to_the_world: China brings its case to Geneva again. The League will pass a resolution; China needs more than resolutions.
focus_desc.chn_arsenal_standards: Hanyang, Gongxian and Jinling make different rifles for different bullets. One pattern, the Mauser, and one cartridge for every arsenal.
focus_desc.chn_arsenals: Rebuild the relocated arsenals in Sichuan and Yunnan and raise the output of rifles and ammunition.
focus_desc.chn_asian_league: Sun Yat-sen spoke of a Greater Asia of equals, not of masters. China can offer its neighbours a league that Japan never meant.
focus_desc.chn_assembly_postponed: The delegates are elected, the hall is ready, and the convening is put off once more. There is always a crisis that makes this the wrong year.
focus_desc.chn_aviation_commission: Madame Chiang chairs the commission that buys the air force. Salesmen from four countries queue outside her office.
focus_desc.chn_axis_partner: If Berlin has truly chosen China over Japan, then China can stand beside Germany in the world, and the German advisers can stay.
focus_desc.chn_bandit_campaign: Five campaigns drove the Red Army out of Jiangxi. One more, from the northwest, can finish it before it recovers.
focus_desc.chn_bandit_suppression: Prepare a new encirclement of the Communist base. The reckoning with Japan must wait.
focus_desc.chn_baojia: Ten households make a jia, ten jia a bao, and every household answers for its neighbours. The old imperial net is cast again over the villages.
focus_desc.chn_berlin_line: Germany trained the army and buys the tungsten. Ask Berlin plainly to choose between its two friends in Asia, and hope it chooses China.
focus_desc.chn_birthday_planes: Provinces, guilds and overseas Chinese buy aircraft by subscription and name them after their towns. The air force grows one gift at a time.
focus_desc.chn_blue_shirt_rising: The society stops waiting for the leader's word and seizes the ministries in his name. Not every army will march behind it.
focus_desc.chn_break_the_dykes: Open the river onto the plain in front of the Japanese columns. It will stop them for years, and it will drown villages no one has warned.
focus_desc.chn_burma_road: Build the road from Yunnan to Burma so supplies can still arrive when the coast is closed.
focus_desc.chn_cairo_claims: The Allies agree that the northeast, Taiwan and the Pescadores shall be restored to China. They have to be taken back first.
focus_desc.chn_canton_hankou: Improve the Canton-Hankow railway, completed in 1936, as the main line between Guangzhou and Wuhan.
focus_desc.chn_canton_hankou_railway: Forty years after the first survey the last gap is closed. Arms landed in Hong Kong can reach the Yangtze by train.
focus_desc.chn_central_academy: Whampoa's successor in Nanjing turns out lieutenants loyal to the Generalissimo. They will hold the army together, or at least its centre.
focus_desc.chn_central_army: Expand the German-trained divisions and bring the central army's organisation and training into line.
focus_desc.chn_central_steel_works: A German-built steel works in Hunan, far from the coast and the Japanese navy. China has iron, coal and no modern mill; this will be the first.
focus_desc.chn_chongqing: Move the government offices to Chongqing in Sichuan as the wartime capital.
focus_desc.chn_civil_rights_league: Sun Yat-sen's widow lends her name to the defence of political prisoners. Her husband's party cannot arrest her, and she knows it.
focus_desc.chn_commission_rule: The Military Affairs Commission becomes the real cabinet. Orders go out on the Generalissimo's handwritten notes, and ministries learn to wait for them.
focus_desc.chn_conscription: Extend conscription under the military service law to the whole country and reorganise the draft offices.
focus_desc.chn_constitutional_assembly: The Assembly meets, adopts the constitution and elects a government answerable to it. Those who ruled by the old rules will not all accept the new ones.
focus_desc.chn_counteroffensive: For years the army has given ground. Now, with new divisions and air cover, it can take some back.
focus_desc.chn_currency: Make the fabi notes of the 1935 currency reform the money of the whole country, uniting finance and banking.
focus_desc.chn_dollar_credits: Washington will not sell arms on credit, but it will lend against future deliveries of wood oil. The money buys trucks, and the trucks carry everything else.
focus_desc.chn_eighth_route_army: The Red Army in the northwest takes the Nationalist badge and a Nationalist number. Who commands it is a question for later.
focus_desc.chn_end_extraterritoriality: Britain and America give up their concessions and their courts on Chinese soil. A century of humiliation ends with a signature.
focus_desc.chn_end_of_tutelage: The party announces that the people have learned enough. Its branches stop speaking for the state, and the provinces notice how much looser the reins have become.
focus_desc.chn_expeditionary: Form an expeditionary force with American equipment for the Burma and India front.
focus_desc.chn_expeditionary_force: Chinese divisions go to Burma to keep the road open. They will learn to fight beside the British, and sometimes despite them.
focus_desc.chn_fabi_reform: Silver flows abroad and prices collapse. The government takes the silver in and issues the fabi, a paper currency of the national banks, backed by sterling and dollars.
focus_desc.chn_factory_evacuation: Lathes on junks, boilers on bamboo rafts, workers walking behind. Shanghai's industry goes upriver through the gorges to Chongqing.
focus_desc.chn_foreign_advisors: Entrust staff training and fortification plans to the foreign advisers, who may leave if politics change.
focus_desc.chn_fortified_lines: Concrete pillboxes between Lake Tai and the Yangtze, planned by German engineers: the Chinese Hindenburg Line, if the keys to the bunkers can be found in time.
focus_desc.chn_four_policemen: Roosevelt counts China among the powers that will keep the peace after the war. Churchill does not, but he is outvoted.
focus_desc.chn_fujian_memory: The officers who once set up a people's government in Fujian are pardoned and back in uniform. They have not forgotten what they wanted.
focus_desc.chn_german_guns: Howitzers, anti-tank guns and anti-aircraft guns from Krupp and Rheinmetall, paid for in tungsten and antimony.
focus_desc.chn_german_mission: Falkenhausen's officers drill companies, plan fortifications and write the war plan against Japan. Berlin's other friend in Asia is not pleased.
focus_desc.chn_grain_tax: Paper money buys less each month, so the state takes its land tax in rice and wheat. The army eats; the collectors grow rich; the peasants remember.
focus_desc.chn_great_power: Take a seat among the principal Allies where the post-war order is decided.
focus_desc.chn_guangxi_terms: Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi run the best-governed province in China and know it. Offer them high command in exchange for their province.
focus_desc.chn_guerrilla_rear: Regular divisions stay behind in the occupied provinces as guerrillas. The Japanese hold the cities and the railways; the countryside is contested.
focus_desc.chn_guerrilla_zones: Set up guerrilla districts in the occupied provinces and leave regular units behind to keep resistance alive.
focus_desc.chn_hanoi_telegram: Wang Jingwei leaves the wartime capital and calls from abroad for peace with Japan. The party expels him; part of it follows him.
focus_desc.chn_hapro_barter: A German company trades arms and machinery for tungsten and antimony, without foreign currency. Both sides think they have the better of it.
focus_desc.chn_hear_the_terms: A German ambassador carries Tokyo's conditions to the government. Listening is not accepting, the peace men say; but everyone knows what listening means.
focus_desc.chn_indochina_question: The railway from Haiphong to Kunming made Indochina China's back door. Its peoples' freedom, and China's friendship with them, can keep that door open.
focus_desc.chn_industrial_cooperatives: Small workshops owned by refugee workers, organised by foreign friends under the motto 'work together'. Blankets, soap and grenades from a thousand villages.
focus_desc.chn_inland_move: Dismantle coastal factories, ship them up the rivers and by rail, and rebuild them in Sichuan.
focus_desc.chn_integrate_guangxi: Negotiate with Li Zongren's Guangxi clique to bring its army and revenues under the centre.
focus_desc.chn_integrate_northwest: Bring the Ma clique of the northwest and Sheng Shicai's Xinjiang into the central government.
focus_desc.chn_integrate_shanxi: Negotiate with Yan Xishan's Shanxi clique to put the defence of North China under central command.
focus_desc.chn_integrate_yunnan: Draw Long Yun's Yunnan into the administration and military system of the central government.
focus_desc.chn_jianqiao_school: American instructors at Hangzhou teach cadets to fly the American way. The cadets are few and every one counts.
focus_desc.chn_join_the_allies: After years of fighting alone, China signs the declaration beside Britain, the Soviet Union and the United States.
focus_desc.chn_korean_provisional_government: Korean exiles in Chongqing have a government, a cabinet and a small army. Recognise them, and Japan has an enemy in its own house.
focus_desc.chn_leader_principle: Pamphlets argue that China needs one will, one leader and no factions. The leader in question has not said whether he agrees.
focus_desc.chn_light_industry: Expand credit to textiles, food processing and other light industry in the cities.
focus_desc.chn_light_industry_first: Cotton mills, flour mills and match factories pay for themselves and employ millions. Guns can be bought with what they earn.
focus_desc.chn_lixingshe: Young Whampoa officers have formed a secret society around the Generalissimo. Outsiders call them the Blue Shirts, after the uniforms of Rome and Berlin.
focus_desc.chn_lost_territories: Schoolroom maps still show the Qing empire's borders, with the lost lands shaded in shame. A strong China could redraw them.
focus_desc.chn_low_key_club: In a Nanjing house a circle of officials says quietly what others will not: China cannot win, and every month of war only makes the terms worse.
focus_desc.chn_may_fifth_draft: Sun Fo's Legislative Yuan has written a constitution with a president, five branches and a National Assembly. It needs only to be put into force.
focus_desc.chn_middle_kingdom: China stands among the great powers again, its borders its own and its neighbours its friends. The century of humiliation is over.
focus_desc.chn_militarised_party: Party branches drill like companies and the cadres wear field grey. The old revolutionaries of the party are told to obey or retire.
focus_desc.chn_military_service_law: Conscription replaces the press gang, on paper. County officials draw lots, and the rich buy substitutes.
focus_desc.chn_model_divisions: German helmets, German rifles, German-trained officers: a handful of divisions the equal of any in Asia. There are never enough of them.
focus_desc.chn_nanjing_decade: Ten years after the Northern Expedition the government in Nanjing rules the Yangtze valley and little beyond it. It must decide what to build first: a state, an army or a nation.
focus_desc.chn_nation_not_yet_one: The Red Army has slipped away to the northwest, the southwest answers to its own generals and Japan presses on the northern provinces. Every road forward begins with the same question: who rules China?
focus_desc.chn_national_highways: Motor roads between provincial capitals, graded by conscript labour and paid for by the Economic Council. Trucks are rarer than the roads.
focus_desc.chn_new_fourth_army: The guerrillas left behind in the south are gathered into one army between the Yangtze and the Huai. Its area and its orders overlap with everyone else's.
focus_desc.chn_new_life: Continue the New Life Movement begun in 1934, with its rules for daily conduct and public order.
focus_desc.chn_new_life_drive: Clean streets, buttoned collars and Confucian virtue drilled like a parade. Missionaries applaud; peasants who cannot afford soap are less sure.
focus_desc.chn_north_china_stand: Keep the best divisions in the north, behind the rivers, and let the coast take care of itself. The plain is wide, but at least it is ours.
focus_desc.chn_northwest_headquarters: A suppression headquarters in Xi'an under the Generalissimo's eye. The Northeastern Army in exile is ordered to fight, and watched.
focus_desc.chn_northwest_terms: The Ma family's Muslim cavalry hold Qinghai and Ningxia; Sheng Shicai holds Xinjiang with Soviet help. Both can be bought, at a price.
focus_desc.chn_officer_academy: Enlarge the Central Military Academy and open branch schools to train more officers.
focus_desc.chn_one_china: With most of the cliques under the national flag, the provinces become provinces again: governors appointed, armies numbered, taxes paid.
focus_desc.chn_one_leader: The Director-General of the party, the Chairman of the Commission and the head of the government become one man. Whoever held the reins before, the party takes them back.
focus_desc.chn_one_national_army: Offer the Communists posts, ranks and pay in a single national army, and wait to see whether they would rather keep their own.
focus_desc.chn_outer_mongolia: Outer Mongolia declared itself independent under Soviet protection. China has never agreed, and a stronger China might say so louder.
focus_desc.chn_over_the_hump: If the road is cut, the supplies fly over the Himalayas from India. Transport crews call the route the aluminium trail, after the wrecks below it.
focus_desc.chn_party_machine: The Organisation Department's men fill the county offices. The party, not the barracks, will hold the country together, if its cadres can be kept honest.
focus_desc.chn_peace_government: The peace camp proclaims itself the true National Government, with the old flag and a new friend. The rest of China calls it something else.
focus_desc.chn_peace_movement: Peace committees appear in the occupied cities and promise order, rice and an end to the bombing. Their patrons in Tokyo pay for the posters.
focus_desc.chn_peoples_revolution: The left proclaims that the party has betrayed its founder and calls the workers and the soldiers to finish the revolution. The right calls the troops too.
focus_desc.chn_ping_hai: The second light cruiser of its class is being fitted out at the Jiangnan yard in Shanghai. Finish her before the yard is in range of the enemy's guns.
focus_desc.chn_political_council: A council of party men, independents and even Communists may advise but not decide. It gives the critics a hall to speak in and the government a record of unity.
focus_desc.chn_provincial_taxes: The salt tax and the customs already come to Nanjing; now the land tax is next. The provinces call it robbery, the treasury calls it a budget.
focus_desc.chn_recover_northeast: Plan the recovery of the Northeast lost in 1931 and of the Kwantung territory.
focus_desc.chn_red_amnesty: Leaflets promise land and a pardon to every Red soldier who comes over with his rifle. Some come.
focus_desc.chn_red_coalition: The left wing proposes what the Communists have demanded for years: a coalition government and joint command of every army.
focus_desc.chn_reorganisation_conference: The provincial commanders are invited to Nanjing to talk about disbanding troops. Each arrives with a list of the others' troops to disband.
focus_desc.chn_resources_commission: Geologists and engineers trained abroad take over the state's mines and plants. Weng Wenhao's commission plans an industry the country has never had.
focus_desc.chn_river_fleet: Place batteries at the mouth of the Yangtze to bar enemy ships from the river.
focus_desc.chn_river_mines: China's navy cannot fight Japan's at sea. It can lay mines in the Yangtze and keep the gunboats out.
focus_desc.chn_road_to_burma: Two hundred thousand labourers cut a road by hand through the mountains from Kunming to Lashio. Every lorry on it carries the war.
focus_desc.chn_second_plan: The first factories run; the engineers want more. A second plan doubles the targets and hopes for the money.
focus_desc.chn_seeckt_plan: The old German general's advice: fewer and better divisions, officers who can read a map, and a state arms industry behind them.
focus_desc.chn_seven_gentlemen: The leaders of the National Salvation Association sit in a Suzhou jail for demanding resistance to Japan. Releasing them costs face and wins the cities.
focus_desc.chn_shanghai_stand: Draw the Japanese onto the Yangtze delta, where their tanks bog down in creeks and the whole world is watching. It will cost the best divisions.
focus_desc.chn_shanxi_terms: Yan Xishan, the model governor, built his own railway on his own gauge. Japan is at his northern border, and he needs friends.
focus_desc.chn_sichuan_brought_in: Sichuan's garrison commanders have fought each other for twenty years. Central troops that came chasing the Reds now stay, and the province's taxes start to reach the centre.
focus_desc.chn_southwest_arsenals: The arsenals reopen in caves cut into the cliffs above the river. They make fewer rifles than before, and the bombers cannot reach them.
focus_desc.chn_soviet_aid: Sign a non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union and open the way to its credits, aircraft and volunteer pilots.
focus_desc.chn_soviet_pact: Moscow offers a non-aggression pact, credits and aircraft. It wants Japan tied down in China, and China is willing to be the rope.
focus_desc.chn_soviet_volunteers: Soviet bombers and fighters come with their own crews, in civilian clothes, under Chinese markings. Nobody is fooled and nobody objects.
focus_desc.chn_space_for_time: China is larger than Japan's army. Every province given up costs the invader garrisons, roads and patience; every year gained brings allies closer.
focus_desc.chn_spare_the_dykes: Some weapons cost more than defeat. The river stays in its bed, and the army fights for the plain as it is.
focus_desc.chn_special_services: Dai Li's men follow students, journalists and Japanese agents alike. Few know how many they are; that is the point.
focus_desc.chn_sterling_credits: London lends to keep the currency standing and the Burma route open. It also keeps Hong Kong out of the argument.
focus_desc.chn_stop_civil_war: Students march with the slogan and generals in the northwest have stopped fighting the Reds. Stop the civil war, and turn every rifle toward Japan.
focus_desc.chn_survey_the_rear: If the coast is lost, the state must live in Sichuan, Guizhou and Yunnan. Send the surveyors before the war sends the refugees.
focus_desc.chn_tannu_uriankhai: The upper Yenisei was Qing land once. Moscow calls it the Tuvan People's Republic; Chinese maps call it lost.
focus_desc.chn_third_parties: The Youth Party, the State Socialists and the rural reconstruction men are neither Nationalist nor Communist. Let them organise openly.
focus_desc.chn_three_year_plan: Steel, machine tools, electrical works and arsenals in the interior, out of reach of the sea. The plan is three years long, if the Japanese allow three years.
focus_desc.chn_tibet_question: Lhasa expelled the Chinese resident and runs its own affairs. A mission of condolence is a way back in; an army is another.
focus_desc.chn_torpedo_boats: Motor torpedo boats bought from Germany and Britain for the river: small, fast and able to hide among junks.
focus_desc.chn_trade_space: Use the depth of the country as a shield: avoid a decisive battle and wear the enemy down by holding out.
focus_desc.chn_trained_in_india: Divisions that retreated into India are rebuilt at Ramgarh with American rifles, American artillery and full rations. They come back different.
focus_desc.chn_tung_oil_exports: Wood oil for American paint and antimony for everyone's bullets: the exports that can stand as security for a foreign loan.
focus_desc.chn_tungsten_monopoly: Southern Jiangxi and Hunan hold much of the world's tungsten. The state buys all of it and sells it to whoever pays in arms.
focus_desc.chn_tutelage_continues: Sun Yat-sen promised military rule, then tutelage, then a constitution. The party decides that the people are not yet ready for the third stage.
focus_desc.chn_unification: Settle the administration and armies of the joined provinces and govern them as one state.
focus_desc.chn_united_front: Halt the civil war with the Communists and form a common front against Japan.
focus_desc.chn_us_aid: Ask the United States for credits and lend-lease, and open the way for American volunteer pilots.
focus_desc.chn_volunteer_airfields: Fields in Lanzhou, Hankou and Chengdu for foreign volunteer squadrons and the planes that come with them.
focus_desc.chn_war_areas: The country is divided into war areas, each with its own commander and its own front. It makes the army easier to run and the commanders harder to move.
focus_desc.chn_war_tax: Reorganise excise and wartime taxes to meet the growing cost of the army.
focus_desc.chn_wartime_capital: A foggy river town on a rock becomes the capital of a nation. The fog hides it from bombers for half the year.
focus_desc.chn_yangtze_barrier: Forts at the river narrows and old ships ready to be sunk across the channel. The Japanese fleet must not steam up to the capital.
focus_desc.chn_yangtze_line: Build fortified lines between Shanghai and Nanjing to shield the industry of the lower Yangtze.
focus_desc.chn_youth_corps: Students in uniform, summer camps on Mount Lu and an oath to the Three Principles of the People. The party wants the young before the Communists get them.
focus_desc.chn_yunnan_terms: Long Yun rules Kunming with his own army, his own money and his own opium. He will listen if the road to Burma runs through his province.
focus_desc.chn_zhejiang_jiangxi_railway: A line from Hangzhou into the tungsten country, built cheaply and fast by the province with central loans.
focus_desc.chw_air_wing: Buy fighters abroad and build airfields for a provincial air wing.
focus_desc.chw_anti_japan: Send the provincial army to the front against Japan alongside the National Government.
focus_desc.chw_arsenal: Enlarge the provincial arsenal so the army can make its own rifles and mortars.
focus_desc.chw_autonomy: Acknowledge the central government's authority in name, but keep the army and the revenues in provincial hands.
focus_desc.chw_border_defense: Fortify the province's borders and post garrisons there.
focus_desc.chw_border_trade: Lower tolls for traders crossing the frontier and improve the trade routes.
focus_desc.chw_guangxi_model: Guangxi's militia training and administrative reforms earned it the name of a model province. Extend them.
focus_desc.chw_join_center: Hand the provincial army and administration to the National Government and become part of the centre.
focus_desc.chw_local_industry: Invest provincial funds in textile mills and machine shops in the provincial capital.
focus_desc.chw_ma_cavalry: Gather the horsemen of Qinghai and Ningxia into cavalry brigades.
focus_desc.chw_militia: Organise militia in every county and village to keep order and supply recruits.
focus_desc.chw_mines: Invest in the province's coal and metal mines and build roads to reach them.
focus_desc.chw_officer_school: Found a provincial officer school to train the army's junior officers.
focus_desc.chw_provincial_army: Reorganise the provincial army and appoint new officers to firm up the chain of command.
focus_desc.chw_regional_power: Join hands with neighbouring provinces and become a regional power able to stand up to the National Government.
focus_desc.chw_roads: Build motor roads between the provincial capital and the main counties.
focus_desc.chw_shanxi_model: Build more factories around Taiyuan under Yan Xishan's ten-year construction plan.
focus_desc.chw_xinjiang_soviet: Widen trade and military cooperation with the Soviet Union and ask for arms and advisers.
focus_desc.chw_xinjiang_turn: Distance the province from the Soviet Union and come to terms with the National Government.
focus_desc.chw_yunnan_railway: Run more trains on the Haiphong-Kunming railway and agree on transport with the French authorities.
focus_desc.csk_activist_ministers: German parties loyal to the Republic still sit in the cabinet. Give them something to show their voters.
focus_desc.csk_aero_bombers: Aero builds the French Bloch bomber under licence. It is slow, but it is ours.
focus_desc.csk_agent_a54: An officer of the German military intelligence sells us its secrets. Moravec's men must keep him safe.
focus_desc.csk_air_bases: Airfields near the border will be bombed on the first day. Build them deeper, in Moravia and Slovakia.
focus_desc.csk_air_defence: Prague is an hour's flight from German airfields. Guns, searchlights and observers must ring the cities.
focus_desc.csk_air_force: Our air force is large for a small state, but its biplanes age fast. Build it up while the factories can.
focus_desc.csk_airmen_in_britain: Czech pilots who escaped through Poland and France now fly in British squadrons of their own.
focus_desc.csk_anti_tank_guns: A light gun that can pierce any tank now in service. Every regiment and every bunker should have it.
focus_desc.csk_arms_plan: The general staff wants the army re-equipped within a few years. Industry must be told what to build and paid to build it.
focus_desc.csk_army_above_parties: The army answers to the nation, not to a party. Its officers will run what must be run.
focus_desc.csk_army_in_the_west: Czechoslovak soldiers gather in France and Britain to fight under their own flag.
focus_desc.csk_army_of_million: Mobilised, the Republic can put more than a million men under arms. The plans must be ready before the call goes out.
focus_desc.csk_army_reform: The army was built from the legions of the Great War. Now it must become an army of conscripts ready for a modern war.
focus_desc.csk_arsenal_of_entente: Our allies in Bucharest and Belgrade arm themselves with Czech guns. Let our industry be the arsenal of the whole alliance.
focus_desc.csk_artillery_school: Škoda's howitzers are among the best in Europe. Our gunners must learn to use them as well as they are made.
focus_desc.csk_authoritarian_democracy: Elections are kept, but only two parties may stand. Order before liberty, for now.
focus_desc.csk_avia_fighters: The Avia B-534 is among the best biplane fighters in the world. Fill every fighter regiment with it.
focus_desc.csk_axis_route: A government of the right seeks a place among the powers of the new order.
focus_desc.csk_bata_zlin: Baťa built a whole town around its shoe factories in Zlín. Its methods and its money can raise more works in Moravia.
focus_desc.csk_beran_cabinet: The leader of the Agrarians takes the government with the backing of the new party. His opponents will resist.
focus_desc.csk_berlin_accommodation: If the West will not help, perhaps Berlin can be calmed. Fewer speeches against Germany, more trade with it.
focus_desc.csk_border_regiments: Regiments raised to hold the fortified line, with the State Defence Guard behind them in the border districts.
focus_desc.csk_budapest_talks: Hungary is our oldest enemy and our closest neighbour. Talk before we fight.
focus_desc.csk_ckd_prague: Českomoravská Kolben-Daněk builds engines and tractors, and now tanks. Its designers want a contract.
focus_desc.csk_coalition_of_five: Five parties share the ministries and settle every quarrel behind closed doors. It is slow, but it holds.
focus_desc.csk_collective_security: A small state is safe only if aggression anywhere is answered by all. Speak for the League in Geneva.
focus_desc.csk_comintern_route: A workers' state belongs beside the first workers' state.
focus_desc.csk_crossroads: Pressed from outside and divided within, the Republic must choose how it will be governed in the hard years ahead.
focus_desc.csk_czechoslovakism: Czechs and Slovaks are one nation with two dialects. The state stays run from Prague.
focus_desc.csk_danube_by_force: Unity freely given is best. Unity taken is still unity.
focus_desc.csk_danube_preferences: Lower tariffs along the river bring the old markets of the monarchy back to life.
focus_desc.csk_danubian_council: A permanent council of the Danube states, with a common market and a common defence to follow.
focus_desc.csk_danubian_federation: The peoples of the middle Danube under one government again, this time by their own choice or ours.
focus_desc.csk_defence_in_depth: If the border falls the army falls back into Moravia and on to Slovakia. Forts and railways must be ready for that too.
focus_desc.csk_defence_loan: Citizens lend the state money for the army. The response will show how much the nation wants to defend itself.
focus_desc.csk_defend_democracy: Laws against parties that serve a foreign power, and a police that enforces them.
focus_desc.csk_defend_the_republic: The war has come. Every man to his post, every gun to its casemate.
focus_desc.csk_doctrine: French advisers taught us methodical battle. Our own staff adds counter-attacks from the depth of the line.
focus_desc.csk_dubnica_works: Factories near the German border can be overrun in days. Škoda's new plant on the Váh in Slovakia is out of reach.
focus_desc.csk_eastern_corps: Soldiers who fled to the Soviet Union form a battalion, then a brigade, then a corps.
focus_desc.csk_enabling_act: Let the government rule by decree for two years. Parliament will only slow the work of saving the state.
focus_desc.csk_entente_arms: Czech guns and tanks for Bucharest and Belgrade bind the alliance tighter than any treaty.
focus_desc.csk_federal_republic: The union will be a federation of free peoples, with no crown and no capital above the others.
focus_desc.csk_fortification_directorate: A directorate of engineers to plan a wall of concrete along the borders. France's line is the model, our mountains the ground.
focus_desc.csk_fortress_artillery: Guns in concrete casemates cover the gaps between the blockhouses. Their crews train for nothing else.
focus_desc.csk_fortress_nation: When the line is finished the whole country stands behind it. Its people know what the concrete is for.
focus_desc.csk_french_treaty: Our oldest alliance. Ask Paris to say plainly that it will march if we are attacked.
focus_desc.csk_friends_of_ussr: The pact with Moscow makes friendship respectable. Societies, newspapers and films carry the message.
focus_desc.csk_gajda_legion: A cashiered general of the Siberian legions leads the movement. Old soldiers follow him.
focus_desc.csk_gendarmerie_border: The State Defence Guard and the gendarmerie keep order in the border districts and watch the passes.
focus_desc.csk_gottwald_rising: The party leader calls the workers out of the factories. The bourgeois state will be swept away or will crush them.
focus_desc.csk_government_in_exile: The state lives on abroad, in its president, its soldiers and its treaties.
focus_desc.csk_habsburg_question: The legitimists of Vienna and Budapest want a crown to unite the Danube. Unthinkable in Prague, but it would bring them in.
focus_desc.csk_hacha_presidency: The new president is a quiet lawyer from the supreme court, above parties and respected by all.
focus_desc.csk_heavy_blockhouses: Artillery forts and infantry blockhouses on the mountain crests, built to hold out for weeks.
focus_desc.csk_heyrovsky_lab: Charles University's chemists lead the world in their field. Their instruments and methods can serve industry and the army.
focus_desc.csk_hodza_cabinet: A Slovak agrarian leads the government. He wants the farmers fed, the Slovaks heard and central Europe brought together.
focus_desc.csk_hodza_plan: The prime minister proposes trade preferences among the Danube states, a first step towards a central European union.
focus_desc.csk_home_resistance: Officers, Sokol members and communists form underground networks in the occupied lands.
focus_desc.csk_hrad_line: The President and his circle hold the coalition together. Stay with parliament, the parties and the alliances.
focus_desc.csk_industrial_survey: Bohemia and Moravia hold most of the old monarchy's industry. Count what we have before we plan what we need.
focus_desc.csk_infantry_weapons: Every squad gets the vz. 24 rifle and a ZB light machine gun. Few armies are as well armed man for man.
focus_desc.csk_jachymov: The mines of Jáchymov gave the Curies their radium. Their ore may yet matter more than anyone in Prague imagines.
focus_desc.csk_lean_east: The Soviet Union has promised help. Make that promise firm and independent of Paris.
focus_desc.csk_lean_west: Britain is not bound to us, but France will not move without it. Win over London.
focus_desc.csk_legion_tradition: The officers who fought across Siberia, France and Italy for a state that did not yet exist still lead the army.
focus_desc.csk_letov_support: The Letov Š-328 scouts for the army and bombs what it finds. The infantry wants more of them.
focus_desc.csk_light_pillboxes: Thousands of small concrete bunkers can go up quickly along the German border while the heavy works are designed.
focus_desc.csk_little_entente: Romania and Yugoslavia stand with us against Hungarian revision. Turn the old treaty into a true alliance.
focus_desc.csk_lt35_order: Škoda's light tank is ready. Order it now and fix its faults in service.
focus_desc.csk_lt38_competition: ČKD's new tank is simple and reliable. Let it compete against Škoda's for the next army order.
focus_desc.csk_march_on_prague: The movement's men gather at the barracks and the ministries. The Republic's defenders will fight.
focus_desc.csk_martial_law: Courts-martial and curfews in the districts where the Sudeten Free Corps raids.
focus_desc.csk_masaryk_legacy: The founder has handed the Castle to Beneš. His republic of law, schools and free newspapers is our inheritance.
focus_desc.csk_monoplane_fighter: Biplanes cannot catch modern bombers. Avia's designers must give us a monoplane.
focus_desc.csk_moravian_rail: Our railways run west towards Germany. Lines through Moravia into Slovakia would keep the country together in a war.
focus_desc.csk_motorisation: Tatra and Praga build lorries that cross bad roads. With enough of them the infantry can ride.
focus_desc.csk_mountain_line: From the Ore Mountains to the Giant Mountains the forts join into one line. Every pass is watched.
focus_desc.csk_nation_in_arms: Reservists report in their hundreds of thousands, and the crowds in Wenceslas Square ask for weapons.
focus_desc.csk_national_league: Stříbrný's newspapers and the fascists' street men make common cause against the Castle.
focus_desc.csk_national_state: Parties dissolved, unions merged into guilds, and the nation placed above every class.
focus_desc.csk_national_unity: The many parties have failed the nation. One great party of the right and centre should lead it now.
focus_desc.csk_nationality_statute: Give the Germans, Hungarians and others schools, offices and a fair share of the state. Take away the grievance before it becomes a weapon.
focus_desc.csk_nof_rallies: The National Fascist Community is small but loud. Its rallies draw the angry and the young.
focus_desc.csk_officers_government: If the politicians cannot defend the country, let the generals form a government of national defence.
focus_desc.csk_ostrava_coal: Coal from Ostrava feeds the furnaces of Vítkovice. New shafts and better roads will carry more of it.
focus_desc.csk_party_legal: Unlike its neighbours, the Republic lets the communists sit in parliament. Their voters are miners, workers and the poor of the east.
focus_desc.csk_peoples_democracy: All parties left standing join one front under the communists' lead.
focus_desc.csk_peoples_of_the_republic: Czechs, Slovaks, Germans, Hungarians, Ruthenians and Jews: the Republic must be a home for all of them, or it will not survive.
focus_desc.csk_rapid_divisions: Cavalry, cyclists, motor transport and tanks in one formation: a reserve to close any breach in the line.
focus_desc.csk_red_unions: Strikes in the mines and the steelworks show who keeps the factories running.
focus_desc.csk_republic_restored: The democrats will not accept rule without parliament. They rise to give the country back its constitution.
focus_desc.csk_return_to_prague: The government comes home to a liberated capital. The Republic is restored.
focus_desc.csk_road_to_the_east: A road and a railway across Slovakia to Ruthenia tie the far east of the country to the rest.
focus_desc.csk_ruthenian_autonomy: The poorest corner of the Republic was promised self-rule in the peace treaty. Keep the promise.
focus_desc.csk_skoda_export: Škoda and Zbrojovka sell to Romania, Yugoslavia, Iran and South America. Every sale keeps the lines warm and brings friends.
focus_desc.csk_skoda_pilsen: Škoda builds guns, locomotives and cars for half of Europe. New halls at Plzeň turn more of it to our own army.
focus_desc.csk_slovak_question: Slovaks were promised a partnership. Many now feel ruled from Prague by Czech officials.
focus_desc.csk_slovak_uprising: The army in Slovakia and the partisans rise together in the central mountains.
focus_desc.csk_southern_line: Austria and Hungary are not our friends. The Danube and the Moravian south need their own bunkers.
focus_desc.csk_soviet_bombers: The Soviet pact brings fast modern bombers and a licence to build them as the Avia B-71.
focus_desc.csk_staff_college: The Prague War College trains staff officers for a war on several fronts at once.
focus_desc.csk_state_defence_act: A law that lets the state organise the whole country for war: the border districts, the factories and the people.
focus_desc.csk_sudeten_question: Three million Germans live along the borders. A party that looks to Berlin now speaks for most of them.
focus_desc.csk_syrovy_cabinet: The one-eyed general of the Siberian legions takes the premiership. The army's opponents will not yield quietly.
focus_desc.csk_technical_universities: Prague and Brno train engineers famous across the continent. Give their laboratories the state's orders.
focus_desc.csk_trust_the_allies: France is bound by treaty to defend us, and Moscow if France does. Our safety lies in Paris.
focus_desc.csk_vienna_talks: Austria fears Berlin as much as we do. Its chancellor may listen.
focus_desc.csk_vitkovice_steel: The ironworks at Vítkovice by Ostrava are the backbone of our heavy industry. More furnaces mean more armour plate.
focus_desc.csk_western_camp: Join the democracies openly, as an ally rather than a client.
focus_desc.csk_will_to_fight: Treaties are paper. The forts are concrete and the army is mobilised. If no one comes, we fight anyway.
focus_desc.csk_zbrojovka_brno: The Brno arms works make the rifles and machine guns that half the world's small armies buy. Its lines should serve us first.
focus_desc.csk_zilina_autonomy: Give Slovakia its own government and assembly within the state. The Hlinka party will hold us to it.
focus_desc.deu_africa_corps: Send a motorised corps under Rommel to North Africa to prop up the Italians.
focus_desc.deu_airborne: Develop the equipment and tactics for troops landing behind enemy lines by parachute and glider.
focus_desc.deu_anti_comintern: Sign a pact with Japan against the Communist International. Its secret annex is aimed at the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.deu_armaments_ministry: Fritz Todt takes over a new ministry to coordinate arms production.
focus_desc.deu_army_command_reform: Rebuild the General Staff on a new footing under officers who can be trusted.
focus_desc.deu_army_misgivings: The generals fear a hasty war will ruin the country. Doubt about the regime spreads through the officer corps.
focus_desc.deu_arsenal: Open more munitions and weapons plants to keep pace with the army's growth.
focus_desc.deu_austria_question: Prepare to press Vienna for union with Germany. Austria's own Nazi movement grows stronger.
focus_desc.deu_autobahn: Put the unemployed to work on a national motorway network. Wide roads will also speed the army's movements.
focus_desc.deu_balkan_partners: Bring Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria and Yugoslavia into the pact to secure the southeastern flank and its oil.
focus_desc.deu_ball_bearing_defence: Scatter the ball-bearing and aircraft plants so no one raid can stop them.
focus_desc.deu_barbarossa_first: Turn east first. Grain, oil and the Ukrainian plains are the prize; the western powers can wait.
focus_desc.deu_battle_fleet: Build a fleet of battleships and cruisers able to face the Royal Navy on the open sea.
focus_desc.deu_blitz_doctrine: Deep thrusts, radio command and air support: break through, then keep going.
focus_desc.deu_bohemia_question: Put pressure on what is left of Czechoslovakia, stripped of its border forts at Munich.
focus_desc.deu_buna: Set up mass production of Buna synthetic rubber, so the wheels keep turning if imports are cut off.
focus_desc.deu_channel_assault: Draw up the crossing of the Channel: landing craft, ports and an air umbrella over the narrow sea.
focus_desc.deu_chemicals: Expand the plants that make explosives and synthetic materials, and fund process research.
focus_desc.deu_coal_to_liquid: Add Bergius coal-hydrogenation plants to feed the fuel-starved forces.
focus_desc.deu_collab_states: Rule through local administrations that cooperate with Berlin. Quieter, but the profit is smaller.
focus_desc.deu_combined_arms: Train tanks, infantry, artillery and aircraft to fight together under one command.
focus_desc.deu_constitution: Revive parliament and elections and hand power to a civilian government. The regime's loyalists take up arms, and the rule of law has to be won in a civil war.
focus_desc.deu_danzig_question: Prepare to demand the Free City of Danzig and a road and railway across the Polish Corridor.
focus_desc.deu_dispersal: Move exposed western factories deep into the east and spread them out against bombing.
focus_desc.deu_dive_bombers: Give priority to developing and using dive bombers that support the ground forces closely.
focus_desc.deu_east_war: With the West settled, draw up the plan to invade the Soviet Union. Army and economy turn east.
focus_desc.deu_eastern_bulwark: Guarantee Poland and the Baltic states and fortify the eastern frontier against any Soviet push west.
focus_desc.deu_eastern_stand: Dig in along the eastern front and hold every foot.
focus_desc.deu_extraction: Take coal, steel and food from the occupied economies by order.
focus_desc.deu_factory_cells: In Hamburg, the Ruhr and Berlin the old union men organise quietly under the Labour Front's nose.
focus_desc.deu_fall_gelb: Concentrate on the West. Manstein's plan sends the armoured spearhead through the Ardennes toward the Channel.
focus_desc.deu_finnish_transit: Seek the right to move troops across Finland to northern Norway. After the Winter War, Helsinki is looking for a patron.
focus_desc.deu_flak_arm: Raise anti-aircraft guns around the cities and plants.
focus_desc.deu_flying_bomb: Develop the pulse-jet flying bomb for long-range bombardment.
focus_desc.deu_four_year_plan: Put raw-material self-sufficiency and arms output first, so the economy is ready for war within four years. Consumer goods come second.
focus_desc.deu_garrison_policy: Leave second-line divisions behind to hold the rear.
focus_desc.deu_generalplan_economy: An economic staff for the east takes over grain, coal and oil in the occupied lands.
focus_desc.deu_german_october: The party calls the rising it failed to win in 1923. A red Germany is proclaimed in the industrial cities, and the Reich goes to civil war.
focus_desc.deu_goering_empire: Goering's state combine seizes ore and steel, at the price of waste and favouritism.
focus_desc.deu_heavy_tanks: Order the Tiger heavy tank, with thick armour and the long 88 mm gun. The first vehicles go to the proving units.
focus_desc.deu_iberian_gambit: Court Franco for a passage to Gibraltar and a closed western Mediterranean.
focus_desc.deu_infantry: Raise more infantry divisions and set up regional replacement battalions to fill losses quickly.
focus_desc.deu_jet_priority: Put every scarce engine and test pilot into the Me 262, whatever the cost in numbers.
focus_desc.deu_jet_programme: Hand the first Me 262 jet fighters to the test units, backed by a jet-engine project.
focus_desc.deu_kwi: Raise the budget of the Kaiser Wilhelm Society's institutes, fostering both basic and applied research.
focus_desc.deu_labour_service: Draft labour from the occupied lands to build plants and rail.
focus_desc.deu_last_levy: Call up the last reserves: boys and old men.
focus_desc.deu_late_war_standardise: Cut the number of types in production and press the plants to a few proven designs.
focus_desc.deu_loyalty_oath: Tie every officer to the leader by personal oath and purge the doubtful.
focus_desc.deu_luftwaffe: Equip the air force, revealed to the world in 1935, with new fighters and bombers in large numbers.
focus_desc.deu_machine_tools: Standardize machine tools and parts so factories can share work and run more efficiently.
focus_desc.deu_mass_fighters: Keep the proven Bf 109 piston fighters coming in large numbers to defend the Reich.
focus_desc.deu_med_strategy: Make the Mediterranean the main theatre: back Italy, strike at Malta and Suez, and cut the British route to the East.
focus_desc.deu_memel_question: Prepare to demand the return of the Memel Territory, ruled by Lithuania since 1923.
focus_desc.deu_moscow_envoy: Open talks with the ideological enemy. Neither side wants its hands tied over Poland.
focus_desc.deu_motorized: Form truck-borne infantry divisions that can keep pace with the panzers.
focus_desc.deu_mountain: Refine the organization and kit of the mountain divisions trained for alpine warfare.
focus_desc.deu_negotiated_end: Open talks to end the war in the West and begin rebuilding.
focus_desc.deu_new_order_europe: Offer the client states a place in a German-led European economic order.
focus_desc.deu_night_fighter: Form dedicated night-fighter wings of Bf 110s, guided by ground radar.
focus_desc.deu_occupation_office: A central office to run the lands the army has overrun.
focus_desc.deu_pact_of_steel: Conclude a military alliance with Italy: if one goes to war, the other fights alongside.
focus_desc.deu_panzer_arm: Build up an arm that groups tanks into independent panzer divisions instead of spreading them among the infantry.
focus_desc.deu_panzer_school: Train tank crews and commanders in a single school, from Wunsdorf to the field.
focus_desc.deu_plan_z: Adopt a building programme for a large fleet of battleships and carriers by the mid-1940s.
focus_desc.deu_polish_alignment: Draw Poland into an anti-Soviet bloc and settle Danzig at the table. Germany's gaze turns east.
focus_desc.deu_radar_net_2: A belt of radar, searchlights and night-fighter control stations across the north-west.
focus_desc.deu_rail_repair: Standing repair columns keep the rail net moving under bombing.
focus_desc.deu_rearm_industry: Ignore the Versailles arms limits and add weapons plants. Rearmament, once hidden, is now out in the open.
focus_desc.deu_red_front: The old Red Front fighters dig up their rifles. The workers' districts start to answer to the party, not to the block wardens.
focus_desc.deu_red_underground: The banned Communist Party lives on in cellars and allotment huts. Its couriers bring leaflets from Prague and keep the cells in touch.
focus_desc.deu_reichskomm: Place the occupied lands under Reich commissars and bind them tightly to Berlin.
focus_desc.deu_resistance_circle: Officers and civil servants who have turned against the regime start to meet in secret.
focus_desc.deu_rhineland: Send troops into the demilitarized Rhineland. It breaks the Locarno Treaty, but Berlin wagers the Western powers will not act.
focus_desc.deu_rocket_site: Build the rocket research station on the Baltic coast under von Braun.
focus_desc.deu_rome_berlin: Reach out to Italy, isolated after its invasion of Ethiopia. The two regimes agree to keep their foreign policies in step.
focus_desc.deu_ruhr: Raise output in the coalfields and steelworks of the Ruhr, the heart of rearmament in the west.
focus_desc.deu_salzgitter: Build a large state steelworks at Salzgitter to smelt low-grade German iron ore.
focus_desc.deu_september_plan: A circle of officers plans to remove the regime before it drags the country into war. If it works, the army will form a provisional government.
focus_desc.deu_silesia: Expand the mines and works of Silesia to share the load of the western industrial belt.
focus_desc.deu_speer_ministry: Albert Speer cuts the maze of authorities, standardises designs and pushes output up.
focus_desc.deu_staff_college: Widen the War Academy's courses to produce staff officers able to run divisions and corps.
focus_desc.deu_standard_tank: Settle on one workhorse, the Panzer IV, and build it in numbers instead of chasing quality.
focus_desc.deu_static_defence: Hold ground in depth with prepared lines and counter-attack reserves.
focus_desc.deu_stormtroop_recon: Form assault-engineer and reconnaissance detachments for the breakthrough battles.
focus_desc.deu_sudeten_question: Turn the grievances of the Sudeten Germans into an international crisis. The government in Prague is shaken.
focus_desc.deu_synthetic_fuel: Build hydrogenation plants that turn coal into oil, easing the dependence on imported fuel.
focus_desc.deu_tech_mobilization: Tie university and industry engineers to state research programmes to speed up weapons development.
focus_desc.deu_total_mobilisation: Close non-essential firms and call up women and older men for war work.
focus_desc.deu_transition: The army's provisional government restores order and eases tensions abroad, stepping out of the old regime's alliances.
focus_desc.deu_tripartite: Prepare a treaty of mutual aid with Italy and Japan, meant also to keep the United States out of the war.
focus_desc.deu_uboats: Put scarce resources into U-boats and concentrate on cutting Britain's sea lanes.
focus_desc.deu_uranverein: Pool the physicists' work on uranium fission under army patronage.
focus_desc.deu_valkyrie: Use the Reserve Army's emergency plan to take the capital and remove the leadership. It may fail, and even if it works, the regime's loyalists will fight on in a civil war.
focus_desc.deu_volksgrenadier: Rebuild shattered divisions as lean, cheap formations heavy on automatic weapons.
focus_desc.deu_volunteer_legions: Raise volunteer legions from abroad to fight alongside the Wehrmacht.
focus_desc.deu_war_college_2: Retrain the staff on the lessons of the campaigns and promote the proven.
focus_desc.deu_war_council: Hitler, Brauchitsch and Halder weigh where the next blow falls. The decision shapes every later plan.
focus_desc.deu_war_production: With war under way, switch the factories to war production and cut civilian consumption further.
focus_desc.deu_wehrmacht: Use the conscription restored in 1935 to grow the army quickly toward 36 divisions.
focus_desc.deu_western_peace_feelers: Sound out London and Washington through neutral channels.
focus_desc.deu_western_reconciliation: Negotiate non-aggression with Britain and France and lower trade barriers, putting the bitterness of Versailles behind.
focus_desc.deu_westwall: Build bunkers and tank obstacles along the western border from the Netherlands to Switzerland.
focus_desc.deu_winter_equipment: Order winter clothing, grease and tracked carriers before the first snow.
focus_desc.dnk_agriculture: Butter and bacon contracts earn foreign currency and widen trade.
focus_desc.dnk_coastal_artillery: Batteries on the Zealand coast and at the entrance to the Øresund.
focus_desc.dom_air_training: Under the Commonwealth air training plan, flying schools turn out pilots and aircrew by the thousand.
focus_desc.dom_home_defense: Coastal batteries cover the main ports against raiders.
focus_desc.dom_imperial_ties: Trade preferences, joint staff talks and family ties keep the dominion close to London.
focus_desc.dom_minerals: Surveys and state contracts open new mines for the metals the war needs.
focus_desc.dom_munitions: Government-owned plants turn out shells, small arms and trucks.
focus_desc.dom_overseas_draft: Volunteers no longer fill the ranks. Conscripts may now be sent abroad, against strong opposition at home.
focus_desc.dom_own_voice: The dominion opens its own legations abroad and speaks for itself at conferences.
focus_desc.dom_pacific_defense: The most exposed harbour gets a naval base and coastal guns.
focus_desc.dom_shipyards: Old repair yards are enlarged to build escorts and cargo ships.
focus_desc.dom_volunteer_force: Recruiting offices open, and the first divisions of volunteers form for service overseas.
focus_desc.dom_war_economy: Government controllers allocate materials and labour to war work first.
focus_desc.dom_westminster: Under the Statute of Westminster the dominion's parliament makes its own laws, and the cabinet says so plainly.
focus_desc.esn_aerospace_institute: A national institute for aircraft and engines, so that licence building can one day become Spanish design.
focus_desc.esn_africanist_dream: The officers who made their careers in Morocco dream of an empire across the Strait. After the civil war, the dream has an army behind it.
focus_desc.esn_air_academy: Train pilots at home instead of in Italy and Germany.
focus_desc.esn_air_bases: Airfields around Seville and in Morocco cover the Strait and the sea lanes to the islands.
focus_desc.esn_air_command: Give the air force its own ministry and its own chief, and stop lending its squadrons out by the dozen.
focus_desc.esn_allied_overture: Offer bases, trade and silence about the past. The coming peace will need Spain more than it admits.
focus_desc.esn_anti_comintern: Join the pact against communism. It costs nothing yet, and it says where Spain stands.
focus_desc.esn_aragon_offensive: A push down the Ebro valley to the Mediterranean would cut the Republic in two.
focus_desc.esn_armoured_division: Gather every tank Spain owns into one division near Madrid. It is small, but it is a start.
focus_desc.esn_army_of_africa: The Legion and the Regulares are the best troops Spain has, and they are on the wrong side of the Strait.
focus_desc.esn_army_reform: The army that rose is not the army that will win. Write down what the war has taught it.
focus_desc.esn_army_school: Teach staff work to the colonels who will lead the next war, and keep the best of them close.
focus_desc.esn_artillery_parks: Mass the guns under corps command, and fire by plan, not by battery.
focus_desc.esn_asturian_mines: The coalfields and iron works of Asturias are ours again. Pump out the flooded shafts and restart the furnaces.
focus_desc.esn_atlantic_islands: The Canaries are the first thing an Atlantic power would take. Fortify their harbours.
focus_desc.esn_autarky_policy: Spain will make what it needs and buy as little as it can. It is a matter of pride, and of necessity.
focus_desc.esn_axis_course: Keep close to the two powers that helped win the war. Their enemies are, for now, Spain's enemies too.
focus_desc.esn_back_to_the_hills: Spaniards have fought occupiers from the sierras before. They know the paths, and the villages know them.
focus_desc.esn_balearic_base: Majorca lies across the Republic's sea lanes. Base cruisers and seaplanes there.
focus_desc.esn_blue_division: Send a division of volunteers to fight the Soviet Union, and stay out of the war in the West.
focus_desc.esn_bomber_wing: The bombers left behind by foreign squadrons become Spain's own, with Spanish crews.
focus_desc.esn_burgos_administration: A real government replaces the technical junta: ministries, budgets and a gazette that the provinces must obey.
focus_desc.esn_canarias: Rush the heavy cruisers into service, and the Republic's blockade of the Strait is over.
focus_desc.esn_carlist_rising: Navarre rises once more, this time against the state it helped to make.
focus_desc.esn_caudillo_state: All power runs to one man, answerable "to God and to history". It is stable as long as he lives, and no one plans for after.
focus_desc.esn_church_and_state: The bishops blessed the rising as a crusade. Give the Church back its schools and its say, and it will preach obedience.
focus_desc.esn_clandestine_party: The defeated left was not destroyed. Its cells rebuild in the mines, the docks and the prisons.
focus_desc.esn_coastal_defence: Spain has more coast than army. Fortify the ports a landing would need first.
focus_desc.esn_comunion_tradicionalista: The Carlists never accepted the merger. Their circles meet again, and their regent waits for the call.
focus_desc.esn_condor_cooperation: German and Italian squadrons fly beside ours. Put Spanish crews in their cockpits and their workshops while they are here.
focus_desc.esn_cortes_law: An assembly of appointed and corporate members gives the state a parliament's face without a parliament's risks.
focus_desc.esn_crowned_spain: The king reigns with a charter, an amnesty and a government of order. Spain rejoins the monarchies of Europe.
focus_desc.esn_democratic_transition: Officers who want elections move against the regime's loyalists. It is not the quiet transition anyone hoped for.
focus_desc.esn_destroyers: Complete and refit the destroyers of the Churruca type, the backbone of any Spanish fleet.
focus_desc.esn_devastated_regions: A state office takes over the towns the war flattened and rebuilds them, one square and one church at a time.
focus_desc.esn_enter_the_war: The price is not paid, but the moment may not come again. Join the Axis and take what Spain was promised.
focus_desc.esn_exiled_right: The Catholic party that won elections before the war waits abroad. Its leader still believes Spain can be governed by votes.
focus_desc.esn_falange_autonomy: Let the Falange keep its own chief and its own programme. Its national-syndicalists will push the state further than the generals intend.
focus_desc.esn_falange_militias: The blue shirts fill their ranks faster than any recruiting office. Arm them, and the party grows with every column.
focus_desc.esn_falange_youth: Every boy in a uniform, every girl in the Women's Section. The party wants the next generation, and the Church wants it too.
focus_desc.esn_ferrol_yards: Ferrol was the first naval base to join the rising. Its slipways hold two cruisers nearly finished.
focus_desc.esn_final_offensive: The Republic's army is worn thin. Gather every corps for one blow, and end the war this year.
focus_desc.esn_first_government: Name ministers who can run a country, not just a front: a party man at the interior, a soldier-diplomat abroad.
focus_desc.esn_foreign_aid: Ask for planes, pilots and rifles. Help like this is never free, and the bill will come in ore and in favours.
focus_desc.esn_foreign_capital: Loans and machines from abroad would rebuild faster than any plan. The price is listening to the lenders.
focus_desc.esn_free_cortes: Spain votes again. The parties return from exile and from the prisons, and they have long memories.
focus_desc.esn_french_morocco: Spain holds the poorer northern strip. The rich plains of the French zone would make the protectorate an empire.
focus_desc.esn_fueros_programme: Promise the provinces their ancient charters back: local rights, a king who swears to them, and no party above the Church.
focus_desc.esn_general_mobilisation: Call up the age groups that fought the civil war. They know how; whether they want to is another matter.
focus_desc.esn_generalissimo: The generals choose one of their own as commander-in-chief and head of the state at war. Divided command has cost enough already.
focus_desc.esn_gibraltar_claim: The Rock has been British since the War of the Spanish Succession. Say aloud what every Spanish schoolchild learns: it must come back.
focus_desc.esn_guerrillas: Men who never surrendered hold out in the mountains of León, Asturias and Aragon, fed by villages that remember.
focus_desc.esn_hendaye_price: Spain will enter the war, says the regime: for Gibraltar, for Morocco, for grain and fuel and guns. The list is long on purpose.
focus_desc.esn_hispanidad: Speak to Spanish America as the mother country: culture, faith and trade, and friends in a world that may turn hostile.
focus_desc.esn_hispano_licence: The Seville works can build the Italian biplane fighter the war made famous. Buy the licence and the jigs.
focus_desc.esn_holy_see: A concordat would give the regime the Church's blessing abroad as well as at home.
focus_desc.esn_iberian_bloc: Two neutral neighbours promise to stand together, so that no one can use one against the other.
focus_desc.esn_iberian_crown: Spain and Portugal under one government. The flags change; the old suspicion between them does not, at least not yet.
focus_desc.esn_iberian_ultimatum: If Portugal will not join, it can be made to. A war goal, an army on the border, and a deadline.
focus_desc.esn_imperial_spain: With a foothold won in Africa, the regime's talk of empire is no longer only talk.
focus_desc.esn_infantry_arms: Oviedo-pattern Mausers, captured Czech guns, Italian and German gifts: standardise what can be standardised.
focus_desc.esn_ini: A state holding company founds what private capital will not: steel, ships, trucks and fuel.
focus_desc.esn_island_government: If the mainland falls, the state moves to the Canaries and fights on from there.
focus_desc.esn_juan_correspondence: The heir to the throne writes from exile. Answer him, and the monarchists in the army will know which way the wind blows.
focus_desc.esn_junta_defense: A council of generals in Burgos runs the rising for now. It keeps the peace among them, but it cannot command a war.
focus_desc.esn_labour_charter: Workers and employers in one vertical union under the state. Strikes end by decree; so does the bargaining.
focus_desc.esn_legion: Raise more banderas of the Legion and group them into divisions. They attack where others dig in.
focus_desc.esn_liberal_monarchists: A constitutional crown with an elected parliament: a programme that monarchists and moderate republicans can both sign.
focus_desc.esn_lisbon_friendship: Portugal let the rising's supplies cross its border. Turn that favour into a treaty.
focus_desc.esn_monarchist_generals: Senior generals sign a respectful letter asking for the king's return. Respectful, but signed by men who command divisions.
focus_desc.esn_moroccan_garrison: Double the garrison of Morocco. Whatever happens next in North Africa, Spain will not be caught empty-handed.
focus_desc.esn_national_aviation: Gather the planes that joined the rising, the ones bought abroad and the ones captured, into one air force.
focus_desc.esn_national_rising: The garrisons that rose hold half the country. Turn a coup that stalled into a war that can be won.
focus_desc.esn_national_union_front: The communists reach out to anyone against the regime, monarchists included, under one patriotic banner.
focus_desc.esn_naval_plan: Plans for battleships and dozens of escorts, far beyond what the yards can build. Even a part of it is a navy.
focus_desc.esn_navarre_requetes: Carlist volunteers in red berets march out of Pamplona by the thousand. They fight for God and the old laws, and they will want a say.
focus_desc.esn_non_belligerence: Not neutral, not at war: friendly to one side, useful to it, and still out of the fighting.
focus_desc.esn_northern_campaign: The Republic's northern strip has coal, steel and ports, and it is cut off from the rest. Take it before it is reinforced.
focus_desc.esn_one_peninsula: Some in Madrid talk of an Iberian union: one state from the Pyrenees to the Atlantic. Lisbon listens, and worries.
focus_desc.esn_oran_claim: Spain held Oran for almost three centuries, and Spanish settlers still fill its streets. Claim it back.
focus_desc.esn_peoples_republic: The war that ended in defeat is fought again and won. The new republic arms its workers and looks to Moscow.
focus_desc.esn_privy_council: Form a council of notables around the pretender: old ministers, bankers and Catholic leaders ready to govern.
focus_desc.esn_provisional_officers: Short courses turn students into platoon leaders in weeks. Many die in their first battle; the rest become the army.
focus_desc.esn_pyrenees_line: Bunkers along the mountain passes, in case an army comes south from France, whoever's army it is.
focus_desc.esn_rear_workshops: Small factories in Seville, Valladolid and Zaragoza turn to repairs, uniforms and spare parts.
focus_desc.esn_recognition: A government needs other governments to call it one. Start with those who are already helping.
focus_desc.esn_reconciliation_pact: Exiles of both camps meet in a neutral city and agree on one thing: free elections, and no reprisals after them.
focus_desc.esn_red_uprising: The guerrilla columns come down to the towns, and the general strike they called for finally comes.
focus_desc.esn_regulares: Recruit more Moroccan regiments under Spanish officers. The Rif has given Spain its hardest infantry before.
focus_desc.esn_requete_reserve: The Navarre battalions go home with their rifles. They drill on Sundays, after mass.
focus_desc.esn_research_council: Gather the universities' institutes into one council, and set them to work for the state's needs.
focus_desc.esn_reservoirs: Dam the rivers for water and current: irrigation for the dry south and power for the new factories.
focus_desc.esn_restoration: The king lands and the generals declare for him. The Falange will not hand over its state without a fight.
focus_desc.esn_roads_and_rails: Supplies move on mule tracks and single-line railways. Widen them before the next offensive.
focus_desc.esn_rock_assault: Siege guns on the isthmus, assault troops trained on mock-ups, and aircraft to keep the fleet away.
focus_desc.esn_second_research: The faculties emptied by war fill again: purged, watched and short of books, but open.
focus_desc.esn_seville_arsenal: The old artillery works of Seville are the only arms factory the rising holds. Expand them.
focus_desc.esn_shale_oil: The shale beds of La Mancha can yield fuel. It is costly, but it is ours.
focus_desc.esn_spanish_messerschmitt: Germany sells the drawings of its fighter but not the engines. Spanish engineers will have to make the rest fit.
focus_desc.esn_standing_army: Keep the army large after the war: a guard against invasion, a reserve for adventure, and a job for the veterans.
focus_desc.esn_strait_airlift: With the fleet against us, the columns cross by air: a few transport planes, flying all day, carry an army to Seville.
focus_desc.esn_strait_batteries: Heavy guns on both shores would close the Strait to anyone Spain chooses.
focus_desc.esn_strict_neutrality: The war has turned. Bring the volunteers home, quiet the press and remind London and Washington that Spain never fired a shot at them.
focus_desc.esn_submarines: Two Italian submarines can be transferred under Spanish names. Their crews will learn from the Italians first.
focus_desc.esn_succession_law: Declare Spain a kingdom again, with the throne empty and the chief of state its regent for life. The monarchists get a promise, not a king.
focus_desc.esn_succession_question: The state has a chief but no rule for what follows him. Monarchists, Carlists and old parliamentarians all have an answer.
focus_desc.esn_tangier: With France beaten or busy, march into the international zone of Tangier "to keep order".
focus_desc.esn_traditionalist_monarchy: A Carlist regency governs in the king's name: Catholic, local and hostile to every party, the Falange included.
focus_desc.esn_trubia_works: Spain's old state arms works can build guns and rifles under licence again, if they get steel and machine tools.
focus_desc.esn_unification_decree: Falangists and Carlists are merged by order into one party under the head of state. Neither asked for it, and both must now obey it.
focus_desc.esn_union_offer: Propose a union of equals, as in the days of the Habsburg kings: two peoples, one state, Lisbon's rights kept.
focus_desc.esn_verdeja: An artillery officer has built a light tank from the lessons of the captured Soviet ones. Fund the prototypes.
focus_desc.esn_war_doctrine: Infantry, guns and aircraft working together won the war's battles. Make it the rule, not the exception.
focus_desc.esn_war_economy: The national zone has wheat, cattle and very little industry. Count what there is and put it to work.
focus_desc.esn_war_production: Arms works run three shifts, and civilian plants turn to munitions.
focus_desc.esn_wolfram_both_ways: Both camps bid for Spanish tungsten. Sell to each, and make each pay more for fear of the other.
focus_desc.esn_wolfram_mines: The hills of Galicia hold tungsten, the metal every armour plate and machine tool needs. Every power at war will want it.
focus_desc.esr_agrarian_reform: The great estates of the south are divided among the labourers who work them, by law and with compensation.
focus_desc.esr_air_doctrine: The pilots' hard-won experience is written down: escorts, formations and the defence of the front.
focus_desc.esr_air_force: Most of the air force's aircraft stayed loyal, though many of its pilots did not. Gather what flies and train men to fly it.
focus_desc.esr_albacete_base: Volunteers from fifty countries gather at Albacete. Give them officers, rifles and a training ground, and they become brigades.
focus_desc.esr_almaden_mercury: The world's richest mercury mines are in Republican hands. Their output buys what the gold cannot.
focus_desc.esr_amnesty: Those who fought on the other side and laid down their arms are pardoned. Reconciliation is the price of a lasting peace.
focus_desc.esr_anti_fascist_front: The Republic offers its army and its ports to the powers that will fight those who armed the rising.
focus_desc.esr_appeal_abroad: A lawful government has the right to buy arms. Envoys go to Moscow, Paris and Mexico City to ask who will sell.
focus_desc.esr_aragon_council: The anarchist columns' own government on the eastern front, answering to no ministry. A model for all of Spain.
focus_desc.esr_archena_tank_school: Soviet instructors train Spanish crews on the tanks that arrive at Cartagena.
focus_desc.esr_arm_the_people: The garrisons have risen. The government can open the arsenals to the unions and parties, or try to fight with what remains of the army.
focus_desc.esr_army_of_maneuver: A reserve of the best divisions, kept out of the trenches and ready to strike wherever the staff decides.
focus_desc.esr_army_of_the_ebro: The best corps of the Popular Army are gathered into one army for the decisive battle.
focus_desc.esr_artillery_parks: Every gun the Republic owns or buys is gathered, repaired and given trained crews.
focus_desc.esr_assault_guards: The Republic's own police, created to defend it, stayed loyal where the army did not. They become the core of the first regular units.
focus_desc.esr_asturian_coal: The miners of the north, the Republic's most militant workers, dig coal for the furnaces and the trains.
focus_desc.esr_auxilio_azul: A clandestine network hides the hunted, forges papers and passes information across the lines.
focus_desc.esr_balearic_landing: An expedition from Catalonia and Valencia is prepared to take the islands back from the rising.
focus_desc.esr_besteiro_mission: A respected moderate travels abroad and sounds out the British about mediation.
focus_desc.esr_brigade_doctrine: Four battalions, a battery and their own services: a unit small enough for raw officers and strong enough to hold a line.
focus_desc.esr_brunete: Strike west of the capital to cut the besiegers off and draw the enemy from the north. The new army's first great attack.
focus_desc.esr_cape_palos: In the dark the destroyers' torpedoes can sink a cruiser the guns could never catch.
focus_desc.esr_carabineros: The customs and frontier guard is expanded into a disciplined corps that answers to the finance ministry, and sent to the front as whole brigades.
focus_desc.esr_cartagena_arsenal: The navy's yard at Cartagena finishes the destroyers on its slipways and repairs the fleet.
focus_desc.esr_cartagena_base: Coastal batteries, anti-aircraft guns and new moorings make the fleet's base safe.
focus_desc.esr_casado_coup: The council declares the government deposed and orders the army to obey it. The Communist units will not.
focus_desc.esr_cave_factories: Workshops move into caves, tunnels and quarries where the bombers cannot reach them.
focus_desc.esr_chato_wings: Biplanes and monoplanes fly together: the agile ones turn, the fast ones strike.
focus_desc.esr_cnt_course: For the anarchists the war and the revolution are one: the land and the factories already belong to those who work them.
focus_desc.esr_collectives: Villages abolish money, workshops elect their committees. The collectives feed the front, as well or as badly as they can.
focus_desc.esr_collectivised_works: The owners have fled or been driven out. The workers run the factories through their own committees.
focus_desc.esr_commissariat: A political commissar beside every commander explains why the soldier fights and watches the officer.
focus_desc.esr_convoy_escort: The fleet's main task is to bring the merchant ships with the arms safely into harbour.
focus_desc.esr_cultural_missions: Travelling libraries, theatres and cinemas go to villages that have never seen a book or a film.
focus_desc.esr_deca: A special command for anti-aircraft guns, searchlights and shelters protects the capital and the ports.
focus_desc.esr_defence_council: A council of officers and moderates governs, seeking a peace without reprisals.
focus_desc.esr_defence_ministry: The war, navy and air ministries are joined into one. Orders, supplies and appointments pass through a single office.
focus_desc.esr_defend_madrid: The rebel columns are at the edge of the capital. Trenches are dug in the parks and the university, and every district holds its own street.
focus_desc.esr_destroyer_flotillas: The destroyers finished at Cartagena join the fleet.
focus_desc.esr_ebro_crossing: Boats and pontoon bridges carry the army across the great river at night, to join the two halves of the Republic again.
focus_desc.esr_engineer_battalions: Bridges, fortifications and roads for an army that must cross rivers and hold mountains.
