focus_desc.grc_government_in_exile: The king and the government carry on the war from abroad with the fleet, the air force's remnants and the volunteers.
focus_desc.grc_great_idea_revived: Constantinople and Smyrna, the two continents and the five seas: the dream that died in Asia Minor finds new voices.
focus_desc.grc_hold_metaxas_line: The forts on the Bulgarian border will not be given up without a fight. Their garrisons will hold to the last.
focus_desc.grc_ionian_memory: Every refugee family remembers a house in Smyrna or a church in Pontus. The regime turns their grief into a cause.
focus_desc.grc_keep_parliament: Let the two great parties bargain for a cabinet, however long it takes. The street stays restless, but the constitution stands.
focus_desc.grc_kings_government: Whoever sits in the premier's chair, the palace now names the ministers of the army and navy and keeps the last word.
focus_desc.grc_land_reclamation: The marshes and lakes of the Macedonian plain become fields for the refugee villages.
focus_desc.grc_line_garrisons: Forts need trained garrisons who know every tunnel. Give each fort its own permanent troops.
focus_desc.grc_merchant_fleet: Bind Greece's ocean-going merchant ships to the nation's own transport.
focus_desc.grc_merchant_fleet_policy: Greek owners run one of the largest tramp fleets in the world from London and Piraeus. Make it serve the country too.
focus_desc.grc_metaxas_line: Mountain forts and underground galleries along the Bulgarian border.
focus_desc.grc_metaxas_premier: The small, stubborn general whose party won barely a few seats becomes the king's premier. He has plans that need no voters.
focus_desc.grc_motor_battalions: Buy what lorries the budget allows and form the first motorised units.
focus_desc.grc_mountain_artillery: Guns that break down into mule loads and go where the infantry goes.
focus_desc.grc_mountain_war: Train in defensive tactics for steep, broken mountain ground.
focus_desc.grc_mountain_warfare: Greece is mountains. Train every division to fight on the ridges, at night and in snow.
focus_desc.grc_mule_trains: No lorries climb the Pindus. Requisition mules and train the columns that will carry shells to the front.
focus_desc.grc_national_economy: Protect the young industries of Piraeus behind tariffs and quotas, and let the state set the direction.
focus_desc.grc_national_regime: No parties, no elections, one leader. The regime calls itself permanent and dates its calendar from its founding day.
focus_desc.grc_national_resistance: In the occupied cities and the mountains, resistance begins: leaflets, sabotage and the first armed bands.
focus_desc.grc_national_schism: Royalists and Venizelists have fought over the state since the last war: two officer corps, two sets of courts, coups in turn. The restored king must govern a country split down the middle.
focus_desc.grc_national_youth: Uniforms, salutes and summer camps for the young, with the leader's portrait in every hall. Membership soon stops being a choice.
focus_desc.grc_naval_cooperation: Floatplanes that can carry a torpedo, for an Aegean full of islands and enemy ships.
focus_desc.grc_naval_reform: The navy was Venizelist and was purged for it. Restore discipline and train new officers.
focus_desc.grc_neu_kings_officers: Garrison commanders are sounded out one by one. Who will march on the capital for the crown?
focus_desc.grc_neu_royal_coup: The royalist officers move on Athens to restore the king's government. The other side will fight for what it holds.
focus_desc.grc_neu_royalist_league: Officers who swore to the crown meet again in the clubs of Athens. The king's portrait comes back out of the drawers.
focus_desc.grc_northern_epirus: The Greek villages beyond the Albanian border. If the war carries our army there, it should not leave.
focus_desc.grc_ochi: Before dawn the Italian minister brought an ultimatum. The answer was one word, and the whole country shouts it in the streets.
focus_desc.grc_plas_cretan_revolt: The island of Venizelos takes up arms against the regime. Even if it fails, the mainland sees that the regime can be defied.
focus_desc.grc_plas_exiles_in_france: From his exile in France, the colonel of the 1922 revolution writes letters, receives envoys and waits for his moment.
focus_desc.grc_plas_officers_league: The officers purged after the failed coups have not forgotten. They still meet, and they still answer to the Black Rider.
focus_desc.grc_plas_officers_pronunciamento: As in 1922, the army deposes the government in the name of the nation. This time the regime's own officers are ready to fight back.
focus_desc.grc_polish_fighters: PZL builds a fast gull-winged fighter with cannon for export. Order a squadron's worth.
focus_desc.grc_polytechnic: Laboratories and new chairs at the Polytechnic and the universities, and scholarships abroad for the best.
focus_desc.grc_public_works: Roads, schools, barracks and drains: the regime builds, and wants to be seen building.
focus_desc.grc_pyrkal_contracts: Give the army's orders to the Greek Powder and Cartridge Company, whose owner sells arms to half of Europe.
focus_desc.grc_refuse_british_troops: British airfields in Greece would give Germany a reason to come. Thank London and keep its soldiers at home.
focus_desc.grc_regime_and_king: Two men who never liked each other share the state. Keep the palace informed and the palace keeps its hands off the government.
focus_desc.grc_reserve_officers: Call up the classes, train reserve officers in every town and make the mobilisation lists real.
focus_desc.grc_rifle_stocks: Every reservist needs a rifle on the day of mobilisation. Fill the depots.
focus_desc.grc_roads_of_the_north: The army's divisions will fight in Epirus and Macedonia. Build the roads and railways that take them there.
focus_desc.grc_royal_air_force: A separate air ministry, a handful of old biplanes and a plan to buy modern ones.
focus_desc.grc_rupel_forts: The Struma flows through a gorge into Macedonia. Close it with the strongest forts of the line.
focus_desc.grc_salamis_dockyard: Expand the naval base and dockyard at Salamis so the fleet can be repaired at home.
focus_desc.grc_salonika_agreement: Offer Bulgaria the end of the Neuilly arms limits in return for a promise to leave the Thracian border alone.
focus_desc.grc_security_police: A minister of public security with files on every agitator, signed declarations of repentance and deportation to the barren islands.
focus_desc.grc_shipowners_committee: Bring the great shipping families into one committee that can charter, insure and requisition when needed.
focus_desc.grc_shipping_abroad: Keep the fleet working the world's routes, earning the currency the country lacks.
focus_desc.grc_social_insurance: Collective contracts, the eight-hour day and a national insurance fund: the regime wants the workers' gratitude instead of their unions.
focus_desc.grc_state_aircraft_factory: The workshops at Phaleron can assemble and repair what we buy, and one day build their own.
focus_desc.grc_state_arsenals: No private fortunes from the army's needs: build state arsenals and keep the profits and the secrets.
focus_desc.grc_submarine_service: Six boats from French yards, and crews who know every channel of the Aegean.
focus_desc.grc_suspend_parliament: The chamber is hung and the communists hold the balance. Dissolve it indefinitely, ban the parties and govern by decree under the king's warrant.
focus_desc.grc_terms_with_rome: We cannot fight Italy and perhaps Germany too. Offer Rome a pact before its demands become an ultimatum.
focus_desc.grc_thessaloniki_port: Deepen the harbour and widen the free zone: the north's tobacco and the Yugoslav transit trade need it.
focus_desc.grc_third_civilisation: After ancient Greece and Byzantium, a third civilisation of discipline and faith: the regime's own myth, taught in every school.
focus_desc.grc_tobacco_trade: Oriental leaf is the country's first export. Find the buyers who pay best, and the ones who pay at all.
focus_desc.grc_two_continents: Our army holds what the Great Idea demanded. Annex it and let the world get used to it.
focus_desc.grc_war_college: Study the last wars and the coming one. A staff that plans instead of plotting.
focus_desc.grc_war_economy: Requisitions, price controls and rationing plans, ready in the drawers of the ministries.
focus_desc.grc_yarrow_destroyers: Order modern destroyers in Britain with the latest guns and torpedoes.
focus_desc.hun_agrarian_crisis: Grain prices collapsed and the country lives on grain. Study what can be built besides wheat.
focus_desc.hun_air_arm_independent: Take the air force out from under the army and give it its own command and schools.
focus_desc.hun_aluminium_smelting: Sell the ore raw or smelt it at home? A smelter keeps the profit, and the metal, in Hungary.
focus_desc.hun_anti_comintern: Sign the pact against Moscow and show Berlin and Tokyo whose side Budapest is on.
focus_desc.hun_anti_tank_drive: Soviet tanks outclass ours. Give the infantry guns and weapons that can stop them.
focus_desc.hun_arbitration: Put the border question to German and Italian arbitration and regain land without a war.
focus_desc.hun_armed_neutrality: Keep the army at home, the borders fortified and the great powers guessing.
focus_desc.hun_arrow_cross_rise: A former staff officer preaches 'Hungarism' to miners and farmhands. His movement grows where the gentry never looked.
focus_desc.hun_artillery_rebuilt: The treaty allowed almost no heavy guns. Order modern howitzers and train the crews.
focus_desc.hun_bajcsy_front: A former right-wing radical turned the sharpest voice against Berlin. Around him gathers everyone who fears the new order.
focus_desc.hun_bakony_bauxite: The hills of the Bakony hold some of Europe's richest bauxite. Every air force wants aluminium.
focus_desc.hun_bethlen_legacy: The former prime minister built a government party and a quiet countryside. His heirs can keep the system or bend it.
focus_desc.hun_carpathian_border: Fortify the passes of the regained mountains. The next army through them may come from the east.
focus_desc.hun_carpathian_line: Bunkers and obstacles across the Carpathian valleys, built to hold an army from the east.
focus_desc.hun_common_border: With Ruthenia regained, Hungary and Poland touch again along the Carpathians, a wall against whoever comes.
focus_desc.hun_corporate_chambers: Replace parties with chambers of trades and estates. Order on paper, though every guild wants its own seat.
focus_desc.hun_council_republic: The workers' councils are ready to rise again. This time they mean to hold the countryside too.
focus_desc.hun_croatian_contacts: Croatian separatists once trained on Hungarian farms. Renew the contacts and weaken the southern neighbour from within.
focus_desc.hun_crown_otto: Bring the claimant home and crown him in Buda. The neighbours swore to march if a Habsburg ever returned.
focus_desc.hun_csepel_cells: The great works on the island hold thousands of workers and a few dozen who meet at night.
focus_desc.hun_csepel_free_port: The Danube is Hungary's sea. Enlarge the free port and let the barges carry what the railways cannot.
focus_desc.hun_csepel_workers_won: The island's factory workers, long the left's, start voting for the arrow. Red and green fight in the canteens.
focus_desc.hun_csepel_works: The Weiss Manfréd works on Csepel Island make everything from bicycles to shells. Give them army orders.
focus_desc.hun_curb_arrow_cross: Put the Arrow Cross leader before a court and the green shirts off the streets. The right will call it betrayal.
focus_desc.hun_danube_customs: Lower the tariffs along the river first. Grain goes up to Vienna, machines come down from Bohemia.
focus_desc.hun_danubian_federation: Call the Danube states into one bloc, neither German nor Soviet.
focus_desc.hun_danubian_idea: The old monarchy was one market from the Alps to the Carpathians. A federation of its heirs could stand between the giants.
focus_desc.hun_danubius_licence: Berlin offers a licence for its new twin-engined fighter-bomber. The design is troubled, the offer is not.
focus_desc.hun_democratic_opening: Open voting in the villages keeps the government party in power. The opposition wants a real ballot.
focus_desc.hun_deputy_regent: The regent is old and the throne is empty. Parliament can name a deputy, and the regent's son is the obvious name.
focus_desc.hun_doctrine: The staff studies the last war and the new one in Spain, and writes rules for a small army on open ground.
focus_desc.hun_eastern_front: The army crosses into the east beside the Germans. Victory would pay the debts of the awards; defeat would cost everything.
focus_desc.hun_equal_rights: The treaty's limits on the army are no longer obeyed in secret; now we ask the neighbours to admit it in the open.
focus_desc.hun_eternal_friendship: Sign a treaty of eternal friendship with Belgrade to secure the southern border. Eternity may be short.
focus_desc.hun_ganz_mavag: The engine and locomotive builders of the capital can turn their halls to civilian and military work alike.
focus_desc.hun_general_staff: Rebuild the staff college the treaty forbade and train officers for corps and armies, not only battalions.
focus_desc.hun_greater_hungary_mandate: The new regime owes its rise to the promise of the lost lands. It must start collecting.
focus_desc.hun_green_shirts: Uniformed squads guard the meetings and break up the others'. The police start to look the other way.
focus_desc.hun_gyor_billion: A billion pengő for rearmament, paid by a levy on wealth, to build arms works far from the borders.
focus_desc.hun_gyor_program: The billion-pengő rearmament plan announced at Győr in 1938 pays for new arms factories.
focus_desc.hun_habsburg_danube: A king in Buda can speak to Vienna as an old partner. The two crowns could be joined once more.
focus_desc.hun_heja_licence: Build the Reggiane fighter at MÁVAG with a Hungarian engine. The hawk will fly with our own guns.
focus_desc.hun_hidden_air_force: Flying clubs, airmail and a civil aviation office have hidden a small air force. Bring it into the open.
focus_desc.hun_hold_the_carpathians: The mountains are the last wall before the plain. Every pass must be held.
focus_desc.hun_holy_crown_doctrine: Sovereignty belongs to the Crown of Saint Stephen, not to any man. The regency is only its keeper.
focus_desc.hun_honved_reborn: The army hidden in police and border guard uniforms can show its true size.
focus_desc.hun_hungarist_rising: The movement is ready to take what the ballot denied it. The army must choose a side.
focus_desc.hun_hussar_tradition: The hussars gave the world their name and their dash. Keep the spirit even as the horses give way to engines.
focus_desc.hun_imredy_government: The right takes the state by the front door. Those who held it will not all go quietly.
focus_desc.hun_imredy_turn: The National Bank's cautious president has found a new creed. He would bring the new order by law, from the top.
focus_desc.hun_independence_front: Parties, students and officers who want Hungary free of every master are ready to act.
focus_desc.hun_infantry_rearmed: New rifles and machine guns from the state arsenal replace the old monarchy's stock.
focus_desc.hun_italian_fighters: Rome sells fighters on easy terms. Fill the squadrons now and build our own later.
focus_desc.hun_kallay_seesaw: Fight in the east, talk to the West. The prime minister rocks the country between the camps and hopes nobody notices.
focus_desc.hun_land_and_factories: Seize the estates and the great works for the state, and build what the old owners never would.
focus_desc.hun_land_to_the_tillers: Break up the great estates and give the land to those who work it, the promise every democrat has made since the old kingdom fell.
focus_desc.hun_leave_the_war: The war is lost for our allies. Seek terms from the enemy before the front reaches the Danube.
focus_desc.hun_legitimist_hope: Hungary is a kingdom, and the lawful king's son lives in exile. The legitimists want the crown on a Habsburg head again.
focus_desc.hun_legitimist_rising: Those who hold power have no right to it. Loyal regiments of the west will restore the kingdom by force.
focus_desc.hun_levente: Every boy from twelve to twenty-one drills on Sundays. Call it sport; the officers call it the reserve.
focus_desc.hun_light_industry: Mills, textile and canning works give work to the villages and goods to the shops.
focus_desc.hun_mass_mobilisation: Call up the older classes and the reserves. The army must be larger than the country can easily bear.
focus_desc.hun_memory_of_1919: The brief council republic ended in terror and counter-terror. Some remember it as a hope, most as a warning.
focus_desc.hun_mobile_corps: Bring cavalry, cyclists and motorised troops together into fast brigades.
focus_desc.hun_moscow_emigres: The party's exiles in Moscow send money, orders and quarrels. Their help comes with Moscow's terms.
focus_desc.hun_moscow_relations: Diplomatic ties with the Soviet Union cost little, and Moscow holds something every Hungarian wants back.
focus_desc.hun_mountain_brigades: The regained borders run along mountains. Form brigades that can fight on them.
focus_desc.hun_national_work_plan: Gömbös's ninety-five points promise work, order and a corporate state. Half of it is a programme, half an admiration for Rome.
focus_desc.hun_otto_correspondence: Write to the young claimant at his Belgian refuge. Every letter is read in Prague, Belgrade and Bucharest too.
focus_desc.hun_polish_friendship: Pole and Hungarian, two good friends, the old saying goes. Warsaw shares our dislike of Prague.
focus_desc.hun_railway_network: Every line of the state railways runs into the capital. Add the cross lines the army needs.
focus_desc.hun_rapid_corps: Form the motorised brigades of the Rapid Corps, with Toldi tanks and towed guns.
focus_desc.hun_rapid_corps_idea: Hussars, cyclists and motor troops in one fast corps: the plains need speed more than mass.
focus_desc.hun_regency_course: Neither the street nor the left: the regent's men govern through the old parliament and keep both extremes at arm's length.
focus_desc.hun_regent_prerogatives: Widen the regent's powers to adjourn parliament and command the army, so no faction can seize the state behind his back.
focus_desc.hun_regents_hungary: A kingdom with an admiral as regent and no king on the throne. Horthy's authority holds the factions together, for now.
focus_desc.hun_renewal_party: A new party gathers the government's right wing and the rich men who fear the Arrow Cross more than they fear Berlin.
focus_desc.hun_resistance: With the capital in foreign hands, every party that wants the country back works together underground.
focus_desc.hun_revision_by_arbitration: Let Rome and Berlin draw the new line at a conference table. The land comes back without a war, but with a debt.
focus_desc.hun_revision_by_arms: No one returns land out of kindness. Name the next lost province and prepare to take it.
focus_desc.hun_revision_league: A league of societies, newspapers and a friendly British press lord keeps the injustice of Trianon in the world's eyes.
focus_desc.hun_right_radical_turn: The gentry's caution has failed to win back a single village. The young officers and the press want a harder hand.
focus_desc.hun_rome_berlin_course: Only the revisionist powers will redraw the map. Lean on both, and on Berlin more each year.
focus_desc.hun_rome_protocols: Rome, Vienna and Budapest promise to consult and to trade. Italy is the first great power to take our side.
focus_desc.hun_ruthenia_question: The poor mountain province beyond the old border would give us a common frontier with Poland.
focus_desc.hun_second_army: Send a whole army to the east to hold a river line far from home.
focus_desc.hun_secret_ballot: Extend the secret ballot to the countryside and let the farmhands vote without the steward watching.
focus_desc.hun_sigray_circle: Count Sigray and the aristocrats of the west keep the royal cause alive in parliament and the clubs.
focus_desc.hun_skilled_workers: Train turners and fitters for the arms works. Machines are bought abroad; skill is not.
focus_desc.hun_smallholders_pact: The peasants' party and the Social Democrats agree to stand together, though they agree on little else.
focus_desc.hun_st_stephens_realm: Most of the lost lands are home. The work now is to keep them, and to keep the peace inside them.
focus_desc.hun_szekely_railway: The Székely Land in the east was cut off from the rest of the country by the new line. Build the railway that joins it.
focus_desc.hun_technical_university: Fund the polytechnic in Buda and keep its engineers at home instead of in Vienna or Detroit.
focus_desc.hun_teleki_cabinet: A geographer who drew the maps of the lost lands takes the government, determined to regain them without losing the country.
focus_desc.hun_toldi_programme: A Swedish light tank built under licence in Budapest, named after a hero of the ballads.
focus_desc.hun_tolerate_arrow_cross: The movement draws workers and peasants the government party never reached. Use its noise instead of fighting it.
focus_desc.hun_total_commitment: Half-measures will bring the worst of both worlds. Stake everything on the alliance.
focus_desc.hun_transylvania_question: The largest loss of all, and the hardest. Bucharest will not give up an acre unless someone makes it.
focus_desc.hun_trianon_question: The peace treaty took two thirds of the kingdom's land. No government can rule without promising to undo it.
focus_desc.hun_tripartite_pact: Join the alliance of Berlin, Rome and Tokyo. The lost lands came from its hands; its wars may come next.
focus_desc.hun_tungsram_labs: The bulb and valve maker keeps one of Europe's best research laboratories. Its physicists can work for the army too.
focus_desc.hun_turan_programme: A Czech medium tank design, bought and rebuilt at home. It will be late, but it will be ours.
focus_desc.hun_turanian_brotherhood: Romantic scholars say the Magyars' kin are the Turks and the Japanese. The societies are small, the friendships useful.
focus_desc.hun_underground_left: The Communist Party is banned and its leader in prison. Its cells survive in the factories of the capital.
focus_desc.hun_upper_hungary: Kassa and the southern strip of Slovakia are ours again. Their schools, roads and markets must be joined to the country.
focus_desc.hun_war_economy: Put the ministries in charge of raw materials, prices and labour. The market will grumble.
focus_desc.hun_weiss_aircraft: The Csepel works can build airframes and engines. Start with a reconnaissance biplane of our own.
focus_desc.hun_western_reinsurance: Britain once listened to the case against Trianon. Keep a door open to London in case Berlin's price is too high.
focus_desc.hun_zala_oil: Drillers in the south-west have struck oil. A country that buys every barrel could soon fill its own tanks.
focus_desc.hun_zrinyi_assault_guns: Put a howitzer in a low armoured hull. Cheaper than a tank and harder to hit.
focus_desc.isl_island_neutrality: Reaffirm the perpetual neutrality declared in 1918 and steady the country.
focus_desc.ita_adriatic_zone: Trade deals and loans bind the Danube and Balkan states to Rome, making the Adriatic an Italian lake.
focus_desc.ita_aerial_torpedo: Skimming low over the water, torpedo planes put the Regia Marina's rivals in range of a cheap, deadly weapon.
focus_desc.ita_albania_protectorate: Zog is kept on as a client under Italian advisers, without the cost of a war.
focus_desc.ita_albania_union: The Albanian crown goes to Victor Emmanuel. The kingdom becomes a personal union under Rome.
focus_desc.ita_albanian_question: Albania already lives on Italian loans and advisers. The army draws up plans to take the country outright.
focus_desc.ita_allied_overtures: Quiet messages go to London and Paris. If the Axis turns out to mean a German war, Italy may not be there.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_claims: With France at war or already beaten, Rome presses its old claims to Nice and Corsica.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_hydro: Italy has little coal but many mountain rivers. New dams send power to the northern factories.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_wall: Bunkers are dug and roads blocked along the mountain frontier with France, Switzerland and Yugoslavia.
focus_desc.ita_alpini: The Alpini, recruited in the mountain valleys, are among Italy's best-trained infantry. More divisions are formed.
focus_desc.ita_ansaldo_yards: Genoa's yards expand their slipways and cranes to lay down warships faster.
focus_desc.ita_anti_comintern_pact: Italy joins the pact against the Communist International that Germany and Japan signed a year earlier.
focus_desc.ita_aoi_autonomy: Chiefs and local officials get a say in running the provinces. The empire costs less to hold, and it is less glorious.
focus_desc.ita_aoi_garrison: A strong colonial army stays in the highlands against the guerrillas, tying down men that other fronts could use.
focus_desc.ita_aoi_roads: Engineers and convict labour push gravel roads from Eritrea and Somalia into the highlands to hold the new empire together.
focus_desc.ita_armed_neutrality: Italy keeps out of both camps and makes any attack on it costly, starting with the Alpine passes.
focus_desc.ita_armistice_cassibile: Castellano signs a short armistice with the Allies under a tent in Sicily. Announcing it before the Germans can react will be the hard part.
focus_desc.ita_armoured_divisions: Tank brigades grow into armoured divisions; the Ariete and the Centauro are formed in 1939.
focus_desc.ita_army_reform: General Pariani's plan for divisions of two regiments instead of three promises a lighter, faster army.
focus_desc.ita_artillery_arm: The guns of 1918 are still the backbone of the army. New pieces and tractors replace them.
focus_desc.ita_autarky: The League's sanctions showed how much Italy imports. Mines, substitutes and home industry are to close the gap.
focus_desc.ita_autarky_push: Domestic ore, lignite and scrap are squeezed harder. It is expensive, but nobody can cut the supply.
focus_desc.ita_axis_alignment: Sanctions have soured relations with London and Paris. Closer ties with Germany promise a free hand in the Mediterranean.
focus_desc.ita_axis_staff_talks: Cavallero and Keitel meet to plan a joint war. The Italians soon learn how little the Germans plan to tell them.
focus_desc.ita_axis_war_economy: Coal, raw materials and machine tools are shared out with Germany, and civilian goods give way to war output.
focus_desc.ita_badoglio_govt: The King dismisses Mussolini and names a marshal as prime minister. The war goes on in public while talks start in secret.
focus_desc.ita_balkan_sphere: Rome still claims the Dalmatian coast promised to it in 1915. Hungary and Bulgaria share its dislike of Yugoslavia.
focus_desc.ita_balkan_spheres: Rome and Berlin draw a line across the peninsula. Greece and the Adriatic coast fall in Rome's zone.
focus_desc.ita_battle_for_grain: Rome launches a campaign to grow every grain the country eats. Bread is cheaper, but only by giving up other crops.
focus_desc.ita_battleship_programme: The Littorio and the Vittorio Veneto, laid down in 1934, are pushed toward completion.
focus_desc.ita_bersaglieri: The cycle and motorcycle riflemen get trucks and light guns, and the feathered hats go on to every motorised division.
focus_desc.ita_bonifica: The Pontine Marshes are drained, and new towns go up where malaria used to be.
focus_desc.ita_brenner_watch: In 1934 Italian divisions moved to the Brenner Pass to warn Germany away from Austria. The frontier is strengthened again.
focus_desc.ita_cape_matapan_prep: The fleet has no radar and little night training. Exercises and new rangefinders aim to close the gap before it costs us a battle.
focus_desc.ita_carrier_project: The admirals long held that the peninsula itself was a carrier. A converted liner could give the fleet aircraft of its own.
focus_desc.ita_clandestine_party: From Paris the exiled leadership rebuilds the party's network inside Italy, one trusted name at a time.
focus_desc.ita_co_belligerent: Italy declares war on Germany and fights on the Allied side as a co-belligerent. The Allies promise little but accept the help.
focus_desc.ita_constitutional_restoration: Parties are allowed again, and the Chamber is freely elected under the kingdom's old constitution, the Statuto. The Fascist militia will not accept it, and the country splits in civil war.
focus_desc.ita_corporative_state: Employers and unions are folded into state corporations. The regime claims to have found a third way between capital and class war.
focus_desc.ita_crown_council: The King gathers marshals and senators who distrust the drift toward Berlin.
focus_desc.ita_danube_diplomacy: The Rome Protocols bind Austria and Hungary to Italy's side, so that the Danube basin does not fall to Berlin by default.
focus_desc.ita_desert_doctrine: Fighting in Libya teaches officers to move by compass, carry their own water and strike across open sand.
focus_desc.ita_dodecanese_bases: Rhodes and Leros, Italian since 1912, lie on the way into the Aegean. They are fitted out as naval and air bases.
focus_desc.ita_empire_consolidation: With the Ethiopian war ending, Rome turns to its debts, its garrisons and order at home.
focus_desc.ita_factory_councils: Turin and Milan remember the councils of 1920. The workers organise again behind the backs of the Fascist unions.
focus_desc.ita_fascist_syndicates: Party-run unions discipline the workforce and send orders through the corporations, whatever it does for real wages.
focus_desc.ita_fermi_group: Fermi and his colleagues at Via Panisperna study slow neutrons. The race laws may drive them abroad.
focus_desc.ita_fighter_modernisation: Biplanes and early monoplanes give way to fighters such as the Macchi C.202, powered by a licence-built German engine.
focus_desc.ita_folgore: A school at Tarquinia trains elite paratroopers. Their first mission may be a jump on Malta.
focus_desc.ita_four_power_pact: Britain, France, Germany and Italy are asked to settle Europe's quarrels at a table. Rome offers to chair it.
focus_desc.ita_garibaldi_brigades: Veterans of the war in Spain come home with their experience and their weapons, and form armed bands in the hills.
focus_desc.ita_german_coal: Rail wagons bring the Ruhr's coal over the Brenner. Italian industry runs, as long as Berlin agrees to keep sending it.
focus_desc.ita_grand_council_check: Members of the Fascist Grand Council fear being dragged into Germany's wars and could vote to curb Mussolini's powers.
focus_desc.ita_grand_council_vote: Grandi tables a motion at the Grand Council asking the King to resume his constitutional powers. The party's own members may vote the Duce out.
focus_desc.ita_greece_ultimatum: Rome plans a short note with an impossible demand, then an advance from Albania before the winter rains.
focus_desc.ita_human_torpedo: Frogmen riding slow-running torpedoes could slip into a defended harbour and sink battleships at their berths.
focus_desc.ita_iri_reorganisation: The Institute for Industrial Reconstruction, set up in 1933 to rescue failing banks, becomes a permanent state holding in 1937.
focus_desc.ita_istrian_bauxite: The bauxite of Istria can supply the aluminium the aircraft factories need.
focus_desc.ita_leave_league: The League that punished Italy over Ethiopia has nothing more to offer Rome. Italy gives notice that it is leaving.
focus_desc.ita_libya_colonisation: Balbo ships twenty thousand farming families to Libya in convoys. Villages with Italian names appear on the coastal plain.
focus_desc.ita_libyan_road: A road along the whole Libyan coast, opened in 1937, links the Tunisian border with the Egyptian one.
focus_desc.ita_m_series_tank: Ansaldo builds a medium tank with a bigger gun and thicker armour, to replace the tankettes that fell short in Africa.
focus_desc.ita_macchi_series: A liquid-cooled engine, copied from the German DB 601, lets the Macchi C.202 stand up to Allied fighters.
focus_desc.ita_malta_assault: Combined landing and parachute plans are drawn up to take the island by storm, as the Comando Supremo studied it in 1942.
focus_desc.ita_malta_question: Malta lies sixty miles from Sicily and sits across every convoy to Libya. Staff planners ask what it would take to remove the problem.
focus_desc.ita_malta_siege: Air and submarine pressure on the island's supply line may starve it without risking the fleet in a landing.
focus_desc.ita_marconi_radar: The Navy and the radio labs finally put money into a set that can see ships and aircraft at night.
focus_desc.ita_mare_nostrum: The navy argues that Italy's fate will be decided at sea. Slipways and naval research come first.
focus_desc.ita_mediterranean_pact: Gentlemen's agreements with the other sea powers secure the status quo and keep the trade routes open.
focus_desc.ita_motor_industry: Fiat, Lancia and Alfa Romeo are asked for trucks and tanks instead of cars.
focus_desc.ita_motorised_divisions: Trucked infantry divisions such as the Trento and the Trieste are meant to keep pace with the tanks.
focus_desc.ita_nile_ambition: If the Delta falls, Egypt's cotton, the canal and the oil routes of the Middle East lie open to Rome.
focus_desc.ita_non_belligerence: Germany is at war, but Italy's army and stockpiles are not ready. Rome declares itself neither neutral nor at war.
focus_desc.ita_northern_arsenal: Most of Italy's heavy industry lies around Turin, Milan and Genoa. New arms works go up in the Po valley.
focus_desc.ita_parallel_war: Rome means to fight its own war beside Germany's, for its own aims in the Balkans and Africa.
focus_desc.ita_partisan_war: Bands in the mountains and the northern cities take up arms against the occupation. The two Italies fight each other too.
focus_desc.ita_rationalise_fiat: Turin's plants are reorganised around standard parts. Lorries and engines come out faster and in more numbers.
focus_desc.ita_red_insurrection: The northern cities rise and proclaim a people's republic. The regime sends in the army, and Italy goes to civil war.
focus_desc.ita_regia_aeronautica: The air force that set flying records in the 1930s needs modern types and spare parts for a long war.
focus_desc.ita_republic_referendum: The people vote on monarchy or republic. Whatever the result, the House of Savoy has to answer for the Duce's twenty years, and the losing side takes up arms.
focus_desc.ita_research_council: The National Research Council, long chaired by Marconi, steers universities and laboratories toward the state's needs.
focus_desc.ita_royal_dictatorship: The King keeps the marshal's cabinet and rules without the party. The Duce's loyalists take up arms against the crown.
focus_desc.ita_salo_republic: With German backing, Mussolini sets up a rump state in the north. It holds on to the Axis, and to little else.
focus_desc.ita_savoia_bombers: The three-engined SM.79 is fast and tough. Its crews are trained for both high-level and low-level raids.
focus_desc.ita_semovente: The industry cannot build enough tanks, so a gun on the existing hull becomes the cheaper answer.
focus_desc.ita_sicilian_narrows: Between Sicily and Tunisia the sea narrows to about 150 km. Batteries on Sicily and Pantelleria can close it.
focus_desc.ita_spain_expedition: Franco's Nationalists ask Rome for help. A corps of Italian volunteers can be raised and shipped across.
focus_desc.ita_steel_pact: Ciano and the German foreign minister draft a full alliance that binds each country to join the other's wars.
focus_desc.ita_stresa_revival: In 1935 Italy, Britain and France agreed at Stresa to stand together against German rearmament. Rome could return to that line.
focus_desc.ita_submarine_arm: Italy already has one of the largest submarine fleets in the world. Newer boats and trained crews are added.
focus_desc.ita_suez_push: Mussolini wants the canal. A motorised thrust along the coast road from Libya is the way to reach it.
focus_desc.ita_suez_question: At war with Britain, the army in Libya can strike east into Egypt and toward the canal.
focus_desc.ita_synthetic_fuel: ANIC, a state company founded in 1936, builds hydrogenation refineries at Bari and Livorno.
focus_desc.ita_taranto_defence: The fleet's main anchorage lacks anti-aircraft guns and torpedo nets. A raid from a carrier could catch it at its moorings.
focus_desc.ita_tobruk_line: The coastal fortress guards the road east. Its works are strengthened and its garrison trained for a long siege.
focus_desc.ita_torpedo_bombers: SM.79 bombers fitted with torpedoes form the first aerial torpedo squadrons in 1940.
focus_desc.ita_tripartite_entry: In Berlin, Germany, Italy and Japan sign a pact recognising each other's spheres in Europe and East Asia.
focus_desc.ita_university_labs: The state funds new university laboratories and ties their work to the National Research Council's programme.
focus_desc.ita_vatican_concordat: Relations with the Holy See, settled in 1929, are given new weight. Church and regime spare each other for the time being.
focus_desc.ita_volunteer_corps: The lessons of the volunteer corps in Spain are put into a standing expeditionary force with its own staff.
focus_desc.ita_war_booty: Repair teams follow the front to put captured trucks, guns and fuel back into service.
focus_desc.ita_western_reconciliation: A government without Mussolini can step back from Berlin and offer London and Paris pacts of non-aggression.
focus_desc.jpn_after_february: Punish the mutinous officers and seat a new cabinet to calm the capital. In return, the army wants a larger share of power.
focus_desc.jpn_agrarian_cause: Soldiers write home and hear that their families are starving. The villages petition the throne, and the officers carry their letters.
focus_desc.jpn_aircraft_industry: Steer military orders to the private aircraft makers and expand their airframe and engine plants.
focus_desc.jpn_amphibious_arm: Army and navy shipping units practise landings and fixed procedures for the beach.
focus_desc.jpn_amur_railways: Strategic lines are laid to the border rivers, with sidings to carry whole armies. The offensive no longer starves at the railhead.
focus_desc.jpn_anti_comintern_pact: Sign a pact with Germany against the Communist International, with a secret annex aimed at the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.jpn_army_air_reform: Air regiments are regrouped into larger air divisions with a better supply tail.
focus_desc.jpn_army_air_service: Expand the fighter and bomber units that support the land fronts on the continent, and their airfields.
focus_desc.jpn_army_modernisation: Replace infantry weapons and guns with newer models and rework outdated formations and training.
focus_desc.jpn_army_navy_accord: The army and navy, long at odds over budgets and policy, agree how to share operations and resources.
focus_desc.jpn_banzai_defence: Garrisons dig in on mandate islands with caves, bunkers and fixed guns.
focus_desc.jpn_battleship_priority: Believing big-gun battleships will decide the decisive battle, put battleship construction first.
focus_desc.jpn_cabinet_purge: The old ministers and their senior advisers are sent into retirement. The offices are handed to men of the Imperial Way.
focus_desc.jpn_capital_rising: Before dawn, regiments close the ministries, the telephone exchange and the approaches to the palace. By evening the plotters hold the capital, and the loyal garrisons march on them in a civil war.
focus_desc.jpn_captured_arms: Repair the enemy weapons and vehicles taken in battle and issue them to units that are short of equipment.
focus_desc.jpn_carrier_decisive: The carrier groups are massed for one great fleet action.
focus_desc.jpn_carrier_strike_force: Bring the carriers together into one force and learn to strike enemy fleets from long range with their aircraft.
focus_desc.jpn_china_escalate: The army commits large forces along the coast and the rivers to force a decision.
focus_desc.jpn_china_incident: A clash near Beijing in July 1937 forces Tokyo to choose how large the fight will be.
focus_desc.jpn_china_localise: Tokyo accepts a local settlement and holds the army back from a wider war.
focus_desc.jpn_china_priority: With the Pacific quiet, every spare division and every yen goes to the continent. The war in China is to be finished, not merely managed.
focus_desc.jpn_china_settlement: End the fighting with China and withdraw from the occupied areas, seeking economic rights at the table instead.
focus_desc.jpn_communist_underground: After the mass arrests a few cadres remain. They rebuild the party from the student circles and the docks.
focus_desc.jpn_continental_railways: South Manchuria Railway engineers extend trunk lines to carry troops and ore.
focus_desc.jpn_control_faction: Army staff officers around Nagata Tetsuzan and Tōjō Hideki favour a planned state under bureaucratic control and an orderly path to total war.
focus_desc.jpn_cooperative_diplomacy: Return to a diplomacy that guards Japan's interests inside the treaty order built with Britain and America.
focus_desc.jpn_coprosperity_sphere: Japan builds a bloc of dependent governments and partners under its lead in Asia.
focus_desc.jpn_court_friends: A few men near the throne hear the plotters out and say nothing to the ministers. The old establishment loses some of its quiet backing.
focus_desc.jpn_east_indies: Oil fields in Sumatra and Borneo become the target of a rapid advance.
focus_desc.jpn_edict_route: The plotters choose to rule in the Emperor's name through decrees rather than through a rising. It is slower, and it needs a real following.
focus_desc.jpn_emergency_decree: A decree suspends the ordinary working of the cabinet. Ministers who object find that they no longer have a seat.
focus_desc.jpn_far_east_offensive: Armoured and infantry divisions are massed on the Amur and Ussuri. New arsenals in Manchuria are ordered to work through the winter.
focus_desc.jpn_firepower_doctrine: Staff officers push for artillery, tanks and supply to reduce losses.
focus_desc.jpn_fleet_compact: The Navy Ministry is promised its building programme in full. The admirals are given ships in exchange for silence.
focus_desc.jpn_fuel_rationing: Fuel is rationed to civilians and the services to stretch scarce stocks.
focus_desc.jpn_fuel_reserve: Fill storage tanks with oil for the navy and army ahead of time, buying time should imports stop.
focus_desc.jpn_garrison_units: Raise more garrison units to guard railways and towns in occupied areas, freeing field divisions for the front.
focus_desc.jpn_hardline_cabinet: The cabinet that kept negotiating resigns and a serving general becomes prime minister. A deadline is set: if diplomacy fails, war.
focus_desc.jpn_hawaii_operation: A plan to strike the US Pacific Fleet at Hawaii with carriers first and so guard the flank of the southern campaign.
focus_desc.jpn_heavy_industry: Pour capital and materials into steel, machinery and chemicals to widen the heavy industry that arms production rests on.
focus_desc.jpn_imperial_conference: The leaders meet before the Emperor to settle the line of the state: war, or more talks.
focus_desc.jpn_imperial_headquarters: The army and navy staffs and the cabinet meet in liaison conferences to run one war.
focus_desc.jpn_imperial_rule: The cabinet is dissolved and the Emperor's direct rule is proclaimed, with the young officers as his ministers. The garrisons loyal to the old order march against them, and the empire goes to civil war.
focus_desc.jpn_independence_burma: Nominally independent governments in Burma and elsewhere take on daily administration.
focus_desc.jpn_indochina_bases: With France fallen, demand the use of the airfields and ports of French Indochina.
focus_desc.jpn_island_airfields: Airstrips and anti-aircraft posts are laid out across the island chain.
focus_desc.jpn_jet_attempt: Engineers copy and adapt a captured German design in a race against the bombing.
focus_desc.jpn_jungle_training: Study fighting in hot, wet forest and swamp, and train to move on little supply.
focus_desc.jpn_kamikaze_corps: Late in a losing war, pilots are ordered into crash attacks on ships. The tactic costs lives, trained crews and morale.
focus_desc.jpn_kodoha_faction: Younger officers of the Imperial Way, close to Araki Sadao, press for direct action and a national renovation in the Emperor's name.
focus_desc.jpn_konoe_cabinet2: Prince Konoe stays in office and seeks a settlement with Washington before the oil runs out.
focus_desc.jpn_kwantung_autonomy: The Kwantung Army acts on its own judgement, and Tokyo follows the facts it creates.
focus_desc.jpn_kwantung_backing: Staff officers in Manchuria promise to follow the plotters. Their garrison is the strongest in the empire, and they will want to be paid for it.
focus_desc.jpn_kwantung_reinforcement: Build forts along the border between Manchukuo and the Soviet Union and give the Kwantung Army more men and equipment.
focus_desc.jpn_kwantung_settlement: The Kwantung Army is given its own budget line, its own border works and a promise that it will not be recalled. It no longer needs to threaten.
focus_desc.jpn_last_stand: The remaining forces and a mobilised population are gathered to meet an invasion of the home islands.
focus_desc.jpn_leave_axis: Wind down the commitments to Germany one by one and choose a course that keeps Japan out of Europe's war.
focus_desc.jpn_long_lance: The oxygen-fed torpedo outranges its rivals and leaves no wake.
focus_desc.jpn_malaya_campaign: Landings in the north of the peninsula open the road to Singapore.
focus_desc.jpn_manchukuo_industry: A five-year plan led by Japanese capital and officials develops Manchukuo's coal and steel, leaving Manchukuo even less say.
focus_desc.jpn_manchuria_development: State planners and the Kwantung Army push heavy industry and mining across Manchukuo.
focus_desc.jpn_merchant_marine: Yards turn out standard cargo ships to move troops and goods across the sea.
focus_desc.jpn_military_ministers: Restore the rule that only serving generals and admirals may be army and navy ministers. No cabinet can stand if the services refuse to name one.
focus_desc.jpn_military_police: The Kempeitai gets new posts, new powers and new files. Staff officers and admirals who talk too freely find they are watched.
focus_desc.jpn_mongol_government: Set up a military government in Inner Mongolia under local Mongol princes, with the Kwantung Army behind it.
focus_desc.jpn_nanjing_gov: Japan props up a collaborating government in the occupied east to ease the burden of rule.
focus_desc.jpn_nanjing_regime: Join with Nationalist figures who broke with Chongqing to set up a government in Nanjing over the occupied areas.
focus_desc.jpn_national_service: Conscription is extended to every able man of age, and the army doubles its yearly intake.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_air_arm: Add carrier and land-based attack aircraft and widen the training of naval pilots for war at sea.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_expansion: With the naval treaties lapsed, draw up replenishment plans for new battleships and carriers.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_landing_force: Expand and train the navy's own landing troops so that islands and coasts can be seized quickly.
focus_desc.jpn_neutrality_pact: Both sides keep to the April 1941 pact, and the northern frontier stays quiet.
focus_desc.jpn_new_order: A movement to dissolve the parties and fold every association into one national organisation takes hold of the cabinet.
focus_desc.jpn_new_york_credit: American banks lend against the new agreement, and American oil is sold to Japan again. The credit buys factories, and the factories buy time.
focus_desc.jpn_night_battle: Cruisers and destroyers train for close torpedo attacks in the dark.
focus_desc.jpn_night_tactics: Infantry short of firepower trains to close with the enemy under cover of darkness.
focus_desc.jpn_north_china_question: Efforts to pry northern China away from the Nationalist government go on. The army is ready for a wider clash.
focus_desc.jpn_north_defence_pact: Fortified lines and garrisons are built along the Soviet frontier in Manchukuo.
focus_desc.jpn_northern_crusade: The old plan of the Imperial Way is taken down from the shelf: the Soviet Far East is to be taken before the Soviets are ready. The southern advance is given up.
focus_desc.jpn_nuclear_nishina: Nishina Yoshio's RIKEN laboratory studies uranium fission with scarce means.
focus_desc.jpn_oil_negotiation: Diplomats seek a way to lift the American embargo before reserves run dry.
focus_desc.jpn_outer_perimeter: As the front gives way, redraw the islands and waters to be held and fortify the mandated islands.
focus_desc.jpn_pacific_partnership: Pledge non-aggression with America and Britain and build a framework of cooperation among the Pacific nations.
focus_desc.jpn_pacification_policy: Garrisons and military police work to hold rail lines and towns against guerrilla attack.
focus_desc.jpn_parliamentary_government: Entrench the practice of cabinets answering to the Diet. The services lose their veto over who governs, and the army's hardliners rise against it in a civil war.
focus_desc.jpn_party_cabinet: Hand the cabinet back to the majority in the Diet. The army bristles, but party politics gets a second wind.
focus_desc.jpn_party_revival: The parties return to the Diet and the cabinet answers to elected members again.
focus_desc.jpn_patriotic_leagues: Scattered nationalist societies are brought under one banner. Their meetings fill the halls and their pamphlets fill the trains.
focus_desc.jpn_pearl_harbor_plan: The Combined Fleet prepares a carrier strike on the American Pacific Fleet to cover the southern advance.
focus_desc.jpn_philippines_op: Air strikes and landings aim at the American garrison on Luzon.
focus_desc.jpn_popular_front: Workers, tenants and the left of the proletarian parties make common cause against the war and the generals.
focus_desc.jpn_radar_jpn: Army and navy laboratories finally take radar seriously and press for working sets.
focus_desc.jpn_radio_weapons: Hurry research into finding the enemy by radio waves — already behind Britain and America.
focus_desc.jpn_rare_materials: Tungsten and chromium are sought for steels and tools.
focus_desc.jpn_red_rising: Strikes in the ports turn into a rising, and soldiers' councils form in some garrisons. The empire goes to civil war.
focus_desc.jpn_regiment_circles: Reading groups in the regiments turn into cells. Captains and lieutenants who share a grievance now share a plan.
focus_desc.jpn_resource_convoys: Escorted shipping lines carry southern raw materials home.
focus_desc.jpn_rising_route: The plotters choose to move before the cabinet can act. Troops will take the government quarter in one night.
focus_desc.jpn_rural_relief: Debts are suspended and rice is bought at a fair price. The villages are the regime's base, and the regime pays them first.
focus_desc.jpn_science_mobilisation: Gather the scientists of universities and institutes around national research programmes and link military and civilian work.
focus_desc.jpn_service_reconciliation: Army and navy, staff and regime, sit at one table. The strife that followed the seizure is set aside. Only open once no breakaway war is running.
focus_desc.jpn_shipbuilding: Add slipways at the navy yards and private shipyards so that several large ships can be built at once.
focus_desc.jpn_southern_resources: Planners look to the oil, rubber and tin of South-East Asia to feed the war economy.
focus_desc.jpn_soviet_neutrality_talks: To go south, the north must stay quiet. Send the foreign minister to Moscow to negotiate a neutrality pact.
focus_desc.jpn_spirit_over_matter: Training stresses the bayonet charge, morale and endurance to make up for thin equipment.
focus_desc.jpn_state_control: The 1938 General Mobilization Law lets the cabinet direct labour, capital and materials.
focus_desc.jpn_state_plan: A planning board sets output targets for steel, oil and shipping, and the zaibatsu fill them. The economy is put on a war footing by order.
focus_desc.jpn_strike_north: Following the northern school, prepare the Kwantung Army for a campaign against the Soviet Far East.
focus_desc.jpn_strike_south: Make the southern school national policy, turn towards the oil and rubber of Southeast Asia and hurry the navy's preparations.
focus_desc.jpn_submarine_fleet: Form flotillas of large submarines to shadow the enemy fleet and wear it down before the decisive battle.
focus_desc.jpn_surrender_faction: Court circles and senior statesmen work to end the war under a cabinet led by Suzuki Kantarō.
focus_desc.jpn_synthetic_oil: Build plants that draw fuel from coal and encourage their output, so the country leans less on imported oil.
focus_desc.jpn_taisei_yokusankai: The parties dissolve into a single national organisation behind the new structure, and elections lose their meaning.
focus_desc.jpn_tank_corps: Gather the tank regiments scattered among the infantry into tank divisions with mobile infantry and artillery.
focus_desc.jpn_tech_exchange_axis: Submarines and couriers carry blueprints and samples between Berlin and Tokyo.
focus_desc.jpn_tenant_unions: Poor villages refuse their rents and stand together against the landlords. The party sends them leaflets and organisers.
focus_desc.jpn_tojo_cabinet: General Tōjō Hideki takes the premiership while keeping the army ministry, joining civil and military power in one hand.
focus_desc.jpn_tripartite: Ally with Germany and Italy: if a power not yet at war attacks one of the three, the others stand with it. The pledge is aimed at America.
focus_desc.jpn_unified_war_administration: Merge scattered ministries and control boards so that the whole war effort answers to one chain of command under the cabinet.
focus_desc.jpn_wartime_mobilisation: As the war drags on, materials, capital and factories come under government plans. Civilian consumption shrinks and arms come first.
focus_desc.jpn_washington_accord: The regime offers Washington a settlement: no southern advance, open markets for American credit, and in return no interference in China. The Pacific plans are shelved for good.
focus_desc.jpn_yamato_class: The largest battleships ever laid down carry 46 cm guns.
focus_desc.jpn_young_cabinet: Majors and colonels take the portfolios. They are inexperienced, but the country is told that the era of drift is over.
focus_desc.jpn_young_officers: Junior officers of the Imperial Way swear to act together. The faction stops talking about renovation and begins to organise for it.
focus_desc.jpn_zaibatsu_coop: Mitsubishi, Mitsui and Sumitomo expand their plants under state contract.
focus_desc.jpn_zaibatsu_levy: The great trading houses are told to hand over their profits and take orders from the state. Some obey with a smile, others with a lawyer.
focus_desc.jpn_zero_fighter: A light, long-range carrier fighter gives Japan control of the air in the first year.
focus_desc.lat_air_routes: Airlines and the air force share new fields and transport aircraft to cross mountains and forest.
focus_desc.lat_army_modernization: Foreign training missions and new manuals replace the parade-ground army of the 1920s.
focus_desc.lat_break_axis: Embassies close, Axis-owned firms come under state control and the country lines up with the United States.
focus_desc.lat_chaco_veterans: Officers who fought in the Chaco War of 1932–1935 write the army's new training.
focus_desc.lat_coastal_patrol: A small yard and a patrol service watch over the shipping lanes off the coast.
focus_desc.lat_export_boom: Coffee, meat, copper and rubber sell at high prices, and the treasury fills.
focus_desc.lat_good_neighbor: Washington has given up armed intervention in the hemisphere. Closer ties with the United States bring credit and arms.
focus_desc.lat_hemisphere_defense: Staff talks with the United States cover coastal guns, airfields and a place in a common front.
focus_desc.lat_import_substitution: Tariffs and state credit turn imported goods into home-made ones, starting with textiles, cement and tools.
focus_desc.lat_inland_rail: New lines link the ports with the farms and mines of the interior.
focus_desc.lat_national_oil: The concessions of the foreign companies pass to a state company, and the oil revenue stays in the country.
focus_desc.lat_regional_bloc: Neighbors sign a pact of mutual support so that no great power can deal with them one by one.
focus_desc.lat_rubber: Tappers go back into the forests: car makers and armies alike need rubber.
focus_desc.lat_state_steel: A state steel company smelts the country's own ore instead of shipping it abroad.
focus_desc.lat_sugar: The mills grind the cane harvest for buyers abroad under a guaranteed quota.
focus_desc.lat_third_way: The country keeps its distance from Washington and the European powers alike and bargains with all of them.
focus_desc.mck_a_voice_of_its_own: Hsinking asks to speak for itself in matters that are its own. Tokyo will notice, and the Kwantung Army will notice first.
focus_desc.mck_air_corps: Thirty volunteers go to Harbin to learn to fly. It is the start of an air force that will always have more pilots than planes.
focus_desc.mck_aircraft_works: A new company at Mukden builds army fighters under licence and trainers of its own.
focus_desc.mck_anshan_steel: New blast furnaces at Anshan turn the low-grade ore of the Liaodong hills into the empire's steel.
focus_desc.mck_anti_comintern: Signing the pact puts Manchukuo's name beside Germany's and Japan's. In Moscow it is read as a list of targets.
focus_desc.mck_army_holds_the_purse: Customs, the salt tax and the arsenals are quietly placed under officers who answer to Hsinking's own generals.
focus_desc.mck_army_of_two_hundred_thousand: From a rabble of former warlord troops the army grows into a force of some two hundred thousand. Whether it will fight for Manchukuo is the question nobody asks aloud.
focus_desc.mck_army_reform: The army was assembled from surrendered warlord troops and is still full of men who would desert at the first shot. It needs officers, drill and pay on time.
focus_desc.mck_asano_brigade: White Russian émigrés from Harbin form a brigade under Japanese officers, trained for raids across the Soviet border.
focus_desc.mck_asia_express: A streamlined train runs from Dairen to Hsinking at a speed no train in Japan can match. It is the state's favourite postcard.
focus_desc.mck_banners_revived: The descendants of the Eight Banners are called back to arms. Few of them have ever held a rifle, but the name still stirs the Manchu towns.
focus_desc.mck_benxihu_iron: The Benxihu works make low-phosphorus pig iron, prized by the arsenals, from coal and ore dug side by side.
focus_desc.mck_beyond_the_wall: The banners march for Beijing and the plain of Hebei. The dynasty came through the passes once before.
focus_desc.mck_border_truce: Joint commissions mark the line on the ground and settle incidents at a table. The Kwantung Army calls it weakness.
focus_desc.mck_chahar_banners: Chahar was a banner land of the Qing. The court claims it as part of the realm the dynasty never gave away.
focus_desc.mck_concordia_association: One mass organisation for every people of the land, Manchu and Han, Mongol, Korean and Japanese. It speaks of harmony and listens for dissent.
focus_desc.mck_cut_the_leash: A dynasty cannot take its orders from a staff officer in Hsinking. The court will speak to Tokyo directly, or not at all.
focus_desc.mck_dragon_throne: The yellow banners fly over Hsinking. The empire that ended in a child's abdication returns in a grown man's name.
focus_desc.mck_extraterritoriality_ended: Japanese residents are to answer to Manchukuo's courts and taxes. On paper, at least, the state now governs everyone in it.
focus_desc.mck_field_artillery: The army has had rifles and little else. Batteries of field and mountain guns give its divisions a spine.
focus_desc.mck_five_races_campaign: Posters, schoolbooks and the radio repeat one slogan until every village has heard it. Whether anyone believes it is another matter.
focus_desc.mck_forbidden_city_claim: The court states openly that Beijing is the dynasty's capital. Nanjing will call it an outrage; Tokyo will have to decide whether it is useful.
focus_desc.mck_fushun_coal: The great open pit at Fushun is cut deeper. Its coal feeds the railways, the furnaces and the ships bound for Japan.
focus_desc.mck_fushun_shale: The rock above the Fushun coal seams holds oil. Retorts can wring it out, at a price, for an empire that has none of its own.
focus_desc.mck_garrison_state: Every province becomes a military district and every district a recruiting ground. The border with the Soviets is the army's first duty.
focus_desc.mck_garrison_terms: The Kwantung Army may stay on the border, but the cities and the ministries are to be left to Manchukuo's own men.
focus_desc.mck_general_affairs_board: Ministers sign, but the Japanese officials of the General Affairs Board decide. Learning to work that machine is the first lesson of government here.
focus_desc.mck_gentry_councils: Merchants and landowners who sit on the Concordia's county boards begin to speak for their towns instead of for Hsinking.
focus_desc.mck_grain_for_the_empire: Japan needs rice and the army needs sorghum. Manchukuo's farms are to deliver both, whatever is left for the farmers.
focus_desc.mck_grain_requisitions: Officials go from farm to farm with quotas and scales. The army is fed; the villages learn to hide what they can.
focus_desc.mck_greater_east_asia: Manchukuo's premier sits in Tokyo among the leaders of the co-prosperity sphere. The photograph is of equals; the agenda is Japan's.
focus_desc.mck_guard_own_house: Hsinking will send grain, but not its divisions. The army stays at home, facing the border it was raised to defend.
focus_desc.mck_guns_over_mukden: The factories of Mukden and Anshan are the obvious targets for any bomber that can reach them. Anti-aircraft batteries ring the works.
focus_desc.mck_harbin_crossroads: Russian émigrés, Chinese merchants, Jewish traders and Japanese firms share one northern city. Its trade reaches from Vladivostok to Berlin.
focus_desc.mck_harbin_flying_school: A proper school with Japanese instructors and Manchurian-built trainers replaces the makeshift courses.
focus_desc.mck_hinggan_timber: Logging camps push into the Greater Hinggan range. The timber goes south for mine props and railway sleepers.
focus_desc.mck_hold_the_border: Every disputed hill and river island is to be held. The Kwantung Army welcomes the firmness; the Soviets answer with artillery.
focus_desc.mck_honour_the_protocol: The Japan-Manchukuo Protocol lets the Kwantung Army stay and defend the realm. Keeping it to the letter buys trust in Tokyo.
focus_desc.mck_hsinking_plan: Broad avenues, ministries in a style of their own and a palace that is never finished: the new capital is built to impress.
focus_desc.mck_imperial_guard_oath: The palace guard is small, but it is the one armed body that takes its oath to the Emperor and not to the Kwantung Army.
focus_desc.mck_imperial_visit_tokyo: Puyi rides beside the Japanese Emperor through cheering crowds. He comes home honoured, and more tightly bound than before.
focus_desc.mck_industrial_plan: Planners from Tokyo arrive with charts for steel, coal and machines. Manchuria is to become the workshop of the empire.
focus_desc.mck_kando_special_unit: A unit of Korean soldiers is raised to hunt the partisans in the Jiandao hills. It knows the forests and the language of its quarry.
focus_desc.mck_kangde_throne: Puyi sits on a throne in Hsinking that Japanese officers built for him. Before anything else the state must decide what that throne is worth.
focus_desc.mck_korean_partisans: Korean fighters make up much of the United Army's southern columns. One of their detachments, under a young commander named Kim Il-sung, even raids across the Yalu.
focus_desc.mck_kwantung_shadow: The commander of the Kwantung Army is also Japan's ambassador, and his staff guide every ministry from within. Any freedom must be won inch by inch.
focus_desc.mck_kyowakai_state: The Association becomes the only voice of the state, with a branch in every county and a uniform for every official.
focus_desc.mck_land_to_tillers: The estates and the settlers' farms are divided among the families who work them.
focus_desc.mck_last_levy: Students, clerks and the last farmhands are called up. They are given rifles and told that the Kwantung Army stands behind them.
focus_desc.mck_lessons_of_khalkha: Soviet tanks and guns showed on the Mongolian steppe what a modern army is. Courage was not enough, and the army must learn what is.
focus_desc.mck_loyalist_court: Old Qing officials and Aisin-Gioro kinsmen gather at the palace again. They have long memories and few soldiers.
focus_desc.mck_manchukuo_born_officials: The training institute for officials takes more students from Mukden and Harbin and fewer from Tokyo.
focus_desc.mck_manchuria_for_its_peoples: Some Kwantung staff officers, Ishiwara Kanji among them, once dreamed of a Manchuria that ran itself. The native officers take the dream more literally than its authors did.
focus_desc.mck_mandate_of_heaven: Rites long abandoned are performed again. To the old families of the Northeast they mean that the dynasty never truly fell.
focus_desc.mck_mangyo: Ayukawa Yoshisuke offers to move his whole Nissan group to Manchuria. Japanese capital will build fast, and it will own what it builds.
focus_desc.mck_mengjiang_brothers: Prince Demchugdongrub's Mongol government in Inner Mongolia shares Manchukuo's patrons and its frontier. The two can at least trade.
focus_desc.mck_military_academy: Manchukuo trains its own officers at last, Chinese, Manchu, Mongol and Korean cadets side by side with Japanese instructors.
focus_desc.mck_military_government: A council of generals governs in the Emperor's name. The throne stays; the orders now come from the barracks.
focus_desc.mck_million_households: Tokyo plans to send a million farming households over twenty years. The land they will farm already has farmers on it.
focus_desc.mck_mongol_princes: The Qing once held the Mongol banners by marriage and oath. The princes of the steppe are reminded of what they owed the throne.
focus_desc.mck_mountain_bases: In the forests along the Korean border, small bands live in log huts and dugouts. Every winter kills some of them; every spring there are more.
focus_desc.mck_mukden_arsenal: The old Fengtian arsenal of the Zhang family, once the largest in China, is retooled for Japanese patterns.
focus_desc.mck_nanjing_recognition: A Chinese government that recognises Manchukuo would make the state look less like a theft. Wang Jingwei's regime is willing.
focus_desc.mck_national_airways: The national airline flies mail and officials between the cities, and its pilots are reservists of the air corps.
focus_desc.mck_national_foundation_shrine: Tokyo asks the Emperor to honour the Japanese sun goddess as the founder of his state. To kneel is to be loyal; to refuse is to be noticed.
focus_desc.mck_national_service_law: Every young man of every people now owes the state his years in uniform. The Concordia's slogans become call-up papers.
focus_desc.mck_native_land_first: The settlement offices are told to buy only empty land. Few settlers will come, and the Kwantung Army will remember who stopped them.
focus_desc.mck_northeast_army_reborn: The regiments that left in the first winter come home to the barracks they were driven from.
focus_desc.mck_northeast_exiles: Hundreds of thousands left the Northeast after the Mukden Incident. Their newspapers and songs still cross the Wall.
focus_desc.mck_northeast_rising: Garrisons mutiny, county towns raise the old flag and the volunteers dig up their rifles. The Northeast declares that it belongs to the Republic.
focus_desc.mck_officers_council: Manchukuo's own generals, trained in Japan or in the old Fengtian army, begin to meet without their Japanese advisers.
focus_desc.mck_officers_coup: Troops of the Imperial Army surround the ministries at dawn. The Concordia men and their advisers must fight or leave.
focus_desc.mck_officers_trained_at_home: Graduates of the academy take over companies and battalions. The Japanese advisers are still there, but now they are outnumbered.
focus_desc.mck_one_party_order: Other societies are closed or folded into the Association. Its yearly congress is where the state pretends to listen.
focus_desc.mck_one_rifle: Twenty kinds of rifle in one army means twenty kinds of cartridge. The Type 38 is to be the only one.
focus_desc.mck_own_foreign_service: Legations in Rome and Berlin are staffed by men from Manchukuo, not seconded Japanese diplomats.
focus_desc.mck_peoples_committees: Committees of farmers, workers and partisans replace the county offices. The war is not over, but the mountains now govern the plain.
focus_desc.mck_qing_empire_reborn: The Emperor enters the Forbidden City not as a guest but as its master. North China answers to the Dragon Throne again.
focus_desc.mck_qing_restoration: The court strikes against the Concordia ministers and their Japanese masters. Whoever holds Hsinking at the end of it will rule.
focus_desc.mck_question_of_the_state: The court dreams of the Qing, the native officers of an army of their own, the Kwantung Army of nothing changing at all. The answer will shape everything after.
focus_desc.mck_rail_network: New lines run towards the Amur and the Mongolian frontier. They carry grain out and soldiers in.
focus_desc.mck_railway_zone_handover: The towns along the South Manchuria Railway, long run by the company, pass to the state's administration.
focus_desc.mck_rear_base_of_empire: With Japan at war, Manchukuo's coal, steel and grain belong to the war first and to Manchukuo after.
focus_desc.mck_red_northeast: The partisans come down from the mountains and the county towns rise with them. The Concordia state must fight for every valley.
focus_desc.mck_return_to_the_republic: The provinces send their delegates south. Whatever Nanjing makes of them, the Northeast has chosen China again.
focus_desc.mck_road_to_beijing: The Forbidden City lies beyond the Wall, in other hands. A Qing emperor without it is a guest in his own story.
focus_desc.mck_rome_and_berlin: Italy and Germany find it convenient to recognise Manchukuo. Their consuls arrive with trade agreements in hand.
focus_desc.mck_second_plan: The first plan built furnaces; the second must feed them. Coal, iron and grain are now to be delivered by quota.
focus_desc.mck_seek_recognition: The League would not recognise the state and Japan left the League over it. Other capitals may be less particular.
focus_desc.mck_sovereign_in_deed: When the advisers leave the ministries for good, the state that was a stage set will have to stand on its own.
focus_desc.mck_soviet_border: Thousands of kilometres of river, swamp and steppe face the Soviet Far East. Incidents there are counted by the hundred.
focus_desc.mck_soybean_economy: Manchurian soybeans feed half the world's oil mills. Every harvest is foreign currency the state badly needs.
focus_desc.mck_state_enterprise: Special companies owned by the state build the mines and mills. Slower than Nissan, but the profits stay in Hsinking.
focus_desc.mck_sungari_dam: A dam across the Sungari above Jilin will light the cities and drive the mills of the north.
focus_desc.mck_sungari_flotilla: The river defence fleet patrols the Sungari and the Amur with a handful of gunboats, the only navy the state will ever have.
focus_desc.mck_synthetic_fuel: A coal liquefaction plant at Jilin is meant to fuel the army's trucks and planes when the tankers stop coming.
focus_desc.mck_throne_asserts: Puyi never forgot that he was the Xuantong Emperor before he was anyone's ward. His courtiers begin to speak of the throne as more than a seal.
focus_desc.mck_tonghua_redoubt: If the plains fall, the court and the army will withdraw to the mountains around Tonghua near the Korean border.
focus_desc.mck_total_concordia: Neighbourhood groups, savings drives and labour service: every household now answers to the Association.
focus_desc.mck_total_mobilisation: Labour service, savings bonds and conscription reach every village. The state that promised harmony now promises only sacrifice.
focus_desc.mck_united_army_founded: The scattered partisan units are joined into route armies under the Party's command, with Yang Jingyu and Zhou Baozhong at their head.
focus_desc.mck_ussuri_fortresses: Concrete works at Hutou and along the eastern rivers face the Soviet railway. Labour gangs dig them, and few of the labourers go home.
focus_desc.mck_village_cells: Farmers driven from their land by the settlers and the collective hamlets feed the partisans, hide them and join them.
focus_desc.mck_volunteers_remembered: The volunteer armies of the first years were broken, not forgotten. Their veterans keep their rifles buried and their names secret.
focus_desc.mck_war_industries: The steel and coal are to become rifles, shells and trucks, here, close to the front the Kwantung Army expects.
focus_desc.mck_winter_on_the_amur: Units train at forty below, when rifles freeze and horses die. Men who learn to live through it will fight through it.
focus_desc.mck_xingan_army: The Mongol banners of Xing'an province ride as the army's cavalry. They fight best on the open steppe toward Outer Mongolia.
focus_desc.mck_young_marshal_letters: Zhang Xueliang lost his father's lands without a fight and has never been forgiven for it. His messages to the old Fengtian officers ask for a second chance.
focus_desc.mck_youth_corps: Young men drill in the county towns under the Association's banner. The army will find its recruits among them.
focus_desc.mex_agrarian_reform: Article 27 promised the land to those who work it. Break up the great haciendas and hand them to the ejidos.
focus_desc.mex_aid_the_republic: Mexico alone among the Americas sends rifles and cartridges to the legitimate government in Madrid.
focus_desc.mex_air_force_arm: The aviation stops being a branch of the army and becomes a service of its own.
focus_desc.mex_altos_hornos: A new blast furnace in Coahuila, built with American credit, doubles the country's steel.
focus_desc.mex_army_modernisation: Modern guns and anti-tank weapons, bought with credit or lend-lease, replace the Revolution's leftovers.
focus_desc.mex_army_of_the_north: Concentrate the best divisions in Sonora, Chihuahua and Coahuila and fortify the crossings.
focus_desc.mex_army_reorganisation: Rotate the zone commanders, pay the troops on time and keep the generals away from politics.
focus_desc.mex_avila_camacho: Manuel Ávila Camacho, the defence secretary, promises calm, work and peace with the Church and with Washington.
focus_desc.mex_axis_sympathy: Berlin and Tokyo would gladly see the United States busy at home. Listen to their envoys.
focus_desc.mex_azcapotzalco_refinery: Refine Mexican crude for Mexican trucks and trains at a plant beside the capital.
focus_desc.mex_border_grievances: Deportations, lynchings, water from the Colorado: list every wrong done along the border and print it.
focus_desc.mex_bracero_program: American farms lack hands. Send Mexican workers north under contract, with wages sent home.
focus_desc.mex_break_the_boycott: With buyers found and ships at sea, the companies' blockade is broken. The oil flows again.
focus_desc.mex_cavalry_tradition: Mexico's soldiers have always fought on horseback in the deserts and sierras. Organise them into proper divisions.
focus_desc.mex_central_american_policy: Guatemala, Honduras and El Salvador look to Washington and the fruit company. Offer them Mexico instead.
focus_desc.mex_claim_british_honduras: Mexico never fully gave up the north of British Honduras. Revive the reservation while London is weak.
focus_desc.mex_claim_the_lost_north: Texas, California and the lands between were Mexican. Say so openly, before the world.
focus_desc.mex_coastal_patrols: Patrol boats for the Gulf and the Pacific, against smugglers and, one day, submarines.
focus_desc.mex_colegio_militar: Officers trained in a school, not on the battlefields of the Revolution, will obey the state.
focus_desc.mex_com_comintern_line: Follow the International's direction closely and ask Moscow for advisers and money.
focus_desc.mex_com_party_cells: Party members take the secretariats of the railway, mining and oil unions one local at a time.
focus_desc.mex_com_popular_front: The Comintern's new line lets the Communists stand beside Cárdenas. Use the alliance to grow.
focus_desc.mex_com_workers_militias: The unions drilled their own militias in the capital's streets. Arm them properly.
focus_desc.mex_com_workers_republic: The bourgeois revolution of 1910 has run its course. The proletariat finishes it.
focus_desc.mex_corsario_licence: Build the American Corsair scout under licence at home, with Mexican hands.
focus_desc.mex_deepen_the_revolution: Nationalise the banks next, then the mines. The radicals of the party want the whole programme, not half of it.
focus_desc.mex_defensas_rurales: Arm the ejidatarios to protect their land from the landlords' gunmen, and the state from rebellious generals.
focus_desc.mex_dem_almazan_campaign: A rich general from Monterrey fills the plazas. For once the official candidate is not sure to win.
focus_desc.mex_dem_almazan_rising: The count was a lie and everyone knows it. The opposition takes up arms for the result it won.
focus_desc.mex_dem_effective_suffrage: Madero's old cry, "effective suffrage, no re-election", still means something to those who count the votes themselves.
focus_desc.mex_dem_national_action: Gómez Morín gathers lawyers, Catholics and businessmen into a party of citizens against the party of the state.
focus_desc.mex_dem_poll_watchers: Volunteers at every polling place, notaries at every count: the opposition will not be robbed quietly.
focus_desc.mex_electricity_commission: Foreign utilities serve the cities that pay. A national commission will bring power to the rest.
focus_desc.mex_escuadron_201: Mexican pilots volunteer to fight abroad. Train them on modern fighters and send them where the war is.
focus_desc.mex_estrada_doctrine: Mexico does not judge other governments or meddle in their affairs, and asks the same of others.
focus_desc.mex_exile_calles: Calles still gives orders from his ranch, and half the cabinet answers to him. Send him north and end the Maximato for good.
focus_desc.mex_expropriation: The companies have defied the courts. The president signs the decree: the oil belongs to the nation.
focus_desc.mex_fas_gold_shirts: The Mexican Revolutionary Action marches in gold shirts against Communists, Jews and Chinese shopkeepers.
focus_desc.mex_fas_hispanidad: Mexico is a Catholic, Spanish nation, say the Synarchists, not a colony of Protestant America. Look to Madrid, Rome and Berlin.
focus_desc.mex_fas_march_on_the_capital: Tens of thousands of peasants in silent ranks walk into the cities. The government counts them and worries.
focus_desc.mex_fas_new_order: The godless revolution ends. A Christian social order takes its place, by force if it must.
focus_desc.mex_fas_sinarquismo: In the Bajío the Catholic peasants who fought the Cristero war join a new movement of order, faith and obedience.
focus_desc.mex_four_sectors: Workers, peasants, the army and the middle classes now speak inside one party. Conflicts are settled within it, not in the streets.
