focus_desc.mex_glass_and_cement: The north builds what the country needs: bottles, window glass, cement for every new road and dam.
focus_desc.mex_good_neighbour: Roosevelt has renounced intervention. Test the promise and build on it.
focus_desc.mex_guard_the_oil_fields: Anti-aircraft guns and garrisons for the wells and refineries of the Gulf coast.
focus_desc.mex_gulf_escorts: German submarines hunt in the Gulf. The tankers sail only under escort.
focus_desc.mex_gulf_military_region: Tampico and the Golden Lane are the most valuable ground in the country. Guard them.
focus_desc.mex_hemisphere_defence: A joint defence commission with the United States: radar on the coasts, airfields, and American credit for arms.
focus_desc.mex_henequen_and_yaqui: Take the reform to Yucatán's sisal plantations and to the irrigated valleys of Sonora, where the old families hold out.
focus_desc.mex_institutional_revolution: The generals step back and the civilians take the party. The Revolution becomes a state that runs itself.
focus_desc.mex_isthmus_league: A pact of the republics between the Río Bravo and Panama, led from Mexico City.
focus_desc.mex_join_the_allies: Mexico is at war. Sign the declaration and take a place in the councils of the coalition.
focus_desc.mex_labour_award: The arbitration board orders higher wages and benefits, and the Supreme Court upholds it. The companies refuse to pay.
focus_desc.mex_laguna_ejidos: The cotton estates of La Laguna become collective farms run by their labourers, with credit from the state bank.
focus_desc.mex_lend_lease_aircraft: American trainers, fighters and dive bombers arrive under the lend-lease agreements.
focus_desc.mex_mendoza_machine_guns: A Mexican light machine gun for every squad, made in Mexico from Mexican steel.
focus_desc.mex_mesoamerican_federation: With Guatemala joined, the union takes a new name for the lands of the old civilisations.
focus_desc.mex_military_aviation_school: Pilots and mechanics trained in Mexico, on a proper airfield beside the capital.
focus_desc.mex_military_sector: The army gets its own seats in the party. Better a voice inside than a pistol outside.
focus_desc.mex_mixed_oil_company: Seizing the wells would bring a boycott. Force the companies into a partnership with the state instead.
focus_desc.mex_monterrey_capital: The brewers and glassmakers of Monterrey know how to build factories. Let them, and keep the state out of their way.
focus_desc.mex_monterrey_steel: Latin America's first integrated steelworks needs new furnaces and ore from Durango.
focus_desc.mex_motorised_battalions: Trucks from Detroit can carry a battalion from Monterrey to the border in a day.
focus_desc.mex_mugica: Francisco Múgica wrote the Constitution's boldest articles. With him the Revolution would not slow down.
focus_desc.mex_nacional_financiera: A state development bank to lend where private banks will not: power, steel, cement, roads.
focus_desc.mex_national_arms_factory: Expand the works in the capital that make Mauser rifles and Mendoza's machine guns.
focus_desc.mex_national_military_service: Every young man drills on Sundays for a year. The nation learns to defend itself.
focus_desc.mex_national_oil_industry: Mexican engineers, Mexican refineries and Mexican geologists: Pemex stands on its own.
focus_desc.mex_national_railways: Buy out the foreign shareholders and run the railways as one Mexican system.
focus_desc.mex_national_unity: "I am a believer," says the new president. Soften the anticlerical laws and call every Mexican to the common task.
focus_desc.mex_naval_school: The heroic naval school trains the officers who will command the new ships.
focus_desc.mex_neu_military_colonies: Old revolutionary soldiers farm their own land and still answer to their general. Count on them.
focus_desc.mex_neu_plan_of_san_luis: Every Mexican rising begins with a plan named after a town. Write one that the generals can sign.
focus_desc.mex_neu_pronunciamiento: The garrisons declare against the government in Mexico City. Order returns at bayonet point.
focus_desc.mex_neu_zone_commanders: The generals who hold the military zones decide more than any governor. Bring them into one pact.
focus_desc.mex_northern_governorates: The recovered lands need governors, schools and Mexican law. Make the victory permanent.
focus_desc.mex_oil_expropriation: The oil fields and refineries of the foreign companies pass to a state company. Washington protests, then negotiates.
focus_desc.mex_oil_for_the_nation: Cheap fuel for Mexican farms, factories and railways comes before exports.
focus_desc.mex_oil_settlement: A mixed commission can price the expropriated wells. Paid in instalments, the claim stops poisoning everything else.
focus_desc.mex_oil_workers_union: The oil workers have one union now, and one demand: a collective contract with every company.
focus_desc.mex_pacific_military_region: One command for the whole Pacific coast, from Baja California to Jalisco.
focus_desc.mex_party_of_the_revolution: Rebuild the ruling party on its sectors: workers, peasants, soldiers and the popular classes, each with its seats and its say.
focus_desc.mex_peasant_confederation: Organise the ejidatarios separately from the urban unions, so that neither can dominate the party.
focus_desc.mex_pemex: One national company takes over every well, pipeline and refinery the foreigners left.
focus_desc.mex_plan_sexenal: The party wrote a programme for the whole term: land, schools, roads and Mexican ownership of Mexican wealth. Now the president must make it real.
focus_desc.mex_politecnico: Engineers and technicians from the workers' own children, trained for the nation's industry.
focus_desc.mex_poza_rica: The richest field in Veracruz has barely been tapped. Drill it properly.
focus_desc.mex_reconquista: While the Americans fight across two oceans, the Army of the North crosses the Río Bravo.
focus_desc.mex_refuge_for_exiles: Open Veracruz to the defeated Republicans: soldiers, teachers, scientists and their children.
focus_desc.mex_second_six_year_plan: The first plan freed the land and the oil. The second must build the factories.
focus_desc.mex_secretariat_of_the_navy: The navy leaves the war ministry and gets its own secretary, dockyard and budget.
focus_desc.mex_socialist_education: The reformed Article 3 sends rural teachers into every village with a secular, socialist lesson plan. The priests call it war.
focus_desc.mex_southeastern_railway: Lay the line from the isthmus to Campeche and Mérida and tie the peninsula to the nation.
focus_desc.mex_spanish_gunboats: The new gunboats built in Spanish yards are the first real warships the navy has had in years.
focus_desc.mex_squadron: Volunteer pilots train in Texas on American fighters to fly against the Axis.
focus_desc.mex_state_led_industry: Tariffs, state credit and public works: make at home what was bought abroad.
focus_desc.mex_state_of_war: Congress declares that a state of war exists. Suspend what must be suspended and mobilise the nation.
focus_desc.mex_stay_out_of_spain: The Spanish war is not ours, and arming one side would anger Washington and the Church. Keep the rifles at home.
focus_desc.mex_supreme_defence_council: A former president becomes secretary of defence and the old rivals sit at one table.
focus_desc.mex_tanker_fleet: The companies took their tankers with them. Buy and charter what ships can be found.
focus_desc.mex_textile_mills: Re-equip the old textile mills of Puebla and Orizaba with modern looms.
focus_desc.mex_the_succession: No president may serve twice. The party must choose who carries the Revolution into the next six years.
focus_desc.mex_tnca_works: The workshops at Balbuena have built aircraft since the Revolution. Give them engines and drawings.
focus_desc.mex_tripartite_approach: A claim needs allies. Ask Berlin whether Mexico has a place in its camp.
focus_desc.mex_truce_with_calles: Breaking the old man could split the army. Leave him his honours and his friends, and govern around him.
focus_desc.mex_union_of_the_isthmus: Central America was once part of the Mexican Empire. Invite its republics to join again, freely.
focus_desc.mex_voice_at_geneva: When Ethiopia and Austria are swallowed, Mexico's delegate protests where the great powers stay silent.
focus_desc.mex_wartime_boom: The war cuts off European goods and American factories buy everything Mexico can make.
focus_desc.mex_workers_and_peasants_state: If the unions and the ejidos already hold the party, let them hold the state as well, openly and without the old forms.
focus_desc.mex_workers_confederation: Unite the unions in one great confederation loyal to the government, with Lombardo Toledano at its head.
focus_desc.mex_wound_of_1847: Half the national territory was lost to the United States in one war. Some say it is time to remember.
focus_desc.new_administration: Ministries, courts and tax offices are staffed and begin their work.
focus_desc.new_alignment: The government coordinates its policy with the state that backs it.
focus_desc.new_army: The first divisions are formed from local units and new recruits.
focus_desc.new_autonomy: The government widens its own room to act and keeps its patron at arm's length.
focus_desc.new_defense: Trenches and strongpoints go up around the capital against a first attack.
focus_desc.new_economy: New trade agreements and local mines reduce the dependence on imports.
focus_desc.new_industry: Idle plants are repaired and put back to work, and the jobs come back with them.
focus_desc.new_recognition: Envoys go abroad to seek recognition and trade agreements.
focus_desc.nld_abda_command: Dutch, British, American and Australian forces plan to fight under one command in the archipelago.
focus_desc.nld_air_cruiser: A twin-boom fighter with eight guns in its nose, built to sweep the sky over Holland.
focus_desc.nld_air_defence_command: Listening posts, guns and fighters are tied together under one command.
focus_desc.nld_allied_guarantees: Neutrality has failed or will fail. The Netherlands takes its place beside Britain.
focus_desc.nld_anti_tank_guns: Light 47 mm guns are ordered for every regiment, the army's answer to the tanks across the border.
focus_desc.nld_applied_research: A council for applied science brings the laboratories and the factories together.
focus_desc.nld_armoured_cars: A truck maker in Eindhoven designs a six-wheeled armoured car with a Bofors gun.
focus_desc.nld_army_aviation: The small army air arm at Soesterberg is to become a real air force.
focus_desc.nld_battlecruiser_plan: Only capital ships can stop a real fleet. The navy draws up three fast battlecruisers for the Indies.
focus_desc.nld_belgian_staff_talks: The two small neighbours under the same shadow compare their defence plans.
focus_desc.nld_benelux: The Low Countries stand together as one state under one name.
focus_desc.nld_bomber_squadrons: A few squadrons of medium bombers to strike at the bridges an invader must cross.
focus_desc.nld_borneo_oil: The wells at Balikpapan and the plantations of Java are pushed to give more.
focus_desc.nld_claim_flanders: The Hague demands Flanders and prepares to take it.
focus_desc.nld_cold_laboratory: In the laboratory where helium was first made liquid, the physicists of Leiden push into the cold.
focus_desc.nld_colonial_trade: The great trading houses of Amsterdam still carry the coffee, tea, tin and rubber of the Indies to the world.
focus_desc.nld_constitution_defended: If others have seized the state, the parliamentarians rise to restore it. If the law still rules, it grows only firmer.
focus_desc.nld_corporate_order: Employers and workers in each trade should settle their own affairs in councils, the movement says, and parliament should step back.
focus_desc.nld_council_republic: The monarchy is gone and the councils govern. Moscow sends its greetings.
focus_desc.nld_council_rising: Strike committees become councils and councils take the factories and the streets.
focus_desc.nld_crisis_cabinet: The slump has lasted six years. Colijn promises sound money, balanced books and calm, and the confessional parties stand behind him.
focus_desc.nld_cruiser_squadron: Light cruisers and destroyers, backed by submarines, form the striking force of the Indies.
focus_desc.nld_customs_union: One tariff for the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg: one market from the Wadden to the Ardennes.
focus_desc.nld_defence_fund: A special fund for arms, outside the ordinary budget, lets the army buy what twenty years of cuts denied it.
focus_desc.nld_delft_and_leiden: The technical college at Delft and the old university at Leiden train the country's engineers and scientists.
focus_desc.nld_delta_studies: An engineer warns that the southern islands lie open to a great storm flood and draws plans to close the estuaries.
focus_desc.nld_den_helder: The navy's home port and the private yards of Rotterdam and Amsterdam take on new work.
focus_desc.nld_dietsland: The new regime proclaims its goal: all the Dutch-speaking lands in one state.
focus_desc.nld_dietsland_legion: Volunteers from both sides of the border drill in the movement's camps.
focus_desc.nld_eastern_squadron: The fleet's best ships and best officers are sent east, where the danger lies.
focus_desc.nld_end_of_neutrality: A century of neutrality is over. The country looks across the Atlantic for its future security.
focus_desc.nld_england_farers: Young men cross the North Sea in small boats to join the forces abroad.
focus_desc.nld_field_army: The militia is called back for longer training and the regiments are filled again.
focus_desc.nld_field_artillery: Old guns from before the Great War are replaced with modern pieces bought abroad and built at home.
focus_desc.nld_fleet_law: Parliament agrees a fleet plan for the Indies: cruisers, destroyers and submarines rather than battleships.
focus_desc.nld_flemish_brothers: Propaganda pours across the border to the Flemish nationalists.
focus_desc.nld_fokker_fighters: Fokker offers a simple, sturdy monoplane fighter that a small country can afford.
focus_desc.nld_fortify_java: Batavia, Surabaya and the passes of the island are fortified against a landing.
focus_desc.nld_fortress_holland: The army will not fight for every province. It falls back behind the water to defend the heart of the country.
focus_desc.nld_forward_defence: The army stands at the IJssel and the Maas, close to the Belgians, and gives no ground for free.
focus_desc.nld_four_corps: The field army is organised in four corps of two divisions each, with their own artillery.
focus_desc.nld_general_mobilisation: War has come to Europe. The whole army is called up and stands at the borders.
focus_desc.nld_general_staff_plans: The staff works out where the army will stand, where it will fall back and where the water will help it.
focus_desc.nld_germanic_partner: The regime seeks Berlin's friendship and a place in its camp.
focus_desc.nld_gold_bloc: Britain and America left gold long ago. With France, Switzerland and a few others the guilder still holds, at the cost of dear exports and idle hands.
focus_desc.nld_government_in_london: The queen and her ministers have left for London. From there they govern the Indies, the fleet and the merchant ships.
focus_desc.nld_greater_dutch_idea: The movement's thinkers speak of one Dutch people on both sides of the Belgian border, and of a state to match.
focus_desc.nld_greater_netherlands: Flanders and the Netherlands are one. The state takes a new name.
focus_desc.nld_grebbe_line: Between the IJsselmeer and the Rhine a new line of trenches and casemates covers the Gelderse Vallei.
focus_desc.nld_hazemeyer: A firm in Hengelo builds stabilised anti-aircraft mounts that hold their aim as the ship rolls.
focus_desc.nld_hembrug_arsenal: The state arsenal on the North Sea Canal makes rifles, machine guns and shells for the army.
focus_desc.nld_hold_gold: A sound guilder is the country's honour. The government stays on gold and cuts again to balance the books.
focus_desc.nld_homeland_resistance: Underground papers, hidden people and sabotage: the occupied homeland fights back.
focus_desc.nld_hoogovens: The blast furnaces at IJmuiden give the Netherlands its own iron and steel.
focus_desc.nld_indies_partnership: The queen promises the Indies an equal place in a commonwealth of the kingdom after the war.
focus_desc.nld_indies_question: Oil, rubber and tin make the Indies the richest prize in Asia, and Tokyo knows it.
focus_desc.nld_industrial_memorandum: Farming and trade can no longer feed a growing people. The state draws up a plan to build factories.
focus_desc.nld_inundation_drills: Sappers and polder boards practise opening the sluices so that the water rises fast enough when it matters.
focus_desc.nld_joint_defence: If one of the three is attacked, the others will fight beside it.
focus_desc.nld_jordaan_remembered: When the dole was cut, the Jordaan quarter rose and the army was sent in. The party keeps that memory alive.
focus_desc.nld_jungle_school: Veterans of the Aceh wars teach the young soldiers to move and fight in the forest.
focus_desc.nld_knil: The Royal Netherlands East Indies Army holds an archipelago larger than Europe with a few divisions.
focus_desc.nld_kornwerderzand: Casemates on the Enclosure Dam shut the northern road into Holland.
focus_desc.nld_leader_state: The movement's leader governs alone. Berlin welcomes a kindred regime on the North Sea.
focus_desc.nld_leave_gold: The guilder leaves gold at last. Exports grow cheap and the yards and mills fill with orders, though savers grumble.
focus_desc.nld_left_unions: The small red unions and the revolutionary socialists agree to work together against the bosses and the government.
focus_desc.nld_light_division: Cyclists, motorcycle hussars and motorised guns form a mobile reserve to strike where the enemy lands.
focus_desc.nld_longer_service: The conscripts serve longer and the training years lost to the cuts are made good.
focus_desc.nld_low_countries_council: Ministers of the three states meet as one council and begin to speak of one state.
focus_desc.nld_lunteren_rallies: On its own field in the Veluwe the movement gathers its members by the tens of thousands each summer.
focus_desc.nld_marine_corps: The oldest marine corps in the world is enlarged and trained to land and to hold ports.
focus_desc.nld_merchant_fleet: Hundreds of Dutch merchant ships at sea refuse to come home and sail under Allied orders.
focus_desc.nld_motorise_knil: Trucks and armoured cars are bought for the mobile columns on Java.
focus_desc.nld_mussert_movement: An engineer from Utrecht leads the NSB: uniforms, rallies and the promise of a strong state that will end the bickering of the parties.
focus_desc.nld_national_concentration: With war near, the parties close ranks. Ministers from every pillar sit at one table.
focus_desc.nld_naval_air_service: Floatplanes and flying boats patrol the seas of the Indies for the fleet.
focus_desc.nld_netherlands_union: Neither the old parties nor the NSB: a broad national movement that wants unity, order and the House of Orange above party strife.
focus_desc.nld_new_water_line: The old line of forts and inundations east of Utrecht is repaired and given concrete shelters.
focus_desc.nld_north_east_polder: Pumping stations work around the clock to lay a new polder dry in the old sea.
focus_desc.nld_nsb_rising: The movement's leaders decide the state will not be won at the ballot box. The rising begins.
focus_desc.nld_old_age_provision: A pension for every old worker, paid by the state: the first stone of a welfare state built on consensus.
focus_desc.nld_oslo_states: The small trading states of the north meet to keep their tariffs low and their neutrality firm.
focus_desc.nld_ouchy_convention: The Low Countries once agreed to lower their tariffs together. The idea is taken out of the drawer again.
focus_desc.nld_party_line: A disciplined party with one line and one leader prepares for the hour when the state can be taken.
focus_desc.nld_pernis_refinery: Royal Dutch Shell refines the Indies crude at Rotterdam, and the state puts by a reserve of fuel.
focus_desc.nld_philips_eindhoven: The light-bulb and radio-valve works of Eindhoven is one of the great electrical firms of Europe.
focus_desc.nld_pillars_hold: Catholics, Protestants, socialists and liberals each live in their own world of papers, schools and clubs. Their leaders agree at the top, and the country stays quiet.
focus_desc.nld_plan_of_labour: Economists of the labour movement draw up a plan of public investment to put the unemployed to work instead of waiting for the market.
focus_desc.nld_policy_of_independence: No alliances, no guarantees: the Netherlands kept out of the last war this way and means to keep out of the next.
focus_desc.nld_radio_oranje: The queen's voice on the radio tells the people that the Netherlands will not give up.
focus_desc.nld_rearmament_credits: Parliament votes credit after credit for arms; the works run day and night.
focus_desc.nld_rebuild_the_netherlands: The dikes, the ports and the bridges must be rebuilt, and the country with them.
focus_desc.nld_red_netherlands: In the docks of Amsterdam and the peat colonies of the north the communists find the poor that the pillars forgot.
focus_desc.nld_relief_works: The unemployed dig canals, build roads and raise dikes for their benefit money.
focus_desc.nld_rhine_port: Half of Germany's trade passes through Rotterdam. New quays and basins bring the port back to life.
focus_desc.nld_rijkswaterstaat: The state's water engineers build roads, bridges and locks as well as dikes.
focus_desc.nld_rule_of_law: The constitution, the States General and the queen remain the frame of Dutch life. Whatever comes, it will be met by law and by vote.
focus_desc.nld_snuiver: A Dutch officer's air mast lets a submarine run its diesels just below the surface.
focus_desc.nld_socialists_in_cabinet: For the first time the Social Democrats are asked into government. The workers' party now shares the burden of the country's defence.
focus_desc.nld_stand_with_washington: Where America leads with its embargoes, Batavia follows. Japan will get no more oil than it must.
focus_desc.nld_strict_neutrality: No staff talks with anyone, guards on every border and the fleet watching every coast.
focus_desc.nld_submarine_service: Submarines are the cheapest guard for the straits of the archipelago.
focus_desc.nld_surabaya_base: The fleet's base on Java is given new docks, oil tanks and workshops.
focus_desc.nld_trade_with_tokyo: Japan pays well for oil. Keeping it supplied may keep it away from the Indies.
focus_desc.nld_triumvirate: A police chief, a provincial governor and a young Catholic scholar lead the movement together.
focus_desc.nld_union_belgium: The Hague asks Brussels to join it in one kingdom of the Low Countries.
focus_desc.nld_union_government: The parties are set aside and the Union governs in the name of the whole people and the crown.
focus_desc.nld_union_luxembourg: The grand duchy, once ruled by the same house, is invited into the union.
focus_desc.nld_union_takes_power: The movement will no longer wait for elections. Its members and its friends in the ministries move to take the state.
focus_desc.nld_volksraad_petition: Members of the Indies' advisory council ask for self-government within the kingdom in ten years.
focus_desc.nld_wa_steps_out: The movement's defence corps, in black shirts, takes to the streets despite the ban on political uniforms.
focus_desc.nld_waalhaven_airfield: Rotterdam's airfield and the Koolhoven works beside it are enlarged.
focus_desc.nld_waalsdorp_laboratory: In the dunes near The Hague army physicists build a set that finds aircraft by radio echo.
focus_desc.nld_water_defence: Since the wars against Spain the Dutch have defended themselves by flooding the land before the enemy. The sluices are checked once more.
focus_desc.nld_werkspoor: The engine builders of Amsterdam and Hengelo turn part of their works over to arms.
focus_desc.nld_western_talks: In secret, officers cross the North Sea to learn what help would come, and when.
focus_desc.nld_which_netherlands: Parliament and crown, a new national union, the NSB's marchers or the communists' councils: the country must choose who will lead it through the storm.
focus_desc.nld_zuiderzee_works: The Enclosure Dam has turned an inland sea into a lake. Now its bottom is to become farmland.
focus_desc.nor_above_parties_course: Farmers, shipowners and officers say the party quarrel has made Norway weak. They want a cabinet of capable men answerable to the King, not to Labour.
focus_desc.nor_accept_hague: The court in the Hague gave East Greenland to Denmark. Norway accepts it and keeps a good neighbour.
focus_desc.nor_air_defense: Anti-aircraft guns around the capital and a squadron of fighters.
focus_desc.nor_air_warning: Observers on the hills and telephone lines to the guns: a simple net to warn of bombers.
focus_desc.nor_aluminium_smelters: Bauxite comes by ship, power comes from the mountains, and the metal leaves for the aircraft factories of Europe.
focus_desc.nor_american_orders: American factories have aircraft to sell and no war of their own yet. The contracts are signed; delivery is another matter.
focus_desc.nor_anti_aircraft: Oslo has almost nothing against bombers. A few batteries are bought and placed.
focus_desc.nor_arctic_realm: Svalbard, Jan Mayen and the whaling grounds of the south: a small country with a large share of the polar seas.
focus_desc.nor_army_air_service: At Kjeller the army keeps a handful of old biplanes. It is a start.
focus_desc.nor_army_order: The army is a frame of officers and a few weeks of drill a year. Before it can grow it must be counted.
focus_desc.nor_ask_guarantee: Oslo asks London to say openly that it will defend Norway.
focus_desc.nor_b_class_boats: The old submarines are refitted and a few new boats laid down.
focus_desc.nor_coastal_defense: Batteries at the mouths of fjords and straits, and a larger naval base.
focus_desc.nor_coastal_forts: Bergen, Trondheim, Kristiansand and the other harbour forts get fresh crews and ammunition.
focus_desc.nor_council_of_the_realm: A council of the King's ministers governs by decree until calmer times. The elections can wait.
focus_desc.nor_crisis_compromise: Labour took office on a bargain with the Farmers' Party: work for the towns, fair prices for the farms. Keeping it means keeping both sides fed.
focus_desc.nor_defence_debate: Pacifists in the party, officers in the press, and a defence budget that has shrunk for fifteen years. The Storting must decide how much a neutral country needs.
focus_desc.nor_defence_grants: The Storting votes special grants, year by year, for rifles, guns and stores. It is more than before and less than the officers ask.
focus_desc.nor_defend_the_north: Narvik and the ore line are what every great power wants. The north gets its own defence works.
focus_desc.nor_defended_democracy: Whoever rules from Oslo, the parties and the unions will not give up the Storting. If it was taken from them, they will take it back.
focus_desc.nor_defense_union: Join our Nordic neighbours in an alliance of mutual defence.
focus_desc.nor_electro_metallurgy: Ferro-alloys and special steels from electric furnaces: a small industry with buyers all over the world.
focus_desc.nor_elverum_powers: Before scattering, the Storting gives the government full powers to act for the country wherever it must go.
focus_desc.nor_emergency_stocks: Grain, fuel and medicine laid by for the day the sea lanes close. A country that imports its bread must think ahead.
focus_desc.nor_erik_the_reds_land: Norwegian trappers and their huts were on that coast first. The ruling was wrong, and Norway will say so with more than notes.
focus_desc.nor_farmers_break: The Farmers' Party walks out of the crisis compromise and calls for order, lower taxes and a stronger hand in Oslo.
focus_desc.nor_fatherland_league: Nansen's old league against the socialists still holds meetings and rallies. Given money and purpose, it could become a movement.
focus_desc.nor_field_artillery: The old quick-firing guns are overhauled and new sights fitted. Some new pieces are ordered.
focus_desc.nor_field_divisions: The country's six division districts get real field formations with their own artillery.
focus_desc.nor_fight_in_the_valleys: The army falls back up the long valleys, blowing bridges and holding every pass it can.
focus_desc.nor_fighters_abroad: Norway cannot build a modern fighter, so it buys a few from Britain and America.
focus_desc.nor_finland_aid: The Finns fight alone in the snow. Norway sends rifles, volunteers and money, but not its army.
focus_desc.nor_fleet_abroad: Ships at sea do not sail home; they go into Allied service from British ports.
focus_desc.nor_fleet_abroad_plan: Quietly the shipping office drafts orders for the day the homeland can no longer give them.
focus_desc.nor_fourth_fleet: Norwegian ships carry the world's cargo, and most of them never see Norway for years.
focus_desc.nor_general_staff: The general staff stops planning for neutrality guards and starts planning for an invasion.
focus_desc.nor_general_strike: The party calls on every worker to down tools until the government falls. Trains stop, and the ports go quiet.
focus_desc.nor_heavy_water: Expand the heavy-water plant at the Vemork hydroelectric station in Telemark.
focus_desc.nor_heavy_water_plant: A by-product of the hydrogen works is the purest heavy water in the world. Physicists abroad have begun to ask how much there is.
focus_desc.nor_hird: The party's guard takes its name from the old kings' retinue. Young men in boots now stand at every meeting.
focus_desc.nor_home_front_leadership: Judges, bishops and teachers refuse the occupier's orders. A quiet leadership forms to tell the country how to resist.
focus_desc.nor_home_guard: Local defence units guard their home districts and deepen the reserves.
focus_desc.nor_horten_yard: The navy's yard can build small warships if it is given steel and men.
focus_desc.nor_hydropower: Power stations on waterfalls and mountain rivers send cheap electricity to industry.
focus_desc.nor_industrial_plan: The government drafts a plan for new industry where the power and the harbours are. Private capital is invited, and watched.
focus_desc.nor_infantry_arms: A Madsen in every section gives the riflemen the fire they lack.
focus_desc.nor_kings_no: Asked to accept a government chosen by the invader, the King answers that he will abdicate first. The country hears him.
focus_desc.nor_kjeller_factory: The army's own workshop builds foreign designs under licence and learns from each one.
focus_desc.nor_kompani_linge: Commandos trained in Scotland go home by boat and parachute to sabotage what the occupier needs most.
focus_desc.nor_kongsberg_works: The state factory that makes the army's rifles and guns has worked at half pace for years. It can be woken.
focus_desc.nor_labour_course: Nygaardsvold governs as a cautious reformer: no revolution, no adventures abroad, and a slow widening of the welfare the workers were promised.
focus_desc.nor_little_norway: In a camp in Canada young Norwegians who escaped by boat learn to fly.
focus_desc.nor_london_government: The King and his ministers carry on the war from Britain, with the fleet and the gold behind them.
focus_desc.nor_main_agreement: The trade unions and the employers sign a basic agreement on how to bargain and when to strike. The years of great lockouts end.
focus_desc.nor_merchant_marine: Expand the merchant fleet and train more seamen.
focus_desc.nor_milorg: The secret army hides its weapons in the forests and waits for the day of liberation.
focus_desc.nor_minefields: Mines are the cheapest guard for a coast of a thousand fjords.
focus_desc.nor_mobilisation_plan: Call-up papers by post will not do. The plan is redrawn so the reservists know where to go before the enemy lands.
focus_desc.nor_mot_dag: A circle of young intellectuals and their journal argue that a revolution needs theory as much as strikes. Students listen.
focus_desc.nor_mountain_warfare: Most of Norway is rock, forest and snow. The army trains to fight where an invader's roads run out.
focus_desc.nor_narvik_harbour: Swedish ore from Kiruna comes down the Ofoten line to an ice-free port. The harbour earns well, and the great powers watch it closely.
focus_desc.nor_national_government: The men above parties declare a government of national unity and dare the Storting to stop them.
focus_desc.nor_naval_air_arm: The naval air service at Horten builds its own floatplanes to watch the long coast.
focus_desc.nor_navy_plan: The armoured ships are forty years old. The admirals ask for destroyers, minelayers and submarines before they ask for more.
focus_desc.nor_neutral_in_all_wars: Norway kept out of the last great war and means to keep out of the next. Friendship with all, alliance with none.
focus_desc.nor_neutrality: Proclaim the Nordic principle of siding with no great power.
focus_desc.nor_neutrality_watch: Ships, guns and battalions are called up to guard the coast and the frontier, so that no one can say Norway let a war through.
focus_desc.nor_nordic_cooperation: The union's members share the work of their laboratories and factories.
focus_desc.nor_nordic_defence: Alone each Nordic state is small; together they have armies, fleets and ore enough to make any invader think twice.
focus_desc.nor_nordic_staff_talks: The general staffs of Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen and Helsinki compare their plans for the first time.
focus_desc.nor_nordland_railway: The railway north from Trondheim stops far short of the Arctic. Every mile laid binds the north closer to the south.
focus_desc.nor_norsk_hydro: The great company at Rjukan turns air and water into fertiliser for half of Europe. More capital means more works in Telemark.
focus_desc.nor_nortraship: Every Norwegian ship outside enemy waters is taken over by the government's shipping mission. The fleet sails on, and pays for the war.
focus_desc.nor_ns_course: Quisling's small party has never won a seat, but it has a programme, a uniform and a leader who believes his hour will come.
focus_desc.nor_ns_new_order: The party is the state now. Berlin sends congratulations, and Norway's neighbours count their guns.
focus_desc.nor_ns_rising: The Hird and its friends in the officer corps move on Oslo. Every garrison town must choose.
focus_desc.nor_old_age_pensions: For the first time the state pays every old man and woman a pension, however small. The fishermen and smallholders notice.
focus_desc.nor_old_armoured_ships: Norge, Eidsvold and their sisters are slow and old, but their guns can still close a harbour mouth.
focus_desc.nor_old_union_ties: Norway was once joined to Denmark and ruled the Atlantic islands. Some say those ties could be renewed by consent.
focus_desc.nor_oscarsborg: The fortress in the Oslofjord narrows has German-made guns older than the century and torpedo tubes hidden in the rock. Old does not mean useless.
focus_desc.nor_oslo_states: The small trading nations of the north and the Low Countries agree to keep their markets open to one another.
focus_desc.nor_protest_violations: Every warship in Norwegian waters and every plane over the coast gets a note from Oslo. Notes are what a small country has.
focus_desc.nor_queen_maud_land: The whalers know the Antarctic coast better than anyone. Norway lays claim to it before others do.
focus_desc.nor_quisling_programme: An end to class struggle, a Nordic people's state and the parties abolished. The pamphlets find readers among the frightened.
focus_desc.nor_radio_signals: A long coast and a scattered people need radio more than most. The research pays off for the army and the fleet.
focus_desc.nor_raufoss_works: Shells and cartridges for an army that has almost none in store. The order book doubles.
focus_desc.nor_rearm_in_earnest: No more half measures: a defence loan, longer drill and a factory working for the army. The budget will feel it.
focus_desc.nor_red_course: Labour has grown respectable. The communists and the radicals say the workers deserve a party that still means what it sang.
focus_desc.nor_research_council: The state gathers its scattered laboratories under one council and gives it a budget of its own.
focus_desc.nor_resistance: The government in exile links up with the resistance at home and keeps it supplied.
focus_desc.nor_return_of_the_king: The government returns to Oslo. The flags come out, and the accounts with the collaborators are opened.
focus_desc.nor_riksting: In place of the Storting, a chamber of trades and professions: fishermen, farmers, workers and owners, each with its seats.
focus_desc.nor_ski_battalions: Every farm boy can ski. Formed into battalions with mountain guns, they move where nothing on wheels can follow.
focus_desc.nor_ski_troops: Light infantry on skis moves fast through snowbound forest.
focus_desc.nor_sleipner_class: Small, fast destroyers from the yard at Horten, built for Norway's narrow waters.
focus_desc.nor_storting_unity: With war in the air the opposition is asked into government. Hambro's Conservatives and the Liberals sit beside Labour.
focus_desc.nor_strict_neutrality: No staff talks, no promises, no favours. Norway will treat every belligerent alike and trust them to respect it.
focus_desc.nor_strong_hand: Retired officers write to the newspapers and businessmen fund the committees. The question is no longer whether, but who.
focus_desc.nor_svalbard_coal: The mines at Longyearbyen send coal south each summer when the ice opens.
focus_desc.nor_tanker_fleet: Modern motor tankers are the pride of the fleet. Oil companies everywhere want them.
focus_desc.nor_technical_institute: The engineers of Trondheim built the power stations; given money, they can build more than that.
focus_desc.nor_trondheim_chemists: Electrochemistry is Norway's own science. Its laboratories train the men who run the hydro works.
focus_desc.nor_union_cells: Communists win shop stewards' posts in the mines, the docks and the paper mills, one meeting at a time.
focus_desc.nor_war_production: The factories built for peace are told to make what the army needs. It will never be enough, but it will be something.
focus_desc.nor_war_risk_insurance: If the state insures the ships against war, the owners will keep them sailing when the shooting starts.
focus_desc.nor_water_to_france: French agents ask to buy the whole stock and fly it out. Selling to Paris means choosing a side in a race no one admits to.
focus_desc.nor_water_to_germany: The German chemical trust pays well and asks few questions. The money is good; what the water is for is not Norway's affair.
focus_desc.nor_weather_stations: Whoever knows the Arctic weather knows tomorrow's weather in Europe. The stations matter to every fleet and air force.
focus_desc.nor_western_camp: Neutrality has failed to protect anyone. Norway joins the side its trade and its sympathies already lie with.
focus_desc.nor_western_talks: Quietly, the foreign ministry asks what the Royal Navy would do if Norway were attacked.
focus_desc.nor_western_ties: Build on trade and shipping with Britain to draw closer to London.
focus_desc.nor_whaling_fleet: Factory ships go south every autumn to the Antarctic and come back full of oil.
focus_desc.nor_which_norway: The parties have had their say. The country can stay on the parliamentary road, or someone can try to take it elsewhere.
focus_desc.nor_white_coal: Norway has no coal to speak of, but it has waterfalls. Every new power station means cheap current for the towns and the smelters.
focus_desc.nor_whole_people_at_work: The slogan that won the election now has to be paid for: public works, roads and a factory or two where the men stand idle.
focus_desc.nor_winter_training: Every unit learns to march and camp in snow and deep cold.
focus_desc.nor_workers_protection: Hours, holidays and safety on the shop floor are written into law. A working man can now count on a summer week off.
focus_desc.nor_workers_republic: Councils of workers and fishermen govern the towns. Moscow is pleased, and the shipowners have sailed away.
focus_desc.nor_workers_rising: Red guards take the factories in Oslo and Trondheim. The army must decide whom it obeys.
focus_desc.nzl_coastwatchers: Radio posts on remote islands report every ship and aircraft that passes.
focus_desc.nzl_division: The expeditionary force forms its own division, with experienced officers at every level.
focus_desc.pol_7tp_tank: A Polish tank from a British design, with a Swedish gun and a diesel engine. There will never be enough of them.
focus_desc.pol_april_constitution: The new constitution puts the President above the Sejm and the government. It was written for one man, and now others must live with it.
focus_desc.pol_armored_brigades: Cavalry brigades receive tanks, lorries and guns of their own. Horse and engine move together.
focus_desc.pol_arms_first: The general staff wants guns now, not a modern economy in ten years. The factories built are arsenals.
focus_desc.pol_army_from_the_east: Prisoners released from Soviet camps march south through Persia to fight again.
focus_desc.pol_army_in_france: Soldiers who escaped through Romania and Hungary form new divisions on allied soil.
focus_desc.pol_ava_radio: A small Warsaw firm builds the bureau's radio sets and copies of the German cipher machine.
focus_desc.pol_aviation: The state aircraft works expand fighter development and production. Fighters of Polish make fill the squadrons.
focus_desc.pol_balance: Poland keeps its pacts with both great neighbours and leans towards neither.
focus_desc.pol_baltic_outreach: Riga, Tallinn and even Kaunas are offered trade and talks. Their fear of Moscow is Poland's argument.
focus_desc.pol_beck_doctrine: The foreign minister keeps Berlin and Moscow at the same arm's length and signs nothing that ties Poland to either.
focus_desc.pol_beyond_the_vistula: Roads and factories reach the poor provinces east of the river, where the land cannot feed everyone.
focus_desc.pol_black_brigade: A cavalry brigade gives up its horses for lorries and tanks. Its men wear black leather coats.
focus_desc.pol_bofors_licence: Sweden sells the rights to its 37 mm anti-tank gun and its 40 mm anti-aircraft gun. Polish works build both.
focus_desc.pol_bomber_brigade: The Łoś is fast for a bomber and carries a heavy load. Few air forces have a better one.
focus_desc.pol_border_corps: Picked troops guard the eastern frontier against raiders and smugglers, and learn its marshes by heart.
focus_desc.pol_brest_amnesty: The opposition leaders sentenced after the Brest trials may come home. Old enemies are cheaper as citizens than as exiles.
focus_desc.pol_budapest_friendship: Poles and Hungarians have been friends for centuries. Warsaw wants a common border with them.
focus_desc.pol_camp_of_unity: One organisation for every loyal Pole, led by the Marshal's men. Unity is the word; obedience is the method.
focus_desc.pol_capital_air_defence: Bofors guns ring Warsaw and the district's works.
focus_desc.pol_castle_course: The President's circle at the Royal Castle trusts engineers and economists more than colonels. Let the state be run, not commanded.
focus_desc.pol_cavalry: The cavalry learns to fight dismounted with anti-tank rifles and machine guns.
focus_desc.pol_cavalry_brigades: The cavalry rides to battle but fights on foot, with anti-tank guns and tankettes beside it.
focus_desc.pol_central_district: Factories are built in the safe interior between the Vistula and the San. A war would not reach them quickly there.
focus_desc.pol_cipher_bureau: Mathematicians of the General Staff work on the German cipher machine. Mathematics is laying bare its inner wiring.
focus_desc.pol_cipher_office: The general staff's code-breakers listen to German army traffic. They have already read the Soviets' codes once.
focus_desc.pol_coal_trunk: The railway from Silesia to the sea carries coal to Gdynia without crossing foreign land.
focus_desc.pol_coal_trunk_line: A railway straight from Silesia to Gdynia carries coal to the sea without crossing Danzig's customs.
focus_desc.pol_colonels_cabinet: Ministries go to officers of the old Legions. Decisions come quickly, and the Sejm hears of them afterwards.
focus_desc.pol_colour_mobilisation: Reservists are called by coloured posters and secret notices, so part of the army can be raised without a public order.
focus_desc.pol_commonwealth_reborn: Poland and Lithuania are one state again, under a name older than either nation's quarrel.
focus_desc.pol_cop_founding: A fork of the Vistula and the San, far from both borders, becomes the place for the new arms industry.
focus_desc.pol_cop_second_stage: With the first works running, the plan spreads to rubber, glass and machine shops across the district.
focus_desc.pol_cowes_destroyers: A British yard builds two large, fast destroyers for the Polish flag.
focus_desc.pol_cryptologic_bomb: Electric machines run through the cipher's settings in hours. When the Germans change their procedure, the bureau builds again.
focus_desc.pol_danzig_firmness: The Free City and the road to the sea are not for sale. Warsaw says so plainly, in Berlin and at home.
focus_desc.pol_defence_fund_drive: Citizens give money, rings and watches for the army's new guns. The gifts are small, the mood they make is not.
focus_desc.pol_defense_fund: Citizens give money and gold to arm the country. The money goes on weapons and aircraft.
focus_desc.pol_dutch_submarines: Two ocean-going submarines are ordered from Dutch yards, partly paid for by the people's collections.
focus_desc.pol_east_wall: Field fortifications are built along the Soviet border. Marshes and forests help the defender.
focus_desc.pol_eastern_army: Polish soldiers released in the Soviet Union form a new army. They will travel far before they fight again.
focus_desc.pol_eastern_question: At war with the Soviet Union, Poland calls on the exiles' networks to raise the borderlands behind the Red Army.
focus_desc.pol_endecja_youth: The young wing of the National Party grows impatient with its elders. Talk turns from elections to action.
focus_desc.pol_exile_officers: Georgian and Ukrainian officers in exile serve in the Polish army on contract, waiting for their own.
focus_desc.pol_exiles_return: The front's leaders cross the border to speak in person. The crowds that meet them are larger than the police expected.
focus_desc.pol_falanga: Piasecki's movement wears green armbands and drills its squads. It wants the street before it wants the Sejm.
focus_desc.pol_fifteen_year_plan: The Treasury draws a plan to bring the backward east up to the west in three steps of five years.
focus_desc.pol_forces_west: Soldiers who escaped the defeat form new divisions and squadrons on Allied soil.
focus_desc.pol_fortification_office: Engineers survey the open plains for places where concrete can make up for missing men.
focus_desc.pol_four_year_plan: The Treasury plans roads, power and factories for four years and pays for them without printing money.
focus_desc.pol_free_elections: A new electoral law, open lists and an honest count. Whatever the camp thinks, the vote now decides who governs.
focus_desc.pol_galician_oil: The old wells at the foot of the Carpathians are drilled deeper. Poland will not have much oil, but it will have some.
focus_desc.pol_gdynia: Poland's own seaport grows into a naval base and a trading harbour. Trade no longer has to pass through Danzig.
focus_desc.pol_general_mobilisation: Every reservist is called. Trains run west day and night.
focus_desc.pol_gold_goes_west: The Bank of Poland's gold leaves by lorry, train and ship. A state that keeps its treasury can keep fighting.
focus_desc.pol_hel_fortified: Coastal guns on the Hel spit cover the bay of Gdańsk and the approach to Gdynia.
focus_desc.pol_home_army: The underground army at home gathers intelligence and prepares for the day of the rising.
focus_desc.pol_intermarium: The states between the Baltic and the Black Sea are drawn into a bloc led from Warsaw.
focus_desc.pol_intermarium_pact: A league of states from the Baltic to the Black Sea, with Warsaw at its centre, is proclaimed.
focus_desc.pol_jagiellonian_offer: Warsaw proposes to Kaunas what the two crowns once had: one state of two nations.
focus_desc.pol_jastrzab: A low-wing fighter with a closed cockpit is meant to replace the old gull wings. It needs an engine Poland does not make.
focus_desc.pol_joint_staff: The pact's armies agree on common plans, maps and codes.
focus_desc.pol_karas_squadrons: Light bombers built for scouting fly low over the columns of an enemy army.
focus_desc.pol_kaunas_note: Lithuania has refused to speak to Poland for twenty years. A short note demands that it open an embassy.
focus_desc.pol_koc_overture: The head of the Camp of National Unity courts the radicals' youth. The ruling camp lends them a door into the state.
focus_desc.pol_kpp_underground: The banned Communist Party of Poland works in cells of three. Half its leaders sit in Polish prisons, the rest fear Moscow's.
focus_desc.pol_kutrzeba_study: The head of the War College writes down what a war with Germany would look like. The answer is not comforting.
focus_desc.pol_labour_party: Christian democrats and the workers' party of the west merge into one. The front gains a party that can stand in elections.
focus_desc.pol_lodz_councils: The textile city elects workers' councils in its mills. The owners call the army; the councils call the next shift.
focus_desc.pol_maritime_league: A league of a million members collects money for the navy and dreams of the sea and lands beyond it.
focus_desc.pol_marshals_testament: Piłsudski is gone and his heirs read his will in different ways. The state must first decide who speaks for it.
focus_desc.pol_mielec_works: The state aircraft works opens a second plant in the district to build bombers away from Warsaw.
focus_desc.pol_military_protocol: The French and Polish staffs set down when France would attack in the west. The paper is better than the plan behind it.
focus_desc.pol_mlawa_position: Bunkers north of Warsaw face East Prussia, the shortest road to the capital.
focus_desc.pol_modernisation_plan: A six-year plan for guns, tanks and radios, sized to what the country can pay. It will not be finished in time unless it starts now.
focus_desc.pol_morges_front: In a villa by Lake Geneva a pianist, a general and a peasant leader agree to oppose the colonels together.
focus_desc.pol_moscice_nitrates: The nitrogen works by Tarnów make fertiliser in peace and explosives in war.
focus_desc.pol_national_radical_camp: Young nationalists banned once already regroup at the universities. They want a Catholic, national state without parties.
focus_desc.pol_national_revolution: The squads march on the ministries to put an end to the colonels' half measures. The army splits over it.
focus_desc.pol_oksywie_base: The navy's harbour next to Gdynia gets new quays, dry docks and workshops.
focus_desc.pol_one_camp: The quarrels of the heirs end with one camp behind one programme. If others have taken the state meanwhile, the camp takes it back.
focus_desc.pol_peasant_congress: The People's Party demands land, a fair vote and the return of its leader. The delegates leave ready to act.
focus_desc.pol_peasant_rising: The countryside rises against the colonels in the name of the people's rule. The towns must choose a side.
focus_desc.pol_peking_plan: If war comes, the destroyers will not die in the Baltic. They will sail for British ports and fight on from there.
focus_desc.pol_plan_east: The general staff keeps its old fear: the Soviet Union is the enemy, and the war will be fought in the eastern marshes.
focus_desc.pol_plan_west: The army plans to meet Germany at the border to protect industry, and to hold until the allies attack.
focus_desc.pol_podhale_rifles: The highlanders' regiments in their capes guard the mountain border to the south.
focus_desc.pol_poznan_mathematicians: Three young mathematicians from Poznań attack the machine cipher with group theory instead of guesswork.
focus_desc.pol_project_uruguay: A light anti-tank rifle is issued in sealed crates marked for export. The soldiers learn of it only when war comes.
focus_desc.pol_promethean_movement: Polish intelligence helps Ukrainian, Georgian and Caucasian exiles who hope to break the Soviet Union apart.
focus_desc.pol_pursuit_brigade: The fighter squadrons around Warsaw are gathered into one brigade to defend the capital's sky.
focus_desc.pol_pzl_works: The gull-winged PZL fighters, once among the best in the world, are built in numbers while the next design is drawn.
focus_desc.pol_radom_rifles: The Radom arms factory turns out short Mausers by the thousand.
focus_desc.pol_rambouillet_credit: France lends money for arms, part of it to be spent in French factories, part in Polish ones.
focus_desc.pol_red_rising: The councils proclaim a workers' Poland. Whether it lives depends on the army and on the Red Army beyond the border.
focus_desc.pol_red_unions: Communists win the workshops of Warsaw and the mines of Dąbrowa. The strikes grow longer.
focus_desc.pol_restoration: With the capital free again, the government returns and rebuilds the country. Ruined towns and factories are raised again.
focus_desc.pol_return_to_warsaw: The government comes home to a ruined capital and starts again.
focus_desc.pol_romanian_alliance: The old treaty with Bucharest is renewed. It guards against the east and keeps a door open to the south.
focus_desc.pol_romanian_bridgehead: The army falls back to the southeast corner, where a friendly border and a railway to the sea remain.
focus_desc.pol_roznow_dam: A dam on the Dunajec gives the south electric power and holds back its floods.
focus_desc.pol_rydz_second_person: The army's Inspector General is named second only to the President. The soldiers' camp now has its own head.
focus_desc.pol_rzeszow_works: Gun barrels and aero engines are made in Rzeszów, a day's march from any border.
focus_desc.pol_secret_shared: In a forest outside Warsaw the bureau hands its allies its copies and its methods. Alone it cannot keep up any longer.
focus_desc.pol_seek_guarantees: Warsaw asks London and Paris to pledge themselves to Polish independence.
focus_desc.pol_sejm_talks: The Castle invites the opposition parties to talk about the electoral law. Concessions cost little and calm the streets.
focus_desc.pol_share_enigma: The Cipher Bureau hands its methods and replica machines to its British and French allies.
focus_desc.pol_silesian_coal: New shafts in Upper Silesia raise output for the furnaces and for export.
focus_desc.pol_silesian_fortified_area: A belt of bunkers protects the mines and mills of Upper Silesia, the richest corner of the country.
focus_desc.pol_six_year_plan: A six-year plan modernises the army's weapons, training and organisation.
focus_desc.pol_socialist_rallies: The Polish Socialist Party fills the squares on May Day. Red flags and white-and-red ones march side by side.
focus_desc.pol_squadrons_in_britain: Polish pilots, already veterans, get modern fighters in Britain and fly them with a vengeance.
focus_desc.pol_stalowa_wola: A steelworks and a gun factory rise in the forest by the San, with a new town around them.
focus_desc.pol_starachowice_guns: The Starachowice works build field howitzers under a Czech licence.
focus_desc.pol_steelworks: A new steel mill on the San gives the arms plants steel of their own. Guns and tanks no longer depend on bought steel.
focus_desc.pol_third_europe: Between Germany and the Soviet Union lie a dozen states. Together they would be a power; apart they are a menu.
focus_desc.pol_two_neighbours: Two great neighbours, two pacts, one long border on each side. Every choice that follows is made in their shadow.
focus_desc.pol_underground_state: Under occupation the state goes on in secret: courts, schools, newspapers and an army that waits.
focus_desc.pol_uprising: Plans, weapons and links with the Allies are readied for a rising in the capital.
focus_desc.pol_village_guards: Young farmers form guards to protect meetings from the police. Scythes hang by the door again.
focus_desc.pol_village_strike: For ten days the villages sell nothing to the towns. The markets empty and the gendarmes go out to the roads.
focus_desc.pol_volhynian_policy: The governor of Volhynia gives Ukrainians their schools, churches and co-operatives to win them for the state.
focus_desc.pol_west_wall: Bunkers and obstacles are built along the German border. The western plains offer no hills to lean on.
focus_desc.pol_western_guarantees: Poland asks the Western powers to say aloud what they would do if it were attacked.
focus_desc.pol_western_ukraine_left: In the eastern borderlands the party speaks to Ukrainian and Belarusian villages about land and their own tongue.
focus_desc.pol_young_poland_union: The camp gathers its own youth into a league of marches, camps and lectures. A new generation is to grow up inside it.
focus_desc.pol_zaolzie: Poland presses its claim to the Polish-speaking district across the Olza.
focus_desc.pol_zaolzie_claim: The Polish villages beyond the Olza have been Czechoslovak since a war Poland did not fight. Warsaw raises them again.
focus_desc.prt_aid_nationalists: Ports and railways for the Nationalists' supplies, volunteers called Viriatos, and silence at the Non-Intervention Committee.
focus_desc.prt_air_arm: Young airmen argue that the army's aviation should become a service of its own, with its own doctrine.
focus_desc.prt_alentejo_labourers: On the great southern estates men work for a pittance half the year and starve the other half. They listen to the party.
focus_desc.prt_alfeite_arsenal: A new naval yard on the south bank of the Tagus to build and repair the fleet at home.
focus_desc.prt_allied_course: The alliance has been honoured in deeds; perhaps it is time to honour it in war as well.
focus_desc.prt_angola_plan: Coffee, diamonds and cotton: Angola could pay for itself and more, with roads and a few factories.
focus_desc.prt_army_of_the_empire: One army for the mainland, the islands and Africa, with officers who have served in all three.
focus_desc.prt_army_reorganisation: Too many officers, too few rifles: the new under-secretary for war cuts the first and buys the second.
focus_desc.prt_atlantic_patrol: The small navy learns to escort, patrol and hunt submarines across the triangle of Lisbon, Madeira and the Azores.
focus_desc.prt_avante: The clandestine paper is printed on hidden presses and carried hand to hand through the factories.
focus_desc.prt_axis_temptation: Some in Lisbon believe the new order will win. Berlin promises the empire will be safe in it.
focus_desc.prt_azores_closed: No foreign base on Portuguese soil, friend or foe: the islands will be defended by Portuguese guns alone.
focus_desc.prt_azores_to_allies: If London asks under the old treaty, Lisbon will answer: the islands can serve the alliance, for a price in arms.
focus_desc.prt_benguela_railway: The line from Lobito to the copper of Katanga crosses all Angola. Extend and double it.
focus_desc.prt_blue_rising: The syndicalists and the radical legionaries move on the barracks and ministries of Lisbon.
focus_desc.prt_blue_shirts: Salazar called the national syndicalists' revolution a fever and banned it. The fever has not passed.
focus_desc.prt_braco_de_prata: The army's own factory in Lisbon learns to make rifles, machine guns and their ammunition at home.
focus_desc.prt_braganza_claim: Both royal lines have stood behind Dom Duarte Nuno since 1932. An heir without a quarrel is a rare gift.
focus_desc.prt_british_mission: Staff officers from London come to advise on training and defence, as the alliance has always promised.
focus_desc.prt_cacadores: The light infantry that fought beside Wellington: fast-marching, sharp-shooting brigades for the hills of the frontier.
focus_desc.prt_coastal_batteries: Heavy guns on the headlands of the coast, so that no fleet can close the Tagus or Leixões unanswered.
focus_desc.prt_collaborating_neutrality: Neutral, but not equally neutral: Portugal stays out of the war while leaning, when it must, toward its ally.
focus_desc.prt_colonial_act: The empire is declared one and indivisible, its riches reserved for the mother country.
focus_desc.prt_colonial_battalions: Expeditionary battalions trained to sail at short notice for Angola, Mozambique or the islands.
focus_desc.prt_colonial_settlement: Villages of Portuguese farmers on the high plateaus of Angola and Mozambique, to hold the land and grow its food.
focus_desc.prt_colonial_sloops: Long-legged sloops that show the flag from Bissau to Macau and escort the convoys home.
focus_desc.prt_constitution_1933: A plebiscite in which abstention counted as a yes gave Portugal a corporative republic. Make its institutions work, and the regime will seem as old as the country.
focus_desc.prt_corporative_state: Guilds and national syndicates replace the free unions; wages, prices and quarrels are settled from above.
focus_desc.prt_crown_council: Landowners, bishops and generals sit down to plan the transition. The President himself is asked to step aside with honour.
focus_desc.prt_crown_course: The republic of 1910 brought sixteen years of chaos. Many officers and churchmen whisper that only a king can hold Portugal together.
focus_desc.prt_crown_rises: If the republicans or the radicals hold Lisbon, the monarchist officers will take it from them by force.
focus_desc.prt_cuf_barreiro: Across the Tagus, Alfredo da Silva's group makes fertiliser, soap, textiles and ships. Give it room to grow.
focus_desc.prt_customs_union: One market from the Pyrenees to the Algarve: Portuguese cork and wine for Spanish iron and wheat.
focus_desc.prt_delfim_submarines: Three Vickers submarines to guard the approaches to the Tagus and the islands.
focus_desc.prt_double_centenary: The founding of the kingdom and the restoration of its independence, celebrated together in a great exhibition at Belém.
focus_desc.prt_electrification: Dams on the northern rivers could light the villages and run new industries. The plans leave the drawers.
focus_desc.prt_emergency_economy: Ration cards, price controls and the requisition of grain, as the war cuts the sea lanes.
focus_desc.prt_estado_novo_course: No parties, no strikes, no adventures: Salazar's state, run like a careful household, stays the course.
focus_desc.prt_estado_novo_endures: Whatever storms come, the regime outlasts them. If others have taken the helm, the New State's men will take it back.
focus_desc.prt_far_provinces: Goa, Macau and Timor lie beside powers far stronger than Portugal. Garrison them as well as can be done.
focus_desc.prt_field_artillery: The 75s of the last war are worn out. New batteries are ordered abroad.
focus_desc.prt_financial_dictatorship: A professor from Coimbra took the purse in 1928 on one condition: every ministry spends only what he allows. The budget balances; now the rest of the state must follow.
focus_desc.prt_fomento_plan: Planned investment in power, chemicals and metal, with the state as banker of last resort.
focus_desc.prt_free_elections_demand: Petitions, strikes and rallies demand a vote that is counted. The police answer, and the anger grows.
focus_desc.prt_frontier_forts: The border with Spain has no line of forts worth the name. Begin one where an invader would come.
focus_desc.prt_german_orders: Krupp and Rheinmetall offer guns quickly and on good credit. The British grumble; the army is pleased.
focus_desc.prt_gladiator_squadron: British fighters for the defence of Lisbon, bought with the alliance's blessing.
focus_desc.prt_god_country_family: The New State's three words go up on every school wall. Order at home is the first defence against the revolution spreading across the border.
focus_desc.prt_government_to_the_azores: If the mainland is overrun, the government sails for the islands and fights on with the empire behind it.
focus_desc.prt_high_culture: Grants for research abroad bring back scientists like the neurologist Egas Moniz's students.
focus_desc.prt_iberian_bloc: Lisbon and Madrid coordinate their neutrality, so that neither can be dragged in alone.
focus_desc.prt_iberian_pact: A treaty of friendship and non-aggression with Spain: two dictatorships agree to keep the peninsula out of other people's wars.
focus_desc.prt_iberian_union: The peninsula is one again, and this time Lisbon speaks first.
focus_desc.prt_iberian_union_idea: Twice in history the peninsula was one. Some in Lisbon now say it could be again, this time on Portugal's terms.
focus_desc.prt_iberist_tradition: Poets and federalists of the last century dreamed of a union of free Iberian peoples. Their books are reprinted.
focus_desc.prt_industrial_conditioning: No new factory without the state's licence: it shelters the existing firms and keeps competition polite.
focus_desc.prt_industrial_reorganisation: Merge the small workshops, build modern plants and let the countryside's surplus labour into the towns.
focus_desc.prt_integralist_heritage: The writers of Lusitanian Integralism dreamed of an organic, Catholic monarchy. Their pamphlets come back into the bookshops.
focus_desc.prt_island_garrisons: Regiments from the mainland sail for the Azores and Madeira to make any landing costly.
focus_desc.prt_islands_question: Whoever holds the Azores holds the middle of the Atlantic. Every belligerent has noticed.
focus_desc.prt_islands_redoubt: Forts and regiments on the Azores and Madeira, so that whoever lands there pays dearly.
focus_desc.prt_junkers_squadron: German bombers that double as transports to the islands and the colonies.
focus_desc.prt_kingdom_restored: A king again at the Ajuda palace: the green and red flag stays, but the crown returns above the shield.
focus_desc.prt_lajes_field: On Terceira, a runway long enough for bombers to close the gap in the middle of the ocean.
focus_desc.prt_legion_radicals: Many legionaries want more than a parade: they want a revolution in uniform, and they have rifles.
focus_desc.prt_lisbon_crossroads: Refugees, spies and smugglers crowd the cafés of the Rossio waiting for a ship to America.
focus_desc.prt_lisbon_defences: New coastal batteries at the mouth of the Tagus and an entrenched camp around the capital.
focus_desc.prt_lusitanian_world: From Minho to Timor, one people of many races, or so the regime's thinkers will say.
focus_desc.prt_military_aviation: The army's aviation still flies biplanes of the last war. Buy, train and learn.
focus_desc.prt_mobilisation_law: A real reserve, called up by classes, so that an army of peace can become an army of war.
focus_desc.prt_modern_fighters: Monoplane fighters are what count now. With a friend's help Portugal gets them; alone, it studies them.
focus_desc.prt_mozambique_ports: Lourenço Marques and Beira handle the trade of half of southern Africa. Make them naval stations too.
focus_desc.prt_national_roads: Asphalt reaches the interior for the first time. Lorries can now go where only ox-carts went.
focus_desc.prt_national_syndicalism: Workers' syndicates under a national leader, not under bankers and professors: the movement's programme is printed again.
focus_desc.prt_national_union: Not a party but a "union" of all good Portuguese: one list at every election, and one man deciding who is on it.
focus_desc.prt_naval_programme: An empire on three oceans needs ships. The programme orders destroyers, sloops and submarines from British yards.
focus_desc.prt_neutral_to_the_end: Portugal has kept the war away from its shores. It means to keep it there.
focus_desc.prt_new_republic: A democratic Portugal, at last at ease with London and Washington. Its old general is asked to lead it.
focus_desc.prt_new_rifles: The old Mauser-Vergueiro gives way to a modern 7.92 mm Mauser and German machine guns.
focus_desc.prt_northern_concessions: German companies hold mines in the north and pay well. Let them dig.
focus_desc.prt_oldest_alliance_renewed: The treaty with England has stood since the fourteenth century. Remind London that it cuts both ways.
focus_desc.prt_olivenca_question: The town taken by Spain in 1801 has never been recognised as lost. Before any union, it must come home.
focus_desc.prt_opposition_unity: Republicans, socialists, liberal Catholics and the Seara Nova writers agree on one thing: free elections.
focus_desc.prt_ota_air_base: A modern airfield north of Lisbon, with hangars, a school and room for more squadrons.
focus_desc.prt_overseas_provinces: Not colonies but provinces of one nation spread across the world: the empire is woven into the state.
focus_desc.prt_panasqueira: The great mine is British-owned. Expand it, and London will remember who supplied its guns.
focus_desc.prt_party_reorganised: A young lawyer named Cunhal rebuilds the party cell by cell, ready for the day of reckoning.
focus_desc.prt_peoples_republic: The estates are divided and the banks nationalised; Moscow welcomes a new comrade on the Atlantic.
focus_desc.prt_port_of_lisbon: New quays and cranes on the Tagus: in a world at war, Lisbon may be the busiest neutral harbour in Europe.
focus_desc.prt_portuguese_legion: Raised in the panic of the Spanish summer, a militia of volunteers in green shirts stands ready against the red danger.
focus_desc.prt_preto_returns: The exiled leader crosses back from Spain, where he has seen what a determined movement can do.
focus_desc.prt_public_works: Duarte Pacheco builds as if the country had money to spare: stadiums, schools, a university city and the marginal road.
focus_desc.prt_pvde: The PVDE watches the ports, the cafés and the post. Communists and conspirators learn to fear a knock at night.
focus_desc.prt_reconstitution_law: Fifteen years of planned spending on ports, roads, irrigation and the forces, paid for from surpluses rather than loans.
focus_desc.prt_red_course: The Communist Party lives in safe houses and prison cells. Its cadres have not given up.
focus_desc.prt_red_rising: General strike in Lisbon and the Barreiro, land seizures in the south: the revolution has come.
focus_desc.prt_republic_course: Freemasons, old republicans and young democrats still meet in back rooms. The republic of 1910 had its sins, but it had elections.
focus_desc.prt_republic_rising: Garrisons that remember the republic open their gates to the opposition.
focus_desc.prt_reviralho: The veterans of the failed revolts against the dictatorship, in prison, in Paris or in the colonies, are called back to the cause.
focus_desc.prt_sound_money: The escudo holds and the debts are paid. A strong currency lets a poor country buy what it cannot make.
focus_desc.prt_spanish_war: Spain has split in two. Whatever wins there will press on Portugal's only land border.
focus_desc.prt_spn_propaganda: António Ferro turns folk dances, model villages and the cult of a modest dictator into the image of a happy, humble nation.
focus_desc.prt_staff_school: Officers learn modern war from the Spanish battlefields and from foreign manuals.
focus_desc.prt_strict_non_intervention: Seal the border, help neither side, and let London see that Portugal keeps its word.
focus_desc.prt_syndicalist_state: The national revolution is made: one movement, one leader, and friends in Rome and Berlin.
focus_desc.prt_technical_institute: Lisbon's engineering school designs the bridges and the factories the plans call for.
focus_desc.prt_union_by_force: If Spain will not join by choice, it will be joined by arms.
focus_desc.prt_union_offer: Lisbon proposes one state for the peninsula, under one government. Madrid must answer.
focus_desc.prt_universities: Coimbra, Lisbon and Porto train the few engineers and doctors the country has. Give them laboratories.
focus_desc.prt_vouga_destroyers: Five modern destroyers, two built on the Clyde and three at home, named for the rivers of Portugal.
focus_desc.prt_which_portugal: Salazar's order, a restored king, the blue shirts, a republic of the exiles or a workers' state: the country will have to choose what it is.
focus_desc.prt_wolfram_board: The state takes control of who sells wolfram, to whom and at what price.
focus_desc.prt_wolfram_both_sides: Neutrality has a price, and the belligerents will pay it: sell to Berlin and to London, and let them bid against each other.
focus_desc.prt_wolfram_fortunes: Peasants buy cars with ore dug from their fields. The money builds factories, and it also builds envy.
focus_desc.prt_wolfram_mines: Beira and Trás-os-Montes hold Europe's richest wolfram outside the Soviet Union, the metal that hardens armour-piercing shot.
focus_desc.prt_wolfram_to_allies: The old ally first: let the British buy up the ore before a ton reaches Germany.
focus_desc.rou_aircraft: Expand the state-backed aircraft works at Brașov and build fighters for the air force.
focus_desc.rou_anglo_french_guarantee: When small states fall one by one, Bucharest asks Britain and France for a guarantee of its independence.
focus_desc.rou_armament_plan: A multi-year plan sets what the army will receive and which factory will make it.
focus_desc.rou_armed_neutrality: Romania will sell to everyone and fight for no one, and keep its army ready for whoever crosses the border first.
focus_desc.rou_armoured_regiment: The new Czech tanks are gathered into one regiment and taught to move together.
focus_desc.rou_army_reorganisation: The army is large on paper and short of everything else. Its divisions are recounted, retrained and re-equipped.
focus_desc.rou_astra_arad: The wagon works at Arad take on military orders and rolling stock for the army.
focus_desc.rou_astra_romana_refinery: The largest refinery in the country is rebuilt to crack more petrol from every barrel.
focus_desc.rou_balkan_entente: Greece, Turkey, Yugoslavia and Romania promised to guard each other's Balkan borders. The promise needs to mean more.
focus_desc.rou_black_sea_division: Four destroyers and a submarine are trained to guard Constanța and the coast.
focus_desc.rou_bridgehead: If Poland is overrun, its army could hold the south-east corner with a road to the Romanian railways and the sea.
focus_desc.rou_bucharest_industry: The capital's workshops grow into a ring of factories around the city.
focus_desc.rou_cairo_talks: Quiet envoys travel to neutral capitals to hear the terms of the other side.
focus_desc.rou_carpathian_roads: Mountain roads are paved so that troops can move between Transylvania and the plains in any season.
focus_desc.rou_coastal_batteries: Heavy guns are placed on the cliffs around Constanța.
focus_desc.rou_com_doftana_school: In prison the party's cadres read, argue and train each other. Doftana becomes their university.
focus_desc.rou_com_grivita: The railway shops where troops fired on strikers are still talked about. The party keeps the memory alive.
focus_desc.rou_com_patriotic_front: Communists reach out to peasants, socialists and anyone who hates the dictatorship more than they fear Moscow.
focus_desc.rou_com_peoples_republic: The new government nationalises the oil and the banks and looks east for friends.
focus_desc.rou_com_underground: The banned party survives in small cells among railwaymen, students and the minorities.
focus_desc.rou_com_workers_rising: The factories of Bucharest and the oil towns walk out, and armed workers take the stations.
focus_desc.rou_conscription_reform: Service terms are lengthened and reserve classes are called up for training.
focus_desc.rou_court_camarilla: Industrialists, courtiers and the king's companion meet at the palace, not in parliament. Decrees come faster that way.
focus_desc.rou_court_the_legion: The Legion has the villages and the students. Better to bring its men into ministries and make them answer to the crown.
focus_desc.rou_cross_the_dniester: Bessarabia is back. The ally asks the army to keep going east, to Odessa and beyond.
focus_desc.rou_crush_the_legion: The Interior Minister has the lists. The Captain and his commanders will be arrested, tried and kept where they can do no harm.
focus_desc.rou_cugir_arsenal: The arms works in the Transylvanian hills are enlarged for rifles, machine guns and ammunition.
focus_desc.rou_czech_arms: Škoda and ČKD sell rifles, machine guns and the first real tanks of the army on credit.
focus_desc.rou_danube_flotilla: Monitors and gunboats hold the river and the delta.
focus_desc.rou_defend_the_carpathians: The mountain passes are the country's last wall. They are dug in and manned.
focus_desc.rou_dem_alba_iulia_rally: Where the union with Transylvania was proclaimed, a hundred thousand peasants hear the demand for honest government.
focus_desc.rou_dem_cooperative_credit: Village banks and cooperatives lend for ploughs, mills and small workshops instead of the moneylenders.
focus_desc.rou_dem_maniu_returns: The leader of the National Peasants has outlasted kings and cabinets. He calls the villages back to politics.
focus_desc.rou_dem_opposition_pact: Peasants and Liberals forget old quarrels and agree on one thing: the king must govern through parliament.
focus_desc.rou_dem_peasant_state: Government by and for the villages: fair credit, honest prefects and schools in every commune.
focus_desc.rou_dem_restore_constitution: The 1923 charter of rights is the opposition's flag. If the palace will not return it, the country will take it back.
focus_desc.rou_dismiss_titulescu: The king and the right want a freer hand between the powers. Titulescu's dismissal tells Warsaw and Berlin that Romania will no longer lean only on Paris.
focus_desc.rou_eastern_line: Fortify the eastern border that faces the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.rou_engineering_schools: Young engineers from the provinces are trained at home instead of in Paris and Berlin.
focus_desc.rou_entente_arms_standard: The allies agree on Czech rifles and ammunition, so that each can feed the others' troops.
focus_desc.rou_entente_bloc: Words have not stopped anyone. Romania proposes that the Little Entente become a military alliance with one command.
focus_desc.rou_entente_general_staff: Officers of the three armies plan together: who holds which pass, which railway carries whose troops.
focus_desc.rou_entente_guarantees: Romania promises in public what the staffs have planned in secret: an attack on one is an attack on all.
focus_desc.rou_fas_everything_for_the_country: The Legion runs for parliament under a new party name and wins a share no one expected.
focus_desc.rou_fas_legion_nests: Small cells of the Legion of the Archangel Michael spread through villages and student halls, each sworn to the Captain.
focus_desc.rou_fas_legion_rule: The movement rules. Its zeal fills the ministries; whether it can also run them is another matter.
focus_desc.rou_fas_legionary_police: Armed squads in green shirts begin to keep their own kind of order in the towns.
focus_desc.rou_fas_legionary_state: The Legion has the street and enough of the barracks. It demands the state itself.
focus_desc.rou_fas_work_camps: Legionaries build dams, churches and roads with their own hands. Peasants who see them work start to listen.
focus_desc.rou_fighter_group_7: The best pilots are gathered into one group; their aces become household names.
focus_desc.rou_first_armoured_division: The tank regiment, motorised riflemen and guns form the 'Greater Romania' armoured division.
focus_desc.rou_fng_line: Bunkers and ditches between Focșani, Nămoloasa and Galați bar the way from the east.
focus_desc.rou_foreign_capital: British, French and Belgian investors are invited in, with their machines and their conditions.
