focus_desc.rou_french_alliance: France built Romania's army and many of its officers. Paris is asked to say plainly what it would do in a war.
focus_desc.rou_galati_shipyard: The Danube yard is enlarged to build submarines and escorts at home.
focus_desc.rou_gen_full_powers: The general's terms are plain: full powers, the parties silenced, the Legion kept on a leash.
focus_desc.rou_gen_military_state: The army takes the state in the name of order. The general becomes Conducător, leader of the nation.
focus_desc.rou_gen_officers_discontent: Generals blame the politicians for a hollow army and lost honour. A few begin to talk of a firmer hand.
focus_desc.rou_gen_order_restored: The barracks run the country now. Strikes, riots and green-shirt squads alike are put down.
focus_desc.rou_gen_staff_politics: A former chief of staff with a hard reputation becomes the officers' spokesman.
focus_desc.rou_general_mobilisation: The reserve classes are called up and the factories turn to war.
focus_desc.rou_german_military_mission: German instructors arrive to train divisions on the newest methods, and to watch over the oil fields.
focus_desc.rou_german_trade_treaty: Berlin offers machines, arms and a guaranteed market in exchange for a share in Romanian oil and grain for years ahead.
focus_desc.rou_greater_romania: Bessarabia, Bukovina, Transylvania and Dobruja were won in one generation, and every neighbour wants a piece back. Holding them is the first task of any government in Bucharest.
focus_desc.rou_holy_war: The priests bless the regiments marching east. For a while the country is united.
focus_desc.rou_holy_war_bessarabia: The lost provinces are the army's first aim. The orders read simply: cross the Prut.
focus_desc.rou_iar37_bombers: A home-built three-seat biplane bomber for the army's reconnaissance squadrons.
focus_desc.rou_iar80_program: Romania's own monoplane fighter, designed and built at Brașov.
focus_desc.rou_iar_brasov: The aircraft works at Brașov build Polish fighters under licence and learn the trade.
focus_desc.rou_industry_encouragement: Tariffs, tax relief and state orders shelter new factories from foreign competition.
focus_desc.rou_join_tripartite: With France gone and the Soviets on the Prut, Romania looks for the one power that can stop Moscow.
focus_desc.rou_keep_titulescu: The foreign minister ties Romania to France, the Little Entente and even a pact with Moscow. Keeping him keeps collective security alive, and Berlin cold.
focus_desc.rou_king_above_parties: Carol II despises the old party bosses. He means to make and unmake cabinets himself and let the parties wear themselves out.
focus_desc.rou_legion_in_cabinet: Green shirts sit beside generals and liberals. The Legion gets its ministries; the crown gets peace in the streets, for now.
focus_desc.rou_little_entente_staff: Prague, Belgrade and Bucharest agreed long ago to stand together against Hungarian revisionism. Their staffs should start planning it.
focus_desc.rou_loyalist_officers: Under a government not of the crown's choosing, officers who swore to the dynasty start to meet in quiet rooms.
focus_desc.rou_malaxa_works: The locomotive works in Bucharest turn to tubes, guns and armoured tractors.
focus_desc.rou_mining_law: Foreign companies may drill, but the state holds the subsoil and takes its share.
focus_desc.rou_motorised_corps: Trucks and tractors replace horses in a few chosen units.
focus_desc.rou_mountain_resistance: With the capital lost, bands of soldiers and peasants fight on from the forests of the Carpathians.
focus_desc.rou_national_railways: New lines link the provinces of the old kingdom with Transylvania and Bessarabia.
focus_desc.rou_national_rebirth_front: One party for the whole nation, in uniform, loyal to the king. Every official and officer is expected to join.
focus_desc.rou_neutral_bloc: The foreign minister proposes that the Balkan states declare their neutrality together, so that no power can pick them off one by one.
focus_desc.rou_northern_transylvania: Cluj and Oradea are under a foreign flag. Allies or not, Romania marks them as its own.
focus_desc.rou_oil_contracts: Every power needs fuel. Bucharest will sign contracts one buyer at a time, and set the price in goodwill as well as money.
focus_desc.rou_oil_diplomacy: Oil contracts become a diplomatic card: every buyer gains a reason to stand by us.
focus_desc.rou_oil_for_arms: Buyers who lack cash pay in aircraft and guns.
focus_desc.rou_oil_leverage: A buyer that threatens Romania can be told that the taps may close.
focus_desc.rou_oil_reserve: Part of the output is kept at home in tanks, against the day the sea lanes close.
focus_desc.rou_palace_circle: Opposition leaders, generals and the young king's advisers draw up a plan and a proclamation.
focus_desc.rou_party_of_the_nation: The front is remade into a party of national unity for dangerous times, open even to the king's former enemies.
focus_desc.rou_pipeline_to_the_sea: Pipelines and tank trains carry crude to the Black Sea ports and the Danube.
focus_desc.rou_ploiesti: New refining plant and fuel storage at the Ploiești oil fields.
focus_desc.rou_ploiesti_fields: New wells and a modern fuel depot in the Prahova valley, the richest oil field in Europe outside the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.rou_ploiesti_flak: Heavy anti-aircraft batteries ring the refineries; whoever comes to bomb them will pay.
focus_desc.rou_polish_alliance: The old treaty with Warsaw was aimed at the east. Both sides renew it, unsure whether it would also hold against the west.
focus_desc.rou_polytechnic_research: The Bucharest Polytechnic gets money for laboratories in aerodynamics, chemistry and metallurgy.
focus_desc.rou_resita_gun: Engineers at Reșița combine the best foreign designs into one gun that can kill the heaviest tanks.
focus_desc.rou_resita_steel: The old Banat ironworks are modernised for steel and gun barrels.
focus_desc.rou_rosiori_cavalry: The cavalry regiments are trained to fight dismounted and to scout for the infantry.
focus_desc.rou_royal_air_force: The air arm becomes a service of its own, with its own ministry and schools.
focus_desc.rou_royal_constitution: A new constitution, approved by a show of hands, gives the king the state. Parties are dissolved and elections set aside.
focus_desc.rou_royal_coup: The head of government is arrested at the palace, the radio reads the proclamation, and the army is asked to follow the crown.
focus_desc.rou_savoia_licence: IAR builds the Italian three-engined bomber as a twin with German engines.
focus_desc.rou_state_industry: Arms and heavy industry are built with state money and run by men the court trusts.
focus_desc.rou_state_of_the_union: Whatever the course abroad, the provinces must feel that they belong to one state: roads, schools and officials from Bucharest.
focus_desc.rou_stop_at_the_dniester: The opposition writes to the leader: the old border is regained, not a single soldier should die beyond it.
focus_desc.rou_straja_tarii: The Sentinel of the Fatherland gathers every boy and girl under the crown's banner, a youth movement to rival the Legion's.
focus_desc.rou_submarine_service: Two new boats join the lone submarine to threaten any enemy landing.
focus_desc.rou_tacam_program: Captured guns are mounted on light chassis: cheap, open-topped and deadly at range.
focus_desc.rou_the_turn: If the war is lost, it need not be lost with the losing side. The army is turned against yesterday's ally.
focus_desc.rou_trade_with_all: Grain and oil go to whoever pays, in the currency the buyer can offer.
focus_desc.rou_transnistria_governorate: The land between the Dniester and the Bug is put under a Romanian governor, with Odessa as its capital.
focus_desc.rou_vanatori_de_munte: The mountain hunters, raised for the Carpathians, become the army's elite.
focus_desc.rou_war_college: The staff college in Bucharest rewrites its lessons after watching the new wars in Spain and Poland.
focus_desc.rou_western_line: Forts on the western frontier face the Hungarian plain.
focus_desc.spa_air_war: Fighters and trained pilots will decide who holds the sky over the fronts. Airfields and ground crews are expanded with them.
focus_desc.spa_army_of_africa: The professional garrison of the Moroccan protectorate becomes the core of the Nationalist army.
focus_desc.spa_axis_aid: Envoys ask Italy and Germany for arms, aircraft and volunteers.
focus_desc.spa_catalan_industry: The textile and metal works of Catalonia are turned to the needs of the war. Barcelona becomes the Republic's workshop.
focus_desc.spa_eastern_division: A volunteer division is raised for the war against the Soviet Union while Spain itself stays out.
focus_desc.spa_ebro: A last great offensive across the river is prepared to join the two halves of the Republic again.
focus_desc.spa_foreign_volunteers: Volunteers from abroad bring battle experience and draw the eyes of friendly governments to Spain.
focus_desc.spa_gibraltar: Spain demands the British fortress at the mouth of the Mediterranean. If talks fail, force is not ruled out.
focus_desc.spa_gold_reserve: The gold of the Bank of Spain is shipped abroad to pay for arms; the decision divides the government.
focus_desc.spa_iberian_pact: A treaty of friendship and non-aggression with Portugal secures the western border.
focus_desc.spa_international_brigades: Volunteers from dozens of countries are formed into brigades and sent to the front. They share trenches even when they share no language.
focus_desc.spa_join_axis: Spain asks to enter the alliance of the powers that stood by it in the civil war. What Spain gets in return is the real question.
focus_desc.spa_madrid_defense: Trenches ring the capital and every district raises its own defenders; Madrid will not be given up.
focus_desc.spa_mobilize: Every age group that can carry a rifle is called up; this war will be decided by numbers.
focus_desc.spa_morocco_claims: Spain claims the French zone of Morocco that borders its own protectorate. It is an old ambition to grow in Africa.
focus_desc.spa_navarre_volunteers: Volunteer battalions from Navarre are grouped into brigades for the mountain front.
focus_desc.spa_navy_rebuild: New slipways and new ships make good the losses of the war at sea. The yards of Ferrol and Cartagena are busy again.
focus_desc.spa_non_belligerence: Spain takes no part in the war, but no longer calls itself neutral.
focus_desc.spa_northern_campaign: The cut-off northern coast, with its mines and factories, becomes the next objective. The mountains of Biscay, Cantabria and Asturias are crossed one by one.
focus_desc.spa_popular_army: The militia columns are merged into a regular army of mixed brigades under one chain of command.
focus_desc.spa_rebuild_army: The wartime formations become a smaller peacetime army built around its veterans. The men no longer needed go back to the fields and factories.
focus_desc.spa_reconstruction: The bridges, railways and workshops destroyed in the war are rebuilt. Work and goods begin to move again in an exhausted country.
focus_desc.spa_republic_exile: With the capital lost, the government carries on abroad and asks the world to recognise it.
focus_desc.spa_republic_unity: Parties, trade unions and regional governments set their quarrels aside under one government. Political quarrels wait until the war is over.
focus_desc.spa_strait_airlift: While the sea route is closed, transport aircraft carry troops from Morocco to the mainland.
focus_desc.spa_unified_command: All fronts are placed under one commander and one general staff. Orders now come from one place only.
focus_desc.spa_war_industry: Workshops and factories turn to shells, rifles and lorries for the front. Peacetime orders wait.
focus_desc.spa_wolfram: The tungsten mines of Galicia sell their ore to every buyer at wartime prices.
focus_desc.sun_academy: Give the Academy, recently moved to Moscow, the institutes and funds to serve industry.
focus_desc.sun_air_arm_rebuilt: Aviation is reorganised under army commanders to fly for the ground battle. Fighters and ground-attack squadrons come first; the long-range bomber enthusiasts lose their funds.
focus_desc.sun_allied_cooperation: Sign aid agreements with Britain and the United States and open a supply route through Iran.
focus_desc.sun_antifascist_front: Openly back threatened neighbors and seek treaties with every government willing to resist Germany.
focus_desc.sun_arctic_ports: Murmansk and Arkhangelsk are readied for the allied convoys.
focus_desc.sun_armoured_force: Tank corps are raised years ahead of schedule and given their own doctrine. Factories and fuel go to the new mechanised arm first, and the rest of the army waits.
focus_desc.sun_army_reformers: Leave the officer corps intact and let the commanders who developed deep operations reshape the Red Army.
focus_desc.sun_atomic_project: Kurchatov leads a secret programme to master the atom.
focus_desc.sun_baku: Drill new wells around Baku and across the Caspian to fuel tractors, tanks and aircraft.
focus_desc.sun_baltic_fleet_arm: Destroyers and training lift the fleet in the Baltic.
focus_desc.sun_baltic_garrisons: Mutual-assistance pacts put Soviet garrisons on the Baltic coast.
focus_desc.sun_barracks_order: The new rulers drill the country like a regiment and stamp out the first signs of plots.
focus_desc.sun_bessarabia_demand: Moscow presses its claim on the lands lost to Romania in 1918.
focus_desc.sun_bukharin_nep: Markets and consumer goods are allowed again, trading headline output for stability.
focus_desc.sun_camp_administration: A single directorate runs the camps as an economic enterprise, with building sites and mines of its own.
focus_desc.sun_china_treaty: Offer the Nationalist government a non-aggression pact, with Soviet arms to follow.
focus_desc.sun_coastal_defence: The navy is kept close to shore under the cover of guns and aircraft.
focus_desc.sun_collective_leadership: Decisions return to the Politburo as a body, and no single man stands above the party.
focus_desc.sun_collective_security: Honor the 1935 mutual assistance pacts with France and Czechoslovakia and stand against aggressors in the League.
focus_desc.sun_cominform_bloc: Friendly governments in the liberated lands bind themselves to Moscow.
focus_desc.sun_comintern_aid: Ship rifles and ammunition to the Spanish Republic and the Chinese communists while courting the government in Nanjing.
focus_desc.sun_commander_rebuild: Release and reinstate surviving officers arrested in the purge, and promote proven younger commanders.
focus_desc.sun_commissar_abolish: Single command is restored and officers decide on the field.
focus_desc.sun_commissar_orders: Commissars share command with officers, to the army's irritation and the party's comfort.
focus_desc.sun_constituent_assembly: Old Mensheviks, liberals and disillusioned party members call for the Constituent Assembly that was dissolved in 1918.
focus_desc.sun_deep_battle: Write the theory of striking the enemy's entire depth at once into the 1936 field regulations.
focus_desc.sun_deep_ops_revived: The theory of striking the whole depth of the enemy at once is taught again, with its authors on the staff. Exercises resume at the scale the old school wanted.
focus_desc.sun_defence_in_depth: Belts of fortified lines let the army trade space for time.
focus_desc.sun_defence_industries: Arms plants are placed under army managers with their own quotas. Output rises and the civilian market gets what is left.
focus_desc.sun_design_bureaus: Organize engineers into bureaus, each taking a weapon from the prototype to the factory. Adds a research slot.
focus_desc.sun_dissolve_comintern: Stalin dissolves the Comintern to reassure his allies.
focus_desc.sun_dnieper_power: Connect the Dnieper hydroelectric station to a grid that feeds the factories of the south.
focus_desc.sun_donbas: Modernize the mines and mills of the Donets Basin, the oldest industrial region of the Union.
focus_desc.sun_espionage_rings: Agents abroad bring home scientific and industrial secrets.
focus_desc.sun_evacuate_east: Factories are dismantled and rebuilt beyond the Urals.
focus_desc.sun_evacuation: Load whole plants onto trains and rebuild them in the Urals before the front reaches them.
focus_desc.sun_far_east_army: Reinforce the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army and fortify the long border with Manchukuo.
focus_desc.sun_finland_demands: Leningrad lies within artillery range of the Finnish border. Ask Helsinki to move the border back in exchange for land further north.
focus_desc.sun_finland_treaty: Moscow settles for a friendship treaty and a quiet northern border.
focus_desc.sun_finland_winter: If Finland will not trade the Karelian Isthmus, the army will be ready to take it.
focus_desc.sun_forced_industrialise: Every resource goes to heavy industry at the cost of the people's patience.
focus_desc.sun_free_soviets: Workers and peasants demand freely elected soviets, as the revolution promised in 1917.
focus_desc.sun_garrison_state: The country is run as one large garrison: reserves are called up, depots are filled and every district has an officer who answers for it.
focus_desc.sun_general_secretary: Party, army and security organs answer to one man. The machine of fear is complete, and so is its price.
focus_desc.sun_general_staff_authority: The General Staff plans the war and the budget on its own authority, and civilian offices may only ask. The army is better organised; the state depends on it more.
focus_desc.sun_german_treaty: Talks with Berlin, on trade first and then on politics, could keep the Soviet Union out of a European war for now.
focus_desc.sun_great_purge: Party, state and army are searched for "enemies of the people". The purge brings huge gains and huge costs together; the control focuses below it soften the costs and sharpen the gains, and it lasts until you wind it down.
focus_desc.sun_ground_attack: Develop an armored aircraft that flies low over the battlefield and supports the infantry directly.
focus_desc.sun_guards: Divisions that distinguish themselves in battle earn the Guards title, higher pay and better equipment.
focus_desc.sun_gulag_labour: State construction trusts push building into the remote north and east, at a heavy cost to stability.
focus_desc.sun_harbin_emissaries: The Russian fascists in Manchuria send agents across the border with money, leaflets and promises.
focus_desc.sun_heavy_tanks: Heavier armour and guns, the KV-1 first, are built to break fortified lines.
focus_desc.sun_il2_sturmovik: The armoured ground-attack plane becomes the army's flying artillery.
focus_desc.sun_informer_network: Every workplace, barracks and village gets its listeners. Order holds because nobody trusts a neighbour.
focus_desc.sun_japan_neutrality: Offer Tokyo a neutrality pact so that the army can face west without worrying about the Far East.
focus_desc.sun_jet_design: A bureau is set up to develop jet engines and the aircraft that use them.
focus_desc.sun_kolkhoz_grain: Better procurement and incentives feed the cities and the army.
focus_desc.sun_lend_lease_soviet: Trucks, rails, fuel and rifles arrive over the northern, Persian and Pacific routes.
focus_desc.sun_long_range_aviation: A bomber arm is built to strike deep behind the lines.
focus_desc.sun_magnitogorsk: Add blast furnaces to the steel city built on the iron ore of Magnitnaya Mountain.
focus_desc.sun_manchurian_plan: With the war in Europe decided, the General Staff plans an offensive against the Kwantung Army in Manchuria.
focus_desc.sun_marshals_council: The marshals meet as a standing council that decides what no single general may. Rivalries are settled in the room instead of in the barracks.
focus_desc.sun_mass_mobilisation: Call up every age class the law allows and form new divisions as fast as they can be armed.
focus_desc.sun_mech_corps: Combine tank brigades into mechanized corps that can break through and drive deep.
focus_desc.sun_military_rule: The hardliners are broken and the army rules openly, with no party above it.
focus_desc.sun_mixed_economy: Peasants and craftsmen may sell what is left after the plan. Factories get new managers, and the shops get goods.
focus_desc.sun_moderate_economy: Slow the pace of heavy industry, ease the burden on the countryside and put more goods in the shops.
focus_desc.sun_mongolia_defence: Under the 1936 mutual assistance protocol, Soviet troops and engineers move into Mongolia.
focus_desc.sun_national_bolsheviks: Some in the party and the army argue that Russia, not the world revolution, is what matters.
focus_desc.sun_national_revolution: The legion rises against the party in the name of Russia. The Red Army splits, and the Union goes to civil war.
focus_desc.sun_nationalities_charter: The union republics receive written charters that fix their languages, schools and local offices. They owe the junta little and expect a lot of it.
focus_desc.sun_nep_amnesty: Prisoners of the old regime are released and its exiles invited home. The generals admit that the country cannot be ruled by orders alone.
focus_desc.sun_new_border_forts: Begin fortified districts along the border that moved west in 1939 and 1940.
focus_desc.sun_new_constitution: The Congress of Soviets adopts the 1936 Constitution, promising universal suffrage and a long list of civil rights.
focus_desc.sun_new_course: After Munich, faith in London and Paris has worn thin. The foreign commissariat gets new leadership and a freer hand.
focus_desc.sun_nkvd_broken: The security service is split into small offices under army officers. Its files, camps and informers no longer answer to the hardliners; the state loses many of its eyes.
focus_desc.sun_nkvd_control: The security organs rise above party and state. Their reports sharpen intelligence, and the economy answers to their plans.
focus_desc.sun_northern_fleet: Submarines and escorts defend the Arctic route.
focus_desc.sun_ocean_fleet: Lay down battleships and cruisers in the Leningrad and Black Sea yards for a fleet worthy of a great power.
focus_desc.sun_officers_restored: Officers are kept at their posts and promoted on merit instead of being denounced. Two new commanders are named, and the cadre trusts the staff again.
focus_desc.sun_old_guard_dismissed: The General Secretary's closest men are relieved one by one: the defence commissar, the head of government and the party's chief ideologue. The staff officers the old regime left idle are called back to fill the gap.
focus_desc.sun_operation_bagration: A vast summer offensive tears open the front in the east and drives the enemy back.
focus_desc.sun_partisan_movement: Units left behind the lines tie down the enemy's rear.
focus_desc.sun_party_collective: The Politburo governs as a body again and the army finds a steady footing in the party.
focus_desc.sun_party_concordat: The generals and the old party men agree on terms: the party keeps its committees in the economy and in the cities, and the army keeps the barracks.
focus_desc.sun_party_out_of_army: Political commissars lose the right to countersign orders and the party cells in the regiments are closed. Commanders command, and the party's eyes in the army go dark.
focus_desc.sun_party_returns: The party takes its seats back in the government, under a head who owes nothing to the old General Secretary. The army goes back to the barracks, with honours.
focus_desc.sun_patriotic_war: The country fights for its survival. Every factory, farm and family is called to the defense of the homeland.
focus_desc.sun_peasant_relief: Grain requisitions are lowered and the worst quotas are cancelled. Fewer villages go hungry, and more sons come back from the fields.
focus_desc.sun_permanent_revolution: The Comintern line returns: the Soviet Union is the base of a world revolution, to the alarm of its neighbours.
focus_desc.sun_personnel_control: Every appointment above company level passes through the center, which prizes obedience over initiative.
focus_desc.sun_poland_partition: Under the secret protocol, the Red Army moves on Poland's eastern half.
focus_desc.sun_political_commissars: Commissars stand beside every commander and answer for the troops' loyalty and discipline.
focus_desc.sun_purge_ends: The purge is wound down at a time of your choosing. Every gain and every cost it brought is removed; only an aftermath is left, heavier the longer the purge ran.
focus_desc.sun_radar_net: Early-warning radars are built along the western approaches.
focus_desc.sun_rail_gauge: New lines and rebuilt junctions speed the movement of troops and goods.
focus_desc.sun_railways: Add a second track to the Trans-Siberian and finish the lines the five-year plans left incomplete.
focus_desc.sun_red_air_force: Order fighters by the hundred and put the research teams to work on faster aircraft.
focus_desc.sun_red_bonaparte: The generals remove the General Secretary and take the state in hand. The party and the security organs rise against them, and the Union goes to civil war.
focus_desc.sun_rehabilitation: Officers jailed in the purge are freed and sent back to their commands.
focus_desc.sun_rkka_expansion: Convert territorial militia divisions into a standing cadre army and train more rifle divisions.
focus_desc.sun_rocket_artillery: Truck-mounted rocket launchers and field guns add fast, heavy fire.
focus_desc.sun_russian_legion: Officers, Cossacks and embittered peasants form a secret legion sworn to the nation.
focus_desc.sun_ryutin_platform: Copies of the banned platform pass from hand to hand: end the dictatorship, free the peasants, restore democracy in the party.
focus_desc.sun_scorched_earth: Retreating armies strip the land of anything the enemy could use, at a heavy cost at home.
focus_desc.sun_second_february: As in February 1917, strikes and mutinies bring down the rulers in the cities. A provisional government forms, the party fights back, and the Union goes to civil war.
focus_desc.sun_second_front_demand: Moscow presses London and Washington to open a front in the west.
focus_desc.sun_second_fyp: Finish the last construction projects of the plan begun in 1933 on schedule and bring the new plants into production.
focus_desc.sun_self_propelled_guns: Guns on tank hulls follow the advance and answer enemy armour.
focus_desc.sun_shock_armies: Reinforced armies are formed to break through the enemy line.
focus_desc.sun_show_trials: Public trials of old Bolsheviks teach the whole party what happens to doubters: steadier streets and a stronger will for war.
focus_desc.sun_siberian_oil: New fields beyond the Volga ease the dependence on Baku.
focus_desc.sun_socialism_one_country: The party doubles down on building socialism at home and drops hopes of imminent revolution abroad.
focus_desc.sun_special_bureaus: Arrested designers keep working under guard in closed bureaus, and the aircraft and tanks keep coming.
focus_desc.sun_spheres: The secret protocol places Finland, the Baltic states and Bessarabia in the Soviet sphere. Moscow prepares its demands.
focus_desc.sun_stakhanov: Since Alexei Stakhanov's record shift in 1935, record-breaking workers are held up as examples to all.
focus_desc.sun_stalin_line: Add bunkers and garrisons to the fortified districts along the old western border.
focus_desc.sun_stavka_control: The high command directs the fronts from Moscow with seasoned generals.
focus_desc.sun_submarines: Build the largest submarine force in the world to guard the approaches to Soviet ports.
focus_desc.sun_tank_armies: T-34 tanks, motor infantry and guns are combined into powerful mobile armies.
focus_desc.sun_tank_works: Turn the locomotive and tractor plants of Kharkiv, Leningrad and Chelyabinsk over to tank production.
focus_desc.sun_tankograd: Chelyabinsk and the Urals become one large tank-building complex turning out the T-34.
focus_desc.sun_tehran_conference: Stalin, Roosevelt and Churchill meet and agree on the shape of the second front.
focus_desc.sun_third_fyp: The new plan puts the defense industry first and builds up production east of the Volga.
focus_desc.sun_ural_base: Build a second industrial heartland in the Urals, far from every border.
focus_desc.sun_war_economy_plan: Gosplan puts the whole economy on a war footing.
focus_desc.sun_western_alliance: Press London and Paris for a binding military pact and pledge to defend Poland and Romania.
focus_desc.sun_winter_war_lessons: The costly war in Finland is studied without illusions, and training, ranks and command are overhauled.
focus_desc.sun_yak_fighters: Light, easy-to-build fighters win back the air.
focus_desc.sun_yalta_terms: The Big Three settle the postwar map and Moscow's entry into the Pacific war.
focus_desc.sun_zhdanov_cultural: Arts and sciences are bound to the party line, which rallies the loyal and stifles the curious.
focus_desc.swe_activist_officers: Young officers who volunteered in Finland despise the neutral politicians and start to listen.
focus_desc.swe_adalen_remembered: Soldiers fired on striking workers at Ådalen in 1931 and five died. The memory still burns in the north.
focus_desc.swe_air_defence_centres: Observers on every hill, telephones to a central room and guns around the capital.
focus_desc.swe_aland_plan: Fortify the Åland Islands together with Finland and close the Gulf of Bothnia. Moscow will not like it.
focus_desc.swe_anti_tank_guns: The Bofors 37 mm can stop any tank of the day. Every infantry regiment needs a company of them.
focus_desc.swe_arctic_supply: Roads and sidings up to the border, depots for a winter campaign.
focus_desc.swe_armed_neutrality: Neutrality is respected only when it can be defended: a larger army and a resolute people.
focus_desc.swe_armed_watch: Neutrality is a promise only as good as the army behind it. Put the forces on watch and prepare to climb the ladder of readiness.
focus_desc.swe_arms_industry: Expand the arms industry that builds field guns and anti-aircraft guns.
focus_desc.swe_arms_programme: Build arms factories for a war Sweden hopes never to fight.
focus_desc.swe_army_doctrine: Hold the coast and the north, trade space in the forests, wait for the enemy to tire. Write it down and teach it.
focus_desc.swe_army_reform_1942: With the lessons of a world at war, rebuild the divisions with more guns, more lorries and armour of their own.
focus_desc.swe_asea_electrification: The electrical company builds transformers and lines for the whole country, and learns a great deal on the way.
focus_desc.swe_ball_bearings: Every tank, aircraft and lorry in Europe rolls on bearings, and the best come from Gothenburg. That is a strength and a danger.
focus_desc.swe_baltic_outposts: Gotland and the outer islands sit in the middle of the Baltic. Garrison them before someone else does.
focus_desc.swe_bergslagen_mills: The old iron country of the middle north still holds forges, mines and skilled hands. Put them to work.
focus_desc.swe_boden_fortress: The great fortress in the north guards the ore railway and the road from Finland. Modernise its forts.
focus_desc.swe_bofors_artillery: Sweden sells modern guns abroad while its own batteries still fire Krupp pieces from 1902. Buy at home first.
focus_desc.swe_bofors_works: The guns of Karlskoga are wanted on every continent. Grow the works and keep the best for Sweden.
focus_desc.swe_bomber_wings: Twin-engined bombers that can reach any port from which an invasion could sail.
focus_desc.swe_carl_gustaf_arsenal: The rifle factory at Eskilstuna can make Swedish rifles and automatic rifles, if it is given the orders.
focus_desc.swe_coastal_artillery: Guns in the rock at the approaches to Stockholm, Gothenburg and Karlskrona.
focus_desc.swe_coastal_fleet: Armoured ships, destroyers and submarines among the skerries: a fleet made to defend, not to roam.
focus_desc.swe_courtyard_memory: Once the king told thirty thousand farmers in his courtyard that the army needed more. Will he say it again?
focus_desc.swe_crisis_settlement: The Social Democrats bought the Farmers' League's votes with grain prices and got public works in return. Keep the bargain alive and the country stays governable.
focus_desc.swe_crown_rises: The king dismisses the ministers and calls his own. If the parties will not go quietly, the country splits.
focus_desc.swe_cruiser_programme: Two real cruisers to lead the coastal fleet, if the yards can find the guns.
focus_desc.swe_danish_brigade: Danes who escaped across the Sound form a brigade on Swedish soil.
focus_desc.swe_defence_question: Ten years of cuts left a cadre army. The Riksdag must decide how much rearmament a neutral country can afford, and the vote may break the cabinet.
focus_desc.swe_defence_research: A defence research institute of the state's own, so the armed forces stop buying their science abroad.
focus_desc.swe_democracy_defended: Should anyone have taken power outside the Riksdag, the democratic majority will take it back. Otherwise, steadiness is its own reward.
focus_desc.swe_destroyer_programme: Fast modern destroyers to escort convoys and chase submarines in the Baltic.
focus_desc.swe_dive_bombers: A home-built dive bomber to strike landing fleets on the coast.
focus_desc.swe_end_of_concessions: As the war turns, take back what was given under pressure and look to the coming peace.
focus_desc.swe_farmers_and_officers: The countryside's defence leagues and the officers' clubs find a common enemy in the Stockholm politicians.
focus_desc.swe_fighters_abroad: Buy whatever fighters the world will sell, British, American or Italian, before the sellers go to war themselves.
focus_desc.swe_finland_alliance: Stand by Finland with the whole army, whatever Moscow says. A small country alone dies; two may live.
focus_desc.swe_finland_volunteers: If Finland is attacked, send volunteers, arms and money, but not the army. Finland's cause is ours, up to a point.
focus_desc.swe_finnish_brothers: Finland is the eastern wall of the north. Sweden promises to stand behind it.
focus_desc.swe_flygvapnet: A young, independent air force with old biplanes. It needs aircraft and pilots quickly.
focus_desc.swe_folkhem_course: Per Albin Hansson's promise: a society like a good home, where no one is a stepchild. Reform stays in parliament and the democrats hold the centre.
focus_desc.swe_four_party_cabinet: With war at the gates, the four democratic parties share the cabinet and leave only the communists outside.
focus_desc.swe_general_staff: Officers who plan corps and armies instead of companies, trained at home.
focus_desc.swe_infantry_divisions: Group the regiments into divisions that can fight on their own, with their own guns.
focus_desc.swe_information_board: A state board that advises the newspapers what not to print. It calls this keeping the peace.
focus_desc.swe_iron_ore: Raise iron-ore output at Kiruna and Gällivare and improve the export terms.
focus_desc.swe_joint_arms_standards: One calibre, one rifle, one manual for every Nordic army.
focus_desc.swe_joint_naval_command: The Swedish, Norwegian and Danish fleets train and plan as one.
focus_desc.swe_karlskrona_yards: The naval base's dockyard and the private yards can build more if they are given steel and men.
focus_desc.swe_kings_cabinet: Draw up a government of civil servants and experts, chosen by the palace and answerable to no party.
focus_desc.swe_kvarntorp_shale: Sweden has no oil, but it has alum shale. Heating it underground gives fuel, expensively.
focus_desc.swe_landsverk_tanks: The Landskrona firm builds light tanks for export with torsion bars and Bofors guns. Order them for the Swedish army.
focus_desc.swe_linderot_line: Sven Linderot keeps the party on Moscow's line and ready for the day the system cracks.
focus_desc.swe_lindholm_movement: Sven Olov Lindholm's party wants a Swedish socialism of the nation, not Berlin's copy. Its torches light up the capital.
focus_desc.swe_lkab_expansion: New shafts and new crushers: whoever wins the war will want more ore than ever.
focus_desc.swe_lulea_harbour: Narvik in Norway never freezes; Luleå on the Baltic does. Deepen Luleå's quays so the ore has a Swedish way out.
focus_desc.swe_minefields: Mine the approaches and the narrow sounds; let no warship pass without a pilot.
focus_desc.swe_national_renewal: Small, quarrelling groups of national socialists and young conservatives dream of a Sweden that marches. Give them a voice.
focus_desc.swe_national_rising: The movement and its officers move on the ministries. The army must choose a side, and so must every town.
focus_desc.swe_neutrality_tested: Every month brings a new demand from one side or the other. The government must bend without breaking.
focus_desc.swe_new_army_order: Throw out the 1925 economies: longer service, real divisions and officers who have seen a manoeuvre.
focus_desc.swe_new_order: Parties are dissolved and unions folded into the state. Berlin watches its new northern friend with interest.
focus_desc.swe_new_swedish_movement: Per Engdahl's young intellectuals preach a corporate state rooted in Swedish tradition.
focus_desc.swe_nordic_crown: The union is proclaimed in Stockholm. The north speaks with one voice.
focus_desc.swe_nordic_defence_council: Bring the Nordic armies under one council, with Stockholm in the chair.
focus_desc.swe_nordic_idea: Three crowns and a republic that once were one: why not again, against the giants on either side?
focus_desc.swe_norrland_air_bases: Airfields cut into the forest and frozen lakes, so the air force can meet an enemy anywhere.
focus_desc.swe_norrland_troops: Half of Sweden is forest, bog and snow. Train troops who live and fight there all winter.
focus_desc.swe_northern_rivers: The Lule and the Indal rivers fall hundreds of metres to the sea. Dam them and the factories run on water.
focus_desc.swe_norwegian_police: Train and arm Norwegian refugees as 'police' in Swedish camps, ready to go home when the time comes.
focus_desc.swe_ore_diplomacy: Both sides need Swedish ore. Sell it by the year, and make every contract buy something back.
focus_desc.swe_ore_fields: Kiruna and Malmberget hold the richest iron ore in Europe. Push the mines and the state company harder.
focus_desc.swe_ore_leverage: Whoever depends on Swedish ore can be made to listen. Hold the threat of an embargo in reserve.
focus_desc.swe_ore_railway: Double the iron road from the Lapland mines to the harbours and keep the trains running through the polar night.
focus_desc.swe_ore_to_britain: Turn the ore trade west, to Britain and America. Berlin will call it a hostile act.
focus_desc.swe_ore_to_germany: Germany pays in coal and coke, which Sweden lacks. The bargain is old and convenient, and London keeps count.
focus_desc.swe_oslo_group: The small neutrals of the north and the Low Countries agree to keep their trade open and their politics apart from the great powers.
focus_desc.swe_own_fighter: When nobody will sell fighters any more, build one at home, of wood and steel tube if need be.
focus_desc.swe_pension_reform: Raise the folk pension, add unemployment insurance and paid holidays. The treasury groans, but fewer families fall through the floor.
focus_desc.swe_permit_traffic: Let German soldiers on leave cross Swedish railways to and from Norway. It buys peace and shames many.
focus_desc.swe_planned_welfare: Planning without socialism, markets without misery: economists and union men draw up the post-crisis economy together.
focus_desc.swe_population_question: The Myrdals warn that Swedes have stopped having children. Child allowances, maternity care and housing loans answer them, and the barracks will fill one day.
focus_desc.swe_post_war_plan: The war will end. Commissions draw up the housing, schools and industry of the years after.
focus_desc.swe_rail_electrification: Coal is imported and electricity is not. Electrify the main lines and the trains no longer depend on foreign ships.
focus_desc.swe_raise_home_guard: Men too old or too young for the army, farmers and factory hands with rifles at home, guarding bridges and villages.
focus_desc.swe_rationing: Coffee, sugar, bread and fuel by the card, so that nobody hoards and nobody starves.
focus_desc.swe_readiness_years: The war has come to the neighbourhood. Call up the reserves and keep them under arms.
focus_desc.swe_red_front: The Social Democrats have made peace with capital, say the communists. The workers of the sawmills and the mines deserve better.
focus_desc.swe_red_unions: Win the locals of the miners, dockers and forest workers away from the reformists.
focus_desc.swe_refuge_in_the_north: Norwegians, Danes, Finnish children and Baltic refugees cross into Sweden. Take them in.
focus_desc.swe_refuse_transit: No foreign soldier crosses Sweden. If Berlin answers with threats, the army will be at the border.
focus_desc.swe_research_council: Bring the universities, the defence staff and industry around one table and fund what they agree on.
focus_desc.swe_royal_course: Officers, farmers and the old right look to the palace. They say parliament talks while the country lies open, and Gustaf V has spoken over its head before.
focus_desc.swe_royal_rule: The king governs with his officials and the army behind him; parliament sits when it is called.
focus_desc.swe_saab_founded: An aircraft company of Sweden's own, so the air force is not at the mercy of foreign suppliers.
focus_desc.swe_safe_conduct: A few ships a month may pass the blockades with both sides' consent. Use every one of them.
focus_desc.swe_saltsjobaden: Unions and employers meet at a seaside hotel to settle strikes and lockouts among themselves, without the state. Whether they sign is their choice.
focus_desc.swe_scandinavian_pact: Sweden guarantees Norway and Denmark: an attack on one is an attack on Sweden.
focus_desc.swe_skane_line: A chain of concrete bunkers along the southern coast, facing Denmark and Germany across the water.
focus_desc.swe_ski_brigades: Light brigades on skis and reindeer sledges, the army's own answer to the north.
focus_desc.swe_special_steels: Swedish charcoal steel is famous for its purity. Ball bearings, gun barrels and armour plate all want it.
focus_desc.swe_submarine_flotillas: Small submarines that lie in wait in the narrow waters of the Baltic.
focus_desc.swe_tank_battalions: A handful of tanks is a curiosity; a battalion is a weapon. Train crews and officers together.
focus_desc.swe_total_defence_plan: Every citizen, factory and village has a task in war, written down in peacetime.
focus_desc.swe_transit: With Norway in German hands, let German soldiers on leave and goods cross Sweden by rail.
focus_desc.swe_union_by_force: If they will not come freely, the union will be made the old way.
focus_desc.swe_union_constitution: Draft a constitution for a Nordic union: one foreign policy, one army, many parliaments.
focus_desc.swe_union_denmark: Denmark lies open to the south. A union would bring it behind Swedish guns.
focus_desc.swe_union_finland: Finland was Swedish for six centuries. Ask it to come home, as an equal.
focus_desc.swe_union_norway: Norway left the union in 1905 and has not forgotten. Offer it a partnership of equals this time.
focus_desc.swe_uppsala_physics: Sweden's Nobel physicists and chemists can turn their laboratories to radio, optics and explosives.
focus_desc.swe_which_sweden: The people's home, a king's government, a national revolution or a workers' state: every movement claims the future of the country.
focus_desc.swe_wood_gas: Lorries and buses grow stoves on their backs and run on charcoal from the forests.
focus_desc.swe_workers_republic: The councils govern, the banks are nationalised and Moscow sends advisers across the Baltic.
focus_desc.swe_workers_rising: A general strike turns into a seizure of the mines and the ports. The government will not give way without a fight.
focus_desc.tur_active_neutrality: Turkey stays out of the war while trading and talking with both sides. Neither side wants Turkey as an enemy.
focus_desc.tur_active_neutrality_course: Friendly to all, bound to none: Turkey will sell to everyone and fight for no one, unless it must.
focus_desc.tur_adana_talks: The British prime minister comes to Adana with promises of arms, and asks when Turkey will join the war.
focus_desc.tur_air_defence_network: Guns and observers around Ankara and the Straits.
focus_desc.tur_air_force: Modern fighters are bought abroad and new squadrons are formed.
focus_desc.tur_aleppo_claim: Aleppo was in the National Pact. The French mandate is no longer what it was.
focus_desc.tur_allied_treaty: A treaty of mutual assistance with Britain and France brings credits and arms.
focus_desc.tur_ammunition_works: A country that buys its shells abroad can be starved of them in a week. New works end that.
focus_desc.tur_anatolian_redoubt: If Istanbul falls the war goes on from the plateau, as it did in 1921.
focus_desc.tur_ankara_faculties: Faculties of language, history and geography in the new capital, and laboratories to go with them.
focus_desc.tur_anti_tank_guns: Light guns for the infantry, so that a single tank no longer scatters a regiment.
focus_desc.tur_army_of_the_republic: The army that won the war of independence is old and poor. It needs schools, rifles and a plan.
focus_desc.tur_army_reform: Divisions are reorganised and officers are trained in modern staff work.
focus_desc.tur_artillery_park: Field guns and howitzers from Škoda and Krupp replace the worn guns of the old wars.
focus_desc.tur_ataturk_succession: The founder is dead. The Assembly must choose who holds the Republic together after him, and quickly.
focus_desc.tur_aviation_society: A national subscription buys aircraft for the army, and every town wants one named after it.
focus_desc.tur_axis_alignment: Berlin promises a free hand among the Turks of the Caucasus. Some in Ankara listen.
focus_desc.tur_balkan_alliance: The pact becomes an alliance with a common command. The small nations stand together or fall alone.
focus_desc.tur_balkan_entente: The pact with Greece, Yugoslavia and Romania is made the core of a regional bloc.
focus_desc.tur_balkan_entente_pact: Turkey, Greece, Yugoslavia and Romania promise to keep each other's frontiers.
focus_desc.tur_balkan_staff_talks: The general staffs of Ankara and Athens meet to plan the defence of Thrace together.
focus_desc.tur_bayar_liberalism: Celal Bayar, the banker of the Republic, wants private enterprise alongside the state mills and fewer orders from Ankara.
focus_desc.tur_bomber_squadrons: A few squadrons of modern bombers, bought abroad, give the air force a longer arm.
focus_desc.tur_british_fighters: London sells fighters to keep Ankara friendly. They arrive in crates at Izmir.
focus_desc.tur_cakmak_staff: Marshal Çakmak has led the General Staff since the war of independence, careful, thorough and in no hurry.
focus_desc.tur_capital_levy: A one-time tax on wealth to pay for the army. The commissions set the sums, and there is no appeal.
focus_desc.tur_caucasus_claim: Azerbaijan was briefly free in 1918, with a Turkish army in Baku. The claim is made again.
focus_desc.tur_caucasus_frontier: Kars and Ağrı face the Soviet border. The old forts are rebuilt for modern guns.
focus_desc.tur_cavalry_divisions: Horses are cheap and Anatolia is wide. The cavalry still has its place.
focus_desc.tur_chromium: Chrome ore becomes a bargaining chip that both blocs want to buy.
focus_desc.tur_chromium_diplomacy: Both sides need Turkish chromium for their steel. Ankara sells to whoever pays best and keeps them both guessing.
focus_desc.tur_conscription_reform: Every man serves, and the villages that hid their sons from the Ottoman recruiters are counted at last.
focus_desc.tur_corporatist_charter: Workers and employers are bound into chambers under the state. Strikes and lockouts are both forbidden.
focus_desc.tur_defence_doctrine: No army of ours can match a great power in the open. Let them come into the mountains and the lines.
focus_desc.tur_democrat_party: The dissidents leave the party and found their own. Villages that never saw a candidate now see two.
focus_desc.tur_dersim_question: The mountain district of Dersim has never answered to Ankara. The government means to settle it, by force if it must.
focus_desc.tur_destroyer_orders: Italian and British yards build the destroyers the Republic cannot build itself.
focus_desc.tur_divrigi_iron: Iron ore in the hills of Sivas, linked by a new line to the steelworks.
focus_desc.tur_dodecanese_claim: Italy's islands lie a few miles off the Anatolian coast, and Italian bases on them threaten Izmir.
focus_desc.tur_eastern_rail: The line from Sivas is carried on towards Erzurum. Troops and supplies reach the eastern border faster.
focus_desc.tur_eastern_railway: The line pushes on from Sivas toward Erzurum, so that an army can reach the eastern frontier in days, not weeks.
focus_desc.tur_etatism: Private capital is scarce and timid. The state will build the factories itself and hand them to the nation.
focus_desc.tur_etibank_mines: A new state bank for mines and power takes over the copper, chromium and coal concessions.
focus_desc.tur_first_five_year_plan: Textile mills, sugar, paper, glass: the first plan builds what the country imports most.
focus_desc.tur_first_plan: State enterprises build textile, paper and cement works across Anatolia.
focus_desc.tur_four_memorandum: Four deputies put a motion to the party group: let the laws of the constitution be applied, and let a second party stand.
focus_desc.tur_free_elections: Secret ballot and open count. If the people vote the old party out, it goes.
focus_desc.tur_free_press_law: The newspapers may criticise the ministers again. Not everyone in the party likes what they print.
focus_desc.tur_general_mobilisation: A million men under arms, on the borders of Thrace and the Caucasus.
focus_desc.tur_german_friendship_treaty: Germany's armies stand on the Bulgarian border. A treaty of friendship keeps them there.
focus_desc.tur_german_treaty: A treaty of friendship with Germany keeps the war away from the Turkish border.
focus_desc.tur_golcuk_navy_yard: A floating dock and a naval yard on the Gulf of İzmit, deep inside the Sea of Marmara.
focus_desc.tur_grey_wolf_journals: The grey wolf of the old legends appears on the covers of new magazines, and their readers multiply in the barracks and the lycées.
focus_desc.tur_guardian_of_the_straits: Guns, mines, ships and the Thracian line make the Straits one fortress.
focus_desc.tur_guleman_chromium: The chromium mines of Elazığ are among the richest in the world, and every arms maker wants their ore.
focus_desc.tur_hatay: Ankara takes up the future of the sanjak of Alexandretta with France.
focus_desc.tur_hatay_republic: With Turkish troops in the Sanjak, its assembly proclaims the State of Hatay. Union is a matter of time.
focus_desc.tur_heavy_industry_plan: Steel, coal and iron are in place. Now the state builds the workshops that turn them into guns and engines.
focus_desc.tur_independent_group: A group of deputies inside the Assembly is told to criticise the government. Opposition, within limits the party sets.
focus_desc.tur_iron_web: Erzurum and Kars are joined to the network. The song of the tenth anniversary comes true.
focus_desc.tur_join_allies: In the last months of the war Turkey declares war on Germany and joins the Allies.
focus_desc.tur_join_the_allies: The war is decided. To sit at the peace table Turkey declares war on Germany.
focus_desc.tur_kadro_circle: Former communists in the journal Kadro argue that statism must go further, toward planning without capitalists.
focus_desc.tur_karabuk: The country's first integrated iron and steel works rises near the Zonguldak coalfield.
focus_desc.tur_karabuk_steelworks: The first blast furnace of the Republic, near the coal of Zonguldak, built with British help.
focus_desc.tur_kayseri_aircraft_works: The aircraft factory at Kayseri grows from an assembly shop into a works that builds whole airframes.
focus_desc.tur_kemalist_course: No new parties and no new masters: the Republican People's Party stays the only road, and the reforms go on from above.
focus_desc.tur_kemalist_republic: Thirteen years after the war of independence the Republic stands on the founder's reforms and one party. What it does next decides what it becomes.
focus_desc.tur_kirikkale_arsenal: Near Ankara, far from any coast, the state builds its own works for rifles, shells and powder.
focus_desc.tur_last_line: There is no line, there is a surface, and that surface is the whole country.
focus_desc.tur_left_opening: The workers of Istanbul and the miners of Zonguldak have no party of their own. Someone offers them one.
focus_desc.tur_liberal_opening: Merchants, landowners and young deputies want the market and the ballot box. The party lets the door open a little.
focus_desc.tur_mechanised_brigade: A few dozen tanks from abroad are gathered into one brigade, to learn what tanks can do.
focus_desc.tur_mehmetcik: The Anatolian soldier who held Gallipoli: patient, hardy, content with little.
focus_desc.tur_menderes_cabinet: The new government favours the farmer, the tractor and the American loan.
focus_desc.tur_mke_merger: The scattered army workshops are merged into one state concern, with modern machine tools.
focus_desc.tur_montreux: Under the new convention the Straits zone is garrisoned and fortified again.
focus_desc.tur_montreux_conference: Lausanne left the Straits demilitarised under an international commission. At Montreux Ankara asks for them back, with the right to fortify them and to close them in war.
focus_desc.tur_mosul_claim: Mosul and its oil went to Iraq by the League's verdict. Ankara asks for it again.
focus_desc.tur_mountain_corps: The frontier with the Soviet Union runs through mountains. Divisions with mules and pack guns are made for it.
focus_desc.tur_national_chief: The new president takes the title of National Chief. Power gathers in one office, and the cabinets come and go beneath it.
focus_desc.tur_national_pact_revived: The pact of 1920 drew the frontier further south and west than Lausanne did. Some say its promise was never given up.
focus_desc.tur_national_protection_law: Prices are fixed, goods requisitioned and men conscripted for work. The government rules the economy by decree.
focus_desc.tur_nationalist_turn: Some in the party look at Rome and Berlin and see a stronger kind of single-party state.
focus_desc.tur_offensive_doctrine: The war of independence was won by attack. The army trusts the charge.
focus_desc.tur_officer_academies: War College graduates come back from courses in Germany, France and Britain and write new manuals.
focus_desc.tur_orkun_circle: Young writers around Nihal Atsız's journal dream of all the Turks under one flag and despise the cautious men in Ankara.
focus_desc.tur_outside_turks: Millions of Turks live under Soviet rule. The new government says they are not forgotten.
focus_desc.tur_p24_licence: Poland sells its gull-winged fighter and the right to build it at Kayseri.
focus_desc.tur_pact_fulfilled: Lands of the National Pact are Turkish again. The Republic has kept a promise older than itself.
focus_desc.tur_party_state_merger: The party's provincial chairmen become the governors; the party's secretary sits in the cabinet. There is no line left between them.
focus_desc.tur_peace_at_home: The founder's motto: no adventures abroad while the country is rebuilt. Old enemies in Athens and Moscow become neighbours to live with.
focus_desc.tur_peker_government: Recep Peker takes the government with the party machine behind him. The Assembly votes as it is told.
focus_desc.tur_peoples_houses: In every town a hall for lectures, plays, libraries and night classes, run by the party to carry the reforms to the people.
focus_desc.tur_peoples_poets: Verses about peasants and stokers pass from hand to hand, and the poets go to prison for them.
focus_desc.tur_railway_nationalisation: Foreign companies built the old lines. The Republic buys them back, one by one.
focus_desc.tur_raman_oil: Geologists find oil near Batman. It is not much, but it is the Republic's own.
focus_desc.tur_red_rising: Strikes become barricades, and the barricades become a civil war.
focus_desc.tur_saadabad: A non-aggression pact with Iran, Iraq and Afghanistan secures the eastern borders.
focus_desc.tur_saadabad_pact: Turkey, Iran, Iraq and Afghanistan sign a pact of non-aggression in the Shah's palace.
focus_desc.tur_sanjak_question: Alexandretta and Antioch, with their Turkish population, were left to French Syria. Ankara raises the matter in Geneva.
focus_desc.tur_second_five_year_plan: Mines, power stations and ports: the second plan reaches for heavy industry.
focus_desc.tur_second_plan: Mining, electric power and roads lead the next plan. More coal and power keep the factories running.
focus_desc.tur_six_arrows_charter: Republicanism, nationalism, populism, statism, secularism and revolution are written into the constitution itself.
focus_desc.tur_soviet_brotherhood: The old friendship of the war of independence returns, this time between two workers' states.
focus_desc.tur_status_quo_frontiers: The Republic wants nothing more from its neighbours. Its strength is that no one fears it.
focus_desc.tur_straits_fleet: Larger shipyards at Istanbul keep a fleet ready to guard the Straits.
focus_desc.tur_straits_guardian: Forts, fleet and the army in Thrace hold the passage between two seas together.
focus_desc.tur_straits_minefields: In 1915 a single minelayer sank three battleships in the Dardanelles. The lesson is kept.
focus_desc.tur_submarine_flotilla: Small submarines to guard the approaches of the Aegean and the Black Sea.
focus_desc.tur_succession: The assembly elects a new president at once and the state carries on.
focus_desc.tur_sumerbank_mills: The state bank builds a great cotton kombinat at Kayseri, with Soviet machines and credit.
focus_desc.tur_thrace: Fortified lines cover the approaches to Istanbul and Edirne. The European foothold is narrow and its neighbours are close.
focus_desc.tur_thrace_fortifications: A belt of bunkers and anti-tank ditches across Thrace, to hold the road to Istanbul.
focus_desc.tur_tripartite_treaty: A treaty of mutual assistance with Britain and France, with credits for arms. There is a clause that keeps Turkey out of a war with the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.tur_turan_mandate: The new rulers speak of a nation beyond the borders: Azerbaijan, Turkestan, the Turks of the Volga.
focus_desc.tur_turan_union: Anatolia and Azerbaijan under one flag: the first step toward the Turan of the poets.
focus_desc.tur_turanist_officers: Junior officers read the journals and talk about the Turks of the Caucasus and Turkestan.
focus_desc.tur_turanist_rising: The circles and their officers move against the government. The army has to choose.
focus_desc.tur_turkestan_appeal: Radio broadcasts and émigré committees speak to the Turks of Central Asia.
focus_desc.tur_turkkusu_school: The gliding and flying school near Ankara trains young pilots, among them the first woman combat pilot of the Republic.
focus_desc.tur_underground_tkp: The banned Communist Party of Turkey rebuilds its cells in the ports and the factories.
focus_desc.tur_university_reform: The old Darülfünun is closed and Istanbul University opened in its place, staffed by scholars fleeing Germany.
focus_desc.tur_village_institutes: Teachers trained in the villages spread reading, farming skills and crafts.
focus_desc.tur_village_institutes_project: Village children are trained as teachers, farmers and builders, then sent home to teach the next village.
focus_desc.tur_western_thrace_claim: A Turkish minority lives across the Evros. Ankara stops pretending not to see it.
focus_desc.tur_yavuz_refit: The old battlecruiser is still the strongest ship in the Black Sea. Her crews train to keep her that way.
focus_desc.tur_youth_drill: Schoolboys march with wooden rifles on Sundays. The party wants a generation that obeys.
focus_desc.tur_zonguldak_coal: New shafts and a railway to the coast feed the furnaces of Karabük.
focus_desc.tur_zonguldak_miners: The coal basin works on forced labour laws and low pay. The miners are ready to listen.
focus_desc.usa_air_corps: The Army Air Corps orders thousands of new aircraft and opens schools to train their crews.
focus_desc.usa_airborne: A test platoon of parachutists grows into whole divisions trained to drop behind enemy lines.
focus_desc.usa_airborne_2: The airborne arm grows from regiments to full divisions, with gliders and troop carriers to match.
focus_desc.usa_aluminium_programme: New smelters, powered by the dams of the Tennessee and the Columbia, feed the aircraft plants.
focus_desc.usa_america_first: The isolationists win the argument: America will arm itself but keep out of Europe's quarrels and guard its own hemisphere.
focus_desc.usa_american_soviet: A general strike in the industrial states becomes a seizure of power. Washington calls out the army, and the Union goes to civil war.
focus_desc.usa_armored_force: Tank units scattered between the infantry and the cavalry are gathered into one force with its own armored divisions.
focus_desc.usa_army_expansion: The small peacetime army begins to grow, with more regiments and a leaner, faster infantry division.
focus_desc.usa_arsenal_of_democracy: The President tells the nation that America must become the great arsenal of democracy for those who fight aggression.
focus_desc.usa_atlantic_conference: Roosevelt and Churchill meet off Newfoundland and set out common war aims: no conquests, self-determination and freedom of the seas.
focus_desc.usa_atlantic_exchange: Engineers and designers cross the ocean in both directions. German armour and aircraft know-how flows to American plants, and American mass production flows back.
focus_desc.usa_axis_pact: Washington signs with the revisionist powers and takes its seat in their camp. The old friendships across the Atlantic are over, and a new order of three great blocs is declared.
focus_desc.usa_b29_programme: The costliest aircraft programme of the war begins before anyone has flown the bomber.
focus_desc.usa_bases_deal: Old destroyers go to Britain, and in return America leases bases from Newfoundland to the Caribbean.
focus_desc.usa_big_inch_pipeline: A pipeline from Texas to the east coast carries oil that tankers can no longer bring safely.
focus_desc.usa_bretton_woods: Delegates plan a postwar monetary order around the dollar, an international bank and a fund for stable exchange rates.
focus_desc.usa_business_backers: Bankers and industrialists who hate the New Deal start paying for the new movement. Money buys newspapers, halls and an organisation that reaches every state.
focus_desc.usa_business_plot: Wealthy men approach a famous general to lead half a million veterans on Washington.
focus_desc.usa_c47_transport: The airliner-turned-transport carries paratroopers, freight and wounded men to every theatre.
focus_desc.usa_caribbean_sea: The island chain is declared the nation's inner sea. A claim is laid on Cuba, new docks are laid down along the Gulf, and the fleet is told to clear the lanes.
focus_desc.usa_cash_and_carry: The Neutrality Act of 1939 lets nations at war buy American arms if they pay in cash and carry them home in their own ships.
focus_desc.usa_central_pacific_drive: The fleet's carriers drive west across the Gilberts, Marshalls and Marianas, each step setting up the next.
focus_desc.usa_china_aid: Rifles and trucks travel the Burma Road to China, and American pilots volunteer to fly for its air force.
focus_desc.usa_china_embargo: Scrap iron, then oil, are cut off from Japan until it leaves China.
focus_desc.usa_coup_path: Financiers, veterans and a few retired generals sound out a march on the capital to push the president aside. They need no majority, only enough rifles in the right place.
focus_desc.usa_court_accept: The administration lets the Supreme Court be and waits for justices to retire. The party stays united, if slowly.
focus_desc.usa_court_neutered: The bench is enlarged, retired and refilled until it stops standing in the way. Rulings that once struck down the programme now bless it.
focus_desc.usa_court_packing: Roosevelt asks Congress for up to six more justices to save the New Deal laws. The fight splits his own party, but the Court begins to bend.
focus_desc.usa_defense_research: Scientists from the universities and industry are organised to develop new weapons under government contracts.
focus_desc.usa_detroit_arsenal: Car plants around the Great Lakes retool to build tanks, engines and bombers.
focus_desc.usa_emergency_powers: Under the cover of crisis, Congress is asked to hand the executive wide powers over banks, prices and assembly. Each extension is called temporary.
focus_desc.usa_escort_fighters: Drop tanks and new fighters let the escorts stay with the bombers all the way to the target and back.
focus_desc.usa_essex_class: A new class of fast carriers leaves the slips every few months, with air groups to match.
focus_desc.usa_europe_first: Staff talks with Britain settle it: Germany is the main enemy, and the Pacific must hold while Europe is decided.
focus_desc.usa_fair_employment: A committee bars defence contractors from discriminating in hiring, opening war work to more of the country's labour.
focus_desc.usa_fast_carriers: New fast aircraft carriers become the heart of the fleet, with battleships as their escorts.
focus_desc.usa_federal_guard: The state guards are taken out of the governors' hands and put under one command. Overnight the country has a standing reserve it can move wherever it chooses.
focus_desc.usa_fleet_programme: A single programme funds yards on both coasts with orders that outlast any budget fight. The navy is meant to be able to face two oceans at once.
focus_desc.usa_free_market_war: Business leaders are given freedom and fat contracts. Output climbs fast, and prices climb with it.
focus_desc.usa_general_in_waiting: A respected general agrees to take charge for the emergency. Officers in several commands are sounded out.
focus_desc.usa_gi_replacement: Individual replacements are sent forward to keep divisions at strength, which spares units from being rotated home.
focus_desc.usa_good_neighbor: Washington renounces armed intervention in Latin America and looks for partners instead of protectorates.
focus_desc.usa_hemisphere_defence: The Panama Canal and the Caribbean approaches become the outer wall of a fortress that spans the Americas.
focus_desc.usa_hemisphere_fortress: The nation turns inward to the Americas and declares them a closed sphere. A new pact is offered to the southern republics, and the powers of the old world are warned off.
focus_desc.usa_home_front: War bonds, scrap drives and ration books turn every household into part of the war effort.
focus_desc.usa_iceland_garrison: American troops take over the defence of Iceland from the British and keep the North Atlantic route open.
focus_desc.usa_industrial_control: The great firms are bound into a directorate that sets output, prices and wages from the top. Factories that built cars now build what the state orders.
focus_desc.usa_industrial_mobilisation: War Department planners set out how the factories will switch to arms if war comes.
focus_desc.usa_internationalism: The State Department argues that America cannot stay safe while aggressors redraw the map, and Washington leans toward London and Paris.
focus_desc.usa_island_hopping: The strongest Japanese garrisons are bypassed and left to wither while Allied forces take the islands that matter.
focus_desc.usa_japan_oil_trade: Washington keeps selling to Tokyo, hoping trade will do what protests cannot, and the oil companies are glad of the business.
focus_desc.usa_jet_bell: Bell takes a British jet engine design and builds America's first jet fighter around it.
focus_desc.usa_kaiser_yards: Henry Kaiser's West Coast yards use prefabricated sections to build a ship in days rather than months.
focus_desc.usa_kwajalein_hub: Kwajalein becomes a forward anchorage, and the fleet no longer needs to sail back to Hawaii for fuel.
focus_desc.usa_legal_path: The movement decides to win inside the rules: use the ballot, the statutes and the emergency clauses already on the books, and let the old institutions hollow themselves out.
focus_desc.usa_lend_lease_bill: A bill lets the President lend or lease war materials to any country whose defence is vital to the United States.
focus_desc.usa_liberty_league: Bankers and industrialists fund a league against the New Deal and warn that the Constitution is in danger.
focus_desc.usa_liberty_ships: A plain, welded cargo ship is built by the hundred to replace what the U-boats sink.
focus_desc.usa_long_populism: The populist current of Huey Long's Share Our Wealth clubs finds a national voice in the depression's second winter.
focus_desc.usa_louisiana_maneuvers: Hundreds of thousands of soldiers fight mock battles across the South; many officers are tested and some are replaced.
focus_desc.usa_macarthur_return: General MacArthur promises to come back to the Philippines, and the Southwest Pacific command begins to plan how.
focus_desc.usa_manhattan_diplomacy: British scientists and their research reports cross the Atlantic, and the two governments agree to share the work.
focus_desc.usa_manhattan_project: Reactors, separation plants and a secret laboratory in the desert are built in the race to make an atomic bomb.
focus_desc.usa_marine_corps: The Marines refine their landing doctrine and grow into divisions made for a war among islands.
focus_desc.usa_military_government: The general takes over the government in the name of order. Congress and the states refuse him, and the Union goes to civil war.
focus_desc.usa_monroe_reborn: The old doctrine is rewritten as a duty to police the whole hemisphere. Invitations go out to the larger republics, and the army trains for operations south of the border.
focus_desc.usa_motor_pool: Trucks and jeeps replace horses, and every infantry division can move on wheels.
focus_desc.usa_national_reunification: With the breakaway states beaten or bought off, the government declares the country whole again. Order returns to the streets, and the strain of the split begins to fade.
focus_desc.usa_naval_expansion: Congress pays for new warships to bring the fleet up to the limits of the naval treaties.
focus_desc.usa_ndrc: Vannevar Bush's committee ties university labs and industry to military problems.
focus_desc.usa_neutral_trade: American merchants sell to every buyer who pays, while the government keeps out of foreign quarrels.
focus_desc.usa_neutrality_acts: Congress bars loans and arms sales to belligerents. America stays out of Europe's quarrels, and the aggressors take note.
focus_desc.usa_neutrality_patrol: American warships patrol a security zone off the coasts of the Americas and report every ship they meet.
focus_desc.usa_new_officer_corps: The old staff is retired and a younger, politically reliable corps takes its places. Promotion now follows loyalty and results, and fresh ideas on mobility are tried at once.
focus_desc.usa_nimitz_command: Admiral Nimitz arrives at Pearl Harbor and takes the Pacific Fleet over to the offensive.
focus_desc.usa_northern_claim: Maps are redrawn to show a continent with one flag. The government lays a claim to Canada and puts the border garrisons on notice.
focus_desc.usa_overlord_prep: Planners gather ships, ports, divisions and air power in Britain for the cross-Channel invasion.
focus_desc.usa_p51_escort: With a Merlin engine and drop tanks, the P-51 can fly with the bombers all the way to Berlin.
focus_desc.usa_pacific_division: The two powers draw a line down the ocean and agree not to cross it. The Pacific fleet is free to look elsewhere, and trade with Japan resumes on the state's terms.
focus_desc.usa_pacific_first: The Navy wins the argument: Japan must be beaten first, and the fleet and the Marines get the largest share.
focus_desc.usa_pan_american_pact: Washington proposes a common defence: an attack on one American republic will be treated as an attack on all of them.
focus_desc.usa_pearl_harbor_base: Dry docks, fuel tanks and airfields on Oahu turn Pearl Harbor into the fleet's forward base.
focus_desc.usa_pershing_heavy: Ordnance pushes a heavier tank with a high-velocity gun, though it will take longer to arrive in numbers.
focus_desc.usa_philippine_defence: Forts at the mouth of Manila Bay and new airfields are to hold the islands until the fleet can arrive.
focus_desc.usa_philippine_independence: The Commonwealth of the Philippines takes charge of its own affairs ahead of the independence promised by law.
focus_desc.usa_preparedness: As the world grows more dangerous, the government quietly places its first large orders for arms and aircraft.
focus_desc.usa_press_control: Newspapers and radio stations are told what the national line is. Dissent loses its megaphones, and the public mood steadies behind the government and the war effort.
focus_desc.usa_price_controls: The Office of Price Administration freezes prices and rations scarce goods, which keeps the home front calm.
focus_desc.usa_proximity_fuse: A tiny radio set in the shell makes it burst near its target, and anti-aircraft fire becomes far deadlier.
focus_desc.usa_quarantine_address: In Chicago the president compares aggression to a contagion that peaceful nations must quarantine.
focus_desc.usa_radar_mit: Working from the British cavity magnetron, the laboratory builds sets small enough for aircraft and ships.
focus_desc.usa_radiation_lab: A new laboratory at MIT takes up microwave radar, building on a device shared by British scientists.
focus_desc.usa_radio_priest: A weekly broadcast reaches tens of millions of kitchens. The preacher's anger at bankers and at Washington turns listeners into a following that writes letters by the sackful.
focus_desc.usa_recession_response: Budget cuts in 1937 send the economy back into a slump. Washington turns to public spending again to restart the recovery.
focus_desc.usa_repeal_neutrality: The embargo on arms sales is lifted, and British and French orders begin to flow to American factories.
focus_desc.usa_rosie_workforce: Millions of women take jobs in plants and shipyards so that men can go to the front.
focus_desc.usa_seabees: Navy construction battalions of older tradesmen go ashore behind the Marines to build airstrips and piers.
focus_desc.usa_second_new_deal: Relief gives way to reform: new laws on labour, banking and public works aim to put the recovery on a lasting footing.
focus_desc.usa_seize_washington: Columns of veterans and guardsmen move on the capital in a single night. The president is confined, Congress is shut and the country splits between those who cheer and those who take up arms.
focus_desc.usa_selective_service: The Selective Training and Service Act of 1940 brings the first peacetime draft in American history.
focus_desc.usa_share_wealth: Long's clubs are turned into a national movement with one demand: break the great fortunes and pay every household. The old parties lose their grip on the loyal, and the man at the head of the movement stops calling it a protest.
focus_desc.usa_sherman_mass: A reliable, easily repaired medium tank is built in thousands and shipped to every front.
focus_desc.usa_sicily_italy: After North Africa the Allies cross into Sicily and then the mainland, to knock Italy out of the war.
focus_desc.usa_silent_service: Fleet submarines, with better torpedoes and good intelligence, strangle the shipping that feeds Japan.
focus_desc.usa_silver_shirts: Uniformed columns march through small-town main streets under a banner of order and national rebirth. The government watches them grow and does not know whether to ban them or to bargain with them.
focus_desc.usa_sit_down_strikes: Auto workers occupy the plants in Flint, and the movement spreads. The radicals win a following on the shop floor.
focus_desc.usa_social_security: The Social Security Act of 1935 sets up old-age pensions and unemployment insurance, a floor under working families.
focus_desc.usa_southern_claim: Old grievances over the Rio Grande and the lost territories are dusted off. Washington lays a claim to Mexico and begins to prepare the border for war.
focus_desc.usa_southern_democrats: The conservative southern bloc keeps its committee chairs and its seat at the table, and in return the Congress passes the war budgets.
focus_desc.usa_standard_freighters: Simple cargo ships of a single standard design are welded together in weeks instead of months.
focus_desc.usa_strategic_bombing: Air Corps theorists hold that heavy bombers flying by day can hit factories precisely and break an enemy's industry.
focus_desc.usa_submarine_campaign: Submarines are ordered to sink Japanese merchant ships wherever they find them and cut Japan's sea lanes.
focus_desc.usa_suspend_congress: With the courts quiet and the streets organised, the session is adjourned without a date. Washington is run by decree, and the opposition in the states takes up arms to answer it.
focus_desc.usa_synthetic_rubber: With Asia's rubber plantations at risk, chemists and oil companies build plants that make rubber from petroleum.
focus_desc.usa_tank_destroyers: Fast, lightly armoured gun carriers are meant to meet panzer thrusts and strike from the flank.
focus_desc.usa_texas_oil: New wells and pipelines raise output in Texas, and the crude flows to the refineries on the coast.
focus_desc.usa_third_term: With war in Europe, Roosevelt breaks the two-term custom set by Washington and runs again.
focus_desc.usa_torch_prep: American troops train for their first landing against opposed shores, to be launched with the British in North Africa.
focus_desc.usa_total_conscription: Every able man owes the state a term of service, and the age limits are pushed out on both sides. Recruiting stops being a question of persuasion.
focus_desc.usa_trinity_test: A tower in the New Mexico desert holds the first test of the plutonium device.
focus_desc.usa_tva: The Tennessee Valley Authority builds dams that stop floods and bring cheap electricity to one of the poorest regions.
focus_desc.usa_two_ocean_coast: Coastal batteries and new shipyards guard the Atlantic and Pacific seaboards against any raid from the sea.
focus_desc.usa_two_ocean_navy: After the fall of France, Congress orders a fleet large enough to fight in the Atlantic and the Pacific at once.
focus_desc.usa_unemployed_councils: Councils of the jobless stop evictions and march on city halls. Many of their leaders carry party cards.
focus_desc.usa_united_nations_plan: Twenty-six nations sign a declaration to fight together and keep faith, and the idea of a successor to the League begins to take shape.
focus_desc.usa_veterans_league: Men who came home from the trenches to bread lines gather in a league of their own. They bring drill, discipline and a list of grievances against the capital.
focus_desc.usa_victory_program: Army and Navy planners work out what it would take to defeat the Axis, and the figures set the targets for industry.
focus_desc.usa_wallace_progressive: Henry Wallace and the New Deal liberals push for labour rights and wider social programmes, at the price of the party's southern wing.
focus_desc.usa_war_economy_order: Civilian production is ordered onto a war footing by decree. Rationing, allocations and quotas replace the market in every key industry.
focus_desc.usa_war_production_board: One board now allocates steel, rubber and machine tools and turns peacetime industry over to war orders.
