focus_desc.usa_washington_precedent: The president keeps to the two-term custom. The party picks a new candidate, and the voters decide who leads the war effort.
focus_desc.usa_willow_run: Ford builds a mile-long plant near Detroit to turn out bombers on an assembly line.
focus_desc.usa_workers_defence: After the company gunmen and the strikebreakers, the unions arm guards of their own.
focus_desc.ven_maracaibo: Derricks spread over Lake Maracaibo, and a new law raises the state's share of the oil revenue.
focus_desc.yug_adriatic_claims: Zara, an Italian enclave in our Dalmatia, and Istria with its Slav villages: the coast question is not settled.
focus_desc.yug_adriatic_fleet: A small navy on a long coast: destroyers, submarines and torpedo boats at Kotor and Split.
focus_desc.yug_agreement: The 1939 agreement creates an autonomous Banovina of Croatia and eases an old quarrel.
focus_desc.yug_air_defence: The capital lies on the border. Guns and fighters must guard it.
focus_desc.yug_albanian_question: King Zog's Albania lives on Italian money. If Rome takes it, the north must not go with it.
focus_desc.yug_allied_front: If war comes, we fight beside Britain as we did in the last one.
focus_desc.yug_anti_tank_guns: Czech 47 mm guns for every division: the tanks will come down the Danube valley.
focus_desc.yug_armed_neutrality: We sign nothing. The army stands on the borders and the kingdom waits.
focus_desc.yug_balkan_bloc: Let the Balkan peoples stand together before the great powers carve them up.
focus_desc.yug_balkan_entente: Greece, Turkey, Romania and Yugoslavia promised to guard each other's borders. Remind them.
focus_desc.yug_balkan_federation: Communists in Belgrade and Sofia dream of one South Slav federation from the Adriatic to the Black Sea.
focus_desc.yug_banovina_croatia: Zagreb gets its own Ban, Sabor and budget. Bosnian Croats and Serbs argue about where its border runs.
focus_desc.yug_belgrade_industry: The capital grows across the Sava. Workshops become factories.
focus_desc.yug_belgrade_students: Belgrade University is the party's best recruiting ground; the police know it too.
focus_desc.yug_beograd_class: Three destroyers, one from Nantes and two from Split, to stand beside the Dubrovnik.
focus_desc.yug_between_the_blocs: France built our alliances, Italy covets our coast, Germany buys our harvest. Choose with care.
focus_desc.yug_bor_copper: Europe's largest copper mine belongs to a French company, and Germany wants its output.
focus_desc.yug_bosnian_bauxite: Herzegovina and Dalmatia hold some of the richest bauxite in Europe.
focus_desc.yug_bosnian_redoubt: Give up the plains, hold the mountains of Bosnia and wait for the Allies.
focus_desc.yug_british_guarantee: Britain has guaranteed Greece and Romania. Ask what it will do for us.
focus_desc.yug_bulgarian_friendship: Old enemies sign a pact of friendship. Macedonia is left unsaid.
focus_desc.yug_chetnik_command: The army keeps its own Chetnik detachments for raids behind enemy lines.
focus_desc.yug_concordat: A treaty with the Holy See would please Catholic Croats and Slovenes; the Orthodox Church calls it a betrayal.
focus_desc.yug_cordon_defence: Seven neighbours, most of them hostile: the army must stand everywhere.
focus_desc.yug_croat_question: Since Radić was shot in parliament, Croatia has refused Belgrade's centralism. Every government must answer it.
focus_desc.yug_crown_restored: The Karađorđević crown was the one thing Serbs, Croats and Slovenes once shared. Its loyalists rise to bring it back.
focus_desc.yug_cvetkovic_cabinet: Dragiša Cvetković, a Niš politician without enemies, takes office with one task: a deal with the Croats.
focus_desc.yug_dismiss_stojadinovic: The premier calls himself Vođa and dresses his youth in green shirts. The regent decides the kingdom needs a quieter man.
focus_desc.yug_domestic_fighter: The designers at Ikarus and Rogožarski can build our own: the IK-3.
focus_desc.yug_economic_council: Stojadinović was a finance man. Balance the budget, then build.
focus_desc.yug_entente_loyalty: France stood with Serbia in the Great War and still arms our army. We keep faith.
focus_desc.yug_federal_kingdom: Croatia, Slovenia and the Serb lands as equal units under one crown: the old kingdom remade.
focus_desc.yug_foreign_fighters: Messerschmitts from Germany, Hurricanes from Britain: the best money can buy.
focus_desc.yug_free_elections_demand: Open voting lets gendarmes watch every ballot. The opposition demands the secret vote.
focus_desc.yug_french_credits: Paris lends money to buy guns from French and Czech works.
focus_desc.yug_general_mobilisation: Every reservist to his regiment. The kingdom fights for its life.
focus_desc.yug_german_clearing: Germany buys wheat, pigs and ore at good prices, paid in marks that buy only German goods.
focus_desc.yug_gold_to_london: The National Bank's gold leaves by sea and air before the enemy reaches Belgrade.
focus_desc.yug_government_in_exile: The king and his ministers carry on from London.
focus_desc.yug_green_shirts: The Radical Union's youth march in green shirts and greet the premier with a raised arm.
focus_desc.yug_grol_democrats: Milan Grol's Democratic Party gives the opposition a Serbian voice.
focus_desc.yug_investment_plan: Foreign loans and state money, poured into the factories the next war will need.
focus_desc.yug_iron_hand: Gendarmes in every Croatian village, censors in every newspaper. Order first, talks later.
focus_desc.yug_italian_pact: A treaty with Italy: Rome reins in the Ustaše exiles, Belgrade stops counting on Paris.
focus_desc.yug_jrz_majority: Stojadinović's Yugoslav Radical Union gathers Serb Radicals, Slovene clericals and Bosnian Muslims into one government party.
focus_desc.yug_king_comes_of_age: Peter II is nearly grown. Officers, students and the Serbian street look to him to end the regency.
focus_desc.yug_kotor_bastion: The deepest bay of the Adriatic is the fleet's base. Fortify its mouth.
focus_desc.yug_kpj_underground: The Communist Party of Yugoslavia has been banned since 1921. Its cells live on in prisons, mines and universities.
focus_desc.yug_kragujevac_arsenal: The old Serbian arsenal makes rifles, shells and guns. Expand it.
focus_desc.yug_kragujevac_rifles: M24 Mausers come off the Kragujevac lines for every new regiment.
focus_desc.yug_kraljevo_bombers: Dorniers built at Kraljevo and Blenheims built at Zemun give the air force a striking arm.
focus_desc.yug_kraljevo_works: The state aircraft factory at Kraljevo builds foreign designs under licence and learns from them.
focus_desc.yug_little_entente_staff: Prague, Bucharest and Belgrade plan together against Hungarian revision.
focus_desc.yug_ljotic_program: No parties, no liberal parliament: estates, faith and the king. The programme wins officers if not voters.
focus_desc.yug_moscow_recognition: One of the last states to shun the Soviets opens relations; Russophile Serbs cheer.
focus_desc.yug_mountain_redoubt: Prepare a last defensive stronghold in the Bosnian mountains.
focus_desc.yug_mountain_resistance: Where the army breaks, the mountains hold. Officers and peasants fight on.
focus_desc.yug_mountain_warfare: Most of the kingdom is mountains. Train divisions to fight in them.
focus_desc.yug_officer_loyalty: The army swore loyalty to the dynasty, not to the regent. Keep the general staff close and its grievances heard.
focus_desc.yug_one_party_state: The Radical Union becomes the only party. Whoever resists, the Vođa's men will answer.
focus_desc.yug_parliamentary_kingdom: The opposition moves to make the king reign and parliament rule.
focus_desc.yug_party_rebuilt: A new secretary brings the leadership home from abroad and tightens discipline.
focus_desc.yug_peasant_coalition: Serbian and Croat peasant parties share a programme: land, credit and an end to the dictatorship.
focus_desc.yug_peoples_front: Communists reach out to peasants, workers and the left of the opposition against the regime.
focus_desc.yug_plan_r41: Call-up lists, railway timetables and depots: mobilising this kingdom takes weeks.
focus_desc.yug_prince_paul: Prince Paul rules as first regent for his young cousin Peter II. He prefers art to politics, but the kingdom will not wait.
focus_desc.yug_public_works: Roads and the Belgrade-Zagreb railway: a peasant country needs to reach its markets.
focus_desc.yug_red_rising: Workers in Kragujevac and miners in Bor take up arms; the party calls for a people's republic.
focus_desc.yug_regency: The regency that rules for the young king wins over the army and the parties.
focus_desc.yug_regent_in_berlin: Prince Paul is received in Berlin with parades. He admires the army and trusts no one.
focus_desc.yug_regents_prudence: Sign nothing that cannot be unsigned, offend no great power, buy time. Paul's method keeps the peace for now.
focus_desc.yug_research_council: Milanković's university and the military technical institute can do more than teach.
focus_desc.yug_rome_model: Corporations instead of parties, the premier instead of parliament: Italy shows how it is done.
focus_desc.yug_royal_air_force: Simović's air force flies French, British, German and Yugoslav types side by side.
focus_desc.yug_rupnik_line: Concrete bunkers along the Italian and German frontier in Slovenia.
focus_desc.yug_salonika_army: The officers who broke through in 1918 command the army now. Their memory is its doctrine.
focus_desc.yug_salonika_free_zone: Our trade reaches the Aegean through the Yugoslav free zone in the port of Salonika.
focus_desc.yug_salonika_promise: Berlin dangles Salonika, the port Serbia always wanted. The price is Greece's friendship.
focus_desc.yug_serb_centralism: Concessions only feed separatism. The kingdom stays unitary and Belgrade keeps every lever.
focus_desc.yug_serb_lands: The Serbian Cultural Club asks what is left for the Serbs. The deal must answer them too.
focus_desc.yug_sign_tripartite: Germany asks for our signature with promises: no troops through our land, no demand for help.
focus_desc.yug_skoda_contracts: Mountain guns and howitzers from Plzeň, paid for over years.
focus_desc.yug_slovene_banovina: If Croatia governs itself, Ljubljana asks for the same. Korošec's party wants its share.
focus_desc.yug_southern_mines: Chrome from Macedonia and lead from Trepča: the south's mines are opened up.
focus_desc.yug_split_yard: The shipyard at Split learns to build warships.
focus_desc.yug_sporazum: Cvetković and Maček sign the Agreement: a self-governing Croatia inside the kingdom, with Maček as deputy premier.
focus_desc.yug_staff_reform: The staff still plans for the last war. Bring in younger officers.
focus_desc.yug_submarine_flotilla: The British-built Hrabri boats and the French-built Osvetnik boats form one flotilla.
focus_desc.yug_talks_with_macek: Vladko Maček leads the Croat Peasant Party from Zagreb. Send someone he will receive.
focus_desc.yug_united_opposition: Maček's Croat Peasants, Grol's Democrats and the Agrarians join one list against the government.
focus_desc.yug_vodja: Stojadinović liked the salutes and the crowds he saw in Rome. Let the premier become the leader.
focus_desc.yug_zagreb_industry: Zagreb has the bankers and the engineers. Let Croatia's capital build too.
focus_desc.yug_zbor_movement: Dimitrije Ljotić's Yugoslav National Movement is small, devout and fanatical. It wants a corporate, Orthodox kingdom.
focus_desc.yug_zbor_rising: With the officers who listened, Zbor moves against the government.
focus_desc.yug_zbor_volunteers: Students in Zbor's ranks fight leftists in the halls of Belgrade University.
focus_desc.yug_zenica_steel: Bosnian iron from Vareš and the furnaces of Zenica can give the kingdom its own steel.
focus_desc.zaf_active_citizen_force: Training camps every year for the part-time regiments, from the Transvaal Scottish to the Regiment President Steyn.
focus_desc.zaf_africa_oath: No conscription: volunteers swear to serve anywhere in Africa and wear an orange tab to show it.
focus_desc.zaf_arm_the_corps: Men who drive the trucks and guard the dumps could hold the line too. Give them rifles and let them fight.
focus_desc.zaf_artillery_regiments: Field guns and trained gunners for every brigade, with the new twenty-five-pounder when Britain can spare it.
focus_desc.zaf_bushveld_chrome: The Bushveld holds most of the world's chrome ore. Steelmakers everywhere will pay for it.
focus_desc.zaf_cape_corps_nmc: Coloured and African volunteers enlist as drivers, guards and labourers. By law they may not carry rifles.
focus_desc.zaf_cape_sea_route: With the Mediterranean closed, every convoy to Egypt and India passes our ports. Feed them, repair them and guard them.
focus_desc.zaf_chamber_of_mines: The mining houses run the economy's heart. Bring their chairmen into the state's planning.
focus_desc.zaf_com_cpsa_reorganised: After years of purges the small Communist Party gets a new secretary and turns back to the trade unions and the townships.
focus_desc.zaf_com_general_strike: The mines stop, the docks stop, the railways stop. The strike committees declare that power now belongs to the workers.
focus_desc.zaf_com_land_to_the_tiller: The land acts are repealed and every citizen may serve under arms. The new army is many times the old one.
focus_desc.zaf_com_mine_workers_union: Hundreds of thousands of migrant miners have no union. Party organisers go into the compounds.
focus_desc.zaf_com_non_european_front: African, Indian and Coloured organisations agree to campaign together against the pass laws and the colour bar.
focus_desc.zaf_com_peoples_republic: The mines are nationalised and the pass offices are burned. A republic of all its peoples is proclaimed in Johannesburg.
focus_desc.zaf_conscription_bill: Call up every white man of military age. Half the country will refuse to serve a British war.
focus_desc.zaf_dem_liberal_union: The restored government opens the civil service and the army to more of its people and promises a slow widening of the vote.
focus_desc.zaf_dem_restore_union: The South Africa Act and Parliament's sovereignty are not for one faction to tear up. The constitution's defenders take back the state.
focus_desc.zaf_dem_springbok_legion: Veterans who fought for the Union organise against the men who stayed home and cheered the other side.
focus_desc.zaf_dem_united_party_regroups: Out of office, Smuts's followers rebuild their branches town by town and wait for the government to stumble.
focus_desc.zaf_desert_air_wings: South African squadrons fly fighters and light bombers over the desert and learn close support the hard way.
focus_desc.zaf_desert_brigades: The divisions move to Egypt. They have trucks enough, but must learn to fight German tanks on open ground.
focus_desc.zaf_durban_graving_dock: Durban's great dry dock can take the largest ships. Damaged warships from the Indian Ocean can be repaired here.
focus_desc.zaf_east_africa: South African divisions move north to fight the Italian forces in East Africa.
focus_desc.zaf_east_africa_campaign: Our brigades drive north through Kenya against the Italians, on roads that have to be built as they go.
focus_desc.zaf_escom_power: Big coal-fired stations on the Rand and the Vaal give the mines and the new factories cheap power.
focus_desc.zaf_far_east_rand: New mines and new towns east of Johannesburg: Springs, Brakpan, Nigel. Each needs shops, foundries and power.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_corporate_union: Mines, farms and factories are grouped into state guilds that answer to the leader. Strikes are over.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_greyshirts_merge: The small shirt movements of the Cape and the Transvaal bring their street organisers and newspapers into the New Order.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_new_order_cabinet: Parliament is told to vote itself out of the way. Those who refuse are left to fight for it.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_new_order_study: The former defence minister gathers nationalist members of parliament around a plan for a one-party state on the European model.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_ob_commandos: Every district gets its own commando, with generals, ranks and oaths. Many members are policemen and railwaymen.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_ob_rising: The commandos are called out. Either the state falls to them, or the country tears itself apart.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_ox_wagon_spirit: The centenary trek left behind a movement that drills on farms and in town halls. It wants more than votes.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_stormjaers: An inner guard sworn to obey on pain of death. Pylons and railway lines start to fall at night.
focus_desc.zaf_fas_volkstaat: Parties are dissolved and the Sentinel's generals run the provinces. The nation, they say, has come home.
focus_desc.zaf_fusion_cabinet: Hertzog and Smuts, generals on opposite sides of the last Boer war, now lead one United Party. Keep the partnership working.
focus_desc.zaf_general_election: Call a general election on Fusion's record. A large United Party majority would quiet the talk of a split.
focus_desc.zaf_gold: Gold from the Witwatersrand pays for imports and fills the war chest.
focus_desc.zaf_gold_pays: Since we left the gold standard the price of gold has soared and the Rand mines pay as never before. Their taxes can build the country.
focus_desc.zaf_gold_to_washington: The American treasury buys gold at thirty-five dollars an ounce. Sell there and make friends with the strongest economy in the world.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_delagoa_bay: The best harbour for the Transvaal is Portuguese. Offer Lisbon gold for Lourenço Marques and its railway.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_greater_union: Smuts once dreamt of a Union reaching to the Zambezi. The dream can be revived with patience and the right offers.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_northern_development: Roads, rail and settlers for the new northern province, and the copper and chrome beyond it.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_protectorates_transfer: A formal request to London: hand Basutoland, Bechuanaland and Swaziland to the Union under the terms of 1909.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_rhodesia_offer: Southern Rhodesia's settlers voted against joining us once. Offer better terms and ask London to let them come.
focus_desc.zaf_gsa_union_of_southern_africa: From the Cape to the Zambezi, one parliament and one market. The Union has become what its founders hoped.
focus_desc.zaf_hct_demand: The Act of Union provided for their transfer. A sovereign Union should not have to ask twice.
focus_desc.zaf_hct_patience: London says the people of the protectorates must be consulted first. We let the matter rest for now.
focus_desc.zaf_hofmeyr_portfolios: The young minister of education and the interior is the liberal conscience of the cabinet. Give him more work and a seat at the centre.
focus_desc.zaf_home_front_economy: Price controls, petrol rationing and controlled factories. The war effort comes before the shops.
focus_desc.zaf_hurricane_squadrons: Biplanes will not survive the next war. Buy monoplane fighters from Britain and train squadrons to fly them.
focus_desc.zaf_imperial_conference: The dominions meet in London. We go as equals, ready to cooperate but promising nothing in advance.
focus_desc.zaf_iscor_state: The state's own steelworks in Pretoria shows that the Union can make what it now imports. Expand it.
focus_desc.zaf_italy_armoured: Our armoured division sails for Italy to fight up the peninsula with the Eighth and Fifth Armies.
focus_desc.zaf_joint_air_training: Clear skies and space: flying schools across the Union train our own crews and thousands from Britain and the empire.
focus_desc.zaf_madagascar_landings: The great island could give an enemy navy a base on our flank. Our brigade lands with the British to take it first.
focus_desc.zaf_maritime_patrol: Long-range aircraft from Cape Town and Durban hunt submarines and raiders along both coasts.
focus_desc.zaf_marmon_herrington_order: Imported Ford chassis, Marmon-Herrington drive and armour plate rolled in the Union. The railway works can build them by the hundred.
focus_desc.zaf_minesweeping_whalers: The whaling and fishing fleets give their boats and crews. Fitted with sweeps and depth charges, they keep the ports open.
focus_desc.zaf_mining_capital: The mining houses have the capital and the engineers. Low taxes and a free hand will get factories built faster than any ministry.
focus_desc.zaf_modderfontein_explosives: The mines' dynamite factory at Modderfontein is one of the largest in the world. It can fill shells as well.
focus_desc.zaf_mozambique_convention: Rand traffic through Lourenço Marques in exchange for Mozambican labour for the mines: renew the bargain with Lisbon.
focus_desc.zaf_native_trust_land_act: With Fusion's two-thirds majority Hertzog passes his long-planned bills on land and the African franchise. Most white voters approve; the Cape liberals and African leaders protest.
focus_desc.zaf_naval_forces: A real navy at last, with its own frigates and its own officers.
focus_desc.zaf_neu_hereniging: Hertzog has left Smuts over the war. Bring the old general and Malan's party together into one Reunited National Party.
focus_desc.zaf_neu_purified_nationalists: Malan and the Cape nationalists refused to follow Hertzog into Fusion. They speak for an Afrikaner nation that owes London nothing.
focus_desc.zaf_neu_republic_proclaimed: The Vierkleur and the Union flag come down together. A republic of South Africa takes their place.
focus_desc.zaf_neu_republic_referendum: The nationalists demand that the voters, not the King, decide what the state shall be. The Crown's men will not give way quietly.
focus_desc.zaf_neu_volkskongres: Savings banks, insurers and a rescue fund to lift poor whites off the land and into Afrikaner-owned business.
focus_desc.zaf_ob_ban_servants: Civil servants, police and soldiers may not belong to the Ossewabrandwag or the other shirt movements. The state keeps its own house in order.
focus_desc.zaf_ob_tolerate: Marching clubs and cultural bodies are not the state's business. Banning them would only make martyrs of their leaders.
focus_desc.zaf_pirow_defence_plan: The defence minister's five-year plan: a stronger Permanent Force, aircraft, coastal guns and a citizen army that can be called up quickly.
focus_desc.zaf_pirow_european_tour: Pirow visits Lisbon, Rome and Berlin to talk about Africa and colonies. London is not pleased.
focus_desc.zaf_port_elizabeth_assembly: Ford and General Motors assemble cars in Port Elizabeth. Their lines can turn out army trucks.
focus_desc.zaf_postmasburg_manganese: Open the manganese fields of the Northern Cape and run a railway to them. Every ton of steel needs some.
focus_desc.zaf_pretoria_steelworks: The furnaces in Pretoria turn to shell steel, gun forgings and armour plate.
focus_desc.zaf_railway_workshops: The state railways' workshops are the best-equipped engineering shops in the country. Put them to war work.
focus_desc.zaf_rand_deep_levels: High gold prices make ore worth mining that was too poor before. The shafts go down past two thousand metres.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_axis_alignment: A nationalist republic owes nothing to the empire it left. It throws in its lot with Germany.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_die_stem: One anthem, one flag and Afrikaans first in the schools and the civil service.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_german_friendship: Wool, gold and a port on the Cape route are worth a great deal to Germany. Its goodwill may be worth more to us.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_kommando_army: Back to the old way: every burgher with his rifle and his horse, called out by district.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_leave_commonwealth: The last ties to the Crown are cut: no governor-general, no appeals to London, no automatic share in Britain's wars.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_protectorates: Basutoland, Bechuanaland and Swaziland were promised to the Union in 1909. If London will not hand them over, we will take them.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_swa_province: No more reports to Geneva: the old German colony becomes a province of the republic.
focus_desc.zaf_rep_volk_economy: The rescue fund's banks get state contracts, and the English houses of Johannesburg lose theirs.
focus_desc.zaf_roberts_heights_depot: The depot near Pretoria builds the Hartbees, a Hart armoured for low attack over the bush.
focus_desc.zaf_saaf_expansion: New squadrons, new airfields on the high veld and the coast, and pilots trained at home.
focus_desc.zaf_satmar_oil_shale: We have no oil wells. The Boksburg works distil fuel from torbanite shale, and more plants could follow.
focus_desc.zaf_scientific_research_council: The physicists of Johannesburg and Cape Town build radio sets and the first radar sets of the Union.
focus_desc.zaf_seaward_defence_force: The Union has almost no warships. Raise a small force to clear mines and guard the harbours.
focus_desc.zaf_simonstown_base: The Royal Navy's base on False Bay guards the route round the Cape. Share it and enlarge it.
focus_desc.zaf_sixth_armoured_division: Volunteers from the old infantry divisions retrain as tank crews. The Union will field an armoured division of its own.
focus_desc.zaf_social_security_report: Hofmeyr's treasury extends old-age pensions and school meals to people the state has long ignored. It costs money and buys loyalty.
focus_desc.zaf_special_service_battalion: Unemployed young men taken into a regular battalion, fed, trained and made into soldiers.
focus_desc.zaf_springbok_divisions: Motorised brigades with their own guns, armoured cars and workshops, made for long distances and open country.
focus_desc.zaf_status_of_the_union: The Statute of Westminster and our own Status Act make Parliament sovereign. Use that freedom in practice, not only on paper.
focus_desc.zaf_steel: The state steel corporation at Pretoria adds furnaces for war orders.
focus_desc.zaf_swa_fifth_province: Annex South West Africa outright and give its settlers seats in Parliament, whatever Geneva says.
focus_desc.zaf_swa_mandate: South West Africa stays a mandate under the League. We report to Geneva and govern it as we see fit.
focus_desc.zaf_total_war_effort: Every workshop that can make a shell or a truck part does. The Union has never worked so hard.
focus_desc.zaf_union_of_south_africa: Four old colonies and two old enemies share one parliament in Cape Town. Holding them together is the first task of every cabinet.
focus_desc.zaf_war_cabinet: The country is at war and the cabinet must act like it: fewer debates, a ministry of war supplies, and old commandos in the ministries.
focus_desc.zaf_war_supplies_directorate: One engineer with full powers over every factory, mine and workshop that can serve the army.
focus_desc.zaf_witbank_coal: Cheap coal close to the surface feeds the power stations, the railways and the steelworks.
focus_desc.zaf_wool_for_machines: Germany pays for our wool in machines and rails instead of scarce sterling. A useful trade, if not a loyal one.

cause.calendar: The war's calendar ran out in {month}/{year}.
cause.capitulation: Joseon fell in {month}/{year}: its king left the land and every province was lost.
cause.expelled: By {month}/{year} Japan had been out of Korea for {days} days.

court_in_exile.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: few officials followed the king. Every month a letter went to the Ming court asking for an army, and every month the answer was to wait.
court_in_exile.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: Korea's king has fled, and its towns pay their rice to Japanese officers. The road to Ming lies open, and so does the question of who will hold it.
court_in_exile.summary: Joseon's king has left his own land, and the court lives on outside it.
court_in_exile.title: A court in exile

expulsion.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the last Japanese forts stood empty, and the king's officials went south to count the dead and the fields left. Offices went to the leaders of the righteous armies; some refused them and went home.
expulsion.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: the last ships left the Korean coast. The lords who came home had spent men and rice, won no land, and remembered who had sent them.
expulsion.summary: No Japanese army is left in Korea. The war that began with a landing ended on the beaches it began on.
expulsion.title: Expulsion

goal.jos_failed: Joseon: did not win back its land, or lost its king's throne. Aims not met.
goal.jos_met: Joseon: won back its land and kept its king on the throne. Aims met.
goal.jpn_failed: Japan: holds no Korean land worth the name and won no recognition on its terms. Aims not met.
goal.jpn_met: Japan: holds Korean land, or won Ming's recognition on its terms. Aims met.
goal.min_failed: Ming: did not expel Japan and keep the tributary order within its silver. Silver spent: {silver} (limit {limit}, in ten thousand taels). Aims not met.
goal.min_met: Ming: expelled Japan and kept the tributary order. Silver spent: {silver} (limit {limit}, in ten thousand taels). Aims met.

investiture_peace.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the peace was made between Ming and Japan, and Joseon's envoy only stood beside it. The court did not trust it and ordered the walls of the southern towns rebuilt.
investiture_peace.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: the Ming envoys brought a robe and a title. Whether this was the peace the Taikō had asked for, only the go-betweens knew, and they kept quiet.
investiture_peace.summary: Japan took the title Ming offered, and the war ended on paper.
investiture_peace.title: Investiture peace

japan_in_liaodong.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the enemy crossed our land to strike at Ming. The court argued whether Joseon was Ming's shield or Japan's road, and found no answer.
japan_in_liaodong.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: the army stands in Liaodong, further than any Japanese army had gone. The rice to feed it must cross the strait and then the whole of Korea.
japan_in_liaodong.summary: Japanese armies crossed the Yalu and hold Ming land in Liaodong. The war is no longer Korea's alone.
japan_in_liaodong.title: Japan as far as Liaodong

partition.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the lost counties were not won back. The officials who fled the capital came home to half a country, and the dead of the south lay long unburied. The record ends with a warning: keep the walls and the ships, so this does not come again.
partition.memoir_jpn: From the Nagoya headquarters, {year}: the forts on the Korean coast stand, and the lords who hold them are paid in Korean land. Yet every year more rice must cross the strait to feed them.
partition.summary: The war stopped where the armies stood: what each held, it keeps.
partition.title: Partition

second_war.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the envoys' words were false to both sides, and the land paid for it twice. The court wrote that this war must be remembered, so that a third does not come.
second_war.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: the second army landed where the first had. The men knew the roads now, and the Koreans knew them.
second_war.summary: The truce broke when the truth came out, and the war began again. It was still being fought at the end.
second_war.title: A second war

share.few: Japan holds a few coastal towns.
share.half: Japan holds about half of Korea.
share.south: Japan holds part of the south.

truce_held.memoir_jos: The court's record, {year}: the truce held, though no one at court believed it would. The farmers went back to their fields, and the soldiers kept watch on the coast.
truce_held.memoir_jpn: From the Japanese camp, {year}: no order came to march again. The garrisons of the Korean forts grew vegetables under their walls and waited for ships from home.
truce_held.summary: The guns fell silent and stayed silent behind the truce lines.
truce_held.title: A truce that held

prep.approximate: approximate: the edited templates share one stock
prep.armies_note: Army presets are saved in the library and show up in the army panel once the game starts. A division whose parts this country has not researched by then will not train; the army panel names it.
prep.designs_intro: Create and edit tank, plane and ship designs and division entries. The ones switched to auto are made when the game starts; any that need parts this country has not researched are skipped.
prep.designs_intro_hist: Edit division entries, army presets and air groups. The ones switched to auto are made when the game starts; any that need parts this country has not researched are skipped.
prep.draft_note: Draft mode: no research lock, and numbers shown without country modifiers.
prep.fill_none: Nothing more fits: the men or the equipment are used up.
prep.library_army_none: No army templates in the library.
prep.library_none: No library division fits this country's 1936 research.
prep.minor_note: This country's start templates depend on its development, which is not known here. Only its main template can be changed.
prep.oob_blocked: The start army plan was not sent: {reason}
prep.oob_empty_required: {army}: an operation is running, so it needs at least one division.
prep.oob_intro: Plan the whole start army: edit or add templates, set how many divisions of each every army holds. The men are those of the original start divisions. Every division is made with all its men and main equipment, so a shortage of those means fewer divisions. Support gear is the exception: a division takes what there is, and a company works only as far as its gear goes.
prep.oob_refused: The game refused the start army plan, so your army is the default one.
prep.oob_special_cap: Special battalions are capped at {cap} (5% of all battalions, at least 24); remove some special divisions from the plan.
prep.oob_unfilled_required: {army}: the stock cannot staff it, and an operation is running.
prep.operation_guide: Was {n} divisions; at least one must stay.
prep.operation_note: An army with a running operation needs at least one division.
prep.preview_limited: With this template: {n} start divisions (was {was}), limited by {equipment}
prep.preview_unknown: The division count cannot be previewed for this country.
prep.short_men: Short of men: {n} divisions at most
prep.start_intro: Change the start templates of your country. When the game starts, the edited ones are applied and the start divisions are re-formed from the same men.

spirit.aus_empire_first_1: Empire First I: Ships for the Empire
spirit.aus_empire_first_2: Empire First II: Divisions for the Middle East
spirit.aus_empire_first_3: Empire First III: Arsenal of the South
spirit.ccp_sp_soviet_model_army: An Army on the Soviet Model

spirit_desc.arg_bop_concordancia_rules: The provincial machines and the landowners hold the country; the barracks keep quiet.
spirit_desc.arg_bop_conservatives_hold: The government holds the reins, though some colonels mutter about corruption.
spirit_desc.arg_bop_lodge_stirs: The secret lodge counts its regiments and its friends in the ministries.
spirit_desc.arg_bop_officers_rule: The colonels decide who governs. A march on the capital is a matter of days.
spirit_desc.arg_bop_uneasy_barracks: Ministers and officers watch each other. Nobody knows who would march if the order came.
spirit_desc.arg_neutral_course: Argentina trades with all sides and joins no one's war.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_air_command: Our pilots train under one command, on their own bases.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_concordancia: The coalition controls the governors, the police and the count. Plots are found early.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_corporate_state: Guilds and the state direct the economy; the opposition is silent but not gone.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_descamisados: The workers have found their colonel. Strikes end at the Secretariat of Labour, and the plazas fill on his call.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_far_from_war: An ocean away from the quarrels of Europe, few Argentines see any reason to fight.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_industrial_promotion: Cheap credit and state orders keep new factories rising around the cities.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_infamous_decade: Elections are won by fraud and everyone knows it. The government is steady, its legitimacy is not.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_malvinas_fever: Every newspaper and every plaza speaks of the islands.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_military_government: Generals in the ministries, discipline in the provinces and arms orders for the arsenals.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_mobilisation: The classes are called up; the shops and the farms run short of hands.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_national_defence: Plans for men, trains and factories are ready for the day of mobilisation.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_officers_arbiters: The army is well trained and proud, and it believes it may replace a government that fails the nation.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_plata_customs: The river's republics trade under one tariff.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_radical_republic: Honest elections and public works win the middle classes for democracy.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_roca_runciman: Britain buys our beef at a quota and British firms keep the railways and the trams. Trade is easy, our own industry is not.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_spy_scandal: The whole hemisphere reads about our secret envoy to Berlin. Every embassy is cooler toward us.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_state_of_siege: Meetings and papers are suspended under the emergency article. The country is quiet, and the work of government slows.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_stubborn_neutrality: Argentina sells to every side and promises nothing to anyone.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_third_position: Argentina deals with every bloc and joins none.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_wartime_exports: Meat and wheat fetch war prices, and the treasury fills.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_workers_republic: The councils run the plants and the ports and send their delegates to Buenos Aires.
spirit_desc.arg_sp_ypf: The state oil company refines enough for the army and the railways.
spirit_desc.aus_aif_spirit: Volunteers to a man, and proud of the name their fathers made in 1915.
spirit_desc.aus_air_training: Thousands of aircrew learn to fly over the open country of the interior.
spirit_desc.aus_allied_base: American men and machines pour through Australian ports.
spirit_desc.aus_austerity: Clothes, tea, sugar and petrol are rationed; the savings go to the war.
spirit_desc.aus_citizen_militia: The home army is part-time and by law may not be sent overseas. Many willing men, few trained ones.
spirit_desc.aus_coastwatch: Hidden observers in the islands report every ship and aircraft that passes.
spirit_desc.aus_crown_rule: A royal house of its own gives the kingdom a focus above party.
spirit_desc.aus_depression_scars: One worker in five was out of work at the worst. The scars are still there in the cities and the bush.
spirit_desc.aus_empire_first_1: Australian cruisers sail where the Admiralty needs them.
spirit_desc.aus_empire_first_2: The AIF fights beside the British in the decisive theatre.
spirit_desc.aus_empire_first_3: Australia is the Empire's workshop and depot east of Suez.
spirit_desc.aus_empire_trade: A sure market in Britain for wool, wheat and meat.
spirit_desc.aus_graving_dock: Damaged ships of any size can be repaired in Sydney.
spirit_desc.aus_independent_companies: Commando companies scout ahead and raid behind the enemy's lines.
spirit_desc.aus_jungle_craft: Patrols, ambushes and silence: the army has learned to fight in the rainforest.
spirit_desc.aus_jungle_warfare: Troops trained for the tropics hold their ground better.
spirit_desc.aus_labor_program: Public works and fair wages keep the unions on side.
spirit_desc.aus_militia_called_up: Militia battalions are in full-time camp; their jobs wait for them.
spirit_desc.aus_munitions_directorate: Businessmen run war production with a free hand and few forms.
spirit_desc.aus_national_government: An all-party ministry rules above the quarrels of Parliament.
spirit_desc.aus_northern_watch: Patrols and outposts along a coast where no one lives.
spirit_desc.aus_pacific_first_1: Money goes to airfields and forts in the north, not to Singapore.
spirit_desc.aus_pacific_first_2: American aircraft and advisers come to Australian bases.
spirit_desc.aus_pacific_first_3: The Pacific war is run from Melbourne and Brisbane.
spirit_desc.aus_pacific_power: Australia guards the islands to its north as its own business.
spirit_desc.aus_raaf_overseas: Crews come home with experience from Europe and the desert.
spirit_desc.aus_set_piece: Careful reconnaissance, a heavy barrage and infantry close behind it.
spirit_desc.aus_singapore_strategy: The defence of Australia rests on a British fleet that would sail to Singapore in a crisis. Few forts are built at home.
spirit_desc.aus_slow_recovery: The factories are working again, but not yet at full stretch.
spirit_desc.aus_steel_mills: Australian mills roll the plate and girders for every new factory.
spirit_desc.aus_tactical_air: Fighters and bombers work hand in glove with the troops on the ground.
spirit_desc.aus_tobruk_defence: Dig deep, let the tanks pass, and kill the infantry behind them.
spirit_desc.aus_total_war: Everything and everyone is directed to the war effort.
spirit_desc.aus_trained_militia: Long camps and regular instructors have turned weekend soldiers into a real home army.
spirit_desc.aus_two_oceans: The navy fights in the Indian Ocean and the Coral Sea alike.
spirit_desc.aus_tyranny_of_distance: Oceans keep enemies far away, and keep friends, supplies and reinforcements far away too.
spirit_desc.aus_uniform_taxation: One income tax, collected by the Commonwealth, pays for the war.
spirit_desc.aus_vdc: Veterans of the last war guard bridges, beaches and airfields.
spirit_desc.aus_war_cabinet: A Labor ministry that the country trusts to run the war.
spirit_desc.aus_wool_contract: Britain buys the whole wool clip for the duration at a fixed price.
spirit_desc.bal_arms_contracts: Foreign arms come on easier credit and barter terms.
spirit_desc.bal_highland_drill: Infantry trained in the hills fights harder on the attack.
spirit_desc.bal_partisan_war: Bands in the mountains keep the occupied lands restless.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_air_reorganised: The military aviation has its own staff and airfields.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_allied_plans: The Allies know where the Belgian army will stand.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_ardennes_forward: Roadblocks and demolitions hold the forest frontier.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_bop_flemish_ascendant: The north sets the course and Wallonia feels a stranger in its own state.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_bop_flemish_rise: The Flemish majority makes itself felt in parliament and the army.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_bop_francophone_lead: French still rules the state, the army and the money, though less each year.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_bop_french_state: Brussels governs in French alone; Flemish anger feeds the radicals.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_bop_language_peace: North and south accept the balance, for now.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_canal_defence: The army digs in fast behind canals and rivers.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_canal_line: The main army stands on the canal from Antwerp to Liège.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_force_publique: The colony's army adds Congolese soldiers to the Belgian ranks.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_franc_recovery: The cheaper franc sells Belgian goods abroad and the building trades are busy again.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_french_accord: The French and Belgian staffs know each other's plans.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_independence: Belgium belongs to no alliance; no one has a pretext to attack it, and few will hurry to help.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_katanga_copper: The mines of the Union Minière pay well and trade far.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_labour_conference: Paid holidays and a shorter week calm the factories.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_labour_plan: The state directs credit and the great industries.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_language_compromise: The language quarrel is fought in committees, not in the street.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_language_regiments: Soldiers are commanded in their own language.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_last_stand: The army fights for every canal and river.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_london_government: The state lives on abroad with its gold, colony and fleet.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_mechelen_alert: The army stands to after the captured invasion plans.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_mobilisation_plans: The works know what to make on the day of mobilisation.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_oslo_trade: Lower tariffs with the small trading nations of the north.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_recovery_office: Cheap credit and careful public works keep the recovery going.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_royal_question: The King and the government have parted: half the country stands with one, half with the other.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_secret_army: Officers in hiding prepare the rising and pass intelligence to the Allies.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_short_service: Conscripts serve only a few months and go home half-trained.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_social_pact: Employers and unions settle their quarrels in joint committees.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_strike_wave: Strikes and lockouts spread through the industrial basins.
spirit_desc.bel_sp_three_parties: Catholics, Liberals and Socialists share power: stable, but every decision is a bargain.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_army_unbound: The military clauses of Neuilly no longer hold and the army grows in the open.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_corporate_bulgaria: Guilds of every trade replace the parties and the state settles their quarrels.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_eastern_corps: Bulgarian soldiers fight far from home in a war many of them do not understand.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_german_clearing: Germany takes most of the crop and pays in credits spent in Germany.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_hidden_army: Labour battalions, police and false depots hide an army larger than the treaty allows.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_imro_bands: Armed bands loyal to the Macedonian cause live in the border districts. They are useful and dangerous in equal measure.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_lands_one: One of the lost lands is Bulgarian again. The country celebrates and looks to the others.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_lands_two: Two of the lost lands have come home. The old bitterness gives way to pride.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_legionary_state: The Legions rule with marches, oaths and a promise of war for the lost lands.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_mountain_redoubt: The army is ready to hold the mountains around the capital to the last.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_national_catastrophes: The defeats of 1913 and 1918 cost the kingdom its southern lands and flooded it with refugees. The wound feeds both bitterness and the will to fight.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_neuilly_chains: The peace treaty limits the army to twenty thousand volunteers and forbids tanks, warplanes and conscription.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_palace_government: Ministers chosen at the palace carry out its wishes without debate.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_peasant_democracy: The villages govern themselves through cooperatives and a freely elected chamber.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_peoples_power: Committees of the Fatherland Front run every town and the party guides them.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_pilot_schools: A steady stream of trained pilots and mechanics reaches the regiments.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_regency: The new Tsar is a child and three regents govern in his name. None of them has Boris's authority.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_san_stefano: Dobruja, Macedonia and Thrace are Bulgarian again. The nation feels whole for the first time in living memory.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_sofia_shelters: Cellars, trenches and evacuations reduce the damage of each raid.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_soviet_friendship: The Soviet pact is popular with the workers and peasants and alarms the palace.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_strict_neutrality: Bulgaria refuses every pact and every army's passage, and guards its borders.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_symbolic_war: Bulgaria is at war on paper, but its soldiers stay at home and its embassy in Moscow stays open.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_tobacco_economy: The country lives from tobacco, roses and grain sold abroad. Trade is easy, but there is little industry to build with.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_tsars_firm_rule: The crown has made itself the one fixed point in Bulgarian politics.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_tsars_personal_rule: Boris III governs through cabinets he appoints and dismisses at will. The parties are banned and grumble, but no one dares to move against the crown.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_war_academy: Staff officers trained at home plan every campaign in advance.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_western_markets: The crop is sold for hard currency in London and Paris, at lower prices but without political strings.
spirit_desc.bgr_sp_zveno_state: Officers and experts run the country by decree, above the old parties and without a king's favour.
spirit_desc.bop_chn_strong_centre: The central government's word carries into the provinces. Stability +10%, political power gain +10%.
spirit_desc.bop_chn_warlords: Provincial commanders look after themselves first. Political power gain −20%, recruitable population +10%.
spirit_desc.bop_fra_national_union: The centre and the right unite around rearmament. Military construction +10%, stability −5%.
spirit_desc.bop_fra_popular_front: A coalition of the left governs with the unions' backing. Consumer goods +3 points, stability +5%, military construction −10%.
spirit_desc.bop_jpn_army: The army sets the national course. Land research +10%, attack +5%, naval research −10%.
spirit_desc.bop_jpn_balance: Neither service holds the budget. Research +3%.
spirit_desc.bop_jpn_navy: The navy sets the national course. Naval research +10%, dockyard output +5%, land research −10%.
spirit_desc.bop_yug_centralism: The unitary state holds, at the cost of unrest.
spirit_desc.bop_yug_concessions: Zagreb has a say; Serbian officers grumble.
spirit_desc.bop_yug_federal_kingdom: The peoples govern themselves under one crown; the army trusts the state less.
spirit_desc.bop_yug_serb_hegemony: Belgrade rules all; the army is loyal and the Croats are in open revolt.
spirit_desc.bra_bop_estado_novo_firm: The palace rules unchallenged and the green shirts are a memory.
spirit_desc.bra_bop_getulio_holds: The president keeps the movement at arm's length.
spirit_desc.bra_bop_green_tide: Green shirts fill the streets and the ministries hesitate.
spirit_desc.bra_bop_integralist_surge: The movement is a state within the state, and it knows it.
spirit_desc.bra_bop_uneasy_truce: Palace and movement watch each other and wait.
spirit_desc.bra_feb_veterans: Officers back from the Italian front pass on what they learned.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_abc_staff: Common plans with Argentina and Chile.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_air_force: One air force, one ministry, one school of flying.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_armed_neutrality: Brazil defends its coast and takes no side.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_barracks_politics: The officers who made the revolution of 1930 still argue politics in the messes, and any of them might march.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_belligerence: The country works and fights for the war.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_coastal_patrol: Aircraft over the shipping lanes find the U-boats before they strike.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_coffee_crisis: Coffee is most of the exports and the world no longer pays for it. Every government lives on the price.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_coffee_managed: The coffee department holds the price, at a cost the treasury can bear.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_dasp: Examined officials run the ministries in place of political favourites.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_dip: Censorship and radio shape what the country hears about its president.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_empire_restored: An emperor above the parties, as in the days of Pedro II.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_equidistance_dividend: Both great buyers pay more to keep Brazil from the other.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_estado_novo: One man, one flag and decree-laws in place of Congress.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_free_coffee: The price falls, planters fail and their capital moves to the cities.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_french_school: Methodical staff work learned from the French mission.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_german_mission: German officers teach at the staff college.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_getulio_back: The old leader returns on the shoulders of the workers.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_hemisphere_partner: American credits and engineers come with the alliance.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_integral_state: The sigma flies over every public building and the militia patrols the streets.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_labour_code: Workers have rights, courts and a ministry that watches their unions.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_march_west: Roads and settlers push into the interior.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_peoples_brazil: Committees run the land and the factories.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_republic_restored: Elections, parties and a free press, and a cautious army watching.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_senta_a_pua: The fighter pilots' battle cry from the Italian front.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_smoking_snakes: Veterans of the Italian mountains lead the army.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_south_atlantic_patrol: Brazilian escorts shepherd the convoys of the South Atlantic.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_state_of_siege: Since the rising of 1935 the constitution is suspended and the police hold thousands without trial.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_state_oligarchies: São Paulo, Minas and Rio Grande still run their own police, budgets and parties.
spirit_desc.bra_sp_technical_schools: Engineers and chemists trained at home.
spirit_desc.can_arsenal_of_empire: Canadian plants supply every Commonwealth front with trucks, shells, ships and aircraft.
spirit_desc.can_baby_bonus: A monthly allowance for every child keeps families fed and spending.
spirit_desc.can_bank_of_england_gold: The reserves of the Empire sit in Canadian vaults, and Canada pays for its war with confidence.
spirit_desc.can_bcatp: Over a hundred schools train pilots, navigators and gunners from the whole Commonwealth.
spirit_desc.can_blue_shirt_state: Rallies, uniforms and a leader's word: a small movement now rules a large country.
spirit_desc.can_ccf_planning: Crown corporations and co-operatives build where private capital would not.
spirit_desc.can_corporate_order: Parish, family and province: the new regime promises order and asks for obedience.
spirit_desc.can_dominion_resources: Nickel, gold, timber, wheat and power: Canada sells what the industrial world needs.
spirit_desc.can_dust_bowl: Drought and low wheat prices have emptied the farms of the West. Relief still eats the budget.
spirit_desc.can_escort_force: Corvettes and destroyers out of St. John's and Halifax take the convoys across the worst of the ocean.
spirit_desc.can_home_defence_draft: Men are called up to defend Canada itself and no further. Those who will not volunteer for overseas are called zombies in the barracks.
spirit_desc.can_howe_boys: Executives on loan to the government run the war plants like businesses, with Ottawa's cheque book.
spirit_desc.can_hyde_park_dollars: Washington buys Canadian munitions, and the dollars pay for American parts.
spirit_desc.can_kings_pledge: The government has promised that no Canadian will be conscripted to fight overseas. Quebec trusts it; the generals do not.
spirit_desc.can_middle_power_spirit: Canada speaks where it contributes, and the great powers have learned to listen.
spirit_desc.can_mining_boom: New mines in the Shield ship nickel, copper and zinc to the world's arms makers.
spirit_desc.can_northwest_atlantic_command: A Canadian admiral directs every escort and patrol aircraft west of the meeting point.
spirit_desc.can_overseas_conscription: Conscripts go to the front. The battalions are full again, and French Canada feels the old promise broken.
spirit_desc.can_peoples_dominion: Workers' councils run the plants and the wheat pools under the party's plan.
spirit_desc.can_pledge_released: The country has released the government from its promise. Conscription for overseas is possible, if necessary.
spirit_desc.can_price_controls: Prices and wages are frozen. Inflation stays low, and so does the grumbling.
spirit_desc.can_quebec_unrest: Crowds in Montreal and Quebec City denounce the government and its war.
spirit_desc.can_rcaf_squadrons: Canadian aircrews fly together under Canadian commanders.
spirit_desc.can_reciprocity_trade: Lower tariffs along the border bring cheaper goods and steadier markets.
spirit_desc.can_set_piece_artillery: Every attack goes in behind a timed barrage, planned to the minute.
spirit_desc.can_social_insurance: Unemployment insurance gives the worker something between a job and the breadline.
spirit_desc.can_two_solitudes: English and French Canada live side by side and read the world differently, above all when Britain goes to war.
spirit_desc.can_victory_bond_drive: Every street has its quota and every office its thermometer poster.
spirit_desc.can_vimy_tradition: The army remembers the corps that took the ridge, and means to fight together again.
spirit_desc.can_volunteer_army: Every soldier overseas chose to go. Fewer men, slower drafts, and a country that holds together.
spirit_desc.ccp_anti_japan_front: Cooperation with the Nationalists focuses effort on the war against Japan.
spirit_desc.ccp_cadre_training: Graduates of the party school run the base areas.
spirit_desc.ccp_captured_weapons: Weapons taken from the enemy fill much of the units' needs.
spirit_desc.ccp_guerrilla_doctrine: Small units fight dispersed on little supply.
spirit_desc.ccp_mass_work: The cadres' work among the people gathers information and support.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_annihilation: Concentrate, encircle, destroy: one enemy unit at a time.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_arms_from_enemy: The enemy's supply columns are our arsenal.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_army_farms: Brigades that farm feed themselves and the villages around them.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_bases_1: One base area behind the enemy's lines gives recruits and grain.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_bases_2: Two bases support each other across the occupier's railways.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_bases_3: Three bases form a network the occupier cannot clear.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_bases_4: The bases have become liberated areas with their own governments, armies and harvests.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_bethune_teams: A foreign surgeon and the village nurses he trained operate a few miles behind the fighting.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_blockade: Nationalist posts ring the Border Region. Cloth, medicine and money do not get through.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_careful_screening: The volunteers who came to fight Japan keep their trust in the party.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_comintern_backing: Moscow's approval lends weight to every decision of the leadership.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_cooperatives: The villages pool tools, draught animals and labour.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_crack_troops: Fewer clerks, more fighters and farmers.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_field_hospitals: Surgery near the front sends more wounded back to their units.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_fourth_front: The largest Red army trusts its own commanders above the party.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_hardened: The bases have survived the worst and know how to recover.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_harvest_drive: Every hand is in the fields, and the granaries fill.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_independent_guerrilla: Small units, light loads and the mountains behind them.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_iron_discipline: A small party of picked cadres who obey orders and do not steal from the people.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_kangda: Officers trained in months, tested in battle.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_land_reform: Peasants with land of their own send their sons to the army; the landlords plot.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_long_march_scars: Nine men in ten were lost on the way. Those who arrived will never break, but there are few of them.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_militia: Every village supplies sentries, porters and reserves.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_mine_war: Every road into the bases may kill.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_mobile_war: Divisions march fast and strike columns on the move.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_northwest_bloc: The armies of the northwest stand together, against Japan and apart from Nanking.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_party_school: Trained cadres from one school run every base the same way.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_poor_border_region: Loess hills, cave homes and thin harvests: there is little to tax and less to build with.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_protracted_war: We do not need to win quickly, only to last longer than the enemy.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_rectified: Old factions are gone. The party speaks with one voice and obeys one centre.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_rent_reduction: Tenants pay less and the landlords stay in the front.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_rescue_fear: Nobody plots, and nobody speaks freely either. Students and scientists keep their heads down.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_rival_centres: Zhang Guotao's rival central committee is dissolved, but the bitterness between the armies remains.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_self_reliance: Soldiers and cadres grow and make what they need.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_sinified_marxism: Theory in the peasants' language wins converts that Moscow's pamphlets never could.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_soviet_model_army: Regular drill and Soviet manuals turn guerrillas into soldiers.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_soviet_republic: The land is the peasants' now, and their sons join the Red Army. The gentry flee and plot.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_sparrow_war: Small groups harass the enemy everywhere and nowhere.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_staff_work: Orders are written, maps are drawn and plans are ready on time.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_three_alls: Burnt villages, killed men and carried-off grain: the bases have shrunk.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_three_thirds: Non-party men share the councils, and the gentry stay loyal.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_tunnels: Under the plain villages runs a second village.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_unity_and_struggle: The front holds, and every provocation is answered within limits.
spirit_desc.ccp_sp_western_route_lost: The army that crossed the Yellow River was destroyed in the corridor. The Fourth Front's men blame the centre.
spirit_desc.ccp_village_militia: Village militia form a reserve for the regular army.
spirit_desc.chn_advisor_training: Foreign advisers have sped up staff work and training.
spirit_desc.chn_anti_japan_solidarity: With the civil war halted, the country stands together against Japan.
spirit_desc.chn_occupied_resistance: Units and villagers left in the occupied areas keep resisting.
spirit_desc.chn_officer_corps: The academies send new officers to the army every year.
spirit_desc.chn_protracted_war: Ground may be given up, but surrender is not.
spirit_desc.chn_provisional_capital: The government carries on the war from Chongqing deep inland.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_baojia: Every household answers for its neighbours and for its sons of military age.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_burma_route: Lorries from Rangoon and Lashio carry what the coast no longer can.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_counteroffensive: Trained divisions with air cover go forward again.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_export_collateral: Tung oil and antimony stand as security for the loans that buy the war.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_fabi: One paper currency for the whole country, as long as the reserves hold.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_flooded_plain: Water stands between the armies, and over the fields of those who lived there.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_front_broken: Divisions that should face Japan watch the Communist border instead.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_front_solid: The Communists and the government fight the same enemy before each other.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_front_uneasy: Two armies, two parties, one enemy, and overlapping areas.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_generalissimo_rule: Decisions are quick when one man makes them all, and slow when he is busy.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_great_power: China counts among the great powers again.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_heavy_plan: Steel and arsenals first, far from the coast.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_hump: Fuel and ammunition flown over the mountains from India.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_inflation: Salaries buy less every week; officials and officers look for other income.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_nanjing_decade: Ten years of roads, railways, banks and schools along the Yangtze: a state is being built where the government's writ runs.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_northern_line: The army digs in behind the rivers of the north.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_party_machine: Cadres in every county office, files on every official.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_personal_armies: Divisions belong to the men who raised them. They fight hardest for their own general and least for someone else's.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_resources_commission: State mines and plants run by engineers rather than by officials.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_river_mines: Mines and sunken hulks keep the gunboats out of the Yangtze.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_shanghai_stand: The best divisions are committed where the world can see them fight.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_standard_arsenals: One rifle pattern, one cartridge, interchangeable parts.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_tungsten: The state buys every ton of ore and sells it for arms.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_vast_peasantry: Endless men for the army, few who can read its orders, and fewer still who have seen a machine.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_war_areas: Each front has its commander, its staff and its own supply.
spirit_desc.chn_sp_warning_net: Village spotters with telephones report every engine they hear.
spirit_desc.chn_war_finance: Wartime taxes give the government more to work with.
spirit_desc.chn_warlords: Provincial generals obey Nanjing only when it suits them.
spirit_desc.chw_cavalry_tradition: Northwest horsemen lead the fight with fast movement.
spirit_desc.chw_frontier_trade: Frontier trade routes draw merchants and goods.
spirit_desc.chw_guangxi_levies: Able-bodied men train in the militia, ready for mobilisation.
spirit_desc.chw_local_militia: County and village militia keep order and supply recruits.
spirit_desc.chw_mining_drive: The provincial government is pushing mining.
spirit_desc.chw_provincial_academy: The provincial school trains junior officers.
spirit_desc.chw_provincial_rule: The province governs itself under the centre's nominal authority.
spirit_desc.csk_air_watch: Observers, searchlights and guns ring the cities.
spirit_desc.csk_arms_programme: Factories work to the army's plan.
spirit_desc.csk_army_rule: Generals sit in the ministries and the army answers to no party.
spirit_desc.csk_aviation_pride: Prizes abroad have made the air force popular and its designers ambitious.
spirit_desc.csk_border_guard: Gendarmes, police and customs men armed and trained to hold the border until the army arrives.
spirit_desc.csk_centralism: Everything is decided in Prague. It is efficient, and it is resented.
spirit_desc.csk_corporate_state: Guilds replace unions and the nation stands above class.
spirit_desc.csk_czech_science: The universities of Prague and Brno work for the state.
spirit_desc.csk_danube_trade: Preferences along the river revive the old markets.
spirit_desc.csk_defiance: Abandoned by its allies, the Republic fights for its borders.
spirit_desc.csk_democratic_defence: The Republic's laws and police watch the enemies of parliament.
spirit_desc.csk_exile_government: The state lives on abroad and speaks for its occupied people.
spirit_desc.csk_export_orders: Foreign orders keep the arms works busy and their skills sharp.
spirit_desc.csk_federal_union: Several peoples under one federal government, still learning to trust each other.
spirit_desc.csk_fortress_gunners: Gun crews who know every range in front of their casemates.
spirit_desc.csk_forts_1: Thousands of light pillboxes line the German border.
spirit_desc.csk_forts_2: Infantry blockhouses and artillery forts hold the mountain passes.
spirit_desc.csk_forts_3: A continuous line of concrete and steel from the Ore Mountains to the Carpathians.
spirit_desc.csk_general_staff: Staff officers trained for a war on several fronts.
spirit_desc.csk_island_of_democracy: The last parliamentary democracy in central Europe, proud of its freedoms and slow to ready its people for war.
spirit_desc.csk_mobilisation_plans: Every reservist knows where to report and what to carry.
spirit_desc.csk_mobilised: Every reservist is under arms. The factories and fields feel their absence.
spirit_desc.csk_national_front: All parties govern together under communist leadership.
spirit_desc.csk_nationalities: Germans, Hungarians, Ruthenians and restless Slovaks: a third of the citizens do not feel the state is theirs.
spirit_desc.csk_nationalities_eased: The statute has calmed the moderate minorities. The radicals remain.
spirit_desc.csk_partial_mobilisation: A class of reservists has been called up and the border forts are manned.
spirit_desc.csk_second_republic: A smaller state with fewer parties and a firmer government.
spirit_desc.csk_skoda_arsenal: Škoda, ČKD and Zbrojovka Brno make the best guns and some of the best tanks east of the Rhine.
spirit_desc.csk_slovak_autonomy: Slovakia governs itself within the state. Fewer quarrels, less control from Prague.
spirit_desc.csk_state_defence: The state may organise the border districts, the factories and the people for war.
spirit_desc.deu_combined_doctrine: Tanks and infantry, guns and aircraft move as one.
spirit_desc.deu_conscription_back: The conscription law of 1935 brings a fresh age class into the ranks every year.
spirit_desc.deu_elastic_defence: Prepared lines in depth strengthen the defence.
spirit_desc.deu_flak_belt: Dense anti-aircraft guns around cities and plants.
spirit_desc.deu_fyp_economy: Raw-material self-sufficiency and arms output come before consumer goods.
spirit_desc.deu_generals_doubt: The army leadership does not trust the regime's plans for war.
spirit_desc.deu_goering_works: The state combine builds plants fast but wastes steel and skill.
spirit_desc.deu_highway_works: Building the motorways has trained construction crews and machinery.
spirit_desc.deu_oath_loyalty: Officers bound by oath make a coup harder.
spirit_desc.deu_rearmament: Since conscription returned in March 1935, arms plants come before consumer goods.
spirit_desc.deu_rebuilding: Peace turns the nation to reconstruction.
spirit_desc.deu_replacement_system: Regional replacement battalions quickly make good the losses at the front.
spirit_desc.deu_rhineland_dmz: The Versailles and Locarno treaties bar German troops and fortifications from the Rhineland.
spirit_desc.deu_speer_rationalisation: Fewer types and central planning raise output, and production lines climb faster again.
spirit_desc.deu_standard_tools: Common standards let factories share their work.
spirit_desc.deu_tank_mass_production: A few fixed tank types are turned out in numbers.
spirit_desc.deu_tech_drive: University and industry engineers work on state research programmes.
spirit_desc.deu_total_mobilised: The whole economy works for the war, at a cost in public mood.
spirit_desc.deu_war_academy: The War Academy, reopened in 1935, turns out trained staff officers.
spirit_desc.deu_wartime_output: The factories run day and night while civilian life grows leaner.
spirit_desc.deu_winter_kit: Fur-lined clothing and cold-weather grease get worn-out units back on their feet sooner.
spirit_desc.dnk_farm_exports: Danish farm goods open markets abroad.
spirit_desc.dom_air_training_scheme: Flying schools across the Commonwealth feed the squadrons with aircrew.
spirit_desc.dom_mining_drive: New mines and state contracts raise the output of strategic metals.
spirit_desc.dom_wartime_output: Factories run extra shifts under government controllers.
spirit_desc.esn_aero_institute: Spanish engineers study engines and airframes.
spirit_desc.esn_african_veterans: Officers and men hardened in the Moroccan wars lead the rising.
spirit_desc.esn_agrarian_rear: Wheat and cattle in plenty, factories almost none.
spirit_desc.esn_air_tactics: Close support and quick sorties, as learned over Spain.
spirit_desc.esn_aragon_drive: The offensive rolls down the Ebro valley.
spirit_desc.esn_autarky: Spain makes do with what it has, and digs for the rest.
spirit_desc.esn_bop_arbiter: No faction can win without the head of state.
spirit_desc.esn_bop_carlist_strength: The Requetés are a power of their own, loyal first to their cause.
spirit_desc.esn_bop_falange_lead: The party's men hold the better posts.
spirit_desc.esn_bop_falange_state: The party runs the syndicates, the press and the street.
spirit_desc.esn_bop_tradition_lead: Carlists, monarchists and the Church's men set the tone.
spirit_desc.esn_caudillaje: All power in one pair of hands, answerable to none.
spirit_desc.esn_constitutional_crown: The king reigns under a charter; Europe's doors open again.
spirit_desc.esn_final_push: Every corps is committed to end the war.
spirit_desc.esn_foreign_instructors: German and Italian airmen train Spanish crews.
spirit_desc.esn_fueros_restored: The provinces keep their ancient rights under a Carlist regency.
spirit_desc.esn_home_trained_pilots: Pilots trained at home, in Spanish.
spirit_desc.esn_iberian_bloc_pact: Spain and Portugal stand together, neutral.
spirit_desc.esn_imperial_pride: A foothold in Africa feeds the regime's talk of empire.
spirit_desc.esn_ini_holdings: A state holding company builds steel, ships and fuel.
spirit_desc.esn_legion_spirit: The Legion's banderas attack where others hold back.
spirit_desc.esn_neutral_course: Spain trades with all and fights for none.
spirit_desc.esn_non_belligerent: Friendly to one side, at war with none.
spirit_desc.esn_occupied_resistance: Bands in the mountains harry the occupier.
spirit_desc.esn_one_iberia: One peninsula, one government, two peoples still wary of each other.
spirit_desc.esn_peoples_militia: Workers in arms defend the new republic.
spirit_desc.esn_provisional_officer_corps: Young officers trained in weeks lead from the front.
spirit_desc.esn_restored_parliament: Free Cortes and free universities, and the arguments that come with them.
spirit_desc.esn_rock_siege: Siege guns and assault troops ready for Gibraltar.
spirit_desc.esn_single_party: One party, one chief, one state.
spirit_desc.esn_staff_schooling: Colonels learn to plan the next war, not refight the last.
spirit_desc.esn_vertical_syndicates: Workers and owners in one state union; no strikes.
spirit_desc.esn_youth_front: Camps, songs and drill for the new generation.
spirit_desc.esp_civil_war_nation: Spain has split in two, and every factory and village has had to choose a side.
spirit_desc.esr_air_doctrine_spirit: The lessons of the air war are applied.
spirit_desc.esr_awaiting_europe: The Republic waits for the democracies to fight.
spirit_desc.esr_bop_cnt_lead: The anarchist union sets the tone in the factories and the villages.
spirit_desc.esr_bop_pce_hegemony: The Communists run the army and the police; discipline is good and fear is everywhere.
spirit_desc.esr_bop_pce_lead: The party's line of order and a regular army prevails.
spirit_desc.esr_bop_popular_front: No party can win without the others; the coalition holds.
spirit_desc.esr_bop_revolution: The committees govern, the collectives produce what they can and volunteers flock to the columns.
spirit_desc.esr_brigadistas: Volunteers from across the world lead the attacks.
spirit_desc.esr_cave_factories_spirit: Workshops out of the bombers' reach.
spirit_desc.esr_collectives_spirit: The villages and workshops run themselves.
spirit_desc.esr_convoy_escorts: The fleet protects the supply ships.
spirit_desc.esr_deca_spirit: Guns, searchlights and shelters defend the cities.
spirit_desc.esr_defence_council_spirit: Officers and moderates govern and seek peace.
spirit_desc.esr_defence_ministry_spirit: One ministry for the army, the navy and the air force.
spirit_desc.esr_divided_officers: Half the officers cannot be trusted, and the rest are not trusted.
spirit_desc.esr_exile_cause: The world has not forgotten the Republic.
spirit_desc.esr_free_communes_spirit: A federation of communes and unions, defended by its militias.
spirit_desc.esr_gold_reserve: One of the largest gold reserves in the world pays for what the Republic must import.
spirit_desc.esr_guerrilleros: Raiders behind the lines bring back news of the enemy.
spirit_desc.esr_iberian_republic_spirit: Two peoples in one federation, not yet used to each other.
spirit_desc.esr_industrial_cities: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia and the north's mines and yards are in Republican hands.
spirit_desc.esr_land_reform: The labourers own the land they work.
spirit_desc.esr_landing_staff: Officers plan the landing on the islands.
spirit_desc.esr_loyal_commands: The key garrisons are held by officers the government trusts.
spirit_desc.esr_maneuver_army: A strike force kept in reserve.
spirit_desc.esr_militia_columns: Brave, numerous and hard to command.
spirit_desc.esr_mixed_brigades: A regular army with its own batteries and services.
spirit_desc.esr_night_torpedoes: The destroyers fight best in the dark.
spirit_desc.esr_nyon_patrols_spirit: The powers' patrols make the sea lanes safer.
spirit_desc.esr_peoples_democracy_spirit: The party governs through the army it built.
spirit_desc.esr_professional_army: A smaller army, loyal to the constitution.
spirit_desc.esr_resistir: Every month the Republic holds brings the European war closer.
spirit_desc.esr_restored_republic: The constitution is in force again.
spirit_desc.esr_revolutionary_rear: Strikes, seizures and street fighting: the state does not govern its own rear.
spirit_desc.esr_rif_unrest: The protectorate is restless and sends fewer recruits.
spirit_desc.esr_sim: One security service watches the army and the rear.
spirit_desc.esr_soviet_advisers_spirit: Experienced officers advise on tanks and staff work.
spirit_desc.esr_soviet_pilots: Volunteer pilots fly the new aircraft.
spirit_desc.esr_soviet_tank_crews: Tank crews trained by Soviet instructors.
spirit_desc.esr_spanish_pilots: Spanish pilots trained abroad fly the fighters.
spirit_desc.esr_summer_offensive: The army attacks with everything it has.
spirit_desc.esr_veteran_brigades: The volunteers who stayed are hardened veterans.
spirit_desc.esr_volunteer_columns: The columns fight for the revolution and take few orders.
spirit_desc.esr_war_commissars: Commissars keep up morale and watch the officers.
spirit_desc.esr_war_industry_commission: Catalan industry works for the front.
spirit_desc.esr_winter_offensive: An attack in the snow, when the enemy expects none.
spirit_desc.esr_workers_control: Committees run the factories, with enthusiasm and little coordination.
spirit_desc.fg_arsenal: The members' factories work as one. Factory output +5%.
spirit_desc.fg_cohesion: The faction holds the heart of Europe. Stability +5%.
spirit_desc.fg_science: The members share their laboratories. Research +5%.
spirit_desc.fg_sea_control: The faction commands the sea lanes. Convoy losses −10%.
spirit_desc.fin_brotherhood_in_arms: German supplies and German divisions in Lapland; a separate war, side by side.
spirit_desc.fin_captured_arms: Captured guns and tanks are repaired and turned on their makers.
spirit_desc.fin_civil_guard_spirit: The Civil Guard stands ready to fill the ranks.
spirit_desc.fin_civil_guards: A hundred thousand armed volunteers drill in every parish, loyal to the White republic.
spirit_desc.fin_crown_restored: A council governs in the name of a crown still waiting for its king.
spirit_desc.fin_democratic_unity: Former enemies of 1918 defend the same constitution.
spirit_desc.fin_empty_arsenal: The army has rifles and brave men, but too few guns and fewer shells.
spirit_desc.fin_forest_war: Small units trained to fight where there are no roads.
spirit_desc.fin_gengas: Lorries and tractors burn birch instead of petrol.
spirit_desc.fin_guards_called: The Civil Guard companies have reported to their battalions.
spirit_desc.fin_home_front_spirit: Rationing is accepted and the factories run day and night.
spirit_desc.fin_isthmus_line_1: Trenches and log bunkers across the Karelian Isthmus.
spirit_desc.fin_isthmus_line_2: Concrete bunkers and machine-gun nests hold the main roads.
spirit_desc.fin_isthmus_line_3: A continuous line of bunkers, tank obstacles and wire from the gulf to Ladoga.
spirit_desc.fin_karelian_evacuees: Hundreds of thousands who lost their homes must be given land and work.
