spirit_desc.fin_labour_peace: Employers and unions negotiate as partners; strikes give way to agreements.
spirit_desc.fin_lotta_spirit: Women's auxiliaries free men for the front and keep it fed.
spirit_desc.fin_marshal_rule: Defence comes first, and one man decides what defence needs.
spirit_desc.fin_mine_barrages: Mine barrages close the approaches to the Finnish coast.
spirit_desc.fin_motti_spirit: Enemy columns are cut up and surrounded piece by piece.
spirit_desc.fin_motti_tactics: The enemy is cut off and surrounded piece by piece.
spirit_desc.fin_neutral_north: Finland declares that it stands outside the quarrels of the great powers, beside its Nordic neighbours.
spirit_desc.fin_paasikivi_course: Finland's safety is sought in Moscow's trust rather than in fortifications.
spirit_desc.fin_parvi_formation: Loose pairs and fours, and fire from close range.
spirit_desc.fin_patriotic_state: One movement, one guard, one aim beyond the eastern border.
spirit_desc.fin_peoples_democracy: Councils run the mills and the banks; the old order resists in the countryside.
spirit_desc.fin_power_grid: The grid reaches the countryside and workshops follow.
spirit_desc.fin_scars_fading: The bitterness of 1918 fades, slowly, with a new generation.
spirit_desc.fin_scars_of_1918: The civil war ended in prison camps; Whites and Reds still live as two nations in one.
spirit_desc.fin_timber_trade: Sawn timber and paper pay for what Finland cannot make.
spirit_desc.fin_western_sympathy: Newspapers in London, Paris and New York take Finland's side.
spirit_desc.fin_winter_war_spirit: Whites and Reds of 1918 fight in the same trenches. The nation is one.
spirit_desc.fra_armament_ministry: One ministry plans the production of arms from the mine to the front.
spirit_desc.fra_colonial_mines: New concessions and roads raise the output of the colonial mines.
spirit_desc.fra_colonial_troops: Regiments from Africa and Asia add to the reserves of the home army.
spirit_desc.fra_defensive_mind: The general staff trusts the Maginot Line and plans for a long defensive war.
spirit_desc.fra_defensive_mind_plus: The fortified line is longer than ever, and the army trusts it more than ever.
spirit_desc.fra_dispersed_factories: Plants spread across the south are harder for enemy bombers to find and to hit.
spirit_desc.fra_divided: Short-lived cabinets and street clashes between left and right shake every government.
spirit_desc.fra_divided_eased: The bitterness between left and right has eased a little, but cabinets still fall easily.
spirit_desc.fra_divided_half: Daladier's centrist cabinet has eased, but not ended, the quarrels of left and right.
spirit_desc.fra_forty_hours: Shorter hours and paid holidays have calmed the strikes but slowed the factories.
spirit_desc.fra_free_france: Every Frenchman who refuses the armistice has a place in the fight.
spirit_desc.fra_hard_line: The government will make no more concessions, though not everyone is ready to pay the price.
spirit_desc.fra_hollow_years: The thin age groups born during the Great War are now reaching call-up age.
spirit_desc.fra_matignon: Wage rises and collective agreements have restored social peace, but labour costs keep climbing.
spirit_desc.fra_mobile_doctrine: Motorised reserves and counter-attacks replace the long wait behind concrete.
spirit_desc.fra_neutrality: France threatens no one, and whoever seeks a quarrel will find her well defended.
spirit_desc.fra_nuclear_physics: French physicists lead the study of chain reactions in uranium.
spirit_desc.fra_parliament_crisis: Rule by decree gets things done but wears away trust in the regime.
spirit_desc.fra_rearm_first: Defence orders take precedence over goods for the shops.
spirit_desc.fra_rearmament_plan_spirit: Long-term arms orders let the military factories grow steadily.
spirit_desc.fra_sacred_union: As in 1914, the nation puts its divisions aside until the enemy is beaten.
spirit_desc.gbr_aus_crown_rule: The states resent the Crown's officials, and London answers every complaint with a new inspector.
spirit_desc.gbr_can_crown_rule: Provincial leaders refuse to cooperate in small ways every day, and the long frontier must be watched.
spirit_desc.gbr_chindits: Long-range columns learn to live on little and hold what they take.
spirit_desc.gbr_codebreakers: Intercepted messages are read within hours, and the mathematics behind it spills into other research.
spirit_desc.gbr_cruiser_tank_doctrine: Fast tanks exploit breakthroughs and raid deep.
spirit_desc.gbr_desert_warfare: Units hardened by heat and sand strike harder.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire: Dominions and colonies around the globe add manpower and political weight.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire_mines: Mines across the Empire feed raw materials to British factories.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire_trade: Low tariffs within the Empire bring in more goods for every trade deal.
spirit_desc.gbr_federal_council: The Commonwealth shares its manpower and its council with London.
spirit_desc.gbr_guarantee_pledge: Britain has publicly promised to defend small nations against aggression.
spirit_desc.gbr_infantry_tank_doctrine: Slow, heavily armoured tanks lead set-piece assaults.
spirit_desc.gbr_kings_party: The King's supporters lead the government, but the constitutional crisis has divided the country.
spirit_desc.gbr_no_more_concessions: Since Prague the public agrees that Germany must be stood up to.
spirit_desc.gbr_nzl_crown_rule: The annexed islands sit uneasily under the Crown, and the garrison and the courts cost more than the colony gives.
spirit_desc.gbr_peace_mood: Memories of the last war leave voters wary of rearmament and conscription.
spirit_desc.gbr_peace_policy: Careful diplomacy to avoid war reassures the public but also dulls its vigilance.
spirit_desc.gbr_planned_economy: The state plans investment and output, driving factory building while protecting living standards.
spirit_desc.gbr_raj_crown_rule: India is held by a vast administration and a garrison that never rests. Men are tied down at the stations, the mills run below their strength, and every ministry fears the next rising.
spirit_desc.gbr_ration_book: Austerity frees factory capacity from consumer goods, though the public grumbles.
spirit_desc.gbr_rearm_programme: A rearmament budget spread over several years speeds up the building of military factories.
spirit_desc.gbr_security_pact: Britain is ready to guarantee threatened nations even before aggression begins.
spirit_desc.gbr_supply_ministry: One ministry now buys the Army's weapons, and production runs more smoothly.
spirit_desc.gbr_territorial_reserve: The doubled Territorial Army offers a deeper pool of recruits.
spirit_desc.gbr_total_output: Every factory keeps war production going day and night.
spirit_desc.gbr_united_empire: Men from across the Empire join the forces under the same flag as Britain.
spirit_desc.gbr_university_drive: University laboratories work for the armed services, speeding up research.
spirit_desc.gbr_war_coalition: All parties sit in one cabinet and share the responsibility for the war.
spirit_desc.gbr_welfare_state: A national insurance system and a health service steady the home front and raise a healthier generation.
spirit_desc.gbr_zaf_crown_rule: The annexed Union is held by a heavy garrison and by informers, and the strain falls on the home government.
spirit_desc.gen_armed_neutrality: Neutrality backed by a ready army makes any would-be attacker hesitate.
spirit_desc.gen_arms_limit: A peace treaty caps our army at twelve divisions, forbids naval construction and halves the output of our arms factories.
spirit_desc.gen_civil_strife: The government changed after civil strife, but wrecked factories and a divided people remain.
spirit_desc.gen_democratic_movement: Civic leagues that stand for democracy keep winning new supporters.
spirit_desc.gen_efficient_government: A leaner administration gets more done with the same effort.
spirit_desc.gen_exile_no_elections: A government abroad cannot hold elections until it returns home.
spirit_desc.gen_industrial_subsidy_spirit: Subsidised builders put up civilian factories faster.
spirit_desc.gen_industrial_zone: Ready-made industrial zones let new buildings go up faster.
spirit_desc.gen_labour_movement: Unions and left-wing clubs widen support for communism step by step.
spirit_desc.gen_martial_law_spirit: Soldiers on the streets have restored order, but the factories have lost hands.
spirit_desc.gen_mining_drive: New mines and machinery bring more ore and oil out of the ground.
spirit_desc.gen_neutrality_declared: Our formal neutrality makes it slower for others to build a case for war against us.
spirit_desc.gen_non_intervention: We have pledged to send neither volunteers nor lend-lease to either side in Spain.
spirit_desc.gen_partisan_support_spirit: Airdrops and couriers keep the partisans fighting behind enemy lines in our occupied lands.
spirit_desc.gen_rally_spirit: While the rallies go on, the ruling party gains a little support every day.
spirit_desc.gen_renewal_movement: A mass movement calling for national renewal keeps widening support for fascism.
spirit_desc.gen_research_institutes: State-funded laboratories speed up every field of research a little.
spirit_desc.gen_resistance_support: Our agents and radios keep the resistance in our occupied homeland growing.
spirit_desc.gen_skilled_workforce: Graduates of the trade schools push the production lines closer to their best.
spirit_desc.gen_staff_college: More officers pass through the staff course. Division experience gain +10%.
spirit_desc.gen_staff_training: Staff college graduates prepare operations sooner and pass their experience to the army.
spirit_desc.gen_strike_losses: Factories that stood idle have not yet returned to full speed.
spirit_desc.gen_war_bonds_spirit: Citizens who bought bonds see the war as their own, though they also want more consumer goods.
spirit_desc.grc_bop_new_state: The Venizelists are scattered, jailed or abroad. The regime rules unopposed, and grows lazy.
spirit_desc.grc_bop_regime_holds: The security police know who meets whom, and nobody moves.
spirit_desc.grc_bop_schism_reopens: Two camps, two armies in waiting. One spark and the officers will choose sides again.
spirit_desc.grc_bop_uneasy_truce: Neither camp dares to strike; the state works while they wait.
spirit_desc.grc_bop_venizelist_officers: Retired colonels hold meetings, Crete grumbles and the regime sees plots everywhere.
spirit_desc.grc_mountain_defense: Troops who know the ridges hold their ground longer.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_crown_and_army: The officers swear to the king, and the king keeps them busy with their profession.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_crowned_democracy: The king reigns, the chamber rules, and the old schism finally rests.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_destroyer_raids: Fast night raids against convoys and harbours.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_eon: Hundreds of thousands of boys and girls in uniform, raised for the regime and for the army.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_fortress_garrisons: The forts' garrisons know every gallery and fight from them to the end.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_fourth_of_august: A paternal dictatorship of order, faith and fatherland, guarded by the security police.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_free_greek_forces: The fleet, the airmen and the brigades abroad keep the state's flag flying.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_great_famine: Requisitions and blockade have emptied the bakeries; the cities bury their dead each morning.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_great_idea: The nation looks east again, to the City and to Ionia.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_island_exile: Opponents are sent to barren islands; the movements lose their leaders, the regime its friends.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_merchant_marine: One of the world's great tramp fleets: cheaper trade and convoys that know their business.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_mountain_warfare: Divisions trained to fight on ridges and in passes hold their ground well.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_mule_columns: Where roads end, mules carry the shells and the bread.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_national_schism: Two officer corps and two loyalties: every government fears the other half of the army.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_new_order: The party rules the streets and the barracks; not everyone has given in.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_ochi: A small country refused a great power, and every Greek feels it.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_parliamentary_rule: The chamber decides again: slower, noisier and trusted by more people.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_peoples_rule: Committees run villages and factories, and the party runs the committees.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_pyrkal: A private arms company with modern plant, foreign partners and a talent for contracts.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_refugee_nation: A million and more from Asia Minor live in shanty towns and new villages: young, poor and politically awake.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_second_republic: The republic stirs the Venizelist heart, and the royalists sulk.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_social_insurance: Workers with insurance and fixed hours listen less to the underground party.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_sovereign_default: Since the drachma left gold and the debt went unpaid, foreign credit is dear and building is slow.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_state_arsenals: Slower to build, but the designs and the profits stay with the state.
spirit_desc.grc_sp_third_civilisation: The regime's myth gives its officials a mission and its speeches a theme.
spirit_desc.hun_air_arm: An air force with its own command trains its pilots better.
spirit_desc.hun_armed_neutrality_spirit: A fortified, watchful neutral is a poor target for a pretext.
spirit_desc.hun_army_limits: A small professional army, no conscripts, no tanks and no war planes, at least on paper.
spirit_desc.hun_bauxite_trade: Ore sold to Germany pays for goods at home.
spirit_desc.hun_carpathian_watch: The mountain passes are watched and fortified.
spirit_desc.hun_councils_state: The councils plan and build, and the new order is guarded closely.
spirit_desc.hun_crusade_spirit: The press calls it a crusade; the army at least believes it is fighting for something.
spirit_desc.hun_csepel_craftsmen: Experienced hands make new production lines efficient sooner.
spirit_desc.hun_danube_trade: Lower tariffs along the river make trade cheaper.
spirit_desc.hun_gyor_rearmament: The rearmament levy pays for new arms factories.
spirit_desc.hun_hold_spirit: Defenders dig in faster and hold harder.
spirit_desc.hun_holy_crown: The Crown of Saint Stephen binds the nation to its oldest law.
spirit_desc.hun_hungarist_state: The movement's state calls every man to arms, and not everyone answers gladly.
spirit_desc.hun_hussar_spirit: Units recover quickly and press on boldly.
spirit_desc.hun_landed_estates: Counts and the Church own much of the land; three million farmhands own little or none.
spirit_desc.hun_levente_drill: Boys already drilled make quicker recruits.
spirit_desc.hun_national_rebirth: A government elected freely and land given to the farmhands: the country breathes.
spirit_desc.hun_polytechnic: Engineers trained at home serve the research institutes.
spirit_desc.hun_rapid_corps_spirit: Motor troops trained for the open plain move faster.
spirit_desc.hun_regency: The regent's wide powers and the officers' loyalty to him make a coup hard.
spirit_desc.hun_regent_powers: Wider powers for the regent steady the state against plots.
spirit_desc.hun_resistance_spirit: The occupied country resists its occupiers.
spirit_desc.hun_revision_advancing: Province after province returns. The country believes the old map can be drawn again.
spirit_desc.hun_revision_begun: The first lost land has come home. The crowds want more.
spirit_desc.hun_revision_fulfilled: The lands the nation mourned for a generation are within its borders again.
spirit_desc.hun_seesaw: Talking to both sides keeps the country calmer and its war half-hearted.
spirit_desc.hun_staff_college: Trained staff officers plan faster and units learn more from battle.
spirit_desc.hun_trianon_wound: Two thirds of the land and a third of the Magyars live under foreign flags. The grief unsettles the country and hardens it.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_archers: Archers drill in every county and stand on the walls.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_caught_unready: The garrisons were not called up and the walls were not repaired.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_cavalry_stand: The horsemen ride out to meet the enemy on open ground.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_cheongya: The people and the grain are inside the fortress walls.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_grain: The army is fed before the villages.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_grain_stores: Grain is stored in the walled towns and hill forts.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_half_ready: Some walls were repaired and some garrisons called up, but not enough.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_jeseung: When the enemy comes, the counties' men gather at set places for a commander from the capital.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_jingwan: Each district commander holds his own ground with his own men.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_jochong: Joseon's smiths make arquebuses copied from captured ones.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_last_stand: The walls will be held to the last man.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_muster_north: Scattered men and new levies gather in the north and are set in order.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_river_line: Every crossing is watched and every boat drawn to our bank.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_samsu: Gunners, archers and spearmen drill together as a standing army.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_scorched: The harvest is hidden in the hills; the plains are left bare.
spirit_desc.imjin_jos_storm: Joseon's men go up the walls beside Ming's.
spirit_desc.imjin_jp_full_wave: Every corps crossed together, fully supplied.
spirit_desc.imjin_jp_regency_spirit: Five great lords rule for the Taikō's heir, and none trusts the others.
spirit_desc.imjin_jp_thin_wave: The army crossed before the muster was complete.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_beachhead: The whole army came ashore before it marched.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_chase_king: The corps press north before the enemy can gather again.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_fall_back: The army draws in its lines around the capital.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_forced_march: The corps march up the roads without waiting for their baggage.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_hold_all: Thin garrisons hold every town taken.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_hold_north: The army stands in the north against Ming.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_hold_pyongyang: The army has dug in at Pyongyang.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_jinju: The Taikō's order drives the army at Jinju.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_one_plan: The corps march to one plan and keep in touch.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_provinces: Each corps governs a province of Joseon.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_pull_south: The army waits in the forts by the sea, close to its rice.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_push_yalu: The army pushes north beyond its supply.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_race: The commanders race each other for glory.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_relay_castles: Castles on Iki and Tsushima shelter the convoys.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_reprisals: Villages that sheltered the righteous armies were burned.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_rice_stores: Storehouses at Nagoya, Iki and Tsushima feed the army.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_road_garrisons: Garrisons hold the roads and the forts between them.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_road_maps: The commanders know the roads to Hanseong.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_sea_hold: The fleet guards the convoys and avoids battle.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_sea_seek: The fleet is massed to hunt down Joseon's ships.
spirit_desc.imjin_jpw_winter_gear: The army has clothes for the cold.
spirit_desc.ita_abyssinia: The war in East Africa, begun in October 1935, rallies the nation but swallows its goods.
spirit_desc.ita_armed_neutrality_spirit: Italy stays out of the war but keeps its army on the frontiers.
spirit_desc.ita_autarky_spirit: Home mines and substitutes are preferred to imports, whatever they cost.
spirit_desc.ita_axis_bond: Rome and Berlin share plans, scientists and an open hostility to the League.
spirit_desc.ita_capital_ships: The shipyards build the new battleships ahead of every other order.
spirit_desc.ita_cobelligerent_prep: While the government changes sides, the army is scattered and confused.
spirit_desc.ita_crown_shadow: The King's circle watches the government closely: decisions are slower, but a coup is harder.
spirit_desc.ita_desert_war: Units in North Africa have learned to strike across open ground and to supply themselves.
spirit_desc.ita_hydro_power: Alpine dams keep the northern factories running without imported coal.
spirit_desc.ita_non_belligerent: Neither neutral nor at war, Italy trades with both sides while it rearms.
spirit_desc.ita_pact: The alliance with Germany ties Italy to its partner's wars.
spirit_desc.ita_sanctions: Since November 1935 the League of Nations has restricted trade with Italy.
spirit_desc.ita_submarine_priority: The best crews and torpedoes go to the submarine flotillas.
spirit_desc.ita_torpedo_tactics: Bomber crews practise low-level torpedo runs against ships at sea.
spirit_desc.ita_war_booty_spirit: Repair teams put captured enemy equipment back into service.
spirit_desc.ita_war_mobilisation: Factories run extra shifts for the war, and the shops have less to sell.
spirit_desc.jpn_big_ship_priority: The navy trusts battleship gunfire to decide sea battles.
spirit_desc.jpn_bureaucratic_control: Staff officers and officials steer the state through planning.
spirit_desc.jpn_captured_arms_spirit: Repair units put captured enemy weapons back into service.
spirit_desc.jpn_carrier_focus: Carriers operate together to land one heavy blow.
spirit_desc.jpn_co_prosperity: A bloc of dependent partners supplies labour and goods.
spirit_desc.jpn_cooperative_diplomacy_spirit: Respect for the treaty order with the powers stirs less international tension.
spirit_desc.jpn_fuel_discipline: Rationing and strict use rules cut consumption at some cost to routine.
spirit_desc.jpn_garrison_system: Garrison units hold railways and towns in occupied areas, easing the field army's load.
spirit_desc.jpn_imperial_hq: Liaison conferences link army, navy and cabinet.
spirit_desc.jpn_jungle_warfare: The troops have learned to hold out on little supply.
spirit_desc.jpn_landing_skill: Landing troops and transports finish their preparations quickly.
spirit_desc.jpn_levied_combines: The great houses work for the state at the state's price. Output is higher and the owners are less comfortable.
spirit_desc.jpn_military_voice: The army and navy hold their ministries and weigh heavily on national policy.
spirit_desc.jpn_night_fighting: The infantry is practised at closing in by night and holding what it takes.
spirit_desc.jpn_northern_readiness: Equipment and training for the Manchurian border get tired units back in shape sooner.
spirit_desc.jpn_one_party_rule: One mass organisation speaks for the whole nation.
spirit_desc.jpn_party_politics: The majority party leads the cabinet while the services stand back.
spirit_desc.jpn_service_rivalry: The army and the navy fight over budgets and over the course of national policy.
spirit_desc.jpn_showa_restoration: The Emperor rules directly and the young officers speak in his name. Decisions come fast, and the mood of the country is fixed on the regime.
spirit_desc.jpn_special_attack: Crash attacks trade crews for ships and wear down morale and trained pilots.
spirit_desc.jpn_spirit_doctrine: Fighting spirit stands in for firepower and training.
spirit_desc.jpn_state_economy: The cabinet allots labour and materials, and civilian goods shrink.
spirit_desc.jpn_submarine_squadrons: Large submarines shadow and attack the enemy fleet.
spirit_desc.jpn_surprise_prep: The carrier force rehearses striking first across the open ocean.
spirit_desc.jpn_total_resistance: The whole population is called up to defend the homeland, at a heavy cost to order.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_administration: Ministries and control boards move under a single command.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_mobilisation: Materials and factories go to war production first under government plans.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_resolve: The decision is made: if diplomacy fails, it will be war.
spirit_desc.jpn_washington_credit: American money and an understanding with Washington make trade cheaper and tension lower.
spirit_desc.lat_export_trade: Strong export earnings make imports cheaper.
spirit_desc.lat_independent_course: The government plays the great powers against one another.
spirit_desc.lat_rubber_trade: Rubber buyers pay well and bring other trade with them.
spirit_desc.mck_bandit_war: Volunteer remnants, partisans and real bandits hold the hills. The state calls them all bandits and never stops fighting them.
spirit_desc.mck_bandits_contained: Collective hamlets and punitive columns have emptied the partisans' valleys. The peace is real, and so is its price.
spirit_desc.mck_banner_revival: The old banner names are carried by new regiments.
spirit_desc.mck_border_watch: Outposts face the Soviets along every river, ready for the next incident.
spirit_desc.mck_concordia_state: One association speaks for the nation, and it speaks the language the Kwantung Army taught it.
spirit_desc.mck_concordia_total: Every household belongs to a neighbourhood group and every group to the Association.
spirit_desc.mck_five_races: The state promises harmony among Manchu, Han, Mongol, Korean and Japanese. Everyone can see which of the five sits at the head of the table.
spirit_desc.mck_five_races_preached: The slogan is on every wall and in every schoolbook. Repetition has done what belief could not.
spirit_desc.mck_five_year_plan: Steel, coal, power and machines, on a schedule written in Tokyo.
spirit_desc.mck_grain_deliveries: Every harvest is weighed and most of it carried away.
spirit_desc.mck_home_guard: The army stays at home and guards the border it knows.
spirit_desc.mck_junta_order: The barracks govern, and the army comes first in everything.
spirit_desc.mck_khalkha_lesson: Anti-tank guns and dug-in positions, learned the hard way.
spirit_desc.mck_kwantung_grip_guidance: The Kwantung Army no longer gives orders outright; it gives advice that cannot be refused.
spirit_desc.mck_kwantung_grip_iron: Japanese vice-ministers run every ministry and the Kwantung Army's staff guides them. Nothing is decided in Hsinking that was not decided first at army headquarters.
spirit_desc.mck_kwantung_grip_loosened: Manchukuo's own officials decide more each month, and the Kwantung Army resents every one of those decisions.
spirit_desc.mck_mountain_war: The partisans know every trail, and the villages feed them.
spirit_desc.mck_national_service: Every young man owes the state his years in uniform.
spirit_desc.mck_northeast_restored: The provinces have rejoined China, and their men are eager to fight for it.
spirit_desc.mck_plan_quotas: Quotas for everything the war needs, and fewer goods for anyone else.
spirit_desc.mck_qing_empire: From the Forbidden City the Dragon Throne rules the north again.
spirit_desc.mck_qing_mandate: The Great Qing reigns again from the Northeast it came from.
spirit_desc.mck_railway_domain: The South Manchuria Railway runs lines, mines, hotels and a research department of its own. It is the most capable institution in the land, and it is Japanese.
spirit_desc.mck_rear_base: Manchukuo's mines and mills work for the empire's war.
spirit_desc.mck_river_fleet: Gunboats on the Sungari and the Amur cover the river crossings.
spirit_desc.mck_settlers: Japanese settler villages stand on land bought cheaply or taken outright. Their neighbours remember which.
spirit_desc.mck_state_of_its_own: The advisers are gone from the ministries. For better or worse the state now answers for itself.
spirit_desc.mex_oil_boycott: The former owners and their governments discourage buyers of Mexican oil.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_braceros: Hundreds of thousands work American fields and send their wages home.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_caudillo_rule: The zone commanders govern the country between them.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_church_and_state: The anticlerical laws stand, and the Cristero war is a recent memory.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_corporate_party: Workers, peasants, soldiers and the middle classes all speak through one ruling party.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_cristero_embers: Armed bands in the west attack teachers and agrarian officials.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_deep_revolution: Banks, mines and power come next. The radicals hold the ministries.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_ejidos: Millions of hectares have gone to the villages. The countryside is calmer, if not richer.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_foreign_oil: British and American companies pump Mexican oil and ship it abroad; the state sees little of it.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_free_suffrage: Votes are counted where they are cast, and the party no longer wins by decree.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_import_substitution: Tariffs and state credit build Mexican industry behind a wall.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_isthmus_league: Mexico speaks for the republics of Central America.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_land_hunger: The Revolution promised land; most villages are still waiting for it.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_lost_north_fever: Newspapers, songs and speeches talk of nothing but the lands lost to the gringos.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_mixed_oil: The state and the companies share the wells and quarrel over the accounts.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_monterrey_capital: Private industrialists build fast, and the unions complain.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_national_unity: Left and right, Church and state, set their quarrels aside for the common good.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_oil_boycotted: The oil is Mexican, but the markets, tankers and spare parts belong to the companies.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_pemex: A national oil industry, run by Mexicans for Mexico.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_pemex_strained: The national company works, barely: old pumps, borrowed tankers, too few engineers.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_refuge: Exiled scientists, teachers and publishers enrich Mexico's universities and presses.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_revolutionary_generals: The divisional generals who won the Revolution hold the military zones like fiefs.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_sinarquista_order: Faith, family and obedience, enforced by marching columns of peasants.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_socialist_school: Rural teachers bring literacy and a secular, socialist creed to the villages.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_war_boom: Factories run three shifts to meet American orders.
spirit_desc.mex_sp_workers_state: The unions and the ejidos govern openly.
spirit_desc.mex_squadron_201: Mexican pilots fly combat missions beside American units.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_army: Foot infantry breaks through harder and keeps more organisation, and battles open with a small edge from radios and mission orders. In return, infantry take longer to train and the army's guns keep pace more slowly.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_panzer: Tank and motorised divisions are trained to break through and keep their organisation, and tank battalions hit harder at the gap.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_sea_air: Submarines hunt in packs of six or more and aircraft work for the army, but codes are easier to read, aircraft have short legs, and there is no heavy bomber or naval air arm.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_strain: Armoured vehicles cost more and break down more often, and scarce raw materials have to be stretched.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_unit: Motorized battalions become Panzergrenadiers: they break through better and hold more organisation, but use more supply and train longer.
spirit_desc.nat_deu_workshop: Efficiency can climb higher, but lines climb slowly and lose more when they change what they make.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_army: A prepared plan reaches a higher readiness and the army has many good guns and anti-tank pieces. Planning is slow, the army reacts badly to surprise, the reserve of men is thin, and tanks hit weaker.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_citadel: Forts are worth more and troops dig in faster and deeper.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_sea_air: Large destroyers make strong screens, but anti-submarine work is weak and the air force flies far fewer sorties.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_slow_heavy: Tanks are well armoured, but the army advances slowly and its infantry attacks are weaker.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_stripped_arsenal: Once the homeland falls and the government is in exile, its factories make only what a licence allows.
spirit_desc.nat_fra_unit: Assault infantry battalions become the Foreign Legion: much more organisation, but they use more supply and train longer.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_army: Guns hit harder and regiments hold more organisation. Infantry attacks are weaker, the few men are replaced slowly, the army advances carefully, and its tanks break down more.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_commonwealth: Colonies supply raw materials and cheaper trade, but the home army is small and its tanks are weak.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_lifeline: Convoys lose fewer ships and sail with stronger escorts.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_radar_net: Aircraft are spotted earlier, defending fighters are sharper and anti-aircraft guns hit more often.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_sea_air: Better depth charges and code-breaking, and bombers that fly at night, but small carrier air groups and a poor daylight bombing score.
spirit_desc.nat_gbr_unit: Marine battalions become Commandos: faster breakthrough and more organisation, but less tough and longer to train. Commando raids succeed 10 points more often and are prepared in three quarters of the time.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_army: Infantry is trained quickly. Its firepower is thin and the staff's grip on a battle is weaker.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_decima: Commando raids on ports and docks succeed more often, and a hit damages the largest ship in harbour.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_light_forces: Light tanks and planes are cheaper.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_sea_air: Torpedoes, naval strike aircraft and agile fighters are strong, but there is no radar, fighters are lightly gunned and fuel is short.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_thin_industry: Building is slower, factories turn out less, and tank and gun quality lag behind.
spirit_desc.nat_ita_unit: Assault infantry battalions become Alpini: faster breakthrough and more organisation, but less tough and heavier on supply. They pay 70 % of river and fort penalties instead of 85 %.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_army: Foot infantry breaks through harder, holds ground to the last and lives on little supply. Few wounded return to the ranks, anti-tank guns pierce less and guns hit weaker.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_assault: Infantry attacks harder and keeps its organisation longer.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_kido_butai: Carrier air wings strike harder, decks hold more planes and torpedoes hit harder.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_scarce: Few raw materials at home, costlier trade, weak tanks and slow-climbing production lines.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_sea_air: Pilots at the start are veterans and aircraft fly farther, but replacements are green, defence is thin, and convoy escort, anti-submarine work and detection at sea are weak.
spirit_desc.nat_jpn_unit: Marine battalions become Special Naval Landing Forces: stronger attack, but lightly equipped, less tough and using less supply.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_army: Rifle divisions train quickly and defend stubbornly, and the opening barrage is stronger. Rifles attack weaker, guns hit less once a battle moves, staff work is stiffer, and tanks have thick plate but break down more.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_mass: A vast pool of recruits and cheap, plentiful infantry, gun and tank production, at lower quality in armour and light aircraft. Lines climb faster and lose less when they change.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_purge_gap: Officer losses leave staff work slow and divisions poorly organised. This fades with time.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_purge_scars: Staff work is recovering: the weakness is smaller and will soon end.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_resilience: Divisions regain organisation faster and reinforcements arrive quicker after a lost battle.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_sea_air: Cheap ground-attack aircraft in great numbers, flown by pilots who start green.
spirit_desc.nat_sun_unit: Assault infantry battalions become Guards Rifles: stronger attack and more organisation, but they use more supply and train longer.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_army: Guns hit harder and eat more shells, tanks are fast and reliable but thinly armoured, replacements flow steadily and more wounded return. Replacements arrive as strangers: infantry hold less organisation and divisions learn slower.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_arsenal: New factories go up faster, dockyards produce more, ships and aircraft cost less, and long production runs climb to a higher efficiency quickly and keep it when a line changes.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_logistics: Armies use less supply and fuel, and fuel reserves are larger.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_mk14: Submarine torpedoes run too deep and often fail. The submarine campaign puts it right.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_sea_air: Carriers are repaired faster, and veteran pilots are rotated home to teach, so wings stay solid but never become elite.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_slow_mobilisation: Training takes longer and fewer men are ready to be called up.
spirit_desc.nat_usa_unit: Marine battalions become Marine Regiments: stronger attack, tougher, more supply. Landings lose 25 % of attack instead of 35 %.
spirit_desc.new_trade_terms: Fresh agreements lower the cost of buying abroad.
spirit_desc.nld_air_watch: Listening posts, guns and fighters work as one.
spirit_desc.nld_benelux_union: The Low Countries are one state.
spirit_desc.nld_capital_ship_plan: The yards prepare to build battlecruisers for the Indies, and the country pays for it.
spirit_desc.nld_cheap_guilder: Off gold, the guilder buys less abroad, but Dutch goods sell again and building picks up.
spirit_desc.nld_colonial_houses: The trading houses of Amsterdam bring the Indies' goods to market.
spirit_desc.nld_council_state: Workers' councils run the factories and the towns.
spirit_desc.nld_dietsland_state: The regime has united the Dutch-speaking lands and wants more.
spirit_desc.nld_forward_line: The army fights at the border alongside the Belgians.
spirit_desc.nld_gold_guilder: The guilder is still tied to gold. Money is sound, but exports are dear and building is slow.
spirit_desc.nld_hard_guilder: The guilder holds its gold. Savers trust the state; builders wait.
spirit_desc.nld_holland_redoubt: The army defends the heart of the country behind the water.
spirit_desc.nld_hollow_army: Twenty years of budget cuts: short service, old guns and few trained officers.
spirit_desc.nld_independence: No alliances and no guarantees. Others find it hard to justify a war on us, but the people see no need to arm.
spirit_desc.nld_indies_commonwealth: A promise of partnership calms the Indies.
spirit_desc.nld_inundation_drill: Sappers and polder boards know how to make the water rise fast, and the troops know how to hold behind it.
spirit_desc.nld_jungle_fighters: The KNIL knows how to fight and live in the forests of the archipelago.
spirit_desc.nld_labour_plan: Public investment puts the unemployed to work on roads, dikes and factories.
spirit_desc.nld_london_cabinet: The lawful government governs from exile, with the Indies, the fleet and the merchant ships behind it.
spirit_desc.nld_low_countries_market: One tariff for the three Low Countries.
spirit_desc.nld_mobilised: The whole army stands under arms at the borders.
spirit_desc.nld_national_cabinet: All the democratic parties govern together.
spirit_desc.nld_neutral_watch: Guards on every border and ships off every coast keep the neutrality strict.
spirit_desc.nld_nsb_state: The movement rules alone and arms the nation.
spirit_desc.nld_oil_for_allies: A year's contract sells the Indies oil to Britain and America.
spirit_desc.nld_oil_for_yen: A year's contract sells the Indies oil to Japan.
spirit_desc.nld_old_age_law: Every old worker receives a pension from the state.
spirit_desc.nld_oranje_broadcasts: The queen's broadcasts from London keep the country's spirit alive.
spirit_desc.nld_philips_works: Eindhoven's valves and radios help every electrical project.
spirit_desc.nld_pillarisation: Every faith and class lives in its own pillar. The country is steady, and every change has to be agreed by all of them.
spirit_desc.nld_sluices_ready: The water lines can be flooded at short notice.
spirit_desc.nld_union_order: The Netherlands Union governs above the parties.
spirit_desc.nld_water_engineers: The state's engineers build roads, works and defences faster than anyone.
spirit_desc.nld_water_line_flooded: The polders before the lines are under water. Any attacker must wade, but the land yields nothing.
spirit_desc.nor_above_parties: Ministers answer to the King and the council, and party quarrels are kept out of the cabinet.
spirit_desc.nor_broad_coalition: The opposition sits in government; the country speaks with one voice.
spirit_desc.nor_charter_east: A year's charter of Norwegian ships to German trade, paid partly in coal and machinery.
spirit_desc.nor_charter_west: A year's charter of Norwegian ships to British trade. London is grateful; Berlin is not.
spirit_desc.nor_coastal_squadron: The old armoured ships and their scouts watch the harbour mouths.
spirit_desc.nor_council_republic: Workers' and fishermen's councils run the factories and the harbours.
spirit_desc.nor_crisis_pact: Labour governs with the Farmers' Party's votes: work programmes for the towns, support prices for the farms.
spirit_desc.nor_defence_cuts: The defence order of the early thirties left an army that drills a few weeks a year and a fleet of old ships.
spirit_desc.nor_government_abroad: From London the King and the cabinet speak for Norway, and the world still listens.
spirit_desc.nor_great_merchant_fleet: Norwegian ships sail every ocean, and their freight earnings pay for much of what the country imports.
spirit_desc.nor_heavy_water_trade: Vemork's output is sold abroad by the litre, and the buyers are grateful.
spirit_desc.nor_home_front: The occupied homeland answers the government in exile.
spirit_desc.nor_home_front_spirit: Under occupation, the courts, churches and schools refuse to serve the occupier.
spirit_desc.nor_home_guard_spirit: Every district keeps a guard ready to defend its own ground.
spirit_desc.nor_hydro_power: New power stations feed the towns and the works.
spirit_desc.nor_insured_fleet: With the state carrying the war risk, owners keep their ships at sea.
spirit_desc.nor_labour_peace: Unions and employers settle their quarrels by agreement rather than strikes.
spirit_desc.nor_linge_commandos: Commandos from Britain strike at the occupier's railways, plants and ships.
spirit_desc.nor_little_norway_camp: Pilots trained in Canada join the squadrons abroad.
spirit_desc.nor_milorg_spirit: Hidden weapons and trained men wait in the forests.
spirit_desc.nor_neutrality_spirit: Any aggressor needs longer to find a pretext against us.
spirit_desc.nor_nortraship_spirit: The fleet abroad works for the government in exile and for the side still fighting; its earnings pay for the war.
spirit_desc.nor_ns_state: Nasjonal Samling holds every office and the Hird keeps the streets.
spirit_desc.nor_ore_harbour: Narvik's quays earn from every ore ship that loads there.
spirit_desc.nor_oslo_trade: The small neutral traders keep their markets open to one another.
spirit_desc.nor_provisioning: Grain and fuel in store keep the people calm when the sea lanes close.
spirit_desc.nor_ski_soldiers: Soldiers who grew up on skis fight well in forest and snow.
spirit_desc.nor_ski_warfare: Ski troops strike quickly and rest quickly.
spirit_desc.nor_strict_neutral: Norway favours no one, and every belligerent must justify a quarrel with it.
spirit_desc.nor_the_kings_no: The King refused to bow to the invader, and the country stands behind him.
spirit_desc.nor_valley_war: Blown bridges and held passes slow every column that comes up the valleys.
spirit_desc.nor_watch: Ships and battalions stand guard on the coast and the frontiers so that no belligerent can pass unseen.
spirit_desc.nor_watch_called_up: The reservists are in uniform and the coast guns are manned. It costs the economy dearly.
spirit_desc.nor_whale_oil: A good Antarctic season brings oil to sell and fat for the margarine factories.
spirit_desc.nor_white_coal_power: Waterfalls turned into power give Norway cheap current for its towns and its electro-industry.
spirit_desc.nor_winter_warfare: Men raised on cold and snow recover fast.
spirit_desc.nzl_coastwatch: Island radio posts give early warning of enemy ships.
spirit_desc.p4_bomber_command: A separate command plans and flies the bombing of enemy industry.
spirit_desc.p4_convoy_system: Merchant ships sail in escorted convoys from the first day of war.
spirit_desc.p4_dispersal: Factories spread out and hidden shrug off part of every bombing raid.
spirit_desc.p4_dive_bombing: Dive bombers trained to work with the army hit the enemy front harder.
spirit_desc.p4_fighter_command: A single command directs every fighter squadron at home.
spirit_desc.p4_fleet_air_arm: The navy controls its own aircraft and trains them to strike ships.
spirit_desc.p4_high_seas_fleet: A balanced battle fleet trains to fight the enemy line head on.
spirit_desc.p4_shturmovik: Armoured ground-attack aircraft fly low over the front in support of the infantry.
spirit_desc.p4_submarine_fleet: A large submarine force guards the coasts and hunts enemy shipping.
spirit_desc.p4_uboat_priority: The U-boat arm gets the best crews and first call on the yards.
spirit_desc.pol_balanced_course: Warsaw keeps the same distance from Berlin and from Moscow.
spirit_desc.pol_between: Wedged between Germany and the Soviet Union, Poland keeps its army ready on both borders.
spirit_desc.pol_cavalry_drill: Mounted units move fast and fight on foot with modern weapons.
spirit_desc.pol_gdynia_trade: Polish goods reach the world through a Polish port.
spirit_desc.pol_home_army_support: Secret networks at home keep resistance alive in the occupied regions.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_after_marshal: The camp has lost its centre and its heirs pull different ways.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_bop_colonels_alone: The camp rules unopposed, and the country grows restless.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_bop_colonels_lead: The camp decides and the opposition protests.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_bop_opposition_gains: The government must bargain with the Sejm.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_bop_opposition_rules: The parties set the course and the colonels follow it reluctantly.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_bop_uneasy_balance: Neither the camp nor the opposition can govern alone.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_border_corps: Picked troops know every path of the eastern frontier.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_borderland_tension: A third of the citizens are Ukrainians, Belarusians, Jews and Germans, and many do not trust the state.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_castle_technocrats: Engineers and economists run the ministries.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_cavalry_brigades: The cavalry moves fast and fights on foot.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_cop_drive: Builders and engineers pour into the triangle of the Vistula and the San.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_defence_fund: Citizens' gifts pay for guns and lift the mood.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_equal_distance: Poland keeps both neighbours at the same distance.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_gold_abroad: The national treasury is safe in an allied vault.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_land_hunger: Too many people live on too little land: many hands for the army, little money to spend.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_last_stand: With the border at their backs, the soldiers dig in.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_long_plan: Building follows a plan that looks fifteen years ahead.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_maritime_league: A nation of farmers learns to love its short coast.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_ozn: One organisation gathers the loyal and watches the rest.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_plan_east: The army is ready for a long war in the eastern marshes.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_plan_west: The army is ready to fight Germany at the border.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_promethean_network: Exiles from the Soviet Union report to Polish intelligence.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_pursuit_brigade: The capital's fighters train together for one task.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_third_europe: Warsaw's diplomats court the states between the giants.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_underground_state: Under occupation, a hidden state keeps its courts, schools and army.
spirit_desc.pol_sp_village_boycott: After the strike was broken, the villages give the towns as little as they can.
spirit_desc.prt_allied_contracts: Wolfram for British oil, wheat and sterling.
spirit_desc.prt_allied_purchases: The British buy up the ore before Germany can.
spirit_desc.prt_armed_islands: No foreign base on the islands; Portuguese guns guard them.
spirit_desc.prt_atlantic_bases: Allied aircraft fly from the islands over the convoy lanes.
spirit_desc.prt_corporative_order: Guilds and national syndicates settle wages and quarrels from above.
spirit_desc.prt_estado_novo: The New State of the 1933 constitution: one list, censorship and order.
spirit_desc.prt_fomento: Planned investment in power, chemicals and metal.
spirit_desc.prt_german_contracts: Wolfram for German coal, steel and gold.
spirit_desc.prt_iberian_cause: One peninsula, one state, under Lisbon's lead.
spirit_desc.prt_legion_mobilised: Legionaries guard the bridges, ports and railways.
spirit_desc.prt_licensing_regime: No new factory without the state's licence.
spirit_desc.prt_neutral_lean: Neutral, but leaning toward the old ally.
spirit_desc.prt_oldest_alliance: The alliance with England, in force since the fourteenth century.
spirit_desc.prt_one_empire: The empire is woven into the state as provinces of one nation.
spirit_desc.prt_patrol_service: The small navy escorts and patrols the Atlantic triangle.
spirit_desc.prt_peninsular_bloc: Lisbon and Madrid keep their neutrality together.
spirit_desc.prt_pluricontinental: One people from Minho to Timor, so the regime says.
spirit_desc.prt_rationing: Ration cards and price controls while the sea lanes are cut.
spirit_desc.prt_refugee_port: Lisbon is the last open door of Europe, full of refugees and spies.
spirit_desc.prt_restored_crown: A king again above the parties and the generals.
spirit_desc.prt_restored_republic: Free elections, free press and friends in London.
spirit_desc.prt_rural_country: Smallholders and fishermen, half of them unable to read.
spirit_desc.prt_salazar_finances: A sound escudo, but every escudo counted twice.
spirit_desc.prt_spanish_volunteers: Portuguese volunteers fight in Spain and come back with experience.
spirit_desc.prt_steadfast_neutrality: The war has been kept away from Portugal's shores.
spirit_desc.prt_syndicalist_order: One movement, one leader, a nation in arms.
spirit_desc.prt_wolfram_rush: Everyone digs, everyone sells, and the price keeps rising.
spirit_desc.prt_workers_republic: The estates divided, the banks nationalised.
spirit_desc.rou_bop_crown_holds: The palace keeps the upper hand over the Legion.
spirit_desc.rou_bop_legion_streets: Green shirts march every Sunday and the police look away.
spirit_desc.rou_bop_legion_terror: Assassinations and street fighting; many fear the Legion more than the law.
spirit_desc.rou_bop_royal_dictatorship: The king holds every lever; the Legion is driven underground and the country grows quiet and wary.
spirit_desc.rou_bop_uneasy_balance: Crown and Legion watch each other; government business waits.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_armament_plan: The factories work to a plan that the army wrote.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_armed_neutrality: The army stands ready on every border and the country sides with no one.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_black_gold: Ploiești's oil pays for imports and keeps every power interested in Romania.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_camarilla: The king's circle trades favours for contracts; governments come and go at the palace's whim, but no one dares a coup.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_entente_staff: The allies' staffs plan together; orders move faster.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_fighter_aces: The best pilots lead the fighter groups and teach the young.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_foreign_capital: Foreign investors build quickly, but take their profits home.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_german_instructors: Foreign instructors train the divisions in the newest methods.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_german_trade: German machines and arms arrive in exchange for oil and grain.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_holy_war: The war in the east is a crusade in the newspapers and the pulpits.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_legionary_zeal: The movement's fervour fills the ministries and the streets, and frightens everyone else.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_many_peoples: Hungarians, Germans, Jews, Ukrainians and Bulgarians make up a third of Greater Romania; the new provinces are not yet one country.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_military_rule: The general governs with soldiers' discipline; strikes and parties are both forbidden.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_national_rebirth: One party, one salute, one king; officials join because they must.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_peasant_country: Four in five Romanians live off the land: many recruits, few factories.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_peasant_state: Honest prefects and village credit win the countryside's trust.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_peoples_republic: Nationalised oil and banks pay for the new state's plans.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_ploiesti_defences: The refineries are among the most heavily defended targets in Europe.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_resistance: Bands in the forests keep the country's will to fight alive.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_royal_dictatorship: The king rules through his own constitution, his own party and his own ministers.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_state_industry: State orders and loans build arms works before anything else.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_straja: The crown's youth movement drills boys and girls in uniform every week.
spirit_desc.rou_sp_vanatori: Elite mountain troops hold ground and learn fast.
spirit_desc.spa_airlift_ready: Transport crews have learned to move troops quickly by air.
spirit_desc.spa_army_rebuilt: Experienced officers and NCOs train the new conscripts.
spirit_desc.spa_capital_holds: Madrid has become a fortress, and its defenders give no ground.
spirit_desc.spa_ebro_offensive: Every reserve has been gathered for one great crossing.
spirit_desc.spa_non_belligerent: Spain leans towards one side but stays out of the fighting.
spirit_desc.spa_northern_offensive: Troops and guns have been massed for the campaign along the northern coast.
spirit_desc.spa_unified_staff: Every front plans its operations through a single headquarters.
spirit_desc.spa_wolfram_trade: Foreign buyers outbid one another for Spanish tungsten.
spirit_desc.sun_amnesty: Released specialists return to work: faster research, slightly higher output.
spirit_desc.sun_armoured_spearhead: A mechanised arm raised early: stronger tank attacks and faster armour research.
spirit_desc.sun_army_air_arm: Air power works for the ground battle: stronger air attack and close support, weaker strategic bombing.
spirit_desc.sun_army_industry: Arms plants under army managers build faster, and civilians pay for it.
spirit_desc.sun_army_regime: The generals hold the state, but power now moves more slowly.
spirit_desc.sun_bread_lines: More of the economy must serve consumers until the shortage passes.
spirit_desc.sun_camp_unrest: Mines and building sites worked by the camps slow down.
spirit_desc.sun_collective_rule: Posts are shared out by agreement, which makes it easier to bring in capable people.
spirit_desc.sun_command_unity: Commanders alone give orders, and the front reacts faster.
spirit_desc.sun_commander_corps: Returning and recently promoted commanders are gaining experience fast.
spirit_desc.sun_consumer_line: More of the plan goes to shoes, cloth and food than to blast furnaces.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_bureaus: Research recovers, aircraft and armour research goes faster, and special projects advance quicker.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_camps: Output recovers; construction and extraction run faster, and fewer factories serve consumers.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_commissars: The army's organisation and attack recover, and its units defend harder and take replacements faster.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_dictator: The army fights better, and the center gathers power and carries out its focuses faster.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_informers: Plots die before they form and occupied lands resist less.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_nkvd: Intelligence improves, political power comes faster and occupied lands comply sooner.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_personnel: Generals gain experience faster, plans are drawn quicker, and the air force and navy recover their edge.
spirit_desc.sun_ctl_trials: Fear of the courts keeps the streets calm and the war effort loyal.
spirit_desc.sun_deep_operations: The army trains to break the front and strike the enemy's rear in one continuous operation.
spirit_desc.sun_deep_ops_doctrine: The old school's offensive doctrine is back: faster plans and sharper breakthroughs.
spirit_desc.sun_defections: Officers who fled abroad took secrets with them, and intelligence suffers.
spirit_desc.sun_defend_motherland: The whole nation has risen against the invader, and surrender is unthinkable.
spirit_desc.sun_denunciations: Managers spend their days writing reports on each other, and output drops.
spirit_desc.sun_design_bureau_system: Competing design bureaus turn out new weapons and machines one after another.
spirit_desc.sun_eased_quotas: For a while the villages breathe: more men, and a bigger share of goods for the people.
spirit_desc.sun_factory_relocation: Construction crews rebuild evacuated plants on open ground in the east.
spirit_desc.sun_false_figures: Staffs plan on numbers nobody believes, and planning slows down.
spirit_desc.sun_five_year_plans: The second plan pours resources into heavy industry and freshly built plants.
spirit_desc.sun_flooded_mines: A neglected pit has flooded, and extraction is slower until it is pumped dry.
spirit_desc.sun_garrison_regime: Reserves trained and ready; civilian goods pay the cost.
spirit_desc.sun_general_staff_rule: The staff plans further ahead and wastes less, at the cost of smoother government.
spirit_desc.sun_grain_deal: Lighter quotas: more men for the army, more bread on the table.
spirit_desc.sun_junta_rule: The army rules without rivals: sturdier units, a larger manpower pool and a firm grip on the state.
spirit_desc.sun_labour_heroes: Shock workers and record-breakers set the pace in every factory.
spirit_desc.sun_market_plan: A mixed economy: higher output, cheaper trade, fewer consumer goods needed.
spirit_desc.sun_marshals_rule: A ruling council makes coups harder and decisions cheaper.
spirit_desc.sun_party_liaison: A standing channel to the party's old men: stability slowly recovers and advisors cost less.
spirit_desc.sun_party_state: The party's machinery works for the government again: more political power, steadier rule.
spirit_desc.sun_power_grid: Hydroelectric power from the Dnieper keeps the southern factories running.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_1: Arrests tighten the center's grip on the party and speed up training and building, while the army's organisation and the state's intelligence begin to suffer.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_2: With the high command arrested, armies and corps pass to inexperienced men. The state commands more and the army fights worse.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_3: Arrests reach down to regiments and battalions, and officers avoid taking any initiative. The center holds nearly everything, and the army pays for it.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_aftermath: The purge is over. Posts are held by officers promoted far beyond their experience, and the intelligence service has lost trained people.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_aftermath_2: Two years of arrests left whole ranks of commanders to be replaced by men without experience.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_aftermath_3: Years of arrests hollowed out the army, the staffs and the intelligence service.
spirit_desc.sun_republic_charters: Written rights for the republics: less garrisoning, faster compliance, a few more men from non-core lands.
spirit_desc.sun_restored_officers: Officers keep their posts and learn from experience: more general experience, firmer organisation.
spirit_desc.sun_rkka_reserves: A standing army with trained reserves can call up more men.
spirit_desc.sun_security_split: The security organs are fragmented: fewer informers, a little more room for engineers.
spirit_desc.sun_surprise_shock: The invasion caught the army unprepared: units are cut off and command is in disarray.
spirit_desc.sun_third_plan: Defense plants come first in every allocation of steel, labor and money.
spirit_desc.sun_total_mobilisation: Every age class able to bear arms has been called to the colors.
spirit_desc.sun_war_lessons: Training now follows what the fighting in Finland revealed.
spirit_desc.swe_armed_neutrality_spirit: A strong army and a resolute people keep the war beyond the border.
spirit_desc.swe_army_1942: Divisions rebuilt with the lessons of the war around them.
spirit_desc.swe_baltic_minefields: The approaches are mined; only those with a pilot pass.
spirit_desc.swe_coal_from_germany: This year's ore contract keeps German coal and coke coming.
spirit_desc.swe_cow_trade: Social Democrats and farmers traded crisis policy for grain prices. The bargain holds the government together.
spirit_desc.swe_crown_rule: The king and his officials govern above the parties.
spirit_desc.swe_defence_1925: Regiments disbanded and service shortened in the belief that the great war was the last. The army is a school, not a force.
spirit_desc.swe_gas_generators: Vehicles run on charcoal gas and save the little fuel there is.
spirit_desc.swe_german_market: Ore goes south and coal comes north; the factories hum.
spirit_desc.swe_grey_press: Newspapers print what the board advises and leave out what might anger a great power.
spirit_desc.swe_home_guard: Volunteers with rifles at home guard every bridge and village.
spirit_desc.swe_labour_peace: Unions and employers settle their disputes at the table, not in the streets.
spirit_desc.swe_national_coalition: Four parties govern together and quarrel behind closed doors.
spirit_desc.swe_national_state: One movement, one people, and a country that marches.
spirit_desc.swe_nordic_cause: The idea of one north stirs students, officers and editors.
spirit_desc.swe_norrland_winter: Troops trained to live in the forest at forty below.
spirit_desc.swe_northern_ore: Lapland's ore is Sweden's fortune and its danger: everyone needs it, and someone may come to take it.
spirit_desc.swe_ore_boom: New shafts and more trains carry record tonnages out of Lapland.
spirit_desc.swe_ore_exports: Iron-ore contracts smooth the rest of our trade.
spirit_desc.swe_quality_steel: Swedish charcoal steel goes into gun barrels and armour plate.
spirit_desc.swe_ration_cards: Everything by the card. Nobody is happy and nobody starves.
spirit_desc.swe_readiness_full: Every class is under arms. The country waits, and the farms and factories feel the loss of hands.
spirit_desc.swe_readiness_reinforced: Reservists are called up in turns and the border posts are manned day and night.
spirit_desc.swe_readiness_watch: The forces watch the borders and the coast in peacetime strength.
spirit_desc.swe_skf_bearings: The bearing works supply every factory at home before they sell abroad.
spirit_desc.swe_social_insurance: Pensions, unemployment insurance and holidays make the people trust the state, at a price.
spirit_desc.swe_staff_college: Staff officers trained at home plan faster and better.
spirit_desc.swe_swedish_model: Unions, employers and the state plan the economy together.
spirit_desc.swe_total_defence: Everyone knows their place if war comes.
spirit_desc.swe_united_north: The Nordic peoples share one state and one army.
spirit_desc.swe_western_market: Trade with Britain and America brings goods and new ideas.
spirit_desc.swe_western_trade: This year's contract with the West brings fuel and goods across the North Sea.
spirit_desc.swe_workers_state: The councils plan the mines and mills; the old order resists in the shadows.
spirit_desc.tur_active_neutrality_spirit: Ankara stays out of the war and makes both sides pay for its goodwill.
spirit_desc.tur_anatolian_redoubt_spirit: The plateau is one fortress, and its defenders dig in.
spirit_desc.tur_bayonet_charge: The infantry attacks with the bayonet as it did in the war of independence.
spirit_desc.tur_deep_defence: Lines behind lines, and mountains behind them.
spirit_desc.tur_eastern_unrest: The eastern provinces answer to tribal chiefs before the governor, and a large garrison is tied down there.
spirit_desc.tur_emigre_scholars: Professors driven out of Germany teach in Istanbul and Ankara.
spirit_desc.tur_general_staff_tradition: A careful staff that plans every move twice.
spirit_desc.tur_greater_turan: Anatolia and the Caucasus under one flag.
spirit_desc.tur_kemalist_revolution: The founder's reforms hold the young Republic together; the old ways have not vanished, but they keep quiet.
spirit_desc.tur_liberal_economy: Private enterprise, open trade and farm credit.
spirit_desc.tur_mehmetcik_spirit: The Anatolian soldier holds his ground on little food and less rest.
spirit_desc.tur_national_chief_regime: One man decides; cabinets carry out.
spirit_desc.tur_national_protection: Fixed prices, requisitions and labour service under emergency law.
spirit_desc.tur_ottoman_arsenal: Rifles, guns and aircraft of a dozen makes, most of them worn out, and almost no industry to replace them.
spirit_desc.tur_pact_restored: Lands promised in 1920 are Turkish again.
spirit_desc.tur_peoples_houses_spirit: Lectures, theatre and night classes in every town carry the reforms to the people.
spirit_desc.tur_peoples_republic: The mills and mines belong to those who work them, and the plan runs everything.
spirit_desc.tur_scars_of_war: Twelve years of war, from Libya to the Sakarya, cost a generation. Nobody wants another.
spirit_desc.tur_six_arrows_constitution: The party's six principles are now the constitution's: the regime has its creed in law.
spirit_desc.tur_state_arsenals: A modern state arms industry at Kırıkkale and Ankara.
spirit_desc.tur_straits_closed: No belligerent's warship passes the Bosporus or the Dardanelles.
spirit_desc.tur_straits_dues: Higher dues on every ship through the Straits fill the treasury and annoy the shipping nations.
spirit_desc.tur_straits_mines: Mines and shore guns make the narrows deadly for any fleet.
spirit_desc.tur_straits_watch: The Straits are held closely by land and by sea.
spirit_desc.tur_turanist_state: The state speaks for all Turks, inside the borders and beyond them.
spirit_desc.tur_village_schools: Teachers from the village institutes bring schooling to the countryside.
spirit_desc.usa_amphibious_doctrine: Landing craft, drills and tested plans let troops go ashore with less preparation.
spirit_desc.usa_arsenal: American industry turns out weapons for itself and for every nation fighting aggression.
spirit_desc.usa_daylight_bombing: Bomber crews train to hit factories and rail yards by day with their bombsights.
spirit_desc.usa_depression: Unemployment stays high, and recovery leans on federal spending.
spirit_desc.usa_depression_eased: Renewed federal spending has softened the downturn, though millions are still out of work.
spirit_desc.usa_europe_first_spirit: Plans and shipping are geared to a landing in Europe, and the staffs work faster.
spirit_desc.usa_fortress_america: Guarded by two oceans and ready to fight on its own ground, America is a hard target.
spirit_desc.usa_great_maneuvers: The lessons of the great exercises are fresh, and commanders learn quickly.
spirit_desc.usa_isolation: The 1935 Neutrality Act and public opinion keep the country out of foreign quarrels. It lifts on the first day Congress backs the government with 50% or more.
spirit_desc.usa_isolation_cracked: Most Americans still want no part in the war, but fewer believe the oceans will keep it away.
spirit_desc.usa_motorised_army: An army that rides in trucks moves faster and wastes less of its supplies.
spirit_desc.usa_neutral_trade_spirit: Exporters thrive on selling to everyone, and their profits ease the burden on the home market.
spirit_desc.usa_pacific_first_spirit: Carrier strikes and island landings get the newest ships and the best crews.
spirit_desc.usa_patrol_fleet: Ships and seaplanes on patrol learn to find and shadow every vessel in their waters.
spirit_desc.usa_preparedness_spirit: Arms are ordered ahead of need, so new arms plants go up faster.
spirit_desc.usa_recovering_economy: The worst is over, but the economy still leans on public spending and patience is wearing thin.
spirit_desc.usa_two_ocean_fleet: Shipyards on both coasts work around the clock to build the new fleet.
spirit_desc.usa_unrestricted_subs: Submarines attack enemy merchant shipping without warning.
spirit_desc.usa_war_production: Civilian goods are rationed so that the factories can run flat out on war orders.
spirit_desc.vic_state_regime: Parliament has been set aside, and all power rests with the head of state and his ministers.
spirit_desc.yug_chetnik_detachments: Army raiders trained for war in the hills and behind the lines.
spirit_desc.yug_clearing_trade: Germany buys what we grow, and we buy what Germany makes.
spirit_desc.yug_croat_discontent: Croatia boycotts parliament and refuses Belgrade's state.
spirit_desc.yug_federal_compromise: Each people has its unit, and the crown holds them together.
spirit_desc.yug_gendarmerie: Order by force: coups are hard, consent is harder.
spirit_desc.yug_guerrilla_war: Where the front is gone, bands fight on.
spirit_desc.yug_investment_drive: State and foreign money build factories.
spirit_desc.yug_jrz_machine: Patronage and prefects deliver the votes.
spirit_desc.yug_kpj_cells: The underground party recruits in mines and universities.
spirit_desc.yug_neutral_kingdom: The kingdom signs nothing and guards every pass.
spirit_desc.yug_opposition_bloc: Serbian and Croat opponents of the regime campaign together.
spirit_desc.yug_peasant_economy: Four in five live off the land: many recruits, little capital.
spirit_desc.yug_prudent_regency: No one is offended, nothing is risked.
spirit_desc.yug_redoubt_spirit: Bosnia's mountains are the last line.
spirit_desc.yug_regency_council: Three regents rule for the boy king: careful, slow and not quite legitimate.
spirit_desc.yug_salonika_veterans: The Serbian army's tradition from the Great War lives on in its officers.
spirit_desc.yug_sporazum_spirit: Croatia governs itself and serves the kingdom again.
spirit_desc.zaf_bop_empire_loyal: Smuts's men hold every lever of the state. English South Africa is behind them; much of the platteland is not.
spirit_desc.zaf_bop_fusion_holds: Neither wing can do without the other, and the cabinet holds together.
spirit_desc.zaf_bop_hertzog_leads: South Africa first: the nationalist wing sets the tone and keeps Europe at arm's length.
spirit_desc.zaf_bop_republican_tide: Every meeting ends with the republic. The Crown's supporters feel the ground moving.
spirit_desc.zaf_bop_smuts_leads: The Commonwealth wing sets the course, and the nationalists grumble.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_africa_oath: Every soldier at the front chose to be there.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_air_training: Training airfields across the Union turn out pilots, navigators and gunners.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_cape_route: Convoys round the Cape fill the docks of Cape Town and Durban.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_corps_armed: Coloured and African soldiers carry rifles beside the white regiments.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_fusion: One governing party for two old rivals: calm at home, caution abroad.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_iscor: The state steelworks supply rails, pipes and plate at home prices.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_liberal_union: More of the country's people have a stake in its government.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_new_order: State guilds direct labour and capital toward the leader's goals.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_ossewa_state: The commandos rule the districts and the volk is called to arms.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_rand_gold: The world's richest gold field pays the state's bills.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_southern_union: One market and one railway system from the Cape to the Zambezi.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_two_streams: Afrikaans and English South Africans remember the last war differently and will judge the next one differently.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_volksrepubliek: A nationalist republic, sovereign and wary of every foreign war.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_war_supplies: Every engineering shop in the Union works to one director's orders.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_white_service: By law only white men may carry arms in the Defence Force. Most of the population is left out of the army.
spirit_desc.zaf_sp_workers_republic: The mines belong to the miners and the party plans the rest.

style.DEU: Quality and speed: radio-led infantry and armoured thrusts, submarine packs and close air support. Gear is dear, production lines climb slowly, and oil, raw materials and heavy bombers are short.
style.FRA: The prepared line: strong forts, plenty of good guns and thick tanks, planned battles. It is slow to act, tanks have few radios, the air force flies far fewer sorties, and the arsenal fails with the homeland.
style.GBR: Sea lanes, guns and night bombers: safe convoys, radar, code-breaking and heavy artillery. The army is small and cautious, tanks are unreliable and carrier air groups are small.
style.ITA: The Mediterranean: a fast fleet, torpedo boats and planes, frogmen and mountain troops. Divisions are small and thinly armed, command and radar are poor, fuel is short and industry is thin.
style.JPN: Infantry spirit and the strike fleet: night assault, stubborn defence, torpedoes, carrier wings and veteran pilots who are not replaced. Convoy escort is neglected, guns and tanks are few, and raw materials are scarce.
style.SUN: Mass and recovery: huge numbers, a planned opening barrage, cheap gear and fast lines. Divisions are weak one on one, command is rigid, and pilots start green.
style.USA: Industry and reach: fast factories, strong guns, carriers that mend quickly and steady replacements. The army starts small, soldiers lose cohesion, tanks are thin and the submarine torpedoes fail until the campaign is put right.

why.neutral: A neutral collaborator cannot be asked to join wars

support_note.engineer: River penalty halved, fort penalty −25%, entrenchment cap +5. Digs in and builds positions faster. Attacking: the enemy's entrenchment and position count 30% less.
support_note.field_hospital: Half the men it loses go back to the pool and new men cost less experience. Attrition −25%.
support_note.military_police: Keeps occupied regions quiet. No effect in battle.
support_note.recon: Initiative +5, picks tactics with the enemy's in view, no ambush lands on it. Attacking: the enemy's position counts 10% less. A narrower forecast on the battle card.
support_note.signal: Initiative +10, reserves enter the line sooner and fight at once, org recovers 10% faster.
support_note.support_anti_air: Anti-air fire. Enemy close air support on this division −20%, the penalty for enemy air superiority −25%.
support_note.support_anti_tank: Anti-tank guns in the division, half as good attacking. Halves the tank fear this division takes.
support_note.support_artillery: A third of a gun battalion in the opening barrage. Attacking: wears the enemy's entrenchment down a level at a time, at most 3 a battle. The loss stays after the battle.

trait_desc.armor_expert: Tank battalions +10% breakthrough, armoured divisions +10% attack. Level 2, needs Panzer Leader.
trait_desc.commando: Assault, marine and airborne divisions +10% attack; raid preparation −25%. Level 2.
trait_desc.deep_thrust: A run through a broken line lasts 6 rounds, not 4. Armoured and motorized divisions use 10% more supply.
trait_desc.fast_infiltration: Foot divisions: speed +10%. Prefers infiltration; initiative +6.
trait_desc.guerrilla_fighter: Supply penalties halved; organisation recovers normally while encircled. Level 2.
trait_desc.hard_pursuit: Armoured and motorized divisions: speed +10%, supply use +10%.
trait_desc.infantry_expert: Infantry divisions: attack and defence +10%. Level 2, needs Infantry Officer.

trait_desc.rearguard: Broken divisions lose 10% of their men, not 15%. Organisation recovery +10%.
trait_desc.reserve_master: Reserves come into the line 15 points more often. Organisation recovery −10%.
trait_desc.set_piece: Readiness cap +10%, but readiness builds 10% slower.
trait_desc.skirmisher: Army intelligence on enemy armies in contact +20 points. Level 1.
trait_desc.trickster: Enemies facing this army lose 10 points of planning bonus. Level 3.
